```javascript
import { createActivity } from './services/activity.js';
import { createBriefing, briefingTick } from './services/briefing.js';
import { createLectures } from './services/lectures.js';
import sharp from 'sharp';
import { writeFileSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createLock } from './security.js';
import { createUpdater } from './updater.js';
import { autoBackup } from './backup.js';
import { createDocs, extractText } from './services/docs.js';
import { createStudy } from './services/study.js';
import { copySelection, pasteText } from './dictation.js';
import { createTimers } from './services/timers.js';
import { MODES, LITE, setLite, isLite } from './models.js';

import { createProviders } from './providers.js';

import { requestApproval } from './approvals.js';
import { BrowserWindow } from 'electron';

/** HTML → PDF bytes with a hidden window (no scripts). */
async function printPdf(html) {
  const win = new BrowserWindow({ show: false, webPreferences: { javascript: false } });
  try {
    await win.loadURL(`data:text/html;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(html)}`);
    return await win.webContents.printToPDF({ pageSize: 'A4', printBackground: true });
  } finally {
    win.destroy();
  }
}

import { webSearch, readPage } from './services/web.js';
import { createSearch } from './services/search.js';

import { createMail } from './services/mail.js';
import { createCalendarFeeds } from './services/calendar-feeds.js';

import { startMcp, MCP_PORT } from './services/mcp.js';
import { dataDir } from './paths.js';
import { createHoldKeys } from './services/holdkeys.js';

const icon = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../assets/icon.png', import.meta.url));

// The app is now called Maya, but Electron's own data (and the single-instance lock) stay in the old Ather
// folder, so updated copies keep everything. Tests with ATHER_DATA get their own folder and lock.
app.setPath('userData', dataDir);
if (!app.requestSingleInstanceLock()) app.quit();
app.setAppUserModelId('com.ather.assistant');

app.whenReady().then(async () => {
  const store = openStore();
  const ml = createMl();
  const secrets = createSecrets(store);
  const quit = () => { app.isQuitting = true; app.quit(); };
  // Tray actions that need services (made below) look them up when clicked.
  const windows = createWindows({ onQuit: quit, onTray: (what) => what === 'prompter' && services.prompter.set(true) });

  const services = {
    web: { search: webSearch, read: readPage },
    search: createSearch({ store, ml }),
    imaging: createImaging({ ml }),
    mail: createMail({ store, secrets }),
    calendarFeeds: createCalendarFeeds({ store }),
    face: { play: (name, message) => { windows.expand(false); windows.toNotch('face:play', { name, message }); } },
    openExternal: (url) => shell.openExternal(url),
    openPath: (path) => shell.openPath(path),
    screen: {
      /** Main screen in DIP (the coordinates the PC helper and UI Automation use). */
      bounds: () => screen.getPrimaryDisplay().bounds,
      /** Screenshot of the main screen as a JPEG data URL, with Maya's own window hidden. */
      async capture() {
        const { size } = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
        const width = Math.min(1600, size.width);
        windows.notch?.setOpacity(0);
        try {
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 120));
          const [source] = await desktopCapturer.getSources({ types: ['screen'], thumbnailSize: { width, height: Math.round((width * size.height) / size.width) } });
          return `data:image/jpeg;base64,${source.thumbnail.toJPEG(80).toString('base64')}`;
        } finally {
          windows.notch?.setOpacity(1);
        }
      },
    },
  };
  services.providers = createProviders({ store, secrets });
  services.trash = (p) => shell.trashItem(p);
  services.mcpClient = createMcpClient({ store, presets: MCP_PRESETS, resolveEnv });
  services.docs = createDocs({ store });
  services.study = createStudy({ store, docs: services.docs });
  services.python = createPython();
  services.pc = createPc({ shell, scale: () => screen.getPrimaryDisplay().scaleFactor, chromeChoice: () => store.getSetting('chromeProfile', null) });
  services.computer = createComputerSession();
  // While Maya controls the PC: a banner in the notch, and Esc takes control back at once.
  services.onComputerStart = (task) => {
    globalShortcut.register('Escape', () => { services.computer.stop('stopped with Esc'); services.onComputerStop(); });
    windows.toNotch('computer', { active: true, task });
  };
  services.onComputerStop = () => { globalShortcut.unregister('Escape'); windows.toNotch('computer', { active: false }); };
  services.activity = createActivity({
    store, pc: services.pc, idleSeconds: () => powerMonitor.getSystemIdleTime(),
    onSample: (sample) => services.computer.noteForeground(sample),
    onDistracted: async (sample, focus) => {
      windows.expand(false);
      windows.toNotch('notify', { title: 'Focus', body: `${sample.label} can wait. Back to ${focus.label} 💪`, kind: 'focus' });
      // Browsers are only minimised (closing would lose every tab); other apps follow the user's setting.
      const action = store.getSetting('focusAction', 'minimize');
      if (action === 'close' && sample.app === sample.label) services.pc.closeApp(sample.process).catch(() => {});
      else if (action !== 'nudge') services.pc.minimizeForeground().catch(() => {});
    },
  });
  services.activity.start();
  services.briefing = createBriefing({ store, services });
  services.lectures = createLectures({ store });
  services.workflows = createWorkflows({
    store,
    tools: () => [...allTools, ...services.mcpClient.tools()],
    // A getter so steps see services added later (and the approval prompt).
    ctx: { store, get services() { return { ...services, confirm: services.workflowConfirm }; } },
    confirm: (req) => services.workflowConfirm(req),
    onChange: (run) => windows.broadcast('workflow:run', run),
  });
  services.workflowConfirm = (req) => { windows.expand(true); return requestApproval(windows.notch.webContents, req); };
  setInterval(() => services.workflows.tick(), 30_000);
  services.qa = createQa({ BrowserWindow });
  services.lastVoice = Date.now(); // updated whenever the user speaks to Maya
  services.clipboard = createClipboardHistory({ clipboard, enabled: () => store.getSetting('clipboardHistory', true) });
  services.clipboard.start();
  // Accessibility (Accessibility page): dwell click, switch scanning, keyboard.
  const a11y = () => ({ dwell: 0, switchKey: 'F9', scanMs: 1200, keyboardLayout: 'en', keyboardSize: 1, ...store.getSetting('a11y', {}) });
  services.keyboard = createKeyboard({ store });
  services.sos = createSos({ store, secrets, onState: (s) => {
    windows.sos(s.state === 'cancelled' || s.state === 'off' ? null : s);
    windows.toNotch('sos', s);
  }, call: (number) => phoneCall({ pc: services.pc, open: (url) => shell.openExternal(url), number }) });
  // Maya from the phone (Telegram): its own conversation, so the chat shows up on the PC too.
  const phoneConversation = () => {
    const id = store.getSetting('phoneConversation');
    if (id && store.get('SELECT id FROM conversations WHERE id = ?', id)) return id;
    const fresh = Number(store.run('INSERT INTO conversations (title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?)', 'From my phone (Telegram)', now(), now()).lastInsertRowid);
    store.setSetting('phoneConversation', fresh);
    return fresh;
  };
  services.telegram = createTelegram({
    store, secrets, onChange: () => windows.broadcast('data:changed'),
    answer: async (text, { confirm }) => {
      const reply = await ask({ text, store, tools: [...allTools, ...services.mcpClient.tools()], services: { ...services, confirm }, conversationId: phoneConversation(), style: 'short' });
      windows.broadcast('data:changed');
      return reply;
    },
  });
  services.telegram.start();
  // Work timer: goodbye, a minute to say "wait", then a normal shutdown (apps can still ask to save).
  // ATHER_NO_SHUTDOWN: the live tests run the whole goodbye without ever switching the PC off.
  services.session = createSession({ store, activity: services.activity,
    power: (a) => (process.env.ATHER_NO_SHUTDOWN ? (console.log(`[test] would ${a} now`), Promise.resolve()) : services.pc.power(a, 0)), onState: (s) => { windows.expand(false); windows.toNotch('session', s); } });
  setInterval(() => services.session.tick().catch(() => {}), 5_000);
  services.voiceControl = createVoiceControl({
    pc: services.pc, overlay: (d) => windows.overlay(d), computer: services.computer, bounds: () => screen.getPrimaryDisplay().bounds,
    keyboard: (on) => windows.keyboard(on ? { layout: a11y().keyboardLayout, size: a11y().keyboardSize } : null),
    sos: services.sos, session: services.session, snippets: () => store.getSetting('snippets', {}), scanMs: () => a11y().scanMs,
    // "Read my document DBMS notes": the best smart-search match that is a document.
    findDoc: async (name) => {
      const hit = (await services.search.query(name)).find((r) => /\.(pdf|docx|txt|md)$/i.test(r.path));
      return hit && { name: basename(hit.path).replace(/\.\w+$/, ''), text: await extractText(hit.path) };
    },
    // While scanning, one key anywhere is the switch (F9 by default); it is released when scanning stops.
    onScan: (on) => {
      const key = a11y().switchKey;
      if (on && !globalShortcut.isRegistered(key)) globalShortcut.register(key, () => services.voiceControl.press().catch(() => {}));
      if (!on && globalShortcut.isRegistered(key)) globalShortcut.unregister(key);
    },
  });
  services.headMouse = {
    set(on) { windows.headMouse(on ? { speed: store.getSetting('headMouseSpeed', 1), dwell: a11y().dwell, blink: a11y().blink } : null); return { on }; },
    get on() { return windows.headMouseOpen; },
  };
  services.complete = (prompt) => complete(prompt);
  // Lite brain: chosen by the user, or on first start when there is no 4 GB graphics card or under 10 GB RAM.
  // start.bat installs only the 2B on Lite laptops. If Maya's own check disagrees (other graphics cards report memory
  // differently), it would ask for a brain that is not there: use the one that is really installed.
  const onlySmallBrain = async () => !(await hasModel(BASE_MODEL).catch(() => true)) && await hasModel(LITE.base).catch(() => false);
  let lite = store.getSetting('liteBrain', null);
  if (lite === null) {
    const gpu = (await systemCheck()).checks.find((c) => c.name === 'Graphics card');
    lite = !gpu?.ok || os.totalmem() < 10e9 || await onlySmallBrain();
    store.setSetting('liteBrain', lite);
  }
  setLite(lite);
  /** Switch Lite on/off; the 2B is downloaded the first time it is needed. */
  services.useLite = async (on) => {
    setLite(on);
    if (!on || await hasModel(LITE.base) || await pullModel(LITE.base).then(() => true, () => false)) await ensureBrainModel(LITE.model, LITE.base);
  };
  // Camera eyes: a webcam photo only when asked; OCR reads printed text from it.
  services.camera = () => windows.cameraFrame();
  services.phoneCall = (number) => phoneCall({ pc: services.pc, open: (url) => shell.openExternal(url), number });
  services.ocr = async (image) => (await ml.call('ocr', image)).text || '';
  services.interpreter = (lang) => { if (lang) windows.expand(false); windows.toNotch('interpreter', lang); };
  services.pasteText = pasteText;
  // "Where is the Save button?": an arrow on screen for a few seconds.
  let pointTimer;
  services.point = (at) => {
    clearTimeout(pointTimer);
    windows.overlay({ kind: 'point', bounds: screen.getPrimaryDisplay().bounds, at });
    pointTimer = setTimeout(() => windows.overlay(null), 6000);
  };
  services.timers = createTimers({
    notify: (title, body, kind) => notify(title, body, kind), // defined further down; timers only fire later
    onChange: (list) => windows.toNotch('timers', list),
  });
  // Esc closes the teleprompter (only while it is open; computer control uses Esc too).
  const closePrompter = () => { windows.prompter(null); if (!services.computer.active) globalShortcut.unregister('Escape'); };
  services.prompter = {
    async set(on, script) {
      if (!on) { closePrompter(); return { on: false }; }
      const text = (script || await clipboard.readText()).trim();
      if (!text) return { error: 'Copy your script first (select it and press Ctrl+C), then say "start teleprompter".' };
      windows.prompter(text);
      if (!globalShortcut.isRegistered('Escape')) globalShortcut.register('Escape', closePrompter);
      return { on: true, words: text.split(/\s+/).length, how: 'It scrolls as you read aloud and waits when you pause. Esc closes it.' };
    },
  };
  services.captions = {
    set(on, { translate = false } = {}) { windows.captions(on ? { translate } : null); return { on, translate }; },
    get on() { return windows.captionsOpen; },
  };
  services.files = createFiles({ outDir: join(app.getPath('documents'), 'Maya'), imaging: services.imaging, printPdf });

  let mcpServer = null;
  let lockRef = null; // set once the PIN lock exists; agents are refused while Maya is locked
  const mcp = {
    url: `http://127.0.0.1:${MCP_PORT}/mcp`,
    set(on) {
      // Agents' risky calls are approved by the user in the notch.
      const confirm = (req) => { windows.expand(true); return requestApproval(windows.notch.webContents, req); };
      if (on && !mcpServer) mcpServer = startMcp({ tools: allTools, ctx: { store, services: { ...services, confirm }, isLocked: () => lockRef?.locked }, onCall: () => windows.broadcast('data:changed') });
      if (!on && mcpServer) { mcpServer.close(); mcpServer = null; }
    },
  };
  mcp.set(store.getSetting('mcpEnabled', false));

  const theme = createTheme({ store, windows });
  const lock = createLock({ store, onChange: (locked) => windows.broadcast('lock:changed', locked) });
  lockRef = lock;
  powerMonitor.on('lock-screen', () => lock.lock());
  setInterval(() => lock.checkIdle(powerMonitor.getSystemIdleTime()), 30_000);
  const updater = createUpdater({
    onStatus: (s) => {
      windows.broadcast('update:status', s);
      if (s.state === 'ready') windows.toNotch('notify', { title: 'Update ready', body: `Maya ${s.available} is downloaded. It installs when you restart Maya.`, kind: 'update' });
    },
  });
  if (app.isPackaged) {
    setTimeout(() => updater.check(), 30_000);
    setInterval(() => updater.check(), 6 * 3600_000);
  }
  try { autoBackup(store, join(app.getPath('documents'), 'Maya', 'Backups')); } catch { /* a failed backup must not stop Maya */ }
  // Settings changed by voice ("make the text bigger") take effect in every window at once.
  services.setSetting = (key, value) => { store.setSetting(key, value); if (key === 'theme') theme.apply(); windows.broadcast('settings:changed', key, value); };
  registerIpc({ store, ml, services, secrets, windows, mcp, theme, lock, updater });

  // Microphone for voice input, and computer sound for lectures/captions; nothing else is granted.
  const allowed = new Set(['media', 'display-capture']);
  session.defaultSession.setPermissionRequestHandler((_, permission, cb) => cb(allowed.has(permission)));
  session.defaultSession.setPermissionCheckHandler((_, permission) => allowed.has(permission));
  // "Computer audio" for online lectures: getDisplayMedia gets the screen plus Windows loopback sound (video is discarded).
  session.defaultSession.setDisplayMediaRequestHandler((_, callback) => {
    desktopCapturer.getSources({ types: ['screen'] }).then(([screenSource]) => callback({ video: screenSource, audio: 'loopback' }));
  });

  windows.create();
  theme.apply();
  services.mcpClient.startAll().then(() => windows.broadcast('data:changed'));

  if (!globalShortcut.register('Control+Space', windows.toggle)) globalShortcut.register('Control+Shift+A', windows.toggle);
  let dictating = false;
  // Hold Right Ctrl = command, hold Right Alt = dictate (Settings can turn it off). The face shows without taking
  // focus, so dictated text lands in the app the user is typing in.
  const ptt = (phase) => (mode) => { if (phase === 'start') windows.expand(false); windows.toNotch('ptt', { mode, phase }); };
  services.holdKeys = createHoldKeys({ onStart: ptt('start'), onEnd: ptt('end'), onCancel: ptt('cancel') });
  if (store.getSetting('holdToTalk', true)) services.holdKeys.start();
  globalShortcut.register('Control+Shift+Space', () => {
    dictating = !dictating;
    windows.toNotch(dictating ? 'dictate:start' : 'dictate:stop');
  });
  // Snip part of the screen and ask about it.
  let snipping = false;
  globalShortcut.register('Control+Shift+S', async () => {
    if (snipping) return;
    snipping = true;
    try {
      const display = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
      const scale = display.scaleFactor;
      windows.notch?.setOpacity(0);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 120));
      const [source] = await desktopCapturer.getSources({ types: ['screen'], thumbnailSize: { width: Math.round(display.size.width * scale), height: Math.round(display.size.height * scale) } });
      windows.notch?.setOpacity(1);
      const shot = source.thumbnail.toPNG();
      const rect = await windows.snip(`data:image/png;base64,${shot.toString('base64')}`);
      if (!rect) return;
      const crop = await sharp(shot).extract({ left: Math.round(rect.x * scale), top: Math.round(rect.y * scale), width: Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * scale)), height: Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height * scale)) }).png().toBuffer();
      windows.expand(true);
      windows.toNotch('attach', `data:image/png;base64,${crop.toString('base64')}`);
    } finally {
      windows.notch?.setOpacity(1);
      snipping = false;
    }
  });

  // Explain / summarise / translate whatever text is selected in any app.
  // Clipboard history: pick something copied earlier and paste it.
  globalShortcut.register('Control+Shift+V', () => {
    windows.expand(true);
    windows.toNotch('clipboard', lock.locked ? [] : services.clipboard.list());
  });
  globalShortcut.register('Control+Alt+C', () => services.captions.set(!services.captions.on));
  globalShortcut.register('Control+Alt+H', () => services.headMouse.set(!services.headMouse.on));

  globalShortcut.register('Control+Shift+E', async () => {
    const text = await copySelection();
    windows.expand(true);
    windows.toNotch('selection', text);
  });

  const notify = (title, body, kind, id) => {
    new Notification({ title, body, icon }).show();
    windows.expand(false);
    windows.toNotch('notify', { title, body, kind, id });
    windows.broadcast('data:changed');
    // Reminders, medicine and classes also reach the phone (Telegram, when paired): the user may be away from the PC.
    if (kind === 'reminder' || kind === 'care') services.telegram.notify(`⏰ ${title}: ${body}`);
  };
  startScheduler(store, notify);
  setInterval(() => careTick(store, (reason) => services.sos.notify(reason)).then((n) => n && windows.broadcast('data:changed')).catch(() => {}), 60_000);
  // The evening "I'm okay" email to caregivers, when switched on (Accessibility page).
  setInterval(() => services.sos.dailyTick({
    summary: () => daySummary(store, services.activity),
    care: () => store.all("SELECT * FROM reminders WHERE deleted = 0 AND care = 1 AND (fired_at >= ? OR at LIKE ?)", new Date(new Date().setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)).toISOString(), `${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA')}%`),
  }).catch(() => {}), 5 * 60_000);
  // Health breaks stay quiet during a focus session; they come after it.
  const health = createHealth({ store, idleSeconds: () => powerMonitor.getSystemIdleTime(), notify,
    quiet: () => !!store.get('SELECT 1 FROM focus_sessions WHERE deleted = 0 AND ended_at IS NULL') });
  setInterval(() => health.tick(), 60_000);
  // The face's eyes follow the mouse (or the head mouse) while the face is open.
  let lastLook = { x: 0, y: 0 };
  setInterval(() => {
    if (!windows.expanded || !windows.notch || windows.notch.isDestroyed()) return;
    const c = screen.getCursorScreenPoint(), b = windows.notch.getBounds();
    const clamp = (v) => Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, Math.round(v * 10) / 10));
    const look = { x: clamp((c.x - (b.x + b.width / 2)) / 500), y: clamp((c.y - (b.y + 70)) / 350) };
    if (look.x !== lastLook.x || look.y !== lastLook.y) { lastLook = look; windows.toNotch('look', look); }
  }, 100);
  // "Are you okay?" check-in: quiet means no keyboard/mouse and nothing said to Maya (voice-only users never type),
  // and, if allowed, nobody seen by the webcam (someone reading quietly is not "inactive").
  let lastSeen = Date.now();
  setInterval(() => services.sos.checkIn(Math.min(powerMonitor.getSystemIdleTime(), (Date.now() - services.lastVoice) / 1000, (Date.now() - lastSeen) / 1000)), 60_000);
  setInterval(async () => {
    const { checkin } = services.sos.settings();
    const hhmm = new Date().toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
    if (!checkin?.on || !checkin.camera || hhmm < checkin.from || hhmm > checkin.to) return;
    const file = join(os.tmpdir(), `maya-presence-${Date.now()}.jpg`);
    try {
      // The photo is only looked at for a face, on this PC, and deleted straight away.
      writeFileSync(file, Buffer.from((await services.camera()).split(',')[1], 'base64'));
      if ((await ml.call('faces', file)).length) lastSeen = Date.now();
    } catch { /* no camera: fall back to keyboard, mouse and voice */ } finally { rmSync(file, { force: true }); }
  }, 10 * 60_000);
  const isAway = () => powerMonitor.getSystemIdleTime() > 300;
  setInterval(() => briefingTick({ store, briefing: services.briefing, notify, isAway }).catch(() => {}), 60_000);
  // Email follow-ups every 30 minutes; the weekly report on Friday evening.
  setInterval(() => checkFollowUps({ store, mail: services.mail, notify }).catch(() => {}), 30 * 60_000);
  setInterval(() => weeklyTick({ store, files: services.files, notify }).catch(() => {}), 10 * 60_000);

  ensureOllama().then(async (up) => {
    if (!up) return;
    if (!isLite() && await onlySmallBrain()) store.setSetting('liteBrain', true);
    await services.useLite(store.getSetting('liteBrain', isLite()));
    await ensureBrainModel(BRAIN_MODEL, BASE_MODEL);
    await ensureBrainModel(MODES.smart.model, MODES.smart.base);
  });
  // First run: open the setup screen until the speech models are on disk.
  if (!Object.keys(hfModels).every(hfInstalled) || !store.getSetting('setupDone', false)) windows.openApp('setup');

  app.on('second-instance', () => windows.openApp('home'));
  app.on('before-quit', () => { app.isQuitting = true; ml.stop(); services.pc.stop(); services.holdKeys?.stop(); services.mcpClient.stopAll(); globalShortcut.unregisterAll(); });
});

// Maya lives in the tray: closing windows does not quit.
app.on('window-all-closed', () => {});
```

### src/main/windows.js

```javascript
import { BrowserWindow, Tray, Menu, screen, nativeImage, app, ipcMain } from 'electron';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = (p) => fileURLToPath(new URL(`../../${p}`, import.meta.url));
const preload = root('src/preload/preload.cjs');
const page = (name) => root(`dist/renderer/${name}.html`);

const NOTCH_W = 480;
const NOTCH_H = 560;
const HOVER_BAND = 4; // px at the very top of the screen that opens the face
const LEAVE_DELAY = 1200;

export function createWindows({ onQuit, onTray }) {
  let notch, appWin, tray;
  let expanded = false;
  let busy = false; // renderer says: typing, thinking, listening or speaking
  let contentHeight = 120;
  let outsideSince = 0;
  let icon = root('assets/icon.png');
  let dark = false;

  const display = () => screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const send = (win, channel, ...args) => win && !win.isDestroyed() && win.webContents.send(channel, ...args);

  function createNotch() {
    const { bounds } = display();
    notch = new BrowserWindow({
      width: NOTCH_W, height: NOTCH_H, x: Math.round(bounds.x + bounds.width / 2 - NOTCH_W / 2), y: bounds.y,
      transparent: true, frame: false, resizable: false, movable: false, skipTaskbar: true, hasShadow: false,
      alwaysOnTop: true, fullscreenable: false, show: false, backgroundColor: '#00000000',
      webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false, backgroundThrottling: false },
    });
    notch.setAlwaysOnTop(true, 'screen-saver');
    notch.setVisibleOnAllWorkspaces(true);
    notch.setIgnoreMouseEvents(true, { forward: true });
    notch.loadFile(page('notch'));
    notch.once('ready-to-show', () => notch.showInactive());
    setInterval(watchPointer, 100);
  }

  function watchPointer() {
    if (!notch || notch.isDestroyed()) return;
    const p = screen.getCursorScreenPoint();
    const b = notch.getBounds();
    const center = b.x + b.width / 2;
    if (!expanded) {
      if (p.y <= display().bounds.y + HOVER_BAND && Math.abs(p.x - center) < 220) expand(false);
      return;
    }
    const inside = p.x >= b.x - 20 && p.x <= b.x + b.width + 20 && p.y <= b.y + contentHeight + 30;
    if (inside || busy || notch.isFocused()) { outsideSince = 0; return; }
    outsideSince ||= Date.now();
    if (Date.now() - outsideSince > LEAVE_DELAY) collapse();
  }

  function expand(focus) {
    expanded = true;
    outsideSince = 0;
    notch.setIgnoreMouseEvents(false);
    if (!notch.isVisible()) notch.showInactive();
    if (focus) { notch.focus(); notch.webContents.focus(); }
    send(notch, 'notch:expand', { focus });
  }

  function collapse() {
    expanded = false;
    notch.setIgnoreMouseEvents(true, { forward: true });
    if (notch.isFocused()) notch.blur();
    send(notch, 'notch:collapse');
  }

  function openApp(section = 'home') {
    if (!appWin || appWin.isDestroyed()) {
      appWin = new BrowserWindow({
        width: 1180, height: 760, minWidth: 900, minHeight: 600, show: false, title: 'Maya', backgroundColor: dark ? '#0b0b0d' : '#f6f4fb',
        icon, autoHideMenuBar: true,
        webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false },
      });
      appWin.loadFile(page('app'), { hash: section });
      appWin.once('ready-to-show', () => appWin.show());
      appWin.on('close', (e) => { if (!app.isQuitting) { e.preventDefault(); appWin.hide(); } });
    } else {
      send(appWin, 'app:section', section);
      appWin.show();
      appWin.focus();
    }
  }

  function createTray() {
    tray = new Tray(nativeImage.createFromPath(icon).resize({ width: 16, height: 16 }));
    tray.setToolTip('Maya');
    tray.setContextMenu(Menu.buildFromTemplate([
      { label: 'Ask Maya   (Ctrl+Space)', click: () => expand(true) },
      { label: 'Open Maya', click: () => openApp('home') },
      { label: 'Teleprompter (copy your script first)', click: () => onTray?.('prompter') },
      { label: 'Settings', click: () => openApp('settings') },
      { type: 'separator' },
      { label: 'Quit', click: onQuit },
    ]));
    tray.on('click', () => openApp('home'));
  }

  /** Fullscreen overlay showing a frozen screenshot; resolves with the dragged rectangle (CSS px) or null. */
  function snip(imageUrl) {
    const { bounds } = display();
    const win = new BrowserWindow({
      ...bounds, frame: false, resizable: false, movable: false, skipTaskbar: true, alwaysOnTop: true, show: false, fullscreenable: false,
      backgroundColor: '#000000', webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false },
    });
    win.setAlwaysOnTop(true, 'screen-saver');
    win.loadFile(page('snip'));
    win.webContents.once('did-finish-load', () => { win.webContents.send('snip:image', imageUrl); win.show(); win.focus(); });
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const done = (_, rect) => { cleanup(); resolve(rect || null); };
      const cleanup = () => { ipcMain.removeListener('snip:done', done); if (!win.isDestroyed()) win.close(); };
      ipcMain.on('snip:done', done);
      win.on('closed', () => { ipcMain.removeListener('snip:done', done); resolve(null); });
    });
  }

  /** Live captions bar at the bottom of the screen; opts null closes it. */
  let captionsWin = null;
  function captions(opts) {
    if (captionsWin && !captionsWin.isDestroyed()) captionsWin.close();
    captionsWin = null;
    if (!opts) return;
    const { workArea } = display();
    const width = Math.min(900, workArea.width - 40), height = 130;
    captionsWin = new BrowserWindow({
      width, height, x: Math.round(workArea.x + (workArea.width - width) / 2), y: workArea.y + workArea.height - height - 24,
      transparent: true, frame: false, resizable: true, skipTaskbar: true, alwaysOnTop: true, focusable: false, hasShadow: false,
      backgroundColor: '#00000000', webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false },
    });
    captionsWin.setAlwaysOnTop(true, 'screen-saver');
    captionsWin.loadFile(page('captions'), { query: { translate: opts.translate ? '1' : '0' } });
    captionsWin.on('closed', () => { captionsWin = null; });
  }

  /** One webcam photo as a JPEG data URL, from a hidden page that closes right after. */
  async function cameraFrame() {
    const win = new BrowserWindow({ show: false, width: 320, height: 240, webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false, backgroundThrottling: false } });
    try {
      await win.loadFile(page('camera'));
      return await win.webContents.executeJavaScript('window.grab()');
    } finally {
      win.destroy();
    }
  }

  /** Teleprompter near the top of the screen (under the webcam, where the eyes should be); script null closes it. */
  let prompterWin = null;
  function prompter(script) {
    if (prompterWin && !prompterWin.isDestroyed()) prompterWin.close();
    prompterWin = null;
    if (script == null) return;
    const { workArea } = display();
    const width = Math.min(1000, workArea.width - 40), height = 300;
    prompterWin = new BrowserWindow({
      width, height, x: Math.round(workArea.x + (workArea.width - width) / 2), y: workArea.y + 70,
      transparent: true, frame: false, resizable: true, skipTaskbar: true, alwaysOnTop: true, focusable: false, hasShadow: false,
      backgroundColor: '#00000000', webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false, backgroundThrottling: false },
    });
    prompterWin.setAlwaysOnTop(true, 'screen-saver');
    prompterWin.loadFile(page('prompter'));
    prompterWin.webContents.once('did-finish-load', () => send(prompterWin, 'prompter:script', script));
    prompterWin.on('closed', () => { prompterWin = null; });
  }

  /** Small camera window in the bottom-right corner for the head mouse; opts null closes it. */
  let headWin = null;
  function headMouse(opts) {
    if (headWin && !headWin.isDestroyed()) headWin.close();
    headWin = null;
    if (!opts) return;
    const { workArea } = display();
    const width = 300, height = 225;
    headWin = new BrowserWindow({
      width, height, x: workArea.x + workArea.width - width - 16, y: workArea.y + workArea.height - height - 16,
      transparent: true, frame: false, resizable: false, skipTaskbar: true, alwaysOnTop: true, focusable: false, hasShadow: false,
      backgroundColor: '#00000000', webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false, backgroundThrottling: false },
    });
    headWin.setAlwaysOnTop(true, 'screen-saver');
    headWin.loadFile(page('headmouse'), { query: { speed: String(opts.speed || 1), dwell: String(opts.dwell || 0), blink: opts.blink ? '1' : '0' } });
    headWin.on('closed', () => { headWin = null; });
  }

  /** On-screen keyboard along the bottom of the screen; it never takes the focus, so keys go to the user's app. */
  let kbWin = null;
  function keyboard(opts) {
    if (kbWin && !kbWin.isDestroyed()) kbWin.close();
    kbWin = null;
    if (!opts) return;
    const { workArea } = display();
    const width = Math.min(1100, workArea.width - 40), height = Math.round(Math.min(360, workArea.height * 0.4) * (opts.size || 1));
    kbWin = new BrowserWindow({
      width, height, x: Math.round(workArea.x + (workArea.width - width) / 2), y: workArea.y + workArea.height - height - 8,
      transparent: true, frame: false, resizable: true, skipTaskbar: true, alwaysOnTop: true, focusable: false, hasShadow: false,
      backgroundColor: '#00000000', webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false },
    });
    kbWin.setAlwaysOnTop(true, 'screen-saver');
    kbWin.loadFile(page('keyboard'), { query: { layout: opts.layout || 'en' } });
    kbWin.on('closed', () => { kbWin = null; });
  }

  /** Full-screen SOS sign with the alarm, for people nearby; data null closes it. */
  let sosWin = null;
  function sos(data) {
    if (!data) { if (sosWin && !sosWin.isDestroyed()) sosWin.close(); sosWin = null; return; }
    if (!sosWin || sosWin.isDestroyed()) {
      sosWin = new BrowserWindow({ ...display().bounds, frame: false, resizable: false, skipTaskbar: false, alwaysOnTop: true, show: false,
        backgroundColor: '#b00020', title: 'Maya SOS', webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false, backgroundThrottling: false } });
      sosWin.setAlwaysOnTop(true, 'screen-saver');
      sosWin.loadFile(page('sos'));
      sosWin.on('closed', () => { sosWin = null; });
    }
    const show = () => { send(sosWin, 'sos', data); sosWin.show(); };
    if (sosWin.webContents.isLoading()) sosWin.webContents.once('did-finish-load', show); else show();
  }

  /** Click-through layer over the main screen with voice-control numbers or the grid; data null hides it. */
  let overlayWin = null;
  // Two things can be on the layer: voice-control numbers/grid, and the dwell-click ring at the cursor.
  let overlayData = null, ringData = null;
  const overlayWindow = () => {
    if (!overlayWin || overlayWin.isDestroyed()) {
      overlayWin = new BrowserWindow({
        ...display().bounds, transparent: true, frame: false, resizable: false, movable: false, skipTaskbar: true, alwaysOnTop: true,
        focusable: false, hasShadow: false, show: false, backgroundColor: '#00000000', webPreferences: { preload, contextIsolation: true, sandbox: false },
      });
      overlayWin.setIgnoreMouseEvents(true);
      overlayWin.setAlwaysOnTop(true, 'screen-saver');
      overlayWin.loadFile(page('overlay'));
      overlayWin.on('closed', () => { overlayWin = null; });
    }
    return overlayWin;
  };
  const paintOverlay = () => {
    if (!overlayData && !ringData) { if (overlayWin && !overlayWin.isDestroyed()) overlayWin.hide(); return; }
    const win = overlayWindow();
    const show = () => { send(win, 'overlay', overlayData); send(win, 'overlay:ring', ringData); win.showInactive(); };
    if (win.webContents.isLoading()) win.webContents.once('did-finish-load', show); else show();
  };
  function overlay(data) { overlayData = data; paintOverlay(); }
  function ring(data) { ringData = data; paintOverlay(); }

  return {
    create() { createNotch(); createTray(); },
    headMouse,
    overlay,
    ring,
    keyboard,
    sos,
    get keyboardOpen() { return !!kbWin; },
    get headMouseOpen() { return !!headWin; },
    snip,
    captions,
    get captionsOpen() { return !!captionsWin; },
    prompter,
    get prompterOpen() { return !!prompterWin; },
    cameraFrame,
    get notch() { return notch; },
    get appWin() { return appWin; },
    toggle: () => (expanded ? collapse() : expand(true)),
    get expanded() { return expanded; },
    /** Switch tray, taskbar and window icons (black face in dark theme). */
    setIcon(path, isDark) {
      icon = path;
      dark = isDark;
      tray?.setImage(nativeImage.createFromPath(path).resize({ width: 16, height: 16 }));
      if (appWin && !appWin.isDestroyed()) { appWin.setIcon(path); appWin.setBackgroundColor(isDark ? '#0b0b0d' : '#f6f4fb'); }
    },
    expand, collapse, openApp,
    setBusy: (b) => { busy = b; },
    setContentHeight: (h) => { contentHeight = Math.min(NOTCH_H, h); },
    toNotch: (channel, ...args) => send(notch, channel, ...args),
    toApp: (channel, ...args) => send(appWin, channel, ...args),
    broadcast: (channel, ...args) => { send(notch, channel, ...args); send(appWin, channel, ...args); },
  };
}
```

```javascript
const on = (channel) => (fn) => {
  const listener = (_, ...args) => fn(...args);
  ipcRenderer.on(channel, listener);
  return () => ipcRenderer.removeListener(channel, listener);
};
```

```javascript
import { ipcMain, dialog, BrowserWindow, shell, app, screen } from 'electron';
import { createBackup, unpackBackup, applyBackup } from './backup.js';
import { writeFileSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { extractText } from './services/docs.js';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { ask, complete, updateSummary, followUps } from './brain.js';
import { requestApproval } from './approvals.js';
import { weather } from './services/briefing.js';
import { PROVIDER_PRESETS } from './providers.js';
import { approvedFolders } from './services/mcp-presets.js';
import { basename } from 'node:path';
import { availableModes, MODES, LITE, isLite } from './models.js';
import { now } from './store.js';
import { allTools } from './tools/index.js';
import { toSendKeys } from './tools/computer.js';
import { speakReply } from './speech.js';
import { allPersonalities, KOKORO_VOICES } from './personality.js';
import { imagesDir } from './paths.js';
import { ensureOllama, hasModel, pullModel, ensureBrainModel } from './ollama.js';
import { BRAIN_MODEL, BASE_MODEL } from './brain.js';
import { ollamaModels, hfModels, fileModels, hfInstalled, fileInstalled, downloadFile } from './ml/catalog.js';
import { systemCheck } from './services/syscheck.js';
import { MAIL_PRESETS } from './services/mail.js';
import { careDone } from './services/scheduler.js';
import { fixHeard, learnWord, wordFixes, saveFeedback, reflect } from './services/learning.js';
import { learnSkill, saveSkill } from './services/skills.js';
import { workToday } from './services/worklog.js';
import { chromeProfiles } from './services/pc.js';
import { finishDictation } from './services/dictate.js';
import { interpretTurn } from './services/interpreter.js';
import { pasteText, pasteClip } from './dictation.js';

export const READ_ONLY_TOOL = /_(query|status|progress|list|files|history)$|^(web_|files_search|mail_(triage|search|read|promotions)|open_)/;

// While locked only these work; settings:get is limited to how things look.
const OPEN_WHEN_LOCKED = new Set(['lock:status', 'lock:unlock', 'settings:get', 'theme:resolved']);
const LOOK_SETTINGS = new Set(['theme', 'faceStyle', 'faceMode', 'motion', 'a11yLarge']);

export function registerIpc({ store, ml, services, secrets, windows, mcp, theme, lock, updater }) {
  const ctx = { store, services };
  const running = new Map(); // ask id -> AbortController
  const changed = () => windows.broadcast('data:changed');
  // The listening language; choosing Tamil fetches the Tamil-trained model once, in the background.
  let fetchingTamil = false;
  const listenLanguage = () => {
    const lang = store.getSetting('listenLanguage', null);
    if (/^(ta|tamil)$/i.test(lang || '') && !fetchingTamil && !fileInstalled('tamilears')) {
      fetchingTamil = true;
      downloadFile('tamilears').catch(() => { fetchingTamil = false; });
    }
    return lang;
  };
  // Handlers get only what the screen sent. The few that need the sender use withEvent and get it first:
  // appended last, it filled any optional argument the screen left out (Test connection sent it as the model name).
  const guarded = (channel, call) => ipcMain.handle(channel, (event, ...args) => {
    if (lock.locked && (!OPEN_WHEN_LOCKED.has(channel) || (channel === 'settings:get' && !LOOK_SETTINGS.has(args[0])))) {
      throw new Error('Maya is locked. Enter your PIN to unlock.');
    }
    return call(event, args);
  });
  const handle = (channel, fn) => guarded(channel, (_, args) => fn(...args));
  const withEvent = (channel, fn) => guarded(channel, (event, args) => fn(event, ...args));

  handle('theme:resolved', () => theme.resolved());

  // ---------- PIN lock ----------
  handle('lock:status', () => ({ enabled: lock.enabled(), locked: lock.locked }));
  handle('lock:unlock', (pin) => lock.unlock(pin));
  handle('lock:now', () => lock.lock());
  handle('lock:set', (currentPin, newPin) => lock.setPin(currentPin, newPin));

  // ---------- backup / restore ----------
  let pendingRestore = null;
  withEvent('backup:create', async (event) => {
    const dir = (await dialog.showOpenDialog(BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender), { title: 'Choose where to save the backup', defaultPath: join(app.getPath('documents'), 'Maya'), properties: ['openDirectory', 'createDirectory'] })).filePaths[0];
    return dir ? createBackup(store, dir) : null;
  });
  /** Step 1: pick and check a backup file. The renderer then asks the user to confirm. */
  withEvent('backup:choose', async (event) => {
    const zip = (await dialog.showOpenDialog(BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender), { filters: [{ name: 'Maya backup', extensions: ['zip'] }], properties: ['openFile'] })).filePaths[0];
    if (!zip) return null;
    pendingRestore = unpackBackup(zip);
    return { file: basename(zip) };
  });
  /** Step 2: replace the data with the checked backup and restart. */
  handle('backup:apply', () => {
    if (!pendingRestore) throw new Error('Choose a backup first.');
    store.db.close();
    applyBackup(pendingRestore);
    app.relaunch();
    app.exit(0);
  });

  // ---------- updates ----------
  handle('update:status', () => updater.status());
  handle('update:check', () => updater.check());
  handle('update:install', () => updater.install());

  // ---------- chat ----------
  const newConversation = (title = 'New chat') =>
    Number(store.run('INSERT INTO conversations (title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?)', title, now(), now()).lastInsertRowid);
  // The notch keeps one running conversation so "open in chat" can continue it.
  const notchConversation = () => {
    const id = store.getSetting('notchConversation');
    if (id && store.get('SELECT id FROM conversations WHERE id = ?', id)) return id;
    const fresh = newConversation('Quick questions');
    store.setSetting('notchConversation', fresh);
    return fresh;
  };

  async function autoTitle(conversationId, question) {
    const conv = store.get('SELECT title FROM conversations WHERE id = ?', conversationId);
    if (conv?.title !== 'New chat') return;
    const title = (await complete(`Give a 2 to 5 word title for a chat that starts with: "${question.slice(0, 300)}". Reply with the title only, no quotes.`))
      .replace(/["*#\n]/g, '').trim().slice(0, 60);
    if (title) { store.run('UPDATE conversations SET title = ? WHERE id = ?', title, conversationId); changed(); }
  }

  withEvent('ask', async (event, { id, text, images = [], conversationId, style = 'short', mode = 'auto' }) => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    running.set(id, controller);
    const conv = conversationId || notchConversation();
    // Save attached pictures so tools (e.g. images_blur) can work on them by path.
    const paths = images.map((url, i) => {
      const file = join(imagesDir, `attached-${Date.now()}-${i}.png`);
      writeFileSync(file, Buffer.from(url.split(',')[1], 'base64'));
      return file;
    });
    const fullText = paths.length ? `${text}\n(Attached image saved at: ${paths.join(', ')})` : text;
    try {
      const answer = await ask({
        text: fullText, images, store, tools: [...allTools, ...services.mcpClient.tools()], signal: controller.signal, conversationId: conv, style, mode,
        services: { ...services, confirm: (req) => requestApproval(event.sender, { ...req, askId: id }, controller.signal) },
        onEvent: (e) => { if (!event.sender.isDestroyed()) event.sender.send('ask:event', { id, ...e }); if (e.type === 'tool' && !READ_ONLY_TOOL.test(e.name)) changed(); },
      });
      changed();
      autoTitle(conv, text).catch(() => {});
      updateSummary(store, conv).catch(() => {});
      // Think back on what the user said and keep the lasting facts (local model, in the background).
      reflect(store, text, answer, (p, o) => complete(p, o)).then((kept) => kept.length && changed()).catch(() => {});
      // A job that worked and no skill covered becomes a skill offer; it is kept only if the user says yes.
      const done = store.get("SELECT tools FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ? AND role = 'assistant' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", conv);
      learnSkill(store, text, JSON.parse(done?.tools || '[]'), (p, o) => complete(p, o))
        .then(async (skill) => { if (skill && await requestApproval(event.sender, { name: 'skills_learn', args: skill })) { saveSkill(store, skill); changed(); } })
        .catch(() => {});
      return answer;
    } finally {
      running.delete(id);
    }
  });
  handle('ask:cancel', (id) => running.get(id)?.abort());
  handle('chat:modes', availableModes);

  // ---------- MCP servers Maya connects to ----------
  const mcpc = services.mcpClient;
  handle('mcp:servers', () => mcpc.configs());
  handle('files:approved', () => approvedFolders(store));
  handle('computer:log', () => services.computer.log());
  handle('timetable:import', async (path) => {
    const image = /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|bmp)$/i.test(path);
    const text = image ? '' : (await extractText(path)).slice(0, 12000);
    const prompt = 'Read this class timetable and list every weekly class. Days are full lowercase English weekday names; times are 24-hour HH:MM.\n'
      + 'Reply as JSON {"classes": [{"day": "monday", "start": "09:00", "end": "09:50", "subject": "DBMS", "room": "A-204 or empty"}]}.'
      + (text ? `\n\nTimetable:\n${text}` : '');
    const out = await complete(prompt, { format: 'json', images: image ? [readFileSync(path).toString('base64')] : undefined });
    // Empty cells ("-", free periods) are not classes.
    return (JSON.parse(out).classes || []).filter((c) => c.subject?.trim() && !/^[-–—]+$|^free$/i.test(c.subject.trim()));
  });
  // Emergencies must work even while Maya is PIN-locked: these skip the lock check on purpose.
  ipcMain.handle('voice:command', (_, c) => {
    if (lock.locked && !['sos', 'cancel', 'later'].includes(c?.cmd)) throw new Error('Maya is locked. Enter your PIN to unlock.');
    services.lastVoice = Date.now();
    return services.voiceControl.run(c);
  });
  ipcMain.handle('sos:trigger', (_, reason) => services.sos.trigger(reason || 'pressed the help button'));
  ipcMain.handle('sos:cancel', () => services.sos.cancel());
  ipcMain.handle('sos:stop', () => services.sos.stopAlarm());
  // The shutdown warning can be stopped while locked too: nobody should lose their work to a timer.
  ipcMain.handle('session:extend', () => services.session.extend(15));
  ipcMain.handle('session:cancel', () => services.session.cancel());
  ipcMain.handle('care:done', (_, id) => { careDone(store, Number(id)); changed(); return true; });
  handle('sos:test', () => services.sos.test());
  handle('sos:testCall', () => services.sos.testCall());
  handle('sos:log', () => store.getSetting('sosLog', []));
  // Telegram (Connections page): the token never comes back to the screen, only the status.
  handle('telegram:status', () => services.telegram.status());
  handle('telegram:setToken', async (token) => { const s = await services.telegram.setToken(token); services.telegram.start(); return s; });
  handle('telegram:forget', () => { services.telegram.forget(); return services.telegram.status(); });
  ipcMain.on('voice:heard', () => { services.lastVoice = Date.now(); });
  handle('headmouse:set', (on) => services.headMouse.set(on));
  handle('headmouse:model', async () => readFileSync(await downloadFile('facemesh')));
  // While switch scanning, a mouth-open "click" is the switch instead.
  handle('headmouse:click', (button) => (services.voiceControl.mode === 'scan' && button !== 'right'
    ? services.voiceControl.press() : services.pc.clickHere(button === 'right' ? 'right' : 'left')));
  ipcMain.on('headmouse:dwell', (_, progress) => windows.ring(progress > 0 ? { progress, at: screen.getCursorScreenPoint(), bounds: screen.getPrimaryDisplay().bounds } : null));
  // ---- on-screen keyboard: keys go to the app with the focus (the keyboard window never takes it) ----
  handle('keyboard:key', async (k) => {
    if (k.text) await services.pc.type(k.text);
    else if (k.keys) await services.pc.keys(toSendKeys(k.keys));
    return true;
  });
  handle('keyboard:suggest', (prefix) => services.keyboard.suggest(prefix));
  handle('keyboard:learn', (word) => services.keyboard.learn(word));
  handle('keyboard:set', (on) => { services.voiceControl.run({ cmd: 'keyboard', on }); return on; });
  // Cursor moves arrive many times a second: plain messages, no reply. x, y are 0..1 of the main screen.
  ipcMain.on('headmouse:move', (_, x, y) => {
    const { bounds } = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
    // Scaled (DIP) coordinates, like Electron's; the PC helper converts them to real pixels.
    services.pc.move(bounds.x + Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x)) * (bounds.width - 1), bounds.y + Math.min(1, Math.max(0, y)) * (bounds.height - 1));
  });
  handle('system:status', async (apps) => (await import('./services/sysmon.js')).systemStatus({ apps }));
  handle('prompter:set', (on, script) => services.prompter.set(on, script));
  // The 9B translates much more faithfully (tested round trip English → Tamil → English); the 4B is the fallback.
  handle('interpret:turn', (audio, lang) => interpretTurn(audio, lang, { ml, complete: (p) => complete(p, { model: 'ather-smart' }).catch(() => complete(p)) }));
  handle('clipboard:paste', async (text) => { windows.collapse(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 120)); await pasteClip(text); return true; });
  handle('clipboard:clear', () => services.clipboard.clear());
  handle('captions:set', (on, opts) => services.captions.set(on, opts));
  handle('captions:transcribe', (audio, translate) => ml.call('transcribe', audio, translate ? null : listenLanguage(), translate ? 'translate' : 'transcribe'));
  handle('workflows:tools', () => allTools.filter((t) => !t.name.startsWith('routines_')).map(({ name, description }) => ({ name, description })));
  handle('workflows:runs', () => services.workflows.runs());
  handle('workflows:control', (id, action) => {
    if (!['pause', 'resume', 'cancel', 'retry'].includes(action)) throw new Error(`Unknown action ${action}`);
    services.workflows[action](id).done?.catch(() => {});
    return true;
  });
  handle('workflows:start', (name) => { services.workflows.start(name).done.catch(() => {}); return true; });
  handle('workflows:draft', async (text) => {
    const tools = allTools.filter((t) => !t.name.startsWith('routines_'))
      .map((t) => `${t.name}(${Object.keys(t.parameters?.properties || {}).join(', ')}): ${t.description.split('. ')[0]}`).join('\n');
    const out = await complete(`Turn this request into an automation workflow for a desktop assistant. Use ONLY these tools, with their argument names:\n${tools}\n\nRequest: ${text}\n\nReply as JSON {"name": short lowercase name, "steps": [{"tool": tool name, "args": {...}}]}: one step per action, in order.`, { model: 'ather-smart', format: 'json' });
    const draft = JSON.parse(out);
    draft.steps = (draft.steps || []).filter((s) => allTools.some((t) => t.name === s.tool && !t.name.startsWith('routines_')));
    return draft;
  });
  withEvent('memory:export', async (event) => {
    const file = (await dialog.showSaveDialog(BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender), { defaultPath: join(app.getPath('documents'), 'ather-memories.json'), filters: [{ name: 'JSON', extensions: ['json'] }] })).filePath;
    if (!file) return null;
    writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(store.all('SELECT fact, category, created_at, updated_at FROM memories WHERE deleted = 0'), null, 2));
    return file;
  });
  handle('computer:stop', () => { services.computer.stop('stopped by you'); services.onComputerStop(); });
  handle('mcp:save', async (id, patch) => {
    mcpc.save(id, patch);
    if (patch.enabled === false) await mcpc.disconnect(id);
    changed();
    return mcpc.configs().find((c) => c.id === id);
  });
  handle('mcp:connect', async (id) => { mcpc.save(id, { enabled: true }); const s = await mcpc.connect(id); changed(); return s; });
  handle('mcp:disconnect', async (id) => { await mcpc.disconnect(id); changed(); });
  handle('mcp:remove', async (id) => { await mcpc.remove(id); changed(); });
  /** "Try a tool" on the MCP page: really runs it, so working tools are verified, not assumed. */
  handle('mcp:call', (id, name, args) => mcpc.call(id, name, args || {}));

  // ---------- model providers (Ollama, LM Studio, cloud) ----------
  const providers = services.providers;
  handle('providers:list', () => providers.list());
  handle('providers:presets', () => PROVIDER_PRESETS);
  handle('providers:save', (id, patch, apiKey) => providers.save(id, patch, apiKey));
  handle('providers:remove', (id) => providers.remove(id));
  handle('providers:test', (id, model) => providers.test(id, model));
  handle('providers:usage', () => providers.usageSummary());
  let modelCache = { at: 0, items: [] };
  /** Every model the chat menu can offer: all local Ollama models plus enabled providers' models. */
  handle('providers:chatModels', async (refresh) => {
    if (!refresh && Date.now() - modelCache.at < 5 * 60_000) return modelCache.items;
    const items = [];
    for (const p of providers.list().filter((x) => x.enabled)) {
      try {
        for (const m of await providers.models(p.id)) {
          if (/embed/i.test(m) || /^ather-/.test(m)) continue;
          items.push({ value: `p:${p.id}:${m}`, label: `${m} · ${p.name}${p.local ? '' : ' ☁'}`, local: p.local });
        }
      } catch { /* provider offline: skip it; the Models page shows the error */ }
    }
    modelCache = { at: Date.now(), items };
    return items;
  });
  handle('chat:followups', (question, answer) => followUps(question, answer).catch(() => []));
  handle('chat:notchConversation', notchConversation);
  handle('chat:conversations', () => store.all('SELECT * FROM conversations ORDER BY updated_at DESC'));
  handle('chat:new', () => newConversation());
  handle('chat:rename', (cid, title) => { store.run('UPDATE conversations SET title = ? WHERE id = ?', title.slice(0, 80), cid); changed(); });
  handle('chat:delete', (cid) => {
    store.run('DELETE FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ?', cid);
    for (const d of services.docs.list(cid)) services.docs.remove(d.id);
    store.run('DELETE FROM conversations WHERE id = ?', cid);
    changed();
  });
  handle('chat:messages', (cid) => store.all('SELECT * FROM messages WHERE conversation_id IS ? ORDER BY id', cid));
  /** Remove the last question + answer so the renderer can ask it again; returns the question. */
  handle('chat:regenerate', (cid) => {
    const last = store.all('SELECT * FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 2', cid);
    const question = last.find((m) => m.role === 'user');
    if (!question) return null;
    for (const m of last) store.run('DELETE FROM messages WHERE id = ?', m.id);
    changed();
    return question.content.replace(/\n\(Attached image saved at:[^)]*\)/, '');
  });
  handle('chat:clear', () => { store.run('DELETE FROM messages'); store.run('DELETE FROM conversations'); changed(); });

  // ---------- documents attached to a conversation ----------
  handle('docs:add', async (cid, path) => {
    // Spreadsheets also go to the Python work folder so the code interpreter can open them by name.
    if (/\.(csv|xlsx|xls)$/i.test(path)) services.python.addFile(cid, path);
    const name = basename(path);
    const d = /\.xlsx?$/i.test(path)
      ? await services.docs.addText(cid, name, `Spreadsheet "${name}" is in the Python working folder. To answer questions about it, use python_run with pandas.read_excel("${name}").`, path)
      : await services.docs.add(cid, path);
    changed();
    return d;
  });
  handle('docs:list', (cid) => services.docs.list(cid));
  handle('docs:remove', (docId) => { services.docs.remove(docId); changed(); });

  // ---------- lectures ----------
  handle('lecture:start', (title, source) => services.lectures.start(title, source));
  handle('lecture:append', (id, text) => services.lectures.append(id, text));
  handle('lecture:finish', async (id, minutes) => { const l = await services.lectures.finish(id, minutes); changed(); return l; });
  handle('lecture:list', () => services.lectures.list());
  handle('lecture:get', (id) => services.lectures.get(id));
  handle('lecture:delete', (id) => { services.lectures.remove(id); changed(); });
  handle('lecture:study', async (id, kind) => {
    const l = services.lectures.get(id);
    const set = await services.study.create({ kind, topic: l.title, text: `${l.notes || ''}\n\n${l.transcript}` });
    changed();
    return set;
  });
  /** Opens a chat with the lecture transcript attached, so the user can ask questions about it. */
  handle('lecture:chat', async (id) => {
    const l = services.lectures.get(id);
    const cid = newConversation(`About: ${l.title}`.slice(0, 60));
    await services.docs.addText(cid, `${l.title} (transcript)`, l.transcript);
    changed();
    return cid;
  });

  // ---------- study ----------
  handle('study:create', async (args) => { const s = await services.study.create(args); changed(); return s; });
  handle('study:list', () => services.study.list());
  handle('study:get', (sid) => services.study.get(sid));
  handle('study:attempt', (sid, score, total) => { services.study.attempt(sid, score, total); changed(); });
  handle('study:delete', (sid) => { store.update('study_sets', sid, { deleted: 1 }, 'Deleted study set'); changed(); });

  // ---------- voice ----------
  handle('speak', (text) => speakReply(text, { ml, store, providers: services.providers }));
  handle('transcribe', async (audio) => fixHeard(store, await ml.call('transcribe', audio, listenLanguage())));
  // Learning: the user fixed what Maya heard before sending it; 👍 / 👎 on an answer.
  handle('learn:edited', (heard, sent) => wordFixes(heard, sent).map(([h, m]) => learnWord(store, h, m)));
  handle('feedback', (f) => saveFeedback(store, f || {}));
  handle('work:today', () => workToday(store, 150));
  handle('chrome:profiles', () => chromeProfiles());
  // Nod / shake in the head mouse answers the oldest open approval card (in the face window or the app).
  handle('headmouse:gesture', (g) => { windows.broadcast('approval:gesture', g === 'yes'); return true; });
  handle('transcribe:quick', (audio) => ml.call('transcribeQuick', audio));
  handle('dictation:result', async (audio) => {
    const heard = fixHeard(store, await ml.call('transcribe', audio, listenLanguage()));
    const text = await finishDictation(heard, store.getSetting('dictationStyle', 'clean'), (p) => complete(p));
    if (text) await pasteText(text);
    return text;
  });

  // ---------- tools for the app screens (same handlers the AI uses) ----------
  withEvent('tool', async (event, name, args = {}) => {
    const tool = [...allTools, ...services.mcpClient.tools()].find((t) => t.name === name);
    if (!tool) throw new Error(`Unknown tool ${name}`);
    const confirm = (req) => requestApproval(event.sender, req);
    if (tool.confirm && !(await confirm({ name, args }))) return { denied: true };
    const result = await tool.run(args, { ...ctx, services: { ...services, confirm } });
    // Only changes are announced: screens reload on "data:changed", so announcing reads would loop forever.
    if (!READ_ONLY_TOOL.test(name)) changed();
    return result;
  });

  // ---------- settings ----------
  handle('settings:get', (key, fallback) => (key.startsWith('secret:') ? null : store.getSetting(key, fallback)));
  handle('settings:set', (key, value) => {
    if (key.startsWith('secret:')) throw new Error('Use secret:set');
    store.setSetting(key, value);
    if (key === 'calendarFeeds') services.calendarFeeds.refresh();
    if (key === 'mcpEnabled') mcp.set(value);
    if (key === 'theme') theme.apply();
    if (key === 'liteBrain') services.useLite?.(!!value).catch(() => {});
    if (key === 'holdToTalk') (value ? services.holdKeys?.start() : services.holdKeys?.stop());
    if (key === 'startWithWindows' && app.isPackaged) app.setLoginItemSettings({ openAtLogin: !!value });
    windows.broadcast('settings:changed', key, value);
  });
  handle('secret:set', (name, value) => secrets.set(name, value));
  handle('secret:has', (name) => secrets.has(name));
  handle('personalities', () => Object.entries(allPersonalities(store.getSetting('customPersonalities', [])))
    .map(([id, p]) => ({ id, label: p.label, voice: p.voice, custom: !!p.custom })));
  handle('voices', () => KOKORO_VOICES);
  handle('weather', (city) => weather(city));
  handle('speak:test', (text, voice) => ml.call('speak', text, voice));
  handle('mail:presets', () => MAIL_PRESETS);
  handle('mcp:status', () => ({ enabled: !!store.getSetting('mcpEnabled', false), url: mcp.url }));

  // ---------- models ----------
  async function modelStatus() {
    const up = await ensureOllama();
    const list = [];
    // Only what this laptop can run: Lite laptops get the 2B instead of the 4B; the 9B needs a 6 GB card and 14 GB RAM.
    const { vramGB, ramGB } = await systemCheck();
    const lite = isLite();
    const skip = { brain: lite, lite: !lite, smart: lite || vramGB < 6 || ramGB < 14 };
    if (up) {
      await ensureBrainModel(BRAIN_MODEL, BASE_MODEL);
      await ensureBrainModel(MODES.smart.model, MODES.smart.base);
      if (lite) await ensureBrainModel(LITE.model, LITE.base);
    }
    for (const [key, m] of Object.entries(ollamaModels).filter(([k]) => !skip[k])) {
      const name = key === 'brain' ? BRAIN_MODEL : key === 'smart' ? MODES.smart.model : key === 'lite' ? LITE.model : m.name;
      list.push({ key, label: m.label, sizeMB: m.sizeMB, kind: 'ollama', installed: up && await hasModel(name) });
    }
    for (const [key, m] of Object.entries(hfModels)) list.push({ key, label: m.label, sizeMB: m.sizeMB, kind: 'hf', installed: hfInstalled(key) });
    for (const [key, m] of Object.entries(fileModels).filter(([, f]) => !f.optional && !(vramGB < (f.minVramGB || 0)))) list.push({ key, label: m.label, sizeMB: m.sizeMB, kind: 'file', installed: fileInstalled(key) });
    return { ollama: up, models: list };
  }
  handle('models:status', modelStatus);
  handle('models:download', async () => {
    const { ollama, models } = await modelStatus();
    if (!ollama) throw new Error('Ollama is not running. Install it from ollama.com, then press Download again.');
    for (const m of models.filter((x) => !x.installed)) {
      const progress = (p) => windows.broadcast('models:progress', { key: m.key, progress: p });
      if (m.kind === 'ollama') await pullModel(ollamaModels[m.key].name, progress);
      if (m.key === 'lite') await ensureBrainModel(LITE.model, LITE.base);
      if (m.kind === 'file') await downloadFile(m.key, progress);
      if (m.kind === 'hf') await ml.warm(m.key, (e) => e?.status === 'progress' && progress(e.progress / 100));
      windows.broadcast('models:progress', { key: m.key, progress: 1, done: true });
    }
    // OCR data comes with the "file" models; load it so the first blur is quick.
    await ml.warm('ocr');
    return modelStatus();
  });
  handle('syscheck', systemCheck);

  // ---------- search ----------
  handle('search:index', (folders) => services.search.index(folders, (done, total) => windows.broadcast('search:progress', { done, total })));
  handle('search:stats', () => services.search.stats());

  // ---------- files, dialogs, windows ----------
  withEvent('dialog:folder', async (event) => (await dialog.showOpenDialog(BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender), { properties: ['openDirectory'] })).filePaths[0] || null);
  withEvent('dialog:document', async (event) => (await dialog.showOpenDialog(BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender), {
    properties: ['openFile'], filters: [{ name: 'Documents', extensions: ['pdf', 'docx', 'txt', 'md', 'csv', 'xlsx', 'xls', 'json', 'html', 'py', 'java', 'js', 'c', 'cpp', 'sql'] }],
  })).filePaths[0] || null);
  withEvent('dialog:image', async (event) => (await dialog.showOpenDialog(BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender), {
    properties: ['openFile'], filters: [{ name: 'Images', extensions: ['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'webp', 'bmp'] }],
  })).filePaths[0] || null);
  handle('open:app', (section) => windows.openApp(section));
  handle('open:path', (path) => shell.openPath(path));
  handle('open:folder', (path) => shell.showItemInFolder(path));
  handle('open:external', (url) => { if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) return shell.openExternal(url); });

  // ---------- notch window state ----------
  ipcMain.on('notch:busy', (_, busy) => windows.setBusy(busy));
  ipcMain.on('notch:height', (_, h) => windows.setContentHeight(h));
  ipcMain.on('notch:collapse', () => windows.collapse());
}
```

### src/main/speech.js

```javascript
// Speaking replies: Kokoro for Latin-script text, Windows voices for other alphabets.
import { allPersonalities } from './personality.js';
import { scriptLanguage, sapiSpeak } from './services/sapi.js';
import { downloadFile } from './ml/catalog.js';

/** Remove markdown, links and emoji that sound odd when read aloud. */
export const speakable = (text) => text
  .replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, ' ')
  .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/g, '$1')
  .replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/g, 'the link')
  .replace(/[*_#>`~|]/g, '')
  .replace(/\p{Extended_Pictographic}/gu, '')
  .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
  .trim();

export const OPENAI_VOICES = ['nova', 'alloy', 'shimmer', 'coral', 'sage', 'echo', 'onyx', 'fable', 'ash', 'ballad'];

/**
 * OpenAI's voices (the ones ChatGPT uses) with the user's own key, from AI models. Paid per use; the text goes
 * to OpenAI. Raw 24 kHz 16-bit audio becomes samples the player understands.
 */
export async function openaiSpeak(text, { providers, voice = 'nova', speed = 1 }) {
  const p = providers?.list().find((x) => x.preset === 'openai' && x.hasKey);
  if (!p) throw new Error('Add your OpenAI key in AI models to use the OpenAI voices.');
  const res = await providers.request(p, '/audio/speech', { model: 'gpt-4o-mini-tts', voice: OPENAI_VOICES.includes(voice) ? voice : 'nova', input: text.slice(0, 4000), response_format: 'pcm', speed });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`OpenAI voice: ${res.status} ${(await res.text()).slice(0, 150)}`);
  const pcm = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  const samples = new Float32Array(pcm.length >> 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) samples[i] = pcm.readInt16LE(i * 2) / 32768;
  return { samples, sampleRate: 24000 };
}

export async function speakReply(text, { ml, store, providers }) {
  const clean = speakable(text);
  if (!clean) return null;
  const agent = store.getSetting('agent', {});
  if (store.getSetting('voiceEngine', 'local') === 'openai') {
    // Offline or a bad key: the free voices on this PC answer instead.
    try { return await openaiSpeak(clean, { providers, voice: agent.openaiVoice, speed: agent.speed || 1 }); } catch { /* fall back */ }
  }
  const lang = scriptLanguage(clean);
  if (lang === 'ta') {
    // Natural offline Tamil voice; the Windows route only works if a Tamil voice pack is installed.
    try { await downloadFile('tamilvoice'); return await ml.call('speakTamil', clean); } catch { /* no internet for the first download */ }
  }
  if (lang) return sapiSpeak(clean, lang);
  const voice = agent.voice || allPersonalities(store.getSetting('customPersonalities', []))[store.getSetting('personality', 'normal')]?.voice || 'af_heart';
  return ml.call('speak', clean, voice, agent.speed || 1);
}
```

```javascript
// "Type with your voice": transcribed text is pasted into whatever app has focus.
// Electron 45's clipboard is async: every read and write is awaited.
import { clipboard } from 'electron';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';

const sendKeys = (keys) => new Promise((resolve) => execFile('powershell.exe',
  ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', `(New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell).SendKeys('${keys}')`], { windowsHide: true }, () => resolve()));

/** Text currently selected in whatever app has focus (copied with Ctrl+C, clipboard restored after). */
export async function copySelection() {
  const previous = await clipboard.readText();
  await clipboard.writeText('');
  await sendKeys('^c');
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250));
  const selected = await clipboard.readText();
  await clipboard.writeText(previous);
  return selected.trim();
}

/** Put text on the clipboard and paste it into the app with focus (the text stays on the clipboard). */
export async function pasteClip(text) {
  await clipboard.writeText(text);
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150));
  await sendKeys('^v');
}

export async function pasteText(text) {
  const previous = await clipboard.readText();
  await clipboard.writeText(text);
  await sendKeys('^v');
  // Put the user's clipboard back once the paste has landed.
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
  await clipboard.writeText(previous);
}
```

### src/main/services/sapi.js

```javascript
// Offline Windows voices (System.Speech) for languages Kokoro cannot speak, e.g. Hindi, Russian, Chinese.
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFileSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';

const run = promisify(execFile);

/** Guess a language from the alphabet used; null means Latin text (Kokoro handles it). */
export function scriptLanguage(text) {
  const checks = [[/[ऀ-ॿ]/, 'hi'], [/[ঀ-৿]/, 'bn'], [/[஀-௿]/, 'ta'], [/[ఀ-౿]/, 'te'],
    [/[Ѐ-ӿ]/, 'ru'], [/[぀-ヿ]/, 'ja'], [/[가-힯]/, 'ko'], [/[一-鿿]/, 'zh'], [/[؀-ۿ]/, 'ar']];
  return checks.find(([re]) => re.test(text))?.[1] ?? null;
}

const SCRIPT = `
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$s = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer
$v = $s.GetInstalledVoices() | Where-Object { $_.Enabled -and $_.VoiceInfo.Culture.TwoLetterISOLanguageName -eq $env:ATHER_LANG } | Select-Object -First 1
if ($v) { $s.SelectVoice($v.VoiceInfo.Name) }
$s.SetOutputToWaveFile($env:ATHER_WAV)
$s.Speak($env:ATHER_TEXT)
$s.Dispose()
`;

export async function sapiSpeak(text, lang = 'en') {
  const wav = join(tmpdir(), `ather-say-${Date.now()}.wav`);
  try {
    await run('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', SCRIPT],
      { env: { ...process.env, ATHER_TEXT: text, ATHER_LANG: lang, ATHER_WAV: wav }, windowsHide: true, timeout: 60_000 });
    return readWav(readFileSync(wav));
  } finally {
    rmSync(wav, { force: true });
  }
}

/** 16-bit PCM WAV → mono Float32 samples. */
export function readWav(buf) {
  const channels = buf.readUInt16LE(22), sampleRate = buf.readUInt32LE(24);
  let p = 12;
  while (p < buf.length && buf.toString('ascii', p, p + 4) !== 'data') p += 8 + buf.readUInt32LE(p + 4);
  const start = p + 8, frames = Math.floor(buf.readUInt32LE(p + 4) / 2 / channels);
  const samples = new Float32Array(frames);
  for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) samples[i] = buf.readInt16LE(start + i * 2 * channels) / 32768;
  return { samples, sampleRate };
}
```
