```jsx
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Face from './shared/Face.jsx';
import ToolResult from './shared/ToolResult.jsx';
import Markdown from './shared/Markdown.jsx';
import Approvals, { approvalTitle } from './shared/Approvals.jsx';
import LockScreen, { useLocked } from './shared/LockScreen.jsx';
import { useAsk } from './shared/useAsk.js';
import { startRecording, playSpeech, stopSpeech, chime } from './shared/audio.js';
import { listenOnce, watchForInterrupt, isStopPhrase, matchWake, greeting, nextSentence } from './shared/voice.js';
import { detectEmotion, afterFeeling } from './shared/emotion.js';
import { parseCommand, parseYesNo } from './shared/voicecommands.js';
import { workMood } from './shared/work.js';
import './shared/base.css';
import './notch.css';

const ather = window.ather;
const errText = (e) => e.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');

const SELECTION_ACTIONS = [
  ['Explain', 'Explain this simply'],
  ['Summarise', 'Summarise this in a few bullet points'],
  ['Translate', 'Translate this to English (or to Hindi if it is already English)'],
  ['Fix grammar', 'Fix the grammar and spelling of this, keep the meaning, and give only the corrected text'],
  ['Reply', 'Write a short, polite reply to this message'],
];

/** Five bars that follow the voice level (0..1). */
function Wave({ level }) {
  const shape = [0.55, 0.85, 1, 0.85, 0.55];
  return <div className="wave" aria-hidden>{shape.map((s, i) => <span key={i} style={{ height: `${4 + level * s * 22 * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4)}px` }} />)}</div>;
}

function Notch() {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [images, setImages] = useState([]);
  const [mood, setMood] = useState('idle');
  const [look, setLook] = useState(0);
  const [mouth, setMouth] = useState(0);
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(null); // 'ask' | 'dictate' | null
  const [speaking, setSpeaking] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState(null); // { title, body }
  const [faceMode, setFaceMode] = useState('face');
  const [speakAlways, setSpeakAlways] = useState(false);
  const [transcribing, setTranscribing] = useState(false);
  const [voiceMode, setVoiceMode] = useState(null); // null | 'listening' | 'thinking' | 'speaking'
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState(null);
  const [approvalPending, setApprovalPending] = useState(false);
  const [wakeOn, setWakeOn] = useState(false);
  const [control, setControl] = useState(null); // task text while Maya controls the PC
  const [clips, setClips] = useState(null); // clipboard history picker (Ctrl+Shift+V)
  const locked = useLocked();
  const { turn, send, cancel, reset } = useAsk();
  const turnText = useRef(''); // the answer as it streams, for speaking sentence by sentence
  turnText.current = turn?.text || '';
  const recorder = useRef(null);
  const recMode = useRef(null); // 'ask' | 'dictate' | 'write' while the mic records
  const [timers, setTimers] = useState([]);
  const [, tick] = useState(0); // redraws the timer badge every second
  useEffect(() => ather.onTimers(setTimers), []);
  useEffect(() => { if (!timers.length) return undefined; const t = setInterval(() => tick((n) => n + 1), 1000); return () => clearInterval(t); }, [timers.length]);
  const left = (ends) => { const s = Math.max(0, Math.round((ends - Date.now()) / 1000)); return `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`; };
  const pttHeld = useRef(false); // the Right Ctrl / Right Alt talk key is held down
  const card = useRef(null);
  const inputRef = useRef(null);
  const fileRef = useRef(null);
  const moodTimer = useRef(null);
  const voiceAbort = useRef(null);

  const thinking = !!turn?.thinking || transcribing;
  const busy = thinking || !!recording || speaking || !!voiceMode || !!selection || !!clips || approvalPending || !!input || images.length > 0;

  const flash = (m, ms = 2500) => {
    setMood(m);
    clearTimeout(moodTimer.current);
    moodTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setMood('idle'), ms);
  };

  // ---- window wiring ----
  useEffect(() => {
    ather.getSetting('faceMode', 'face').then(setFaceMode);
    ather.getSetting('speakAlways', false).then(setSpeakAlways);
    ather.getSetting('wakeWord', true).then(setWakeOn);
    const offs = [
      ather.onExpand(({ focus }) => { setExpanded(true); woke(); if (focus) setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 50); }),
      ather.onLook(setLook),
      // Something finished (a workflow, a Builder job): a little celebration.
      ather.onWorkflowRun((run) => { if (run.status === 'completed') flash('celebrate', 2600); }),
      ather.onCollapse(() => setExpanded(false)),
      ather.onSettingsChanged((key, value) => {
        if (key === 'faceMode') setFaceMode(value);
        if (key === 'speakAlways') setSpeakAlways(value);
        if (key === 'wakeWord') setWakeOn(value);
      }),
      ather.onNotify(async ({ title, body, kind, id }) => {
        chime();
        setNotice({ title, body });
        flash('surprised', 1200);
        setTimeout(() => flash('happy', 3000), 1200);
        setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 12000);
        await say(`${title}. ${body}`);
        // Medicine: listen for "done" (a caregiver is emailed if nobody confirms within 15 minutes).
        if (kind !== 'care') return;
        for (let tries = 0; tries < 3; tries++) {
          const audio = await listenOnce(new AbortController().signal, setMicLevel).catch(() => null);
          setMicLevel(0);
          if (!audio) continue;
          const heard = await ather.transcribe(audio).catch(() => '');
          if (parseYesNo(heard) || /\b(done|taken|took it|finished)\b|எடுத்துட்டேன்|முடிஞ்சது|சாப்பிட்டேன்/i.test(heard)) {
            await ather.careDone(id);
            flash('nod', 1200);
            say('Great, noted.');
            return;
          }
        }
      }),
      ather.onFacePlay(({ name, message }) => {
        flash(name, 3500);
        if (message) { setNotice({ title: 'Maya', body: message }); setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 6000); }
      }),
      ather.onDictateStart(() => startMic('dictate')),
      ather.onDictateStop(() => stopMic()),
      ather.onInterpreter((lang) => (lang ? startInterpreter(lang) : stopVoiceMode())),
      // Hold Right Ctrl (command) / Right Alt (dictate); letting go before the mic is ready still stops it.
      ather.onPtt(async ({ mode, phase }) => {
        if (phase === 'start') {
          pttHeld.current = true;
          await startMic(mode === 'command' ? 'ask' : 'dictate');
          if (!pttHeld.current) stopMic();
        } else {
          pttHeld.current = false;
          if (phase === 'end') stopMic(); else discardMic();
        }
      }),
      ather.onComputer(({ active, task }) => setControl(active ? task : null)),
      ather.onAttach((url) => {
        reset();
        setImages([url]);
        setExpanded(true);
        setTimeout(() => inputRef.current?.focus(), 80);
      }),
      ather.onClipboard((items) => { reset(); setSelection(null); setClips(items); }),
      ather.onSelection((text) => {
        reset();
        if (text) setSelection(text);
        else { setNotice({ title: 'Nothing selected', body: 'Select some text in any app, then press Ctrl+Shift+E.' }); setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 5000); }
      }),
    ];
    return () => offs.forEach((off) => off());
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { ather.setBusy(busy); }, [busy]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!card.current) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => ather.setHeight(card.current.getBoundingClientRect().bottom));
    ro.observe(card.current);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [expanded]);
  useEffect(() => { if (thinking) setMood((m) => (m === 'worried' || m === 'sad' || m === 'excited' || m === 'angry' ? m : 'think')); }, [thinking]);
  // A tool is running (adding a task, drawing, searching…): show the working face.
  useEffect(() => { if (turn?.thinking && turn.tools.length) setMood(workMood(turn.tools.at(-1).name)); }, [turn?.tools.length]);
  // Music started: Maya grooves along for a bit.
  useEffect(() => { if (turn && !turn.thinking && turn.tools.some((t) => t.name === 'music_play' && t.result?.playing)) flash('groove', 15000); }, [turn?.thinking]);
  // Finishing something (a task done, a habit kept, a focus session, a commit, a website published) earns confetti.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (turn && !turn.thinking && turn.tools.some((t) => /^(tasks_complete|habits_checkin|focus_stop|routines_run|git_commit|github_publish)$/.test(t.name) && !t.result?.error && !t.result?.denied)) flash('celebrate', 2600);
  }, [turn?.thinking]);

  // ---- asleep after a long quiet time; a stretch on waking ----
  const lastActive = useRef(Date.now());
  function woke() {
    lastActive.current = Date.now();
    setMood((m) => (m === 'sleep' ? 'wake' : m));
    setTimeout(() => setMood((m) => (m === 'wake' ? 'idle' : m)), 1100);
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => setMood((m) => (m === 'idle' && Date.now() - lastActive.current > 10 * 60_000 ? 'sleep' : m)), 30_000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { if (busy) woke(); }, [busy]);

  // Live microphone level for the waveform during push-to-talk.
  const [micLevel, setMicLevel] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!recording) { setMicLevel(0); return; }
    let raf;
    const tick = () => { setMicLevel(Math.min(1, (recorder.current?.level() || 0) * 8)); raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); };
    tick();
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [recording]);

  // ---- speaking ----
  async function say(text, { interruptible = false } = {}) {
    if (!text) return false;
    let interrupted = false;
    let stopWatch = null;
    try {
      const audio = await ather.speak(text);
      if (!audio) return false;
      setSpeaking(true);
      if (interruptible) stopWatch = await watchForInterrupt(() => { interrupted = true; stopSpeech(); });
      await playSpeech(audio, setMouth);
    } catch { /* voice model missing: the answer is still on screen */ } finally {
      stopWatch?.();
      setSpeaking(false);
    }
    return interrupted;
  }

  // ---- asking ----
  async function submit(text, viaVoice = false) {
    const q = text.trim();
    if (!q && !images.length) return null;
    stopSpeech();
    setInput('');
    setSelection(null);
    const pics = images;
    setImages([]);
    // React to how the user feels first (tense when overwhelmed, sad, excited…), then think.
    const feeling = detectEmotion(q);
    if (feeling) setMood(feeling);
    const answer = await send(q || 'What is in this picture?', pics, { style: 'short' });
    if (answer === null) { flash('error'); return null; }
    flash(afterFeeling(feeling), 3500);
    if (viaVoice || speakAlways) say(answer);
    return answer;
  }

  // ---- "Hey Maya": listen in the background while idle, start voice mode on the wake word ----
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!wakeOn || voiceMode || recording || locked) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    (async () => {
      while (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        const audio = await listenOnce(controller.signal).catch(() => null);
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        if (!audio || audio.length > 16000 * 4) continue; // wake phrases are short
        const rest = matchWake(await ather.transcribeQuick(audio).catch(() => ''), (await ather.getSetting('agent', {}))?.name || '');
        if (rest === null) continue;
        controller.abort();
        setExpanded(true);
        woke();
        flash('wake', 1100);
        // Just "Hey Maya": greet like a personal assistant, then listen for the work.
        if (rest.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length < 2) await say(greeting(new Date(), await ather.getSetting('userTitle', 'boss')));
        startVoiceMode(rest.split(/\s+/).length >= 2 ? rest : null);
      }
    })();
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, [wakeOn, voiceMode, recording, locked]);

  // ---- approvals by voice: someone who can only speak cannot click Allow ----
  const wakeRef = useRef(false);
  wakeRef.current = wakeOn;
  useEffect(() => ather.onApprovalRequest(async (r) => {
    if (!voiceAbort.current && !wakeRef.current) return; // typing users click the card
    setMood('ask');
    // An email is read out before "yes": someone who only speaks cannot read the card.
    const body = /^mail_(send|reply)$/.test(r.name) && r.args?.text ? ` It says: ${r.args.text}.` : '';
    await say(`${approvalTitle(r)}${body} Say yes or no.`);
    for (let tries = 0; tries < 3; tries++) {
      const audio = await listenOnce(new AbortController().signal, setMicLevel).catch(() => null);
      setMicLevel(0);
      if (!audio) continue;
      const yes = parseYesNo(await ather.transcribe(audio).catch(() => ''));
      if (yes === null) { await say('Please say yes or no.'); continue; }
      ather.answerApproval(r.id, yes);
      flash(yes ? 'nod' : 'idle', 900);
      return;
    }
  }), []);

  // ---- emergency: the face shows it, and Maya listens for "cancel" even outside voice mode ----
  const sosState = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => ather.onSos(async (s) => {
    sosState.current = s.state;
    if (s.state === 'countdown') {
      setMood('sos');
      setExpanded(true);
      await say(s.reason?.startsWith('did not answer') ? 'Are you okay? Say "I am okay", or I will call for help.' : `Getting help in ${s.seconds} seconds. Say cancel if you are okay.`);
      if (voiceAbort.current) return; // voice mode is already listening and handles "cancel"
      while (sosState.current === 'countdown') {
        const audio = await listenOnce(new AbortController().signal, setMicLevel).catch(() => null);
        setMicLevel(0);
        if (!audio || sosState.current !== 'countdown') continue;
        if (parseCommand(await ather.transcribe(audio).catch(() => ''))?.cmd === 'cancel') await ather.sosCancel();
      }
    } else if (s.state === 'alarm') setMood('sos');
    else if (s.state === 'cancelled') flash('happy', 2500);
    else setMood('idle');
  }), []);

  // ---- work timer over: summary, goodbye, and a minute to say "wait" before the PC shuts down ----
  const [goodbye, setGoodbye] = useState(null);
  const sessionState = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => ather.onSession(async (s) => {
    sessionState.current = s.state;
    if (s.state === 'done') { setExpanded(true); flash('happy', 4000); await say(`Your ${s.task} time is over. ${s.summary} Well done, ${s.title}!`); return; }
    if (s.state !== 'goodbye') { setGoodbye(null); if (s.state === 'off') flash('happy', 1500); return; }
    setGoodbye(s);
    setExpanded(true);
    flash('sleepy', 6000);
    await say(`${s.summary} Bye ${s.title}, have a great day! I will shut down the computer in ${s.seconds} seconds. Say wait if you are still working.`);
    if (voiceAbort.current) return; // voice mode is already listening and handles "wait" / "cancel"
    while (sessionState.current === 'goodbye') {
      const audio = await listenOnce(new AbortController().signal, setMicLevel).catch(() => null);
      setMicLevel(0);
      if (!audio || sessionState.current !== 'goodbye') continue;
      const c = parseCommand(await ather.transcribe(audio).catch(() => ''));
      if (c?.cmd === 'later' || c?.cmd === 'cancel') { const r = await ather.voiceCommand(c).catch(() => null); if (r?.said) say(r.said); }
    }
  }), []);

  // ---- hands-free voice mode ----
  async function startVoiceMode(firstQuestion = null) {
    if (voiceAbort.current) return;
    stopSpeech();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    voiceAbort.current = controller;
    setNotice({ title: 'Voice mode', body: 'Just talk. Say "stop" or press 🎧 to finish.' });
    setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 5000);
    let pending = firstQuestion;
    let lastQuestion = ''; // for "good / bad answer"
    try {
      while (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        let text = pending;
        pending = null;
        if (!text) {
          setVoiceMode('listening');
          setMood('listen');
          const audio = await listenOnce(controller.signal, setMicLevel);
          setMicLevel(0);
          if (controller.signal.aborted) break;
          if (!audio) continue;
          setVoiceMode('thinking');
          setMood('think');
          text = await ather.transcribe(audio);
        }
        if (!text) continue;
        ather.voiceHeard();
        // "show numbers", "click 5", "help", "read the screen", "type …": done at once, no AI needed.
        // Commands come before "stop": while an alarm counts down, "stop" / "cancel" must cancel the alarm.
        const command = parseCommand(text);
        // "Good answer" / "bad answer": a bad one asks what to change, and Maya follows that from now on.
        if (command?.cmd === 'feedback') {
          let note = '';
          if (!command.good) {
            await say('Sorry. What should I do differently?');
            const audio = await listenOnce(controller.signal, setMicLevel).catch(() => null);
            setMicLevel(0);
            note = audio ? await ather.transcribe(audio).catch(() => '') : '';
          }
          await ather.feedback({ question: lastQuestion, good: command.good, note });
          flash(command.good ? 'happy' : 'nod', 1500);
          await say(command.good ? 'Thank you!' : note ? 'Got it, I will remember that.' : 'Okay.');
          continue;
        }
        if (command) {
          const r = await ather.voiceCommand(command).catch((e) => ({ error: errText(e) }));
          if (!r.pass) {
            if (r.error) { flash('error', 1500); await say(r.error); }
            else if (r.read) { setVoiceMode('speaking'); await say(r.read, { interruptible: true }); }
            else { chime(); flash('nod', 900); }
            continue;
          }
        }
        if (isStopPhrase(text)) break;
        setVoiceMode('thinking');
        const feeling = detectEmotion(text);
        setMood(feeling || 'think');
        lastQuestion = text;
        // Talk while thinking (like a person, or NVIDIA PersonaPlex): each finished sentence is spoken as soon as it
        // is written; talking over Maya stops her at once and she listens again.
        let spoken = 0, cutIn = false, done = false;
        const asking = send(text, [], { style: 'short' }).finally(() => { done = true; });
        while (!cutIn && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          const sentence = nextSentence(turnText.current, spoken);
          if (sentence) { spoken = sentence.end; setVoiceMode('speaking'); cutIn = await say(sentence.text, { interruptible: true }); continue; }
          if (done) break;
          await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 120));
        }
        if (cutIn) { cancel(); continue; }
        const answer = await asking;
        if (answer === null || controller.signal.aborted) continue;
        flash(afterFeeling(feeling), 3500);
        const left = answer.length > spoken ? answer.slice(spoken).trim() : '';
        if (left) { setVoiceMode('speaking'); await say(left, { interruptible: true }); }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setNotice({ title: 'Voice mode', body: errText(err) });
    } finally {
      voiceAbort.current = null;
      setVoiceMode(null);
      setMood('idle');
    }
  }
  const stopVoiceMode = () => { voiceAbort.current?.abort(); stopSpeech(); };

  /** Interpreter mode: each sentence heard is said aloud in the other language, until "stop" (or 🎧). */
  async function startInterpreter(lang) {
    if (voiceAbort.current) stopVoiceMode();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    voiceAbort.current = controller;
    setNotice({ title: 'Interpreter', body: 'Each person just talks; I say it in the other language. Say "stop" to end.' });
    try {
      while (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setVoiceMode('listening');
        setMood('listen');
        const audio = await listenOnce(controller.signal, setMicLevel);
        setMicLevel(0);
        if (controller.signal.aborted) break;
        if (!audio) continue;
        setVoiceMode('thinking');
        setMood('think');
        const turn = await ather.interpretTurn(audio, lang);
        if (!turn) continue;
        if (isStopPhrase(turn.heard) || /^\s*(நிறுத்து|बंद करो|रुको)\s*[.!]?\s*$/.test(turn.heard)) break;
        setNotice({ title: turn.to === 'en' ? 'In English' : 'Translated', body: `${turn.heard}\n→ ${turn.said}` });
        setVoiceMode('speaking');
        setMood('happy');
        await say(turn.said);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setNotice({ title: 'Interpreter', body: errText(err) });
    } finally {
      if (voiceAbort.current === controller) voiceAbort.current = null;
      setVoiceMode(null);
      setMood('idle');
    }
  }

  // ---- push-to-talk microphone ----
  async function startMic(mode) {
    if (recorder.current) return;
    stopSpeech();
    try {
      recorder.current = await startRecording();
      recMode.current = mode; // listeners registered once would otherwise read a stale `recording`
      setRecording(mode);
      setMood('listen');
    } catch {
      setNotice({ title: 'Microphone', body: 'Maya could not use the microphone. Check Windows Settings → Privacy → Microphone.' });
    }
  }

  async function stopMic() {
    const rec = recorder.current;
    if (!rec) return;
    recorder.current = null;
    const mode = recMode.current || recording || 'dictate';
    setRecording(null);
    setMood('think');
    const audio = await rec.stop();
    if (audio.length < 16000 * 0.3) { setMood('idle'); return; } // under 0.3 s: nothing said
    setTranscribing(true);
    try {
      if (mode === 'dictate') {
        const typed = await ather.dictationResult(audio);
        setNotice(typed ? { title: 'Typed', body: typed } : { title: 'Dictation', body: 'I did not catch that.' });
        setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 4000);
        flash(typed ? 'happy' : 'sad');
      } else {
        const text = await ather.transcribe(audio);
        setTranscribing(false);
        // The pen: what was said is what to write, typed where the user's cursor was.
        if (text) submit(mode === 'write' && !/^\s*write\b/i.test(text) ? `Write ${text}` : text, true); else flash('sad');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setNotice({ title: 'Listening', body: errText(err) });
      flash('sad');
    } finally {
      setTranscribing(false);
    }
  }

  /** Another key was pressed while holding the talk key: it was a shortcut, so throw the recording away. */
  async function discardMic() {
    const rec = recorder.current;
    if (!rec) return;
    recorder.current = null;
    setRecording(null);
    setMood('idle');
    await rec.stop();
  }

  const toggleMic = () => (recording ? stopMic() : startMic('ask'));

  async function openInChat() {
    ather.openApp(`chat:${await ather.notchConversation()}`);
    ather.collapse();
  }

  function addImageFiles(files) {
    for (const f of files) {
      if (!f.type.startsWith('image/')) continue;
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => setImages((imgs) => [...imgs, reader.result].slice(0, 3));
      reader.readAsDataURL(f);
    }
  }

  const onKey = (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); submit(input); }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { reset(); setSelection(null); setClips(null); stopVoiceMode(); ather.collapse(); }
  };

  // Glow colour follows the real state.
  const glow = recording || voiceMode === 'listening' ? 'listen'
    : speaking ? 'speaking'
      : mood === 'working' ? 'working'
        : thinking ? 'think'
          : ['happy', 'celebrate', 'excited', 'error'].includes(mood) ? mood : 'idle';

  const voiceLabel = { listening: 'Listening… just talk', thinking: 'Thinking…', speaking: 'Speaking… talk to interrupt' }[voiceMode];

  return (
    <div className={`notch ${expanded ? 'is-open' : ''}`}>
      {control && (
        <div className="peek peek-rec control-banner" role="status">
          <span>🖱 Maya is using your PC: {control.slice(0, 50)} · press Esc to stop</span>
        </div>
      )}
      {!expanded && !control && (
        <div className={`peek ${recording === 'dictate' || voiceMode ? 'peek-rec' : ''}`}>
          {recording === 'dictate' ? <span>● Listening… {pttHeld.current ? 'let go of Right Alt' : 'Ctrl+Shift+Space'} to type it</span>
            : voiceMode ? <span>🎧 {voiceLabel}</span>
              : <><i /><i />{wakeOn && <span className="ear" title='Listening for "Hey Maya"'>👂</span>}
                {timers[0] && <span className="timer-badge" title={timers[0].label || 'Timer'}>⏱ {left(timers[0].ends)}</span>}</>}
        </div>
      )}

      {expanded && locked && <div className="card" ref={card}><LockScreen compact /></div>}

      {expanded && !locked && (
        <div className="card" ref={card}>
          {faceMode === 'face' && (
            <div className={`face-wrap glow-${glow}`} onDoubleClick={() => ather.openApp('home')} title="Double-click to open Maya">
              <Face mood={mood} mouth={mouth} size={104} look={look} level={micLevel} />
            </div>
          )}
          {(recording || voiceMode === 'listening' || speaking) && <Wave level={speaking ? mouth : micLevel} />}

          {voiceMode && <div className="voice-status">🎧 {voiceLabel}</div>}

          {notice && (
            <div className="bubble notice">
              <b>{notice.title}</b> {notice.body}
            </div>
          )}

          {goodbye && (
            <div className="bubble notice" role="alertdialog" aria-label="Shutting down">
              <b>👋 Shutting down in a minute</b> {goodbye.summary}
              <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 8, gap: 8 }}>
                <button className="btn primary" onClick={() => ather.sessionExtend()}>I'm still working (+15 min)</button>
                <button className="btn" onClick={() => ather.sessionCancel()}>Don't shut down</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {clips && (
            <div className="bubble">
              <div className="question">Copied earlier · click to paste</div>
              {!clips.length && <p className="muted">Nothing copied yet. Text you copy (not passwords) shows here until Maya closes.</p>}
              <ul className="clips">
                {clips.slice(0, 12).map((c, i) => (
                  <li key={i}><button className="clip" onClick={() => { setClips(null); ather.pasteClip(c.text); }} title={c.text.slice(0, 500)}>
                    {c.text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 110)}{c.text.length > 110 ? '…' : ''}</button></li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              {!!clips.length && <button className="btn small" onClick={() => { ather.clearClipboard(); setClips([]); }}>Clear history</button>}
            </div>
          )}

          {selection && (
            <div className="bubble">
              <div className="question">Selected text</div>
              <div className="selection-text">{selection.slice(0, 400)}{selection.length > 400 ? '…' : ''}</div>
              <div className="selection-actions">
                {SELECTION_ACTIONS.map(([label, instruction]) => (
                  <button key={label} className="btn small" onClick={() => submit(`${instruction}:\n\n"""\n${selection.slice(0, 6000)}\n"""`)}>{label}</button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {turn && (
            <div className="bubble" aria-live="polite">
              <div className="question">{turn.question.includes('"""') ? turn.question.split(':')[0] : turn.question}</div>
              {turn.tools.map((t, i) => <ToolResult key={i} event={t} />)}
              {turn.text && <div className="answer"><Markdown text={turn.text} /></div>}
              {turn.thinking && !turn.text && <div className="dots"><span /><span /><span /></div>}
              {turn.error && <div className="chip chip-error">⚠ {turn.error}</div>}
              {!turn.thinking && turn.text && <button className="link continue" onClick={openInChat}>Continue in chat ↗</button>}
            </div>
          )}

          <Approvals onPending={setApprovalPending} />

          {images.length > 0 && (
            <div className="attachments">
              {images.map((src, i) => (
                <button key={i} className="thumb" onClick={() => setImages(images.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} title="Remove picture">
                  <img src={src} alt="Attached" />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="input-row">
            <button className="icon-btn" onClick={() => fileRef.current.click()} title="Attach a picture" aria-label="Attach a picture">📎</button>
            <input type="file" accept="image/*" ref={fileRef} hidden onChange={(e) => { addImageFiles(e.target.files); e.target.value = ''; }} />
            <textarea
              ref={inputRef}
              rows={1}
              value={input}
              placeholder={recording ? 'Listening… click the mic when done' : transcribing ? 'Writing down what you said…' : 'Ask Maya anything…'}
              onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={onKey}
              onPaste={(e) => addImageFiles(e.clipboardData.files)}
              aria-label="Message to Maya"
            />
            {thinking && !voiceMode
              ? <button className="icon-btn stop" onClick={cancel} title="Stop" aria-label="Stop">■</button>
              // "Hey Maya" is listening: no button to press (people who cannot click just speak).
              : wakeOn && !recording
                ? <span className="icon-btn wake-hint" role="status" title="Always listening: just say “Hey Maya”" aria-label="Always listening. Say Hey Maya.">👂</span>
                : <button className={`icon-btn mic ${recording === 'ask' ? 'rec' : ''}`} onClick={toggleMic} title={recording ? 'Stop listening' : 'Talk to Maya'} aria-label="Talk to Maya">🎤</button>}
            <button className={`icon-btn ${recording === 'write' ? 'rec' : ''}`} onClick={() => (recording ? stopMic() : startMic('write'))}
              title="Write: say what to write; Maya types a first draft where your cursor is" aria-label="Write for me">✏️</button>
            <button className={`icon-btn ${voiceMode ? 'voice-on' : ''}`} onClick={voiceMode ? stopVoiceMode : startVoiceMode}
              title={voiceMode ? 'End voice conversation' : 'Hands-free voice conversation'} aria-label="Voice mode" aria-pressed={!!voiceMode}>🎧</button>
            <button className="icon-btn" onClick={() => ather.openApp('home')} title="Open the Maya app" aria-label="Open the Maya app">⤢</button>
          </div>
          <div className="hint">{wakeOn ? 'Say “Hey Maya” any time' : 'Enter to send · 🎤 talk'} · 🎧 voice chat · Ctrl+Shift+E on selected text · Ctrl+Shift+V copied earlier · Ctrl+Shift+Space voice typing</div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<Notch />);
```

### src/renderer/shared/voice.js

```javascript
// Hands-free voice: wait for the user to speak, notice when they stop, and detect them talking over Maya.
import { startRecording } from './audio.js';

const SILENCE_MS = 900;   // this much quiet after speech ends the turn
const MIN_SPEECH_MS = 350;

/** Measure room noise for a moment so the speech threshold fits this microphone and room. */
async function calibrate(start = startRecording) {
  const rec = await start();
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
  const noise = rec.level();
  await rec.stop();
  return Math.max(0.012, noise * 3);
}

let threshold = null;

/** Record one utterance. Resolves with 16 kHz audio, or null if nothing was said / it was cancelled. */
const PREROLL = 8000; // 0.5 s kept from before speech starts, so the first word is not clipped
const join = (a, b) => { const out = new Float32Array(a.length + b.length); out.set(a); out.set(b, a.length); return out; };
export async function listenOnce(signal, onLevel = () => {}, start = startRecording) {
  threshold ??= await calibrate(start);
  const rec = await start();
  let speechStart = 0;
  let lastVoice = 0;
  let before = new Float32Array(0);
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const timer = setInterval(async () => {
      const level = rec.level();
      onLevel(Math.min(1, level / (threshold * 4)));
      const t = Date.now();
      if (level > threshold) { speechStart ||= t; lastVoice = t; }
      // Waiting in a quiet room: drop the silence, or a "Hey Maya" said after a long wait becomes a long clip the wake check ignores.
      if (!speechStart) before = join(before, rec.take()).slice(-PREROLL);
      const ended = speechStart && t - lastVoice > SILENCE_MS;
      if (!signal.aborted && !ended) return;
      clearInterval(timer);
      const audio = join(before, await rec.stop());
      resolve(!signal.aborted && lastVoice - speechStart >= MIN_SPEECH_MS ? audio : null);
    }, 50);
  });
}

/** Watch the mic while Maya talks; calls onInterrupt once if the user speaks loudly over it. Returns stop(). */
export async function watchForInterrupt(onInterrupt) {
  threshold ??= await calibrate();
  const rec = await startRecording();
  let loudSince = 0;
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    // Higher bar than normal speech: Maya's own voice leaks into the mic despite echo cancellation.
    if (rec.level() > threshold * 2.5) {
      loudSince ||= Date.now();
      if (Date.now() - loudSince > 250) { stop(); onInterrupt(); }
    } else loudSince = 0;
  }, 50);
  let stopped = false;
  const stop = () => { if (stopped) return; stopped = true; clearInterval(timer); rec.stop(); };
  return stop;
}

// Whisper tiny hears "Hey Maya" almost always right; these are the misses seen in tests ("Hymaya", "Hi, Myers").
// "Ather", the old name, still works.
const WAKE = /\b(?:(?:hey|hi|hello|okay|ok|hay)[\s,.!]*(?:maya|maia|maaya|mayah|myah|mya|mia|myers?|ather|aether)|hymaya|heymaya)\b[\s,.!?]*(.*)$/i;
// Whisper often mishears "Hey" ("Tae Maya", "A Maya"): the name at the very start, after at most one short word, wakes it too.
const WAKE_START = /^\W*(?:[a-z]{1,3}[\s,.!]+)?(?:maya|maia|maaya|mayah|mia)\b[\s,.!?]*(.*)$/i;

/** null if the wake word is not there, otherwise whatever was said after it ("" if nothing). */
export function matchWake(text, name = '') {
  const m = text.match(WAKE) || text.match(WAKE_START);
  if (m) return m[1].trim();
  // The name the user gave Maya (My Maya) wakes it too: "Hey Priya".
  const n = name.trim().replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  const own = n && !/^maya$/i.test(n) ? text.match(new RegExp(`\\b(?:hey|hi|hello|okay|ok)[\\s,.!]*${n}\\b[\\s,.!?]*(.*)$`, 'iu')) : null;
  return own ? own[1].trim() : null;
}

/**
 * The next finished sentence in a streaming answer after position `from`, or null until one is complete.
 * Text that was replaced (shorter than `from`) starts again from 0.
 */
export function nextSentence(text, from = 0) {
  const start = text.length < from ? 0 : from;
  const m = text.slice(start).match(/^[\s\S]*?[.!?।…](?=\s)|^[\s\S]*?\n\n/);
  if (!m || m[0].trim().length < 2) return null;
  return { text: m[0].trim(), end: start + m[0].length };
}

/** "Good morning, boss! What's the work today?" by the time of day. */
export function greeting(at = new Date(), title = 'boss') {
  const h = at.getHours();
  const part = h < 5 ? 'Hello' : h < 12 ? 'Good morning' : h < 17 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening';
  const name = title ? `, ${title}` : '';
  return h >= 22 || h < 5 ? `${part}${name}! Working late? What's the work?` : `${part}${name}! What's the work${h < 12 ? ' today' : ''}?`;
}

export const isStopPhrase = (text) => /^\s*(stop|exit|bye|goodbye|that'?s all|stop voice mode)[.!]?\s*$/i.test(text);
```

### src/renderer/shared/audio.js

```javascript
// Microphone capture at 16 kHz (what Whisper expects) and speech playback with a mouth-level callback.

/** Record 16 kHz mono from the mic (default) or a given MediaStream (e.g. computer audio). */
export async function startRecording(given = null) {
  const stream = given || await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { channelCount: 1, echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true } });
  const ctx = new AudioContext({ sampleRate: 16000 });
  const source = ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
  const processor = ctx.createScriptProcessor(4096, 1, 1);
  const chunks = [];
  let level = 0;
  processor.onaudioprocess = (e) => {
    const data = e.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0);
    chunks.push(new Float32Array(data));
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 16) sum += data[i] * data[i];
    level = Math.sqrt(sum / (data.length / 16));
  };
  source.connect(processor);
  processor.connect(ctx.destination);

  const drain = () => {
    const out = new Float32Array(chunks.reduce((n, c) => n + c.length, 0));
    let offset = 0;
    for (const c of chunks) { out.set(c, offset); offset += c.length; }
    chunks.length = 0;
    return out;
  };

  return {
    level: () => level,
    /** Audio recorded since the last take(), while recording continues. */
    take: drain,
    async stop() {
      processor.disconnect();
      source.disconnect();
      stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      await ctx.close();
      return drain();
    },
  };
}

let current = null;

/** Play { samples, sampleRate }; onLevel(0..1) is called every frame for the mouth. Resolves when finished. */
export function playSpeech(audio, onLevel = () => {}) {
  stopSpeech();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const ctx = new AudioContext();
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, audio.samples.length, audio.sampleRate);
    buffer.copyToChannel(Float32Array.from(audio.samples), 0);
    const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = buffer;
    const analyser = ctx.createAnalyser();
    analyser.fftSize = 512;
    src.connect(analyser);
    analyser.connect(ctx.destination);
    const data = new Float32Array(analyser.fftSize);
    let raf;
    const tick = () => {
      analyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(data);
      let sum = 0;
      for (const v of data) sum += v * v;
      onLevel(Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(sum / data.length) * 6));
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    const finish = () => { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); onLevel(0); ctx.close(); current = null; resolve(); };
    src.onended = finish;
    current = { stop: () => { try { src.stop(); } catch { finish(); } } };
    src.start();
    tick();
  });
}

export function stopSpeech() { current?.stop(); }

/** Short two-note chime for reminders. */
export function chime() {
  const ctx = new AudioContext();
  [660, 880].forEach((f, i) => {
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.frequency.value = f;
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + i * 0.18);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime + i * 0.18 + 0.02);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + i * 0.18 + 0.35);
    osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start(ctx.currentTime + i * 0.18);
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + i * 0.18 + 0.4);
  });
  setTimeout(() => ctx.close(), 1200);
}

export const fileUrl = (path) => `file:///${encodeURI(path.replace(/\\/g, '/'))}`;
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useId, useState } from 'react';
import { useLook, faceColors, faceInk, DEFAULT_FACE } from './look.js';

/**
 * Maya's face. mood: idle | happy | think | listen | love | surprised | sleepy | celebrate | wave | sad
 *   | worried (tense) | excited | angry | working (a tool is running) | error
 *   | ask (waiting for a spoken yes/no) | nod (a voice command was done)
 *   | sos (emergency) | sleep (idle for long) | wake (just woken by "Hey Maya")
 * mouth: 0..1 how open the mouth is while speaking. level: 0..1 voice level while listening (ripples).
 * look: -1..1 or { x, y } where the eyes look. style: optional face style override (Appearance preview).
 * The user picks shape (classic | round | robot | cat | blob) and liveliness (calm | normal | lively) in Appearance.
 */

// How often the face does something on its own while idle (ms): [glance, little expression].
const LIFE = { calm: [[10000, 16000], [18000, 30000]], normal: [[6000, 13000], [9000, 15000]], lively: [[3000, 6000], [4000, 8000]] };
const EXPRESSIONS = ['smile', 'curious', 'yawn', 'smile', 'wink'];
const between = ([a, b]) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const BLOBS = [
  'M60 8 C92 6 114 26 112 52 C110 80 88 94 60 92 C30 94 8 78 8 52 C8 24 30 10 60 8 Z',
  'M60 10 C94 4 116 30 110 56 C106 82 84 96 58 92 C28 90 6 74 10 48 C14 22 32 12 60 10 Z',
  'M62 6 C90 10 112 24 112 50 C112 78 90 96 62 92 C34 90 8 80 8 54 C8 26 34 4 62 6 Z',
];

function Body({ shape, fill, stroke }) {
  const common = { fill, stroke, strokeWidth: 1.5 };
  if (shape === 'round') return <ellipse cx="60" cy="50" rx="52" ry="46" {...common} />;
  if (shape === 'bear') return (
    <g {...common}><circle cx="22" cy="14" r="15" /><circle cx="98" cy="14" r="15" /><circle cx="22" cy="14" r="7" fill="#ff9ccb" opacity="0.6" stroke="none" /><circle cx="98" cy="14" r="7" fill="#ff9ccb" opacity="0.6" stroke="none" />
      <rect x="8" y="10" width="104" height="82" rx="40" /></g>
  );
  if (shape === 'alien') return (
    <g><path d="M38 12 L28 -6 M82 12 L92 -6" stroke={fill} strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" /><circle cx="28" cy="-7" r="5" fill="#7dffb2" /><circle cx="92" cy="-7" r="5" fill="#7dffb2" />
      <path d="M60 4 C100 4 114 26 110 50 C106 78 82 94 60 94 C38 94 14 78 10 50 C6 26 20 4 60 4 Z" {...common} /></g>
  );
  if (shape === 'ghost') return <path className="ghost-body" d="M14 52 C14 22 34 6 60 6 C86 6 106 22 106 52 L106 94 L94 86 L82 94 L70 86 L60 94 L50 86 L38 94 L26 86 L14 94 Z" {...common} />;
  // Jarvis-style glowing orb: a sphere with orbit rings that turn while Maya works or listens.
  if (shape === 'orb') return (
    <g>
      <circle cx="60" cy="50" r="46" fill="#071a2b" stroke="#36e0ff" strokeWidth="2.5" className="orb-glow" />
      <g className="orb-rings" fill="none" stroke="#36e0ff" strokeWidth="1.2" opacity="0.55">
        <ellipse cx="60" cy="50" rx="44" ry="14" /><ellipse cx="60" cy="50" rx="14" ry="44" /><ellipse cx="60" cy="50" rx="34" ry="34" transform="rotate(45 60 50)" strokeDasharray="4 5" />
      </g>
    </g>
  );
  if (shape === 'blob') {
    const still = document.documentElement.dataset.motion === 'off';
    return (
      <path d={BLOBS[0]} {...common}>
        {!still && <animate attributeName="d" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite" values={[...BLOBS, BLOBS[0]].join(';')} />}
      </path>
    );
  }
  return <rect x="8" y="8" width="104" height="84" rx={shape === 'robot' ? 14 : shape === 'cat' ? 34 : 32} {...common} />;
}

export default function Face({ mood = 'idle', mouth = 0, size = 96, look = 0, level = 0, style }) {
  const { theme, face: saved } = useLook();
  const face = { ...DEFAULT_FACE, ...(style || saved) };
  const shape = face.shape || 'classic';
  const life = LIFE[face.liveliness] || LIFE.normal;
  const [colorA, colorB] = mood === 'sos' ? ['#ff4d5e', '#b00020'] : faceColors(face, theme);
  const gradient = `face-${useId().replace(/:/g, '')}`;
  const [blink, setBlink] = useState(false);
  const [drift, setDrift] = useState(0);
  const [expr, setExpr] = useState(null); // a short idle expression: smile | curious | yawn
  useEffect(() => {
    let timer, glance, moment;
    const next = () => {
      timer = setTimeout(() => { setBlink(true); setTimeout(() => setBlink(false), 130); next(); }, 2200 + Math.random() * 3500);
    };
    // Idle life: glance around now and then, and sometimes smile, wonder or yawn.
    const wander = () => {
      glance = setTimeout(() => { setDrift(Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1); setTimeout(() => setDrift(0), 900); wander(); }, between(life[0]));
    };
    const feel = () => {
      moment = setTimeout(() => { setExpr(EXPRESSIONS[Math.floor(Math.random() * EXPRESSIONS.length)]); setTimeout(() => setExpr(null), 1600); feel(); }, between(life[1]));
    };
    next(); wander(); feel();
    return () => { clearTimeout(timer); clearTimeout(glance); clearTimeout(moment); };
  }, [face.liveliness]);

  // An idle expression shows only while nothing else is going on.
  const m = mood === 'idle' && expr ? { smile: 'happy', curious: 'curious', yawn: 'yawn', wink: 'wink' }[expr] : mood;
  const lx = typeof look === 'object' ? look.x : look, ly = typeof look === 'object' ? look.y : 0;

  // Working moods: what Maya is doing right now (typing, building, searching, checking), like a person at work.

  const lookY = m === 'think' ? -5 : busy ? 4 : m === 'searching' ? -2 : (ly || 0) * 4;
  const ink = faceInk(face).eyes; // the user's eye colour ("Any pill. Any eyes.")
  const eye = (cx) => {
    const x = cx + lookX, y = 44 + lookY;
    const arc = (d) => <path d={d} stroke={ink} strokeWidth="5" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" />;
    if (m === 'excited') return <path d={`M${x} ${y - 11} L${x + 3} ${y - 3} L${x + 11} ${y} L${x + 3} ${y + 3} L${x} ${y + 11} L${x - 3} ${y + 3} L${x - 11} ${y} L${x - 3} ${y - 3} Z`} fill="#ffe066" />;
    if (m === 'error') return <path d={`M${x - 7} ${y - 7} L${x + 7} ${y + 7} M${x + 7} ${y - 7} L${x - 7} ${y + 7}`} stroke={ink} strokeWidth="4.5" strokeLinecap="round" />;
    if (busy) return <rect x={x - 7} y={y - 5} width={14} height={blink ? 3 : 12} rx={6} fill={ink} />;
    if (m === 'wink' && cx < 60) return arc(`M${x - 8} ${y + 2} Q${x} ${y - 6} ${x + 8} ${y + 2}`);

    if (m === 'sleepy' || m === 'sleep' || m === 'yawn' || blink) return arc(`M${x - 8} ${y} ${m === 'sleep' ? `Q${x} ${y + 6} ${x + 8} ${y}` : 'h16'}`);
    if (m === 'sad') return arc(`M${x - 8} ${y - 2} Q${x} ${y + 6} ${x + 8} ${y - 2}`);
    // "meh": half-closed, looking away

    if (shape === 'robot') return <rect x={x - 9} y={y - (big ? 9 : 7)} width={18} height={big ? 18 : 14} rx={3} fill={face.color === 'custom' ? ink : '#bff7ff'} />;

  } else if (m === 'worried') {

  } else if (m === 'angry') {

      {m === 'checking' && <path className="tick" d="M96 14 l6 6 12 -14" stroke="#7dffb2" strokeWidth="4.5" fill="none" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />}
      {m === 'excited' && <g fill="#ffd166"><path d="M10 18 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2z" /><path d="M108 70 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5z" /></g>}
      {m === 'celebrate' && <g>
        <g fill="#ffd166"><path d="M14 10 l3 7 7 3 -7 3 -3 7 -3 -7 -7 -3 7 -3z" /><path d="M104 6 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2z" /></g>
        {/* Confetti burst */}
        {['#ffd166', '#ff6b9a', '#7dffb2', '#7cc7ff', '#c4a1ff', '#ffd166', '#ff6b9a', '#7dffb2'].map((c, k) => (
          <rect key={k} className="confetti" x={14 + k * 13} y="-10" width="4" height="7" rx="1" fill={c} style={{ animationDelay: `${(k % 4) * 0.12}s` }} />
        ))}
      </g>}
      {m === 'wave' && <g className="wave-hand"><circle cx="108" cy="80" r="9" fill="#ffd6a5" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="2" /></g>}
      {m === 'think' && <g fill="#fff" opacity="0.8"><circle cx="100" cy="20" r="3" /><circle cx="108" cy="12" r="4.5" /></g>}
      {(m === 'ask' || m === 'curious') && <g>

        {m === 'ask' && <text className="ask-mark" x="104" y="16" fontSize="22" fontWeight="800" fill="#ffd166" textAnchor="middle">?</text>}
```

### src/renderer/shared/emotion.js

```javascript
// How the user seems to feel, from their words, so Maya's face can react before it answers.
// Returns a face mood or null. Instant and offline; covers English, Hinglish and Tanglish phrases.

const RULES = [
  ['worried', /\b(stress(ed)?|tension|tense|worried|anxious|anxiety|panic(king)?|overwhelm(ed|ing)?|too much (work|to do)|so much (work|to do)|deadline (is )?(today|tomorrow)|exam (is )?(today|tomorrow)|no time|help me please|bahut tension|tension ho|kya karu|bayama irukku|romba tension)\b/i],
  ['sad', /\b(sad|depressed|lonely|crying|cry|upset|heart ?broken|failed|feel(ing)? (low|bad|down)|bad day|give up|giving up|miss (her|him|them|home)|dukhi|kashtam)\b/i],
  ['angry', /\b(angry|annoyed|frustrat(ed|ing)|irritat(ed|ing)|hate (this|it)|so done|ugh+|wtf|not working again|gussa)\b/i],
  ['love', /\b(love you|you'?re the best|thank you so much|thanks a lot|you'?re amazing|best (assistant|buddy)|i like you)\b/i],
  ['excited', /\b(yay+|woo+h*o*|awesome|amazing news|great news|i passed|got (the|a) (job|internship|offer)|we won|i won|so happy|so excited|can'?t wait|let'?s go+|semma|mast)\b|!{3,}/i],
  ['sleepy', /\b(sleepy|tired|exhausted|so late|can'?t sleep|good ?night|neend)\b/i],
];

/** Count separate requests in one message ("do X, Y and also Z" → 3). */
export function countRequests(text) {
  return text.split(/[,;\n]|\band (also |then )?(?=(add|remind|make|create|send|book|call|finish|write|buy|study|open|schedule|set|plan|check|email|pay)\b)|\balso\b|\bthen\b/i)
    .filter((part) => part && /\b(add|remind|make|create|send|book|call|finish|write|buy|study|open|schedule|set|plan|check|email|pay|submit|prepare|clean)\b/i.test(part)).length;
}

export function detectEmotion(text) {
  if (!text) return null;
  for (const [mood, pattern] of RULES) if (pattern.test(text)) return mood;
  // Piling on many things at once is stressful: Maya looks a little tense, then gets to work.
  if (countRequests(text) >= 3) return 'worried';
  return null;
}

/** The face to show after answering someone who felt this way. */
export const afterFeeling = (mood) => ({ worried: 'love', sad: 'love', angry: 'happy', excited: 'celebrate', love: 'love', sleepy: 'sleepy' }[mood] || 'happy');
```

### src/renderer/shared/useAsk.js

```javascript
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';

/** Send a question to the brain and follow its streamed answer, reasoning and tool calls. */
export function useAsk() {
  const [turn, setTurn] = useState(null); // { question, text, reasoning, model, tools, thinking, error }
  const idRef = useRef(null);

  /** opts: { conversationId, style: 'short' | 'chat', mode: 'auto' | 'fast' | 'think' | 'smart' | 'coder' } */
  async function send(question, images = [], opts = {}) {
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    idRef.current = id;
    const started = Date.now();
    setTurn({ question, images, text: '', reasoning: '', model: null, tools: [], thinking: true, started });
    const off = window.ather.onAskEvent((e) => {
      if (e.id !== id) return;
      if (e.type === 'model') setTurn((t) => t && ({ ...t, model: e.label }));
      if (e.type === 'reasoning') setTurn((t) => t && ({ ...t, reasoning: t.reasoning + e.text }));
      if (e.type === 'token') setTurn((t) => t && ({ ...t, text: t.text + e.text, thoughtFor: t.thoughtFor ?? (t.reasoning ? Math.round((Date.now() - started) / 1000) : null) }));
      if (e.type === 'skill') setTurn((t) => t && ({ ...t, model: [t.model, `✨ ${e.name}`].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') }));
      if (e.type === 'retry') setTurn((t) => t && ({ ...t, text: '' })); // the first answer is being redone with tools
      if (e.type === 'tool') setTurn((t) => t && ({ ...t, text: '', tools: [...t.tools, e] }));
    });
    try {
      const answer = await window.ather.ask({ id, text: question, images, ...opts });
      setTurn((t) => t && ({ ...t, text: answer, thinking: false }));
      return answer;
    } catch (err) {
      const message = /abort/i.test(err.message) ? 'Stopped.' : err.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
      setTurn((t) => t && ({ ...t, thinking: false, error: message }));
      return null;
    } finally {
      off();
    }
  }

  const cancel = () => idRef.current && window.ather.cancel(idRef.current);
  return { turn, send, cancel, reset: () => setTurn(null) };
}
```

### src/renderer/shared/Markdown.jsx

```jsx
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Marked } from 'marked';
import markedKatex from 'marked-katex-extension';
import DOMPurify from 'dompurify';
import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';

const marked = new Marked({ gfm: true, breaks: true }).use(markedKatex({ throwOnError: false, nonStandard: true }));

/** Renders an AI answer as Markdown (code, tables, maths). Model output is untrusted, so it is sanitised. */
export default function Markdown({ text }) {
  const ref = useRef(null);
  const html = useMemo(() => DOMPurify.sanitize(marked.parse(text || '')), [text]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = ref.current;
    if (!root) return;
    for (const pre of root.querySelectorAll('pre')) {
      if (pre.querySelector('.copy-code')) continue;
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = 'copy-code';
      btn.textContent = 'Copy';
      btn.onclick = () => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(pre.innerText.replace(/Copy$/, '')); btn.textContent = 'Copied'; setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'Copy'; }, 1500); };
      pre.appendChild(btn);
    }
  }, [html]);

  // Links open in the real browser, never inside Maya.
  const onClick = (e) => {
    const a = e.target.closest('a');
    if (!a) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    window.ather.openExternal(a.href);
  };

  return <div className="md" ref={ref} onClick={onClick} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html }} />;
}
```

```jsx
        </ul>
      )}

}
```

### src/main/services/holdkeys.js

```javascript
// Push-to-talk like a walkie-talkie: hold Right Ctrl to give Maya a command, hold Right Alt to dictate; let go to finish.
// A small PowerShell watcher reports key states; the timing rules live here so they can be tested.
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
import { dataDir } from '../paths.js';

// Prints "ctrl alt other" (1/0 each) whenever one changes. "other" = any key except Ctrl/Alt, so Right Ctrl+C is not a hold.
const WATCHER = String.raw`
Add-Type @"
using System; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; using System.Threading;
public static class MayaHoldKeys {
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern short GetAsyncKeyState(int vk);
  static bool Down(int vk) { return (GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) != 0; }
  public static void Run() {
    string last = "";
    while (true) {
      bool other = false;
      for (int vk = 0x08; vk <= 0xFE && !other; vk++) {
        if (vk == 0x11 || vk == 0x12 || (vk >= 0xA2 && vk <= 0xA5)) continue; // Ctrl and Alt (AltGr also reports Left Ctrl)
        if (Down(vk)) other = true;
      }
      string now = (Down(0xA3) ? "1" : "0") + " " + (Down(0xA5) ? "1" : "0") + " " + (other ? "1" : "0");
      if (now != last) { Console.WriteLine(now); last = now; }
      Thread.Sleep(25);
    }
  }
}
"@
[MayaHoldKeys]::Run()
`;

const KEYS = [['ctrl', 'command'], ['alt', 'dictate']];

/**
 * The hold rules: a key counts after `hold` ms with no other key pressed → onStart(mode); releasing it → onEnd(mode);
 * another key while held → onCancel(mode) (it was a shortcut, not talking). Exported for tests.
 */
export function createHoldMachine({ onStart, onEnd, onCancel, hold = 300, setTimer = setTimeout, clearTimer = clearTimeout }) {
  const s = Object.fromEntries(KEYS.map(([k]) => [k, { down: false, active: false, spoiled: false, timer: null }]));
  return (state) => {
    for (const [k, mode] of KEYS) {
      const st = s[k];
      if (state[k] && !st.down) {
        Object.assign(st, { down: true, spoiled: !!state.other, active: false });
        st.timer = setTimer(() => { if (st.down && !st.spoiled) { st.active = true; onStart(mode); } }, hold);
      } else if (state[k] && state.other && !st.spoiled) {
        st.spoiled = true;
        if (st.active) { st.active = false; onCancel(mode); }
      } else if (!state[k] && st.down) {
        st.down = false;
        clearTimer(st.timer);
        if (st.active) { st.active = false; onEnd(mode); }
      }
    }
  };
}

export function createHoldKeys(handlers) {
  let child = null;
  return {
    start() {
      if (child) return;
      const file = join(dataDir, 'hold-keys.ps1');
      writeFileSync(file, WATCHER);
      child = spawn('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', file], { windowsHide: true });
      const feed = createHoldMachine(handlers);
      createInterface({ input: child.stdout }).on('line', (line) => {
        const [ctrl, alt, other] = line.trim().split(' ').map((x) => x === '1');
        feed({ ctrl, alt, other });
      });
      child.on('exit', () => { child = null; });
    },
    stop() { child?.kill(); child = null; },
    get running() { return !!child; },
  };
}
```

### src/main/services/dictate.js

```javascript
// Dictation clean-up, like a careful typist: drop "um"s, follow spoken corrections ("ten, actually fifteen"),
// and turn spoken punctuation and "bullet point" into real text. 'polished' also lets the local AI fix small slips.

const NUMBER = String.raw`(?:\d+(?:[.:]\d+)?|zero|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve|fifteen|twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|sixty|hundred|half)`;
const SPOKEN = [
  [/\s*\b(?:new paragraph)\b[,.]?\s*/gi, '\n\n'],
  [/\s*\b(?:new line|next line)\b[,.]?\s*/gi, '\n'],
  [/\s*\b(?:bullet point|bullet|next bullet)\b[,.:]?\s*/gi, '\n- '],
  [/\s*\b(?:full stop|period)\b/gi, '.'],
  [/\s*\bcomma\b/gi, ','],
  [/\s*\bquestion mark\b/gi, '?'],
  [/\s*\bexclamation (?:mark|point)\b/gi, '!'],
  [/\s*\bcolon\b/gi, ':'],
  [/\s*\bsemicolon\b/gi, ';'],
];

/** Rule-based clean-up (no AI): fast and predictable. Exported for tests. */
export function cleanDictation(text) {
  let s = ` ${text} `;
  // Fillers, with the comma Whisper often puts after them.
  s = s.replace(/[\s,]*\b(?:um+|uh+|uhm|erm|er|ah+|hmm+|mm+)\b[,.]?(?=\s)/gi, ' ');
  // "about ten, actually fifteen minutes" / "ten, no, make that fifteen" → the corrected number.
  s = s.replace(new RegExp(String.raw`\b${NUMBER}[,.]?\s+(?:actually|sorry|no|i mean)[,.]?\s+(?:make (?:it|that)\s+)?(${NUMBER})\b`, 'gi'), '$1');
  // "on Tuesday, actually make that Wednesday" → "on Wednesday"
  s = s.replace(/\b[\w'-]+[,.]?\s+(?:actually|sorry|no|i mean)[,.]?\s+make (?:it|that)\s+([\w'-]+)/gi, '$1');
  for (const [said, mark] of SPOKEN) s = s.replace(said, mark);
  s = s
    .replace(/[ \t]+([,.!?;:])/g, '$1') // no space before punctuation
    .replace(/([,.!?;:])(?=[^\s\d"')\]])/g, '$1 ') // one space after it
    .replace(/([.!?]){2,}/g, '$1')
    .replace(/,([.!?])/g, '$1')
    .replace(/[ \t]{2,}/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[ \t]*\n[ \t]*/g, '\n')
    .trim();
  // Capital letter at the start of each sentence, line and list item.
  s = s.replace(/(^|[.!?]\s+|\n-?\s*)([a-z])/g, (_, before, c) => before + c.toUpperCase());
  return s.replace(/^-\s/, '- ').replace(/^\n+/, '');
}

/**
 * Turn what Whisper heard into the text to type. style: 'raw' | 'clean' (default) | 'polished'.
 * complete(prompt) is the local model; if it fails or rewrites too much, the clean text is used.
 */
export async function finishDictation(text, style = 'clean', complete = null) {
  if (!text || style === 'raw') return text;
  const clean = cleanDictation(text);
  if (style !== 'polished' || !complete) return clean;
  try {
    const out = (await complete(`Fix only clear spelling, grammar and punctuation mistakes in this dictated text. Keep the same words, meaning, tone and line breaks. Do not add or answer anything. Reply with the corrected text only.\n\n${clean}`)).trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, '');
    // A rewrite that changes length a lot is not "fixing slips": keep the user's own words.
    return out && Math.abs(out.length - clean.length) <= Math.max(12, clean.length * 0.25) ? out : clean;
  } catch {
    return clean;
  }
}
```

### src/renderer/shared/voicecommands.js

```javascript
// Voice-only control (for people who cannot use a keyboard or mouse): direct spoken commands run at once,
// without the AI, like Windows Voice Access. Everything else goes to Maya as a normal question.

const WORDS = { one: 1, two: 2, to: 2, too: 2, three: 3, four: 4, for: 4, five: 5, six: 6, seven: 7, eight: 8, ate: 8, nine: 9, ten: 10,
  eleven: 11, twelve: 12, thirteen: 13, fourteen: 14, fifteen: 15, sixteen: 16, seventeen: 17, eighteen: 18, nineteen: 19, twenty: 20 };
const num = (s) => (/^\d+$/.test(s) ? Number(s) : WORDS[s] ?? null);
const KEYS = { enter: 'enter', return: 'enter', tab: 'tab', escape: 'esc', esc: 'esc', backspace: 'backspace', delete: 'delete', space: 'space',
  up: 'up', down: 'down', left: 'left', right: 'right', home: 'home', end: 'end', 'page up': 'pageup', 'page down': 'pagedown' };
const SHORTCUTS = {
  'go back': 'alt+left', 'go forward': 'alt+right', 'new tab': 'ctrl+t', 'close tab': 'ctrl+w', 'switch window': 'alt+tab', 'next window': 'alt+tab',
  'select all': 'ctrl+a', copy: 'ctrl+c', paste: 'ctrl+v', cut: 'ctrl+x', undo: 'ctrl+z', redo: 'ctrl+y', save: 'ctrl+s', refresh: 'f5', 'reload page': 'f5',
  'zoom in': 'ctrl+=', 'zoom out': 'ctrl+-', 'find on page': 'ctrl+f',
};

/** Spoken yes / no for approval cards, in English and Tamil. null when it is neither. */
export function parseYesNo(text) {
  const t = text.toLowerCase().replace(/[.,!?]/g, ' ').trim();
  if (/^(no|nope|nah|cancel|stop|don'?t|do not|deny|wait)\b|வேண்டாம்|வேணாம்|இல்லை|வேண்டா/.test(t)) return false;
  if (/^(yes|yeah|yep|yup|sure|ok|okay|allow|go ahead|do it|run it|fine|alright|correct)\b|ஆம்|ஆமா|சரி|செய்|பண்ணு|ஓகே/.test(t)) return true;
  return null;
}

/**
 * A direct command, or null when the words are a question for Maya.
 * { cmd: 'sos' | 'cancel' | 'later' | 'magnify' | 'readdoc' | 'page' | 'read' | 'keyboard' | 'scan' | 'switch' | 'numbers' | 'grid' | 'hide' | 'click' | 'cell' | 'scroll' | 'keys' | 'type', … }
 */
export function parseCommand(text) {
  const t = text.toLowerCase().replace(/[“”"]/g, '').replace(/[.,!?]+$/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  // Emergency: only these exact words, so "help me with my homework" never sets off an alarm.
  if (/^(help|help me|help me please|please help( me)?|emergency|it'?s an emergency|call for help|sos)$|^(உதவி|உதவி செய்|காப்பாத்து(ங்க)?|காப்பாற்று(ங்கள்)?)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'sos' };
  if (/^(cancel|stop|i'?m (ok|okay|fine)|no|false alarm)$|^(வேண்டாம்|பரவாயில்லை|நான் நலம்)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'cancel' };
  // What is under the mouse / head pointer (low vision).
  if (/^(what('?s| is) (this|that|under the (mouse|pointer|cursor))|what am i pointing at|read (this|that) (button|link|thing))$|^(இது என்ன|இது என்னது)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'whatis' };
  // Repeat the last command ("scroll down… again… again").
  if (/^(again|do (it|that) again|repeat (that|the last) command|one more time|மறுபடி செய்)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'again' };
  // Drag by voice: between two numbers, or two grid cells.
  let d = t.match(/^(?:drag|move|drag and drop) (?:number )?(\w+) (?:to|onto|into) (?:number )?(\w+)$/);
  if (d && num(d[1]) && num(d[2])) return { cmd: 'drag', from: num(d[1]), to: num(d[2]) };
  d = t.match(/^(?:drag|move|drag and drop) ([a-p]) ?(10|[1-9]) (?:to|onto|into) ([a-p]) ?(10|[1-9])$/);
  if (d) return { cmd: 'drag', fromCell: `${d[1].toUpperCase()}${d[2]}`, toCell: `${d[3].toUpperCase()}${d[4]}` };
  // Teaching Maya by voice: was that answer good?
  if (/^(good|great|nice|perfect|excellent) (answer|job|reply)$|^that was (good|great|helpful|perfect)$|^(நல்ல பதில்|சூப்பர்)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'feedback', good: true };
  if (/^(bad|wrong|poor) (answer|reply)$|^that'?s (wrong|not right|not what i (wanted|asked))$|^that was (bad|wrong|not helpful)$|^(தவறு|தப்பு|தப்பான பதில்)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'feedback', good: false };
  // The shutdown countdown after a work timer: more time instead of shutting down.
  if (/^(wait|not yet|hold on|i'?m still working|keep working|give me (15|fifteen) (more )?minutes)$|^(இரு|இன்னும் வேலை இருக்கு|பொறு)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'later' };
  // Windows Magnifier (low vision, or a screen far from the bed or wheelchair).
  if (/^(start|open|turn on) (the )?magnifier$|^magnif(y|y more|ier on)$|^பெரிதாக்கு$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'magnify', action: 'in' };
  if (/^magnify less$|^சிறிதாக்கு$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'magnify', action: 'out' };
  if (/^(stop|close|turn off) (the )?magnifier$|^magnifier off$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'magnify', action: 'off' };
  if (/^magnifier (lens|full ?screen|docked)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'magnify', action: t.split(' ')[1].replace(' ', '') };
  // Reading a document page by page.
  let m = t.match(/^read (?:my |the )?(?:document|file|pdf|notes?|book) (?:called |named )?(.+)$/);
  if (m) return { cmd: 'readdoc', name: m[1] };
  if (/^next page$|^அடுத்த பக்கம்$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'page', go: 'next' };
  if (/^(previous|last|go back a) page$|^முந்தைய பக்கம்$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'page', go: 'previous' };
  if (/^(repeat|repeat (that|the page)|read (that |it )?again)$|^(மீண்டும்|மறுபடியும்)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'page', go: 'repeat' };
  if (/^stop reading$|^படிப்பதை நிறுத்து$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'page', go: 'stop' };
  m = t.match(/^(?:go to )?page (\w+)$/);
  if (m && num(m[1])) return { cmd: 'page', go: num(m[1]) };
  if (/^(read|read (this|it|that|the screen|the page|this page|my screen|aloud|it aloud|this aloud))$|^(படி|திரையை படி|இதை படி|வாசி)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'read' };
  if (/^(open|show|start) (the )?(on-?screen )?keyboard$|^கீபோர்டு (திற|காட்டு)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'keyboard', on: true };
  if (/^(close|hide|stop) (the )?(on-?screen )?keyboard$|^கீபோர்டு (மூடு|மறை)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'keyboard', on: false };
  if (/^(start|begin) scanning$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'scan', on: true };
  if (/^stop scanning$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'scan', on: false };
  if (/^(select|pick|this one|choose)$|^(இது|இதை)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'switch' };
  if (/^(delete|remove) (the )?last word$|^கடைசி வார்த்தையை (அழி|நீக்கு)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'keys', keys: 'ctrl+backspace' };
  if (/^(delete|remove) (that|this|it)$|^(அழி|நீக்கு)$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'keys', keys: 'backspace' };
  if (/^new line$|^புது வரி$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'keys', keys: 'shift+enter' };
  if (/^(show|display) (the )?(numbers|labels|tags)$|^எண்(கள்|களை)? காட்டு/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'numbers' };
  if (/^(show|display) (the )?grid$|^கட்டம் காட்டு/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'grid' };
  if (/^(hide|remove|clear) (the )?(numbers|labels|grid|overlay)$|^hide$|^மறை/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'hide' };

  m = t.match(/^(double |right )?(click|press|tap|select|open) (on )?(number )?(\w+)$/);
  if (m && num(m[5]) !== null) return { cmd: 'click', n: num(m[5]), double: m[1] === 'double ', right: m[1] === 'right ' };
  m = t.match(/^(double |right )?(click|tap) (on )?(cell |square )?([a-p]) ?(10|[1-9]|\w+)$/);
  if (m && num(m[6]) >= 1 && num(m[6]) <= 10) return { cmd: 'cell', cell: `${m[5].toUpperCase()}${num(m[6])}`, double: m[1] === 'double ', right: m[1] === 'right ' };

  m = t.match(/^scroll (up|down)( a lot| more)?$/);
  if (m) return { cmd: 'scroll', direction: m[1], amount: m[2] ? 15 : 5 };
  if (/^(கீழே|கீழ) (போ|ஸ்க்ரோல்)/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'scroll', direction: 'down', amount: 5 };
  if (/^(மேலே|மேல) (போ|ஸ்க்ரோல்)/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'scroll', direction: 'up', amount: 5 };

  m = t.match(/^press (.+)$/);
  if (m) {
    const k = m[1].replace(/^the /, '').replace(/ key$/, '');
    if (KEYS[k]) return { cmd: 'keys', keys: KEYS[k] };
    const combo = k.replace(/\bcontrol\b/g, 'ctrl').replace(/\bwindows\b/g, 'win').split(/ (?:plus |\+ )?|\+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (combo.length >= 2 && /^(ctrl|alt|shift|win)$/.test(combo[0])) return { cmd: 'keys', keys: combo.join('+') };
  }
  if (SHORTCUTS[t]) return { cmd: 'keys', keys: SHORTCUTS[t] };
  if (/^minimi[sz]e( (this|the) window)?$/.test(t)) return { cmd: 'minimize' };

  // "write a letter…" and "type of animals…" are questions for Maya, not text to type.
  m = text.trim().match(/^(?:type(?!\s+of\b)|dictate|டைப் பண்ணு|எழுது)[:,]?\s+(.+)$/i);
  if (m) return { cmd: 'type', text: m[1].replace(/[.]$/, '') };
  return null;
}
```
