### src/main/services/voicecontrol.js

```javascript
// Runs direct commands for people who can only speak or press one switch: number labels or a grid over the screen,
// clicking, scrolling, keys and typing, switch scanning, reading aloud, the on-screen keyboard and the SOS alarm,
// always in the app the user is working in (never in Maya itself).
import { cellCenter, toSendKeys } from '../tools/computer.js';
import { createScanner } from './scanning.js';

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
// UI Automation control types, as a person would say them.
const KINDS = { Button: 'button', Hyperlink: 'link', Edit: 'text box', Text: 'text', CheckBox: 'tick box', RadioButton: 'option', ComboBox: 'drop-down list',
  MenuItem: 'menu item', ListItem: 'list item', TabItem: 'tab', Image: 'picture', Slider: 'slider', Document: 'page', TreeItem: 'item', DataItem: 'cell' };
const REPEATABLE =new Set(['scroll', 'keys', 'click', 'cell', 'drag', 'magnify', 'page', 'minimize']);
const READ_LIMIT = 1500; // about a minute of speech; "read" again continues later
// Windows Magnifier keys (virtual-key codes): Win + Plus / Minus / Esc, Ctrl + Alt + L / F / D for the view.
const MAGNIFIER = { in: [0x5b, 0xbb], out: [0x5b, 0xbd], off: [0x5b, 0x1b], lens: [0x11, 0x12, 0x4c], full: [0x11, 0x12, 0x46], docked: [0x11, 0x12, 0x44] };

/** A document split into spoken pages of about a minute each, cut at a paragraph or sentence (exported for tests). */
export function pages(text, size = READ_LIMIT) {
  const clean = String(text).replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
  const out = [];
  for (let at = 0; at < clean.length;) {
    const part = clean.slice(at, at + size);
    const cut = at + size < clean.length ? Math.max(part.lastIndexOf('\n'), part.lastIndexOf('. '), size / 2) + 1 : part.length;
    out.push(part.slice(0, cut).trim());
    at += cut;
  }
  return out.filter(Boolean);
}

/**
 * overlay(data|null) draws numbers, the grid or the scan highlight; bounds() is the main screen in DIP.
 * keyboard(on) shows the on-screen keyboard; sos is services.sos; scanMs() is the scanning speed;
 * onScan(on) lets main grab/release the switch key.
 */
/** "my address" / "my home address" → the saved snippet text, or null (exported for tests). */
export function snippetFor(all, said) {
  const m = /^(?:my|our)\s+(.+?)[.!]?$/i.exec(String(said).trim());
  if (!m) return null;
  const want = m[1].toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(all).find((k) => k.toLowerCase() === want) || Object.keys(all).find((k) => want.includes(k.toLowerCase()));
  return key ? all[key] : null;
}

export function createVoiceControl({ pc, overlay, computer, bounds, keyboard = () => {}, sos = null, session = null, findDoc = null, snippets = () => ({}), scanMs = () => 1200, onScan = () => {} }) {
  let mode = null; // 'numbers' | 'grid' | 'scan' | null
  let elements = [];
  let scanner = null, scanTimer = null;
  let reading = { text: '', at: 0 };
  let book = null; // { name, pages, i } while reading a document page by page
  let last = null; // the last repeatable command, for "again"
  const page = () => ({ read: `${book.pages[book.i]} … Page ${book.i + 1} of ${book.pages.length}.${book.i + 1 < book.pages.length ? ' Say "next page".' : ' That is the end.'}` });

  // The face window takes the focus while listening: hand it back to the app the user was in.
  async function toApp() {
    const fg = await pc.foreground();
    const last = computer.lastExternal();
    if (/^(Ather|Maya|electron)$/i.test(fg.process) && last) { await pc.activate(last.hwnd); await sleep(300); }
  }
  const draw = (extra = {}) => overlay({ kind: 'numbers', bounds: bounds(), items: elements.map(({ i, x, y, w, h, name }) => ({ i, x, y, w, h, name })), ...extra });
  async function showNumbers() {
    await toApp();
    elements = await pc.elements();
    draw();
    return elements.length ? `${elements.length} numbers` : 'No numbers here. Say "show grid" instead.';
  }
  // Numbers follow the screen: after an action they are drawn again for what is there now.
  const refresh = async () => { if (mode === 'numbers') { await sleep(700); await showNumbers(); } };

  // ---- switch scanning: controls light up in turn; one press picks ----
  const drawScan = () => { const { items, back } = scanner.lit; draw({ lit: items.map((e) => e.i), back }); };
  async function startScan() {
    await toApp();
    elements = await pc.elements();
    if (!elements.length) return { error: 'Nothing to scan in this window.' };
    scanner = createScanner(elements);
    mode = 'scan';
    clearInterval(scanTimer);
    scanTimer = setInterval(() => { scanner.next(); drawScan(); }, scanMs());
    drawScan();
    onScan(true);
    return { said: 'Scanning. Press your switch when the right box lights up.' };
  }
  function stopScan() {
    clearInterval(scanTimer);
    scanner = null;
    if (mode === 'scan') { mode = null; overlay(null); }
    onScan(false);
  }

  const api = {
    get mode() { return mode; },
    /** The switch (key, "select", or mouth-open in head mouse) was pressed while scanning. */
    async press() {
      if (!scanner) return { error: 'Say "start scanning" first.' };
      const chosen = scanner.press();
      if (!chosen) { drawScan(); return { said: 'Ok' }; }
      await toApp();
      await pc.invoke(chosen.i);
      await sleep(700);
      await startScan(); // the screen may have changed: scan what is there now
      return { said: `Picked ${chosen.name || chosen.i}` };
    },
    async run(c) {
      // "Again": the last action once more (scroll, keys, click, drag, page…).
      if (c.cmd === 'again') {
        if (!last) return { error: 'There is nothing to repeat yet.' };
        c = last;
      } else if (REPEATABLE.has(c.cmd)) last = c;
      switch (c.cmd) {
        case 'numbers': stopScan(); mode = 'numbers'; return { said: await showNumbers() };
        case 'whatis': {
          const e = await pc.atPointer();
          if (!e.name && !e.value) return { read: `That is ${KINDS[e.kind] ? `a ${KINDS[e.kind]}` : 'an empty part of the screen'} with no label.` };
          return { read: [`${KINDS[e.kind] ? `${KINDS[e.kind][0].toUpperCase()}${KINDS[e.kind].slice(1)}` : 'It says'}: ${e.name}`, e.value?.trim() && e.value.trim() !== e.name ? `It contains: ${e.value.trim().slice(0, 300)}` : '', e.hint].filter(Boolean).join('. ') };
        }
        case 'drag': {
          // Between two numbered controls, or two grid cells.
          const at = (n, cell) => (cell ? cellCenter(cell, bounds()) : elements.find((e) => e.i === n));
          const a = at(c.from, c.fromCell), b = at(c.to, c.toCell);
          if (!a || !b) return { error: c.fromCell ? 'Grid cells go from A1 to P10.' : 'Say "show numbers" first, then "drag 3 to 7".' };
          await toApp();
          await pc.drag(a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y);
          await refresh();
          return { said: 'Dragged' };
        }
        case 'grid': stopScan(); mode = 'grid'; overlay({ kind: 'grid', bounds: bounds() }); return { said: 'Grid' };
        case 'hide': stopScan(); mode = null; overlay(null); return { said: 'Hidden' };
        case 'click': {
          const el = elements.find((e) => e.i === c.n);
          if (!el) return { error: mode === 'numbers' ? `There is no number ${c.n}.` : 'Say "show numbers" first.' };
          await toApp();
          if (c.right || c.double) { await pc.click(el.x, el.y, c.right ? 'right' : 'left'); if (c.double) await pc.click(el.x, el.y); } else await pc.invoke(c.n);
          await refresh();
          return { said: `Clicked ${c.n}` };
        }
        case 'cell': {
          const p = cellCenter(c.cell, bounds());
          if (!p) return { error: 'Grid cells go from A1 to P10.' };
          await toApp();
          await pc.click(p.x, p.y, c.right ? 'right' : 'left');
          if (c.double) await pc.click(p.x, p.y);
          return { said: `Clicked ${c.cell}` };
        }
        case 'scroll': await toApp(); await pc.scroll((c.direction === 'up' ? 120 : -120) * (c.amount || 5)); await refresh(); return { said: `Scrolled ${c.direction}` };
        case 'keys': await toApp(); await pc.keys(toSendKeys(c.keys)); await refresh(); return { said: c.keys };
        case 'type': {
          // "Type my address": a saved snippet instead of the words themselves.
          const saved = snippetFor(snippets(), c.text);
          await toApp();
          await pc.type(saved ?? c.text);
          return { said: saved ? 'Typed it' : 'Typed' };
        }
        case 'minimize': await toApp(); await pc.minimizeForeground(); await refresh(); return { said: 'Minimised' };
        case 'scan': return c.on ? startScan() : (stopScan(), { said: 'Scanning stopped' });
        case 'switch': return api.press();
        case 'keyboard': keyboard(c.on); return { said: c.on ? 'Keyboard open' : 'Keyboard closed' };
        case 'read': {
          // "Read" again on the same window continues where the last part stopped.
          await toApp();
          const text = String(await pc.readText()).replace(/\s+\n/g, '\n').trim();
          if (!text) return { error: 'I cannot find any text to read in this window.' };
          if (text !== reading.text) reading = { text, at: 0 };
          const part = reading.text.slice(reading.at, reading.at + READ_LIMIT);
          const cut = part.length === READ_LIMIT ? Math.max(part.lastIndexOf('. '), part.lastIndexOf('\n'), 200) + 1 : part.length;
          reading.at += cut;
          const more = reading.at < reading.text.length;
          return { read: part.slice(0, cut).trim() + (more ? ' … Say "read" to continue.' : '') };
        }
        case 'sos': return sos ? { said: 'Getting help', ...sos.trigger('asked for help by voice') } : { error: 'Emergency help is not set up.' };
        // "cancel" / "I'm okay" only matters while an alarm is counting down; otherwise it is a normal sentence.
        case 'cancel':
          if (sos?.pending) { sos.cancel(); return { said: 'Cancelled. I am glad you are okay.' }; }
          if (session?.status().saying_goodbye) { session.cancel(); return { said: 'Okay, I will not shut down. The work timer is off.' }; }
          return { pass: true };
        case 'later': return session?.status().saying_goodbye ? (session.extend(15), { said: 'Okay, 15 more minutes.' }) : { pass: true };
        case 'magnify': {
          // Releasing the Windows key leaves the taskbar focused: give the focus back to the user's app.
          await toApp();
          const before = await pc.foreground();
          await pc.chord(...MAGNIFIER[c.action]);
          await sleep(500);
          if ((await pc.foreground()).hwnd !== before.hwnd) await pc.activate(before.hwnd);
          return { said: { in: 'Magnifying', out: 'Less', off: 'Magnifier off' }[c.action] || 'Ok' };
        }
        case 'readdoc': {
          const doc = await findDoc?.(c.name);
          if (!doc?.text?.trim()) return { error: `I could not find a document called ${c.name} with text in it.` };
          book = { name: doc.name, pages: pages(doc.text), i: 0 };
          return { read: `${doc.name}. ${page().read}` };
        }
        case 'page': {
          if (!book) return { error: 'Say "read my document" and its name first.' };
          if (c.go === 'stop') { book = null; return { said: 'Stopped reading.' }; }
          const i = c.go === 'next' ? book.i + 1 : c.go === 'previous' ? book.i - 1 : c.go === 'repeat' ? book.i : c.go - 1;
          if (i < 0 || i >= book.pages.length) return { error: `There are ${book.pages.length} pages.` };
          book.i = i;
          return page();
        }
        default: return { error: `Unknown command ${c.cmd}` };
      }
    },
  };
  return api;
}
```

```html
<html lang="en">

        box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0,229,255,.9); animation: glow 1s ease-in-out infinite; }

      .ring-track { fill: rgba(0,0,0,.25); stroke: rgba(255,255,255,.55); stroke-width: 6; }

      .point { position: absolute; border: 4px solid #8b7bff; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(139,123,255,.25), 0 0 26px rgba(139,123,255,.9);
        animation: pop .25s ease-out both, pulse 1.1s ease-in-out .25s infinite; }
      .arrow { position: absolute; width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 16px solid transparent; border-right: 16px solid transparent; border-top: 24px solid #8b7bff;
        filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.5)); animation: bob .7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
      .label { position: absolute; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: #8b7bff; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4); }
      @keyframes pulse { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px rgba(139,123,255,.12), 0 0 40px rgba(139,123,255,1); } }
      @keyframes bob { to { transform: translateY(-10px); } }
      @keyframes glow { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(0,229,255,.2), 0 0 34px rgba(0,229,255,1); } }
      @keyframes pop { from { transform: scale(.4); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .tag, .point, .arrow { animation: none; } }
    </style>
  </head>

    <div id="root"></div>
    <script type="module" src="./overlay.jsx"></script>
```

### src/renderer/overlay.jsx

```jsx
// Click-through layer over the whole screen for hands-free control: yellow numbers on every control, a lettered grid,
// the glowing boxes of switch scanning, and the filling ring of a dwell click at the cursor.
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

const COLS = 16, ROWS = 10; // same grid as computer control (A1 … P10)

function Marks({ data }) {
  const { bounds } = data;
  if (data.kind === 'point') {
    // "Where's the Save button?": a glowing outline, an arrow above it and its name.
    const { x, y, w = 40, h = 30, label } = data.at;
    const left = x - w / 2 - bounds.x, top = y - h / 2 - bounds.y;
    const above = top > 70;
    return (
      <>
        <div className="point" style={{ left: left - 6, top: top - 6, width: w + 12, height: h + 12 }} />
        <div className="arrow" style={{ left: left + w / 2 - 16, top: above ? top - 38 : top + h + 14, transform: above ? undefined : 'rotate(180deg)' }} />
        {label && <div className="label" style={{ left: Math.max(4, left + w / 2 - 60), top: above ? top - 72 : top + h + 44 }}>{label}</div>}
      </>
    );
  }
  if (data.kind === 'grid') {
    const w = bounds.width / COLS, h = bounds.height / ROWS;
    return Array.from({ length: COLS * ROWS }, (_, k) => {
      const c = k % COLS, r = Math.floor(k / COLS);
      return <div key={k} className="cell" style={{ left: c * w, top: r * h, width: w, height: h }}><span>{String.fromCharCode(65 + c)}{r + 1}</span></div>;
    });
  }
  const lit = new Set(data.lit || []);
  const scanning = !!data.lit;
  return (
    <>
      {data.back && <div className="back">↩ Back</div>}
      {data.items.map((e) => {
        const left = e.x - (e.w || 0) / 2 - bounds.x, top = e.y - (e.h || 0) / 2 - bounds.y;
        // While scanning only the lit boxes show, so the eye goes straight to them.
        if (scanning && !lit.has(e.i)) return null;
        return (
          <div key={e.i}>
            <div className={`box ${lit.has(e.i) ? 'lit' : ''}`} data-name={e.name} style={{ left, top, width: e.w, height: e.h }} />
            <div className="tag" style={{ left: Math.max(0, left - 4), top: Math.max(0, top - 8) }}>{e.i}</div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

function Ring({ ring }) {
  const r = 26, c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  return (
    <svg className="ring" style={{ left: ring.at.x - ring.bounds.x - 32, top: ring.at.y - ring.bounds.y - 32 }} width="64" height="64" aria-hidden="true">
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r={r} className="ring-track" />
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r={r} className="ring-fill" strokeDasharray={c} strokeDashoffset={c * (1 - ring.progress)} />
    </svg>
  );
}

function Overlay() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [ring, setRing] = useState(null);
  useEffect(() => { const a = window.ather.onOverlay(setData); const b = window.ather.onOverlayRing(setRing); return () => { a(); b(); }; }, []);
  return <>{data && <Marks data={data} />}{ring && <Ring ring={ring} />}</>;
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<Overlay />);
```

```jsx
/** Everything for people with physical disabilities in one place: voice-only use, head mouse, keyboard, switch, emergency, display. */

            (medicines taken or missed, how the day went)</label>

            and <input className="input" type="time" style={{ width: 110 }} value={s.checkin.to} onChange={(e) => setS({ checkin: { ...s.checkin, to: e.target.value } })} aria-label="To" />, ask “Are you okay?”</label>
          {s.checkin.on && <label className="row field"><input type="checkbox" className="check" checked={!!s.checkin.camera} onChange={(e) => setS({ checkin: { ...s.checkin, camera: e.target.checked } })} />
            Also use the webcam: if it sees me, I am not “quiet” (one look every 10 minutes, checked on this PC and never saved)</label>}
          <div className="row wrap">
            <button className="btn danger big-sos" onClick={() => window.ather.sosTrigger('pressed the help button')}>🆘 Get help now</button>
            <button className="btn" onClick={testEmail} disabled={!s.contacts.length}>Send a test email</button>
            <button className="btn" onClick={testCall} disabled={!s.phones.length}>Test call</button>
          </div>
          {msg && <p className="muted" role="status">{msg}</p>}
          {!!log.length && <details><summary className="muted">Recent alerts</summary><ul className="list">{log.slice(0, 6).map((l, i) => <li className="item" key={i}><span className="badge">{new Date(l.at).toLocaleString()}</span><span className="item-title">{l.event}: {l.reason}{l.sent ? ` · emailed ${l.sent}` : ''}{l.calling ? ` · called ${l.calling}` : ''}{l.error ? ` · ${l.error}` : ''}</span></li>)}</ul></details>}
        </section>

        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="a11y-timer">
          <h2 id="a11y-timer">⏳ Work timer</h2>
          <p className="muted">Say “I will work for 2 hours, then shut down”. When time is up Maya tells you how your day went, says goodbye and shuts the PC down after one minute — say “wait” for 15 more minutes.</p>
          {timer?.running ? (
            <div className="row wrap"><span>Until <b>{new Date(timer.ends).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })}</b> ({timer.minutes_left} min left){timer.shutdown ? ', then shut down' : ''}</span>
              <button className="btn" onClick={() => window.ather.tool('work_timer_cancel', {}).then(refresh)}>Stop timer</button></div>
          ) : (
            <div className="row wrap">{[60, 120, 180].map((m) => <button key={m} className="btn" onClick={() => startTimer(m)}>{m / 60} h, then shut down</button>)}</div>
          )}
          <div className="field"><label htmlFor="a11y-title">Maya calls you</label>
            <input id="a11y-title" className="input" value={userTitle} onChange={(e) => setUserTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="sir, madam, or your name" /></div>
        </section>

        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="a11y-care">
          <h2 id="a11y-care">💊 Medicine and care</h2>
          <p className="muted">Say “remind me to take my tablets at 9 pm every day”. Maya asks you to say “done”; if you don't within 15 minutes, your caregivers get an email.</p>
          {!care.length && <p className="empty">No medicine reminders today.</p>}
          <ul className="list">{care.map((r) => <li className="item" key={r.id}><span className="item-title">💊 {r.text}</span>
            <span className={`badge ${!r.confirmed_at && r.fired_at ? 'late' : ''}`}>{r.confirmed_at ? '✓ done' : r.fired_at ? 'not confirmed yet' : r.at.slice(11, 16)}</span></li>)}</ul>
        </section>

        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="a11y-display">
          <h2 id="a11y-display">🔍 Display</h2>
          <label className="row field"><input type="checkbox" className="check" checked={large} onChange={(e) => setLarge(e.target.checked)} />
            Large and high contrast: bigger text and buttons, stronger outlines</label>
          <div className="row wrap">
            <button className="btn" onClick={() => window.ather.voiceCommand({ cmd: 'magnify', action: 'in' })}>🔍 Magnifier on / more</button>
            <button className="btn" onClick={() => window.ather.voiceCommand({ cmd: 'magnify', action: 'off' })}>Magnifier off</button>
          </div>
          <p className="muted">Theme, face shape, colours and how lively the face is: Settings → Appearance.</p>
        </section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### src/main/services/scanning.js

```javascript
// Switch scanning, for people who can press only one button (or make one sound): controls light up in turn and a
// press picks the lit one. Groups of controls come first (fewer waits), then the controls of the chosen group,
// then a "back" step to return to the groups. Pure, so it is unit tested.

export function createScanner(items, { size = 8 } = {}) {
  const groups = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < items.length; k += size) groups.push(items.slice(k, k + size));
  let level = groups.length > 1 ? 'group' : 'item', g = 0, i = 0;
  return {
    /** What is lit now: the controls of a group, one control, or [] with back = true. */
    get lit() {
      if (!groups.length) return { items: [], back: false };
      if (level === 'group') return { items: groups[g], back: false };
      return i === groups[g].length ? { items: [], back: true } : { items: [groups[g][i]], back: false };
    },
    next() {
      if (!groups.length) return;
      if (level === 'group') g = (g + 1) % groups.length;
      else i = (i + 1) % (groups[g].length + (groups.length > 1 ? 1 : 0)); // the back step only when there are groups
    },
    /** The switch was pressed: returns the chosen control, or null when it moved into or out of a group. */
    press() {
      if (!groups.length) return null;
      if (level === 'group') { level = 'item'; i = 0; return null; }
      if (i === groups[g].length) { level = 'group'; g = 0; return null; }
      const chosen = groups[g][i];
      level = groups.length > 1 ? 'group' : 'item'; g = 0; i = 0;
      return chosen;
    },
  };
}
```

```javascript
// Word suggestions for the on-screen keyboard: common English words plus the words this user types (English or Tamil).
// Typing one letter at a time is slow with a head mouse; picking a suggestion saves most of the presses.
import { looksLikePassword } from './clipboard.js';

const COMMON = (`the be to of and a in that have i it for not on with he as you do at this but his by from they we say her she or
an will my one all would there their what so up out if about who get which go me when make can like time no just him know take
people into year your good some could them see other than then now look only come its over think also back after use two how our
work first well way even new want because any these give day most us is was are has had am been please thank thanks hello hi yes
okay ok sorry help call send message mom dad amma appa friend today tomorrow tonight morning evening night meeting class exam study
college school homework assignment project report notes book read write open close search find show tell where when why water food
eat lunch dinner breakfast medicine doctor hospital pain tired sleep home office phone email whatsapp youtube google chrome video
music play stop pause next later soon minutes hours late early coming going waiting reached done ready happy fine love bye`).split(/\s+/);
const MAX_LEARNED = 600;

export function createKeyboard({ store }) {
  return {
    /** Up to 3 words that start with what has been typed of the current word. */
    suggest(prefix) {
      const p = String(prefix || '').toLowerCase();
      if (!p) return [];
      const learned = Object.entries(store.getSetting('kbWords', {})).filter(([w]) => w.startsWith(p) && w !== p)
        .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([w]) => w);
      return [...new Set([...learned, ...COMMON.filter((w) => w.startsWith(p) && w !== p)])].slice(0, 3);
    },
    /** Remember a finished word, unless it could be a password, a code or a number. */
    learn(word) {
      const w = String(word || '').toLowerCase().trim();
      if (w.length < 2 || w.length > 30 || looksLikePassword(word) || /\d/.test(w)) return false;
      const words = store.getSetting('kbWords', {});
      words[w] = (words[w] || 0) + 1;
      const kept = Object.entries(words).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, MAX_LEARNED);
      store.setSetting('kbWords', Object.fromEntries(kept));
      return true;
    },
  };
}
```

```jsx
// On-screen keyboard for people who type with a head mouse, dwell clicks or a switch. Keys go to the app with the focus
// (this window never takes it). English and Tamil layouts, word suggestions, and an SOS key.
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

const LAYOUTS = {
  en: [
    ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '0'],
    ['q', 'w', 'e', 'r', 't', 'y', 'u', 'i', 'o', 'p'],
    ['a', 's', 'd', 'f', 'g', 'h', 'j', 'k', 'l', "'"],
    ['z', 'x', 'c', 'v', 'b', 'n', 'm', ',', '.', '?'],
  ],
  ta: [
    ['அ', 'ஆ', 'இ', 'ஈ', 'உ', 'ஊ', 'எ', 'ஏ', 'ஐ', 'ஒ', 'ஓ', 'ஔ'],
    ['க', 'ங', 'ச', 'ஞ', 'ட', 'ண', 'த', 'ந', 'ப', 'ம', 'ய', 'ர'],
    ['ல', 'வ', 'ழ', 'ள', 'ற', 'ன', 'ஜ', 'ஷ', 'ஸ', 'ஹ', 'ஃ', '?'],
    ['ா', 'ி', 'ீ', 'ு', 'ூ', 'ெ', 'ே', 'ை', 'ொ', 'ோ', 'ௌ', '்'],
  ],
};
const ENDS_WORD = /[\s,.?!]/;

function Keyboard() {
  const [layout, setLayout] = useState(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('layout') === 'ta' ? 'ta' : 'en');
  const [shift, setShift] = useState(false);
  const [word, setWord] = useState('');
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState([]);
  const [hit, setHit] = useState(null);
  const wordRef = useRef('');

  useEffect(() => { window.ather.keyboardSuggest(word).then(setSuggestions).catch(() => setSuggestions([])); }, [word]);
  const setW = (w) => { wordRef.current = w; setWord(w); };
  const flash = (k) => { setHit(k); setTimeout(() => setHit(null), 150); };

  async function type(ch) {
    flash(ch);
    const text = shift ? ch.toUpperCase() : ch;
    await window.ather.keyboardKey({ text });
    if (shift) setShift(false);
    if (ENDS_WORD.test(ch)) { window.ather.keyboardLearn(wordRef.current); setW(''); } else setW(wordRef.current + text);
  }
  async function keys(combo, label) {
    flash(label);
    await window.ather.keyboardKey({ keys: combo });
    if (combo === 'backspace') setW(wordRef.current.slice(0, -1));
    else if (combo === 'enter') { window.ather.keyboardLearn(wordRef.current); setW(''); } else setW('');
  }
  async function pick(s) {
    await window.ather.keyboardKey({ text: `${s.slice(wordRef.current.length)} ` });
    window.ather.keyboardLearn(s);
    setW('');
  }
  const k = (label, onClick, cls = '') => <button key={label} className={`${cls} ${hit === label ? 'hit' : ''}`} onClick={onClick} aria-label={label}>{label}</button>;

  return (
    <div className="kb">
      <div className="top">
        {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => <button key={i} className="sugg" onClick={() => suggestions[i] && pick(suggestions[i])}>{suggestions[i] || ''}</button>)}
        {k(layout === 'en' ? 'தமிழ்' : 'ABC', () => setLayout(layout === 'en' ? 'ta' : 'en'), 'tool')}
        {k('SOS', () => window.ather.sosTrigger('pressed SOS on the on-screen keyboard'), 'tool sos')}
        {k('✕', () => window.ather.keyboardSet(false), 'tool')}
      </div>
      {LAYOUTS[layout].map((row, r) => (
        <div className="row" key={`${layout}${r}`}>
          {r === 3 && layout === 'en' && k('⇧', () => setShift(!shift), `wide ${shift ? 'on' : ''}`)}
          {row.map((ch) => k(shift && layout === 'en' ? ch.toUpperCase() : ch, () => type(ch)))}
          {r === 3 && k('⌫', () => keys('backspace', '⌫'), 'wide')}
        </div>
      ))}
      <div className="row">
        {k('Ctrl+Z', () => keys('ctrl+z', 'Ctrl+Z'), 'tool')}
        {k('Copy', () => keys('ctrl+c', 'Copy'), 'tool')}
        {k('Paste', () => keys('ctrl+v', 'Paste'), 'tool')}
        {k('Space', () => type(' '), 'space')}
        {k('⏎', () => keys('enter', '⏎'), 'wide')}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<Keyboard />);
```

### src/main/services/sos.js

```javascript
// Emergency SOS for people who may not be able to reach a phone: a short countdown (so a misheard word can be undone),
// then a loud alarm with a full-screen "I need help" sign, and an email to the caregivers saved on the Accessibility page.
// The optional check-in asks "Are you okay?" after a long silence and raises the alarm if nobody answers.
import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';

// The mail account connected in Inbox (IMAP) also sends: the matching SMTP servers.
const SMTP = { 'imap.gmail.com': 'smtp.gmail.com', 'outlook.office365.com': 'smtp.office365.com', 'imap.mail.yahoo.com': 'smtp.mail.yahoo.com' };
export const SOS_DEFAULTS = { contacts: [], phones: [], name: '', note: '', shareLocation: false, daily: { on: false, time: '20:00' }, checkin: { on: false, camera: false, hours: 3, from: '08:00', to: '22:00' }, medical: {} };

// Medical ID: what a caregiver or paramedic needs first. Shown on the help sign and sent with the SOS email.
export const MEDICAL_FIELDS = [['blood', 'Blood group'], ['allergies', 'Allergies'], ['conditions', 'Conditions'], ['medicines', 'Medicines'], ['doctor', 'Doctor']];
/** "Blood group: O+" lines for the fields that are filled in (exported for tests). */
export const medicalLines = (medical) => MEDICAL_FIELDS.filter(([k]) => String(medical?.[k] ?? '').trim()).map(([k, label]) => `${label}: ${String(medical[k]).trim()}`);

/** The email caregivers get (exported for tests). */
export function sosEmail({ name, note, reason, at, location, medical }) {
  const who = name || 'Your contact';
  const when = at.toLocaleString('en-IN', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  return {
    subject: `SOS: ${who} needs help`,
    text: `${who} asked for help through Maya (${reason}) on ${when}.\n\n`
      + 'Please call or go to them now. An alarm is sounding on their computer and a "I need help" sign is on the screen.'
      + (location ? `\n\nApproximate location (from the internet connection, may be a few km off): ${location}` : '')
      + (note ? `\n\nNote from ${who}: ${note}` : '')
      + (medicalLines(medical).length ? `\n\nMedical ID:\n${medicalLines(medical).map((l) => `- ${l}`).join('\n')}` : '') + '\n\nSent automatically by Maya.',
  };
}

/** Rough location from the internet address, only when the user allowed it; null when offline. */
export async function approxLocation(fetchFn = fetch) {
  try {
    const j = await (await fetchFn('https://ipapi.co/json/', { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000) })).json();
    if (!j.city) return null;
    return `${[j.city, j.region, j.country_name].filter(Boolean).join(', ')} — map: https://maps.google.com/?q=${j.latitude},${j.longitude}`;
  } catch { return null; }
}

/** The evening "I'm okay" email to caregivers (exported for tests). */
export function dailyEmail({ name, at, summary, care }) {
  const who = name || 'Your contact';
  const day = at.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' });
  const meds = care.length ? care.map((c) => `- ${c.text}: ${c.confirmed_at ? 'taken ✓' : c.fired_at ? 'NOT confirmed' : 'later today'}`).join('\n') : '- No medicine reminders today.';
  return {
    subject: `Daily update: ${who}, ${day}`,
    text: `Hello,\n\nThis is ${who}'s daily update from Maya.\n\nMedicines and care:\n${meds}\n\nToday: ${summary || 'Maya was not used much today.'}\n\nNo help was asked for. If anything looks wrong, please give ${who} a call.\n\nSent automatically by Maya.`,
  };
}

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
export const validPhone = (n) => /^\+?[0-9][0-9 ()-]{2,19}$/.test(String(n).trim());

/**
 * A phone call through Windows Phone Link (the user's paired phone): open tel:, then press its Call button.
 * pc is the PC helper; open(url) is shell.openExternal.
 */
export async function phoneCall({ pc, open, number, tries = 12 }) {
  if (!validPhone(number)) return { error: `"${number}" is not a phone number.` };
  const tel = String(number).replace(/[^0-9+]/g, '');
  await open(`tel:${tel}`);
  for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) {
    await sleep(1000);
    const fg = await pc.foreground().catch(() => null);
    if (!/phone ?link|your ?phone|PhoneExperienceHost/i.test(`${fg?.process} ${fg?.title}`)) continue;
    const call = (await pc.elements().catch(() => [])).find((e) => /^(call|dial)\b/i.test(e.name || ''));
    if (call) { await pc.invoke(call.i); return { calling: tel }; }
  }
  return { error: 'Phone Link did not start the call. Pair your phone in the Phone Link app once.' };
}

/**
 * onState({ state: 'countdown' | 'alarm' | 'cancelled' | 'off', seconds, reason, sent, error }) drives the SOS window and the face.
 * transport: a nodemailer transport (tests pass a JSON one).
 */
export function createSos({ store, secrets, onState = () => {}, transport, call = null, countdownMs = 10_000, locate = approxLocation }) {
  let pending = null;
  const settings = () => ({ ...SOS_DEFAULTS, ...store.getSetting('sos', SOS_DEFAULTS) });
  // The SOS screen shows these even while Maya is PIN-locked, so they travel with each state.
  const who = () => ({ name: settings().name, note: settings().note, medical: medicalLines(settings().medical) });
  const log = (entry) => store.setSetting('sosLog', [{ at: new Date().toISOString(), ...entry }, ...store.getSetting('sosLog', [])].slice(0, 30));

  async function email(reason, { test = false, message = null } = {}) {
    const { contacts, name, note, shareLocation, medical } = settings();
    if (!contacts.length) return { sent: 0, error: 'No caregiver email is saved (Accessibility page).' };
    const cfg = store.getSetting('mail');
    const pass = secrets.get('mail-password');
    if (!transport && (!cfg?.user || !pass)) return { sent: 0, error: 'Email is not connected (Inbox page), so no email could be sent.' };
    const mailer = transport || nodemailer.createTransport({ host: SMTP[cfg.host] || cfg.host.replace(/^imap\./, 'smtp.'), port: 465, secure: true, auth: { user: cfg.user, pass } });
    const msg = message || sosEmail({ name, note, reason, at: new Date(), location: shareLocation && !test ? await locate() : null, medical });
    await mailer.sendMail({ from: cfg?.user || 'ather@localhost', to: contacts.join(', '), subject: test ? `Test: ${msg.subject}` : msg.subject,
      text: test ? `This is only a test of Maya's emergency button. Nothing is wrong.\n\n---\n${msg.text}` : msg.text });
    return { sent: contacts.length };
  }

  async function fire() {
    const { reason } = pending;
    pending = null;
    onState({ state: 'alarm', reason, ...who() });
    // The call and the email go out together; the first saved phone number is called.
    const phone = settings().phones?.[0];
    const [result, rang] = await Promise.all([
      email(reason).catch((e) => ({ sent: 0, error: e.message })),
      phone && call ? call(phone).catch((e) => ({ error: e.message })) : { error: 'No emergency phone number is saved (Accessibility page).' },
    ]);
    Object.assign(result, { calling: rang.calling, call_error: rang.error });
    log({ event: 'alarm', reason, ...result });
    onState({ state: 'alarm', reason, ...who(), ...result });
    return result;
  }

  return {
    get pending() { return !!pending; },
    /** Starts the countdown; a check-in waits longer for an answer. */
    trigger(reason = 'asked for help', { ms = countdownMs } = {}) {
      if (pending) return { already: true };
      pending = { reason, timer: setTimeout(fire, ms) };
      onState({ state: 'countdown', seconds: Math.round(ms / 1000), reason, ...who() });
      return { countdown: Math.round(ms / 1000) };
    },
    cancel() {
      if (!pending) return false;
      clearTimeout(pending.timer);
      log({ event: 'cancelled', reason: pending.reason });
      pending = null;
      onState({ state: 'cancelled' });
      return true;
    },
    stopAlarm() { onState({ state: 'off' }); },
    test: () => email('test from the Accessibility page', { test: true }),
    testCall: () => (settings().phones?.[0] && call ? call(settings().phones[0]) : { error: 'Save a phone number first.' }),
    /** A quiet alert to caregivers (no alarm), e.g. a medicine not confirmed. */
    notify: (reason) => email(reason).then((r) => { log({ event: 'notice', reason, ...r }); return r; }),
    /** Once a day at the chosen time (if switched on): the "I'm okay" update. summary() and care() are read only when it is sent. */
    async dailyTick({ summary, care, at = new Date() }) {
      const { daily, name } = settings();
      const today = at.toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
      if (!daily?.on || at.toTimeString().slice(0, 5) < daily.time || store.getSetting('sosDailyLast', '') === today) return null;
      store.setSetting('sosDailyLast', today);
      const r = await email('daily update', { message: dailyEmail({ name, at, summary: summary(), care: care() }) }).catch((e) => ({ sent: 0, error: e.message }));
      log({ event: 'daily update', reason: 'evening update', ...r });
      return r;
    },
    settings,
    /** Call every minute: asks "Are you okay?" when the user has been silent for too long inside the set hours. */
    checkIn(idleSeconds, date = new Date()) {
      const { checkin } = settings();
      const hhmm = date.toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
      if (!checkin.on || pending || hhmm < checkin.from || hhmm > checkin.to || idleSeconds < checkin.hours * 3600) return false;
      this.trigger('did not answer an "are you okay?" check-in', { ms: 120_000 });
      return true;
    },
  };
}
```

### src/main/services/telegram.js

```javascript
// Talk to Maya from your phone through your own Telegram bot (free). Off until the user pastes a bot token from
// @BotFather; the token is kept encrypted (secrets). The first chat that sends the 6-digit code shown in Maya becomes
// the owner, and every other chat is ignored without a reply. From the phone Maya answers and does safe things
// (tasks, reminders, notes, questions); anything that needs an approval card is refused: approve it on the PC.
import { randomInt } from 'node:crypto';

const API = 'https://api.telegram.org/bot';
const LIMIT = 4096; // Telegram's longest message

/** A long answer in Telegram-sized parts (exported for tests). */
export const splitMessage = (text) => {
  const parts = [];
  for (let s = String(text || '…'); s.length; s = s.slice(LIMIT)) parts.push(s.slice(0, LIMIT));
  return parts;
};

const newCode = () => String(randomInt(100000, 1000000));

export function createTelegram({ store, secrets, answer, fetchFn = fetch, onChange = () => {} }) {
  const state = () => ({ ownerId: null, chat: '', code: '', bot: '', offset: 0, ...store.getSetting('telegram', {}) });
  const save = (patch) => { store.setSetting('telegram', { ...state(), ...patch }); onChange(); };
  let running = false, error = null;

  async function call(method, body = {}, token = secrets.get('telegram-token')) {
    const res = await fetchFn(`${API}${token}/${method}`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(40_000) });
    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (res.status === 401) throw Object.assign(new Error('Telegram no longer accepts the bot token: paste a new one from @BotFather.'), { unauthorized: true });
    if (!res.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(`Telegram: ${data.description || `error ${res.status}`}`);
    return data.result;
  }
  const send = async (chatId, text) => { for (const part of splitMessage(text)) await call('sendMessage', { chat_id: chatId, text: part }); };

  async function handle(msg) {
    const chatId = msg.chat?.id, text = String(msg.text || '').trim();
    if (!chatId || !text) return;
    const s = state();
    if (!s.ownerId) {
      if (text.replace(/^\/start\s*/, '') !== s.code) return send(chatId, 'Hi! To use me, send the 6-digit code shown in Maya on your PC (Connections → Telegram).');
      save({ ownerId: chatId, chat: msg.from?.first_name || 'you', code: '' });
      return send(chatId, '✅ Paired! I am Maya. Ask me anything, or tell me to add a task, a reminder or a note. Things that need your OK (mouse and keyboard, sending mail) must be approved on the PC.');
    }
    if (chatId !== s.ownerId) return; // strangers get nothing, not even a hint that the bot works
    const refused = [];
    let reply;
    try {
      reply = await answer(text, { confirm: async (req) => { refused.push(req.name); return false; } });
    } catch (e) { reply = `Sorry, that did not work: ${e.message}`; }
    if (refused.length) reply += `\n\n🔒 For safety, approve ${[...new Set(refused)].map((n) => n.replace(/_/g, ' ')).join(', ')} on the PC.`;
    await send(chatId, reply);
  }

  /** One round of long polling: handles every new message once; false when Telegram could not be reached. */
  async function pollOnce(timeout = 0) {
    if (!secrets.get('telegram-token')) return false;
    try {
      const updates = await call('getUpdates', { offset: state().offset, timeout, allowed_updates: ['message'] });
      for (const u of updates) {
        save({ offset: u.update_id + 1 }); // first: a message that crashes Maya is not retried forever
        if (u.message) await handle(u.message).catch(() => {});
      }
      error = null;
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      error = e.message;
      if (e.unauthorized) running = false;
      onChange();
      return false;
    }
  }

  return {
    status: () => { const s = state(); return { configured: !!secrets.get('telegram-token'), bot: s.bot, paired: !!s.ownerId, chat: s.chat, code: s.ownerId ? '' : s.code, running, error }; },
    /** Checks the token with Telegram, keeps it encrypted, and starts a fresh pairing. */
    async setToken(token) {
      token = String(token || '').trim();
      let me;
      try { me = await call('getMe', {}, token); } catch { throw new Error('Telegram did not accept this token. Copy it again from @BotFather (it looks like 123456:ABC…).'); }
      secrets.set('telegram-token', token);
      save({ bot: me.username, ownerId: null, chat: '', code: newCode(), offset: 0 });
      error = null;
      return this.status();
    },
    /** A reminder to the paired phone; does nothing if not paired and never throws (it runs inside timers). */
    async notify(text) {
      const { ownerId } = state();
      if (ownerId && secrets.get('telegram-token')) await send(ownerId, text).catch(() => {});
    },
    forget() { this.stop(); secrets.set('telegram-token', null); store.setSetting('telegram', {}); error = null; onChange(); },
    pollOnce,
    start() {
      if (running || !secrets.get('telegram-token')) return;
      running = true;
      (async () => {
        // Offline or Telegram down: wait a little before trying again (a revoked token stops the loop).
        while (running) if (!(await pollOnce(25))) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5000));
      })();
    },
    stop() { running = false; },
  };
}
```

### src/renderer/sos.jsx

```jsx
// Full-screen emergency sign: a countdown first (so a misheard "help" can be undone), then a flashing
// "I need help" sign with a siren, so people nearby notice even if the person cannot call out.
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/** A rising and falling siren until stop() is called. */
function siren() {
  const ctx = new AudioContext();
  const osc = ctx.createOscillator(), gain = ctx.createGain(), lfo = ctx.createOscillator(), depth = ctx.createGain();
  osc.type = 'sawtooth'; osc.frequency.value = 760;
  lfo.frequency.value = 0.9; depth.gain.value = 260;
  lfo.connect(depth).connect(osc.frequency);
  gain.gain.value = 0.35;
  osc.connect(gain).connect(ctx.destination);
  osc.start(); lfo.start();
  return () => ctx.close();
}

function Sos() {
  const [s, setS] = useState(null);
  const [left, setLeft] = useState(0);
  const stopSiren = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => window.ather.onSos(setS), []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (s?.state !== 'countdown') return;
    setLeft(s.seconds);
    const t = setInterval(() => setLeft((n) => Math.max(0, n - 1)), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [s?.state, s?.seconds]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (s?.state === 'alarm' && !stopSiren.current) stopSiren.current = siren();
    return undefined;
  }, [s?.state]);
  useEffect(() => () => stopSiren.current?.(), []);
  if (!s) return null;

  if (s.state === 'countdown') {
    return (
      <div className="sos">
        <p>{s.reason?.startsWith('did not answer') ? 'Are you okay? Say "I\'m okay" or press the button.' : 'Getting help in'}</p>
        <div className="count" role="timer" aria-live="assertive">{left}</div>
        <p>Say <b>“cancel”</b> or <b>“வேண்டாம்”</b> if you are okay.</p>
        <button autoFocus onClick={() => window.ather.sosCancel()}>I'm okay — cancel</button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const stop = () => { stopSiren.current?.(); stopSiren.current = null; window.ather.sosStop(); };
  return (
    <div className="sos alarm" role="alert">
      <h1>I NEED HELP</h1>
      <div className="ta">எனக்கு உதவி தேவை</div>
      {s.name && <p>{s.name} needs help. Please come and check on them.</p>}
      {s.note && <p className="info">Note: {s.note}</p>}
      {s.medical?.length > 0 && <section className="medical" aria-label="Medical ID"><h2>MEDICAL ID</h2><ul>{s.medical.map((l) => <li key={l}>{l}</li>)}</ul></section>}
      {(s.calling || s.call_error) && <p className="info">{s.calling ? `📞 Calling ${s.calling}…` : `⚠ ${s.call_error}`}</p>}
      <p className="info">{s.sent ? `✓ ${s.sent} caregiver${s.sent > 1 ? 's were' : ' was'} emailed.` : s.error ? `⚠ ${s.error}` : 'Contacting caregivers…'}</p>
      <button autoFocus onClick={stop}>Help is here — stop the alarm</button>
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<Sos />);
```

### src/main/services/session.js

```javascript
// Work timer: "work for 2 hours, then shut down". When time is up Maya sums up the day, says goodbye,
// counts down a minute (cancel by voice or button) and shuts the PC down. Setting the timer is the approval.

// Times are stored as UTC ISO strings: "today" starts at local midnight, in UTC.
const today = () => new Date(new Date().setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)).toISOString();
const hm = (min) => (min >= 60 ? `${Math.floor(min / 60)} hour${min >= 120 ? 's' : ''}${min % 60 ? ` ${min % 60} minutes` : ''}` : `${min} minutes`);

/** One spoken paragraph about today: computer time, tasks, focus, emails (exported for tests and the briefing). */
export function daySummary(store, activity) {
  const a = activity?.summary();
  const done = store.get("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 1 AND completed_at >= ?", today()).n;
  const open = store.get('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 0').n;
  const focus = store.get('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(minutes), 0) AS m FROM focus_sessions WHERE deleted = 0 AND completed = 1 AND started_at >= ?', today()).m;
  const mail = store.getSetting('mailTriage', null)?.needs_you?.length || 0;
  const parts = [];
  if (a?.total_minutes) {
    const top = a.apps.filter((x) => x.minutes >= 5).slice(0, 3).map((x) => x.label);
    parts.push(`Today you worked ${hm(a.productive_minutes)}${a.distracting_minutes ? ` and spent ${hm(a.distracting_minutes)} on distractions` : ''}${top.length ? `, mostly in ${top.join(', ')}` : ''}.`);
  }
  parts.push(`You finished ${done} task${done === 1 ? '' : 's'}${open ? ` and ${open} ${open === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} still open` : ''}.`);
  if (focus) parts.push(`${hm(focus)} of focus time.`);
  if (mail) parts.push(`${mail} email${mail === 1 ? '' : 's'} still need${mail === 1 ? 's' : ''} you.`);
  return parts.join(' ');
}

/**
 * onState({ state: 'running' | 'goodbye' | 'off', ends, task, summary, title, seconds }) drives the notch.
 * power(action) shuts the PC down (tests pass a fake). clock() is Date.now (tests pass a fake).
 */
export function createSession({ store, activity, power, onState = () => {}, clock = Date.now, countdownMs = 60_000 }) {
  let goodbye = null; // { at } while counting down to shutdown
  const saved = () => store.getSetting('workSession', null);
  const title = () => store.getSetting('userTitle', 'boss');
  const off = () => { store.setSetting('workSession', null); goodbye = null; onState({ state: 'off' }); };

  return {
    status() {
      const s = saved();
      if (!s) return { running: false };
      return { running: true, task: s.task, ends: new Date(s.ends).toISOString(), minutes_left: Math.max(0, Math.round((s.ends - clock()) / 60_000)), shutdown: s.shutdown, saying_goodbye: !!goodbye };
    },
    start(minutes, task = 'work', shutdown = true) {
      if (!(minutes > 0 && minutes <= 12 * 60)) throw new Error('A work timer is 1 minute to 12 hours.');
      const s = { ends: clock() + minutes * 60_000, task, shutdown };
      store.setSetting('workSession', s);
      goodbye = null;
      onState({ state: 'running', ...this.status() });
      return { ...this.status(), note: shutdown ? 'The PC shuts down when it ends, after a 1 minute warning.' : 'Maya will tell you when it ends.' };
    },
    /** "I'm still working": more time, the shutdown stays planned. */
    extend(minutes = 15) {
      const s = saved();
      if (!s) return { running: false };
      store.setSetting('workSession', { ...s, ends: Math.max(s.ends, clock()) + minutes * 60_000 });
      goodbye = null;
      onState({ state: 'running', ...this.status() });
      return this.status();
    },
    cancel() { const was = !!saved(); off(); return { cancelled: was }; },
    /** Every few seconds from main: time up → goodbye; goodbye over → shut down. */
    async tick() {
      const s = saved();
      if (!s || clock() < s.ends) return null;
      // Ended long ago (the PC was off or asleep): never shut down a PC the user has just switched on.
      if (!goodbye && clock() - s.ends > 10 * 60_000) { off(); return 'expired'; }
      if (!s.shutdown) { onState({ state: 'done', task: s.task, summary: daySummary(store, activity), title: title() }); off(); return 'done'; }
      if (!goodbye) {
        goodbye = { at: clock() + countdownMs };
        onState({ state: 'goodbye', task: s.task, summary: daySummary(store, activity), title: title(), seconds: Math.round(countdownMs / 1000) });
        return 'goodbye';
      }
      if (clock() < goodbye.at) return null;
      off();
      await power('shutdown');
      return 'shutdown';
    },
  };
}
```

### src/main/services/chatbots.js

```javascript
// "Ask ChatGPT / ask Claude …" for people who cannot type: open the prompt in the user's own browser (where they
// are signed in), send it, wait until the answer stops growing, and hand the answer back to be read aloud.
// A human check ("verify you are human") is never answered by Maya: the user is told instead.

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

export const SITES = {
  chatgpt: { name: 'ChatGPT', url: (q) => `https://chatgpt.com/?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`, title: /chatgpt/i, footer: /ChatGPT (is AI and )?can make mistakes[\s\S]*$/i },
  claude: { name: 'Claude', url: (q) => `https://claude.ai/new?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`, title: /claude/i, footer: /Claude (is AI and )?can make mistakes[\s\S]*$/i },
};

const sent = (page, prompt) => page.split(prompt.trim().slice(0, 60)).length - 1;

/**
 * The answer in the page text: what follows the user's sent message, up to the site's footer (exported for tests).
 * The prompt can also still sit in the text box further down; the first copy is the sent one.
 */
export function answerIn(page, prompt, site) {
  const key = prompt.trim().slice(0, 60);
  const at = page.indexOf(key);
  if (at < 0) return '';
  const after = page.slice(at + key.length).replace(prompt.trim().slice(60), '');
  const footer = after.search(SITES[site].footer);
  return (footer >= 0 ? after.slice(0, footer) : '').replace(/￼/g, '')
    .replace(/^\s*(ChatGPT said:|Claude said:|Copy|Copy response|Edit|Retry|Good response|Bad response|Share|More actions|Read aloud)\s*$/gim, '').trim().slice(0, 4000);
}

/** pc: the PC helper; open(url) opens the user's default browser. */
export async function askChatbot({ pc, open, site, prompt, timeoutMs = 120_000, poll = 2000 }) {
  const s = SITES[site];
  if (!s) throw new Error('site must be chatgpt or claude');
  await open(s.url(prompt));
  // Wait for the browser to show the site.
  let fg;
  for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) { await sleep(1000); fg = await pc.foreground(); if (s.title.test(fg.title)) break; }
  if (!s.title.test(fg?.title || '')) return { site: s.name, error: `${s.name} did not open in the browser.` };
  const start = Date.now();
  let last = '', same = 0, pressed = false;
  while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {
    await sleep(poll);
    const page = String(await pc.readText().catch(() => ''));
    if (/verify you are human|are you a robot|captcha/i.test(page)) return { site: s.name, error: `${s.name} is asking to check that you are human. Please do that on the screen, then ask again.` };
    // The sign-in buttons show before the question does, so only give up once the question never appeared.
    if (Date.now() - start > 15_000 && /log ?in|sign ?up|continue with google/i.test(page) && !page.includes(prompt.slice(0, 30))) return { site: s.name, error: `Please sign in to ${s.name} in your browser once, then ask again.` };
    const answer = answerIn(page, prompt, site);
    if (/temporarily experiencing issues|something went wrong|network error|too many requests/i.test(answer)) return { site: s.name, error: `${s.name} says: ${answer.split('\n')[0]}` };
    // The prompt is only in the box, not sent yet (Claude only fills it in): press Enter once.
    if (!answer && !pressed && sent(page, prompt) < 2 && Date.now() - start > 5000) { await pc.activate(fg.hwnd); await pc.keys('{ENTER}'); pressed = true; continue; }
    same = answer && answer === last ? same + 1 : 0;
    last = answer;
    if (same >= 2 && answer.length > 2) return { site: s.name, answer };
  }
  return last ? { site: s.name, answer: last, note: 'It may still be writing; this is what it had so far.' } : { site: s.name, error: `No answer from ${s.name} within ${timeoutMs / 1000} seconds.` };
}
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { startRecording } from './audio.js';

/** 🎤 next to a text field: press, speak, press again; the words are added to the field. For people who cannot type. */
export default function MicButton({ onText, label = 'Speak instead of typing' }) {
  const [recorder, setRecorder] = useState(null);
  async function toggle() {
    if (!recorder) { try { setRecorder(await startRecording()); } catch { /* no microphone */ } return; }
    const audio = await recorder.stop();
    setRecorder(null);
    if (audio.length >= 16000 * 0.3) onText((await window.ather.transcribe(audio)).trim());
  }
  return <button type="button" className={`btn small mic ${recorder ? 'primary' : ''}`} onClick={toggle} aria-label={recorder ? 'Stop and use what I said' : label} title={label}>{recorder ? '⏹' : '🎤'}</button>;
}
```

```jsx
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Face from './shared/Face.jsx';
import Setup from './app/Setup.jsx';
import Home from './app/Home.jsx';
import Chat from './app/Chat.jsx';
import Tasks from './app/Tasks.jsx';
import Notes from './app/Notes.jsx';
import Habits from './app/Habits.jsx';
import Focus from './app/Focus.jsx';
import Calendar from './app/Calendar.jsx';
import Inbox from './app/Inbox.jsx';
import Search from './app/Search.jsx';
import Images from './app/Images.jsx';
import Settings from './app/Settings.jsx';
import Study from './app/Study.jsx';
import Activity from './app/Activity.jsx';
import Models from './app/Models.jsx';
import Mcp from './app/Mcp.jsx';
import Workflows from './app/Workflows.jsx';
import Accessibility from './app/Accessibility.jsx';
import Skills from './app/Skills.jsx';
import Monitor from './app/Monitor.jsx';
import Agent from './app/Agent.jsx';
import Connections from './app/Connections.jsx';
import Brain from './app/Brain.jsx';
import Approvals from './shared/Approvals.jsx';
import LockScreen, { useLocked } from './shared/LockScreen.jsx';
import './shared/base.css';
import './app.css';

const SECTIONS = [
  ['home', 'Home', '🏠', Home],
  ['chat', 'Chat', '💬', Chat],
  ['accessibility', 'Accessibility', '♿', Accessibility],
  ['brain', 'Brain', '🧠', Brain],
  ['agent', 'My Maya', '🤖', Agent],
  ['connections', 'Connections', '🔗', Connections],
  ['skills', 'Skills', '✨', Skills],
  ['monitor', 'Work monitor', '🛠', Monitor],
  ['tasks', 'Tasks', '✅', Tasks],
  ['notes', 'Notes', '📝', Notes],
  ['habits', 'Habits', '🔁', Habits],
  ['focus', 'Focus', '⏱', Focus],
  ['study', 'Study', '🎓', Study],
  ['workflows', 'Workflows', '🔀', Workflows],
  ['activity', 'Activity', '📊', Activity],
  ['calendar', 'Calendar', '📅', Calendar],
  ['inbox', 'Inbox', '✉️', Inbox],
  ['search', 'Smart search', '🔎', Search],
  ['images', 'Image tools', '🖼', Images],
  ['models', 'AI models', '🧠', Models],
  ['mcp', 'Connected tools', '🔌', Mcp],
  ['settings', 'Settings', '⚙️', Settings],
];

function App() {
  const [section, setSection] = useState(location.hash.slice(1) || 'home');
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0); // bumps when data changes so screens reload

  useEffect(() => {
    const offs = [
      window.ather.onSection(setSection),
      window.ather.onDataChanged(() => setVersion((v) => v + 1)),
    ];
    return () => offs.forEach((off) => off());
  }, []);
  // Hidden pages and Maya's own name (My Maya).
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState([]);
  const [myName, setMyName] = useState('Maya');
  useEffect(() => {
    window.ather.getSetting('ui', {}).then((ui) => setHidden(ui?.hidePages || []));
    window.ather.getSetting('agent', {}).then((a) => setMyName(a?.name || 'Maya'));
    return window.ather.onSettingsChanged((key, value) => {
      if (key === 'ui') setHidden(value?.hidePages || []);
      if (key === 'agent') setMyName(value?.name || 'Maya');
    });
  }, []);

  const locked = useLocked();
  if (locked) return <LockScreen />;

  // "chat:12" opens section chat with argument 12 (a conversation id).
  const [name, arg] = section.split(':');
  if (name === 'setup') return <Setup onDone={() => setSection('home')} />;
  const Current = SECTIONS.find(([id]) => id === name)?.[3] || Home;

  return (
    <div className="shell">
      <nav className="sidebar" aria-label="Sections">
        <div className="brand"><Face size={40} mood="happy" /><span>{myName}</span></div>
        {SECTIONS.filter(([id]) => !hidden.includes(id) || name === id).map(([id, label, icon]) => (
          <button key={id} className={`nav ${name === id ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => setSection(id)} aria-current={name === id ? 'page' : undefined}>
            <span className="nav-icon" aria-hidden>{icon}</span>{label}
          </button>
        ))}
        <div className="sidebar-foot">Hover the top of your screen or press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Space</kbd></div>
      </nav>
      <main className="content">
        <Current version={version} go={setSection} arg={arg} />
      </main>
      <div className="approvals-dock"><Approvals /></div>
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<App />);
```
