```css
.suggestion:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); }
.followups { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }
.suggestion.small { padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.chat-log { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; }
.msg { max-width: 85%; padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 18px; }
.msg.user { align-self: flex-end; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border-bottom-right-radius: 5px; white-space: pre-wrap; }
.msg.assistant { align-self: flex-start; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom-left-radius: 5px; width: 85%; }
.msg-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; }
.msg-actions button { border: 0; background: var(--paper); border-radius: 7px; padding: 3px 9px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
.msg-actions button:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.model-tag { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-faint); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.reasoning { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--paper); border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.reasoning summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
.reasoning div { white-space: pre-wrap; max-height: 220px; overflow-y: auto; margin-top: 6px; }
.composer-box { margin: 0 6% 18px; max-width: 860px; align-self: center; width: 88%; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(40, 24, 110, .07); padding: 8px 10px; }
.composer-input { width: 100%; border: 0; resize: none; outline: none; padding: 6px; max-height: 200px; background: none; }
.composer-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.composer-bar .icon { border: 0; background: none; border-radius: 9px; width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 16px; }
.composer-bar .icon:hover { background: var(--paper); }
.composer-bar .icon.rec { background: var(--bad); animation: pulse 1s infinite; }
.mode-pick { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 8px; background: var(--card); max-width: 320px; }
.attach-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 4px 8px; align-items: center; }
.attach-row .x { border: 0; background: none; padding: 0 0 0 4px; }
.thumb.small { width: 42px; height: 42px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: none; }
.thumb.small img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.approvals-dock { position: fixed; right: 24px; bottom: 110px; width: min(520px, 60vw); z-index: 20; }
.approvals-dock .approval { background: var(--card); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.checker { background: repeating-conic-gradient(#ccc 0% 25%, #fff 0% 50%) 0 0 / 16px 16px; }
.transcript { margin-top: 12px; max-height: 260px; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--paper); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }
.rec-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bad); animation: pulse 1s infinite; display: inline-block; }
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.split-bar { display: flex; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--paper); margin: 4px 0 10px; }
.seg.good { background: var(--good); }
.seg.bad { background: var(--bad); }
.week-chart { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-end; }
.week-col { flex: 1; text-align: center; }
.week-col .bars { display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; justify-content: flex-start; background: var(--paper); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
.table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
.table th, .table td { text-align: left; padding: 7px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.table th { color: var(--ink-soft); font-weight: 600; }
.provider { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.swatch { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--line); padding: 0; }
.swatch.on { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }

/* Study */
.quiz-option { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--card); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; margin: 6px 0; }
.quiz-option:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent); }
.quiz-option.right { border-color: var(--good); background: var(--good-soft); }
.quiz-option.wrong { border-color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-soft); }
.flashcard { min-height: 220px; display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; font-size: 20px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--card); cursor: pointer; width: 100%; }
.flashcard.back { background: var(--accent-soft); }

.compare { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.compare img { width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--card); }
.code { font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; user-select: all; }
.ok { color: var(--good); font-weight: 600; }
.bad { color: var(--bad); font-weight: 600; }
.setup { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 40px 24px; }
.setup-hero { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 26px; }

/* Workflows: steps as connected nodes, coloured by their real state */
.wf-graph { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; row-gap: 10px; margin: 10px 0; }
.wf-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.wf-link { width: 26px; height: 2px; background: var(--line); position: relative; }
.wf-link.on { background: var(--accent); }
.wf-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: -1px; top: -4px; border: 5px solid transparent; border-right: 0; border-left-color: var(--line); }
.wf-link.on::after { border-left-color: var(--accent); }
.wf-node { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; min-width: 120px; max-width: 190px; padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line); background: var(--card); color: var(--ink); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s, transform .2s; }
.wf-node:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
.wf-node.picked { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }
.wf-node b { font-size: 13px; text-transform: capitalize; }
.wf-node small { color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 11px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; max-width: 165px; }
.wf-state { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-soft); }
.wf-node.s-running { border-color: var(--accent); animation: wf-glow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.wf-node.s-running .wf-state { display: inline-block; animation: spin-in-place 1s linear infinite; color: var(--accent); }
.wf-node.s-awaiting-approval { border-color: #e0a100; animation: wf-glow 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.wf-node.s-completed { border-color: var(--good); }
.wf-node.s-completed .wf-state { color: var(--good); }
.wf-node.s-failed { border-color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-soft); }
.wf-node.s-failed .wf-state { color: var(--bad); }
.wf-node.s-cancelled { opacity: .55; border-style: dashed; }
.badge.s-running { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.badge.s-completed { color: var(--good); }
.badge.s-failed { background: var(--bad-soft); color: var(--bad); }
.wf-run, .wf-saved { padding: 10px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.wf-run .row, .wf-saved .row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.wf-detail { background: var(--paper); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px; font-size: 12px; max-height: 220px; overflow: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; }
.wf-edit .item .input:first-child { width: 220px; flex: none; }
.mono { font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; }
@keyframes wf-glow { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-soft); } }
@keyframes spin-in-place { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .wf-node, .wf-node .wf-state { animation: none !important; } }
[data-motion='off'] .wf-node, [data-motion='off'] .wf-node .wf-state { animation: none !important; }

/* Exam countdown and weekly timetable */
.exam-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.exam { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper); }
.exam.soon { border-color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-soft); }
.exam-days { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; color: var(--accent); }
.exam.soon .exam-days { color: var(--bad); }
.exam-label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-faint); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.exam .btn { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; padding: 2px 7px; }
.timetable { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
.tt-day { background: var(--paper); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px; min-height: 90px; }
.tt-day.today { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); }
.tt-day h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-soft); }
.tt-class { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 13px; }
.tt-class small { color: var(--ink-faint); font-size: 11px; }
.tt-x { position: absolute; top: 2px; right: 3px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink-faint); cursor: pointer; opacity: 0; }
.tt-class:hover .tt-x, .tt-x:focus-visible { opacity: 1; }

/* This PC meters */
.meters { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: 12px 20px; margin: 8px 0; }
.meter small { font-size: 12px; }
.meter-bar { height: 8px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--paper); overflow: hidden; margin-top: 5px; }
.meter-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--accent); transition: width .6s ease; }
.meter-bar span.warm { background: #e0a100; }
.meter-bar span.hot { background: var(--bad); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .meter-bar span { transition: none; } }

/* Face shape picker */
.shape-pick { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--card); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; }
.shape-pick.on { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }
.shape-pick span { font-size: 12px; }

/* Accessibility page */
.a11y-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(380px, 1fr)); align-items: start; }
.cmds { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; }
.cmds td { padding: 5px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); vertical-align: top; }
.sos-panel { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 45%, var(--line)); }
.big-sos { font-size: 18px; padding: 14px 26px; background: var(--bad); color: #fff; border-color: var(--bad); }
.pair-code { display: inline-block; margin-top: 8px; font: 700 32px/1.2 ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 6px; padding: 6px 14px; border: 2px dashed var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius); }
.steps { margin: 0 0 8px; padding-left: 20px; }
.medical-id { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 8px 14px 2px; margin: 6px 0 10px; }
.medical-id legend { padding: 0 6px; font-weight: 600; }
.medical-id .small-print { font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
.medical-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 0 12px; }

/* Large and high-contrast mode: bigger everything, strong outlines, clearer text */
body { zoom: var(--ui-zoom, 1); }
[data-a11y='large'] body { zoom: calc(1.2 * var(--ui-zoom, 1)); }
/* Compact spacing (My Maya → Look): more fits on the screen. */
[data-density='compact'] .panel { padding: 12px 14px; }
[data-density='compact'] .item { padding-top: 5px; padding-bottom: 5px; }
[data-density='compact'] .grid { gap: 10px; }
[data-a11y='large'] { --ink-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 85%, transparent); --ink-faint: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 70%, transparent);
  --line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 35%, transparent); }
[data-a11y='large'] .btn, [data-a11y='large'] .input, [data-a11y='large'] select { min-height: 44px; }
[data-a11y='large'] :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent) !important; outline-offset: 2px; }
/* Brain page: a mind map that glows while Maya works. */
.brain-map svg { display: block; max-height: 64vh; }
.brain-map .link { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-opacity: .35; stroke-width: 2; }
.brain-map .link.thin { stroke-width: 1; stroke-opacity: .25; }
.brain-map .node { fill: var(--accent-soft); stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 2; transition: all .4s; }
.brain-map .node-text { font-size: 22px; }
.brain-map .node-label { font-size: 12px; fill: var(--ink-soft, #888); font-weight: 600; }
.brain-map .leaf { fill: var(--accent); opacity: .6; }
.brain-map .leaf-text { font-size: 12px; fill: var(--ink, #222); }
.brain-map .hit .leaf { fill: #ffb703; opacity: 1; r: 8; }
.brain-map .hit .leaf-text { font-weight: 700; fill: #ff8800; }
.brain-map .core { fill: var(--accent); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px var(--accent)); transition: filter .4s; }
.brain-map .core-text { fill: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; }
.brain-map .branch.lit .node { fill: var(--accent); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px var(--accent)); }
.brain-map .branch.lit .link { stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-width: 3; animation: synapse .6s linear infinite; stroke-dasharray: 8 6; }
.brain-map .core.lit { animation: brainpulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes synapse { to { stroke-dashoffset: -28; } }
@keyframes brainpulse { 50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 26px var(--accent)); } }
[data-motion='off'] .brain-map * { animation: none !important; }
/* Quick actions: big targets for head mouse, dwell and switch users. */
.quick-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(215px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.quick-btn { min-height: 64px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; white-space: normal; }

/* ---------- 1.8.2 look: one listening hero, quieter everything else ---------- */
.content { background:
  radial-gradient(900px 420px at 85% -120px, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent), transparent 70%),
  var(--paper); }
.sidebar .nav { position: relative; min-height: 40px; }
.sidebar .nav.active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -10px; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 4px; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: var(--accent); }
.brand { letter-spacing: -.02em; }

.hero { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 26px; margin: 0 0 18px; padding: 26px 30px; border-radius: 22px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, var(--line));
  background:
    radial-gradient(120% 140% at 0% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 16%, transparent), transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(90% 120% at 100% 100%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 14%, transparent), transparent 60%),
    var(--card); }
.hero-face { position: relative; flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 132px; height: 132px; }
.hero-face::before, .hero-face::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent); opacity: 0; }
.hero-face.listening::before { animation: halo 3.2s ease-out infinite; }
.hero-face.listening::after { animation: halo 3.2s ease-out 1.6s infinite; }
@keyframes halo { 0% { transform: scale(.72); opacity: .9; } 100% { transform: scale(1.18); opacity: 0; } }
.hero-title { font-size: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px); line-height: 1.08; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.03em; margin: 0 0 6px; }
.hero-sub { font-size: 17px; color: var(--ink-soft); margin: 0 0 14px; max-width: 60ch; }
.hero-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.hero-chips li { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--card) 70%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
@media (max-width: 720px) { .hero { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; padding: 22px 18px; } .hero-chips { justify-content: center; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .hero-face.listening::before, .hero-face.listening::after { animation: none; opacity: .5; transform: scale(1); } }
[data-motion='subtle'] .hero-face.listening::after { animation: none; }

.quick-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; justify-content: flex-start; text-align: left; padding: 12px 14px; transition: border-color .15s, background .15s; }
.quick-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, var(--card)); }
.quick-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }
.quick-icon { flex: none; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 21px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 13%, var(--card)); }
.quick-btn.sos .quick-icon { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bad) 15%, var(--card)); }
.stat { color: var(--accent-ink); }
```

### src/renderer/shared/base.css

```css
﻿:root {
  --ink: #1d1638;
  --ink-soft: #5d5778;
  --ink-faint: #8e89a6;
  --paper: #f6f4fb;
  --card: #ffffff;
  --line: #e6e2f2;
  --accent: #6c5cff;
  --accent-2: #a35cff;
  --accent-soft: #efecff;
  --good: #1f9d6b;
  --bad: #d64545;
  --accent-ink: #4a3ad6;
  --card-2: #fbfaff;
  --good-soft: #e8f7ef;
  --bad-soft: #fdecec;
  --warn-soft: #fff7e0;
  --warn-line: #ffe2a1;
  --warn-ink: #a35f00;
  --code-bg: #1d1638;
  --face-a: #6c5cff; /* face colours, set from the face style */
  --face-b: #a35cff;
  --radius: 14px;
  --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(40, 24, 110, 0.14);
  font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color-scheme: light;
}

/* Dark theme: near-black surfaces, the face turns black too. */
:root[data-theme='dark'] {
  --ink: #ececf1;
  --ink-soft: #b4b3c2;
  --ink-faint: #85849a;
  --paper: #0b0b0d;
  --card: #151518;
  --card-2: #111114;
  --line: #2a2a31;
  --accent: #8b7dff;
  --accent-2: #b48cff;
  --accent-soft: #24213d;
  --accent-ink: #c3bbff;
  --good: #3ccf8e;
  --bad: #ff6b6b;
  --good-soft: #10291e;
  --bad-soft: #331717;
  --warn-soft: #2b2312;
  --warn-line: #4d3d14;
  --warn-ink: #ffc46b;
  --code-bg: #000;
  --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  color-scheme: dark;
}
body { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { margin: 0; }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
input, textarea, select { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

.chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-ink); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; margin: 2px 0; }
.chip-error { background: var(--bad-soft); color: var(--bad); }
.link { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--accent); text-align: left; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
.result-image { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 240px; border-radius: 12px; margin-top: 8px; cursor: zoom-in; }
.result-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 6px; }
.result-grid .result-image { margin-top: 0; width: 100%; max-height: none; aspect-ratio: auto; }
.result-list { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 13px; }
.result-list li { margin: 2px 0; }
.result-list em { color: var(--ink-faint); font-style: normal; }

.dots { display: flex; gap: 5px; padding: 6px 0; }
.dots span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); animation: dot 1s infinite ease-in-out; }
.dots span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .15s; }
.dots span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .3s; }
@keyframes dot { 0%, 80%, 100% { opacity: .25; transform: translateY(0); } 40% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-3px); } }

.pulse-ring { animation: pulse 1.2s infinite ease-in-out; transform-origin: center; }

/* Face life: breathing, tool gear, sweat drop, error shake, excited bounce. Driven by real state (mood). */
.face { overflow: visible; animation: breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 50% 90%; }
@keyframes breathe { 50% { transform: scale(1.025, 0.985); } }
.face .gear { animation: spin 1.6s linear infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: translate(101px, 20px) rotate(360deg); } }
/* Working moods: keys tapping, a progress bar filling, a lens scanning, a tick drawn. */
.face .key { animation: keytap 0.45s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes keytap { to { transform: translateY(2px); opacity: 0.35; } }
.face .progress { animation: build 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: left; }
@keyframes build { from { transform: scaleX(0.05); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } }
.face .lens { animation: scan 1.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes scan { from { transform: translate(-70px, -8px); } to { transform: translate(0, 0); } }
.face .tick { stroke-dasharray: 30; animation: draw 1.2s ease-out infinite; }
@keyframes draw { from { stroke-dashoffset: 30; } 60%, to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
.face .sweat { animation: sweat 1.6s ease-in infinite; }
@keyframes sweat { 0% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(10px); opacity: 0; } }
.face-error { animation: shake .45s ease-in-out 2; }
@keyframes shake { 25% { transform: translateX(-4px); } 75% { transform: translateX(4px); } }
.face-excited, .face-celebrate { animation: bounce .6s ease-in-out 3; }
@keyframes bounce { 50% { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.04); } }
.face-worried { animation: tremble .25s ease-in-out infinite; }
/* Waiting for a spoken yes/no: a curious head tilt and a pulsing question mark. */
.face-ask { animation: tilt 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes tilt { 25% { transform: rotate(-5deg); } 75% { transform: rotate(4deg); } }
.face .ask-mark { animation: pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
/* Emergency: the face turns red, pulses, and a white "!" blinks. */
.face-sos { animation: sos-pulse .8s ease-in-out infinite; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255, 50, 70, .8)); }
@keyframes sos-pulse { 50% { transform: scale(1.06); } }
.face .sos-mark { animation: pulse .5s steps(2) infinite; }
/* Asleep after a long quiet time: slow breathing and floating Zzz. */
.face-sleep { animation: breathe 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.face .zzz text { animation: zzz 3s ease-in-out infinite; opacity: 0; }
.face .zzz text:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .8s; } .face .zzz text:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 1.6s; }
@keyframes zzz { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(0, 6px); } 30% { opacity: .9; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(6px, -8px); } }
/* Woken by "Hey Maya": a big stretch. */
.face-wake { animation: stretch .9s ease-out; }
@keyframes stretch { 30% { transform: scale(.94, 1.12); } 60% { transform: scale(1.08, .95); } }
/* Idle moments: a curious tilt, a yawn. */
.face-curious { animation: tilt 1.6s ease-in-out; }
.face-yawn { animation: yawn 1.6s ease-in-out; }
@keyframes yawn { 40% { transform: scale(1.03, .96); } }
/* Celebration confetti, voice ripples, the robot's antenna light. */
.face .confetti { animation: confetti 1.4s ease-in forwards; }
@keyframes confetti { from { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0); opacity: 1; } to { transform: translateY(105px) rotate(320deg); opacity: 0; } }
.face .ripple { transition: rx .12s linear, ry .12s linear; }
.face .antenna { animation: pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
/* A voice command was done: a quick double nod. */
.face-nod { animation: nod .32s ease-in-out 2; }
@keyframes nod { 50% { transform: translateY(5px) scale(1, .97); } }
@keyframes tremble { 50% { transform: translateX(.8px); } }

/* Glow follows what Maya is doing. */
.glow-think { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(139, 125, 255, .65)); }
.glow-working { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255, 209, 102, .7)); }
.glow-listen { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(56, 217, 169, .75)); }
.glow-speaking { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255, 143, 199, .6)); }
.glow-error { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255, 107, 107, .8)); }
.glow-happy, .glow-celebrate, .glow-excited { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(60, 207, 142, .55)); }
.face-wrap { transition: filter .4s; }

/* Voice waveform under the face while listening or speaking. */
.wave { display: flex; gap: 4px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 26px; }
.wave span { width: 5px; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(var(--face-a), var(--face-b)); transition: height 80ms; }

/* Animation intensity (Settings): subtle keeps state changes, drops idle motion; off stops all motion. */
[data-motion='subtle'] .face, [data-motion='subtle'] .face-worried { animation: none; }
[data-motion='off'] *, [data-motion='off'] *::before, [data-motion='off'] *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
@keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: .3; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }
.face-wave .wave-hand { animation: wave .5s 4 ease-in-out; transform-origin: 100px 90px; }
@keyframes wave { 50% { transform: rotate(-25deg); } }

.lock { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100; background: var(--paper); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; }
.lock.compact { position: static; padding: 8px 0; }
.lock .pin { width: 150px; text-align: center; letter-spacing: .4em; font-size: 18px; }
.approval { border: 2px solid var(--warn-line); background: var(--warn-soft); border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 12px; margin: 8px 0; }
.approval-body { max-height: 220px; overflow: auto; margin: 6px 0 8px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.agent-plan { background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 13px; }
.agent-plan ol { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 6px 0 0; }
.agent-plan li { margin: 3px 0; }
.agent-plan li.done { color: var(--ink-soft); }
.py-out { background: var(--code-bg); color: #e9e7ff; border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 12px; white-space: pre-wrap; max-height: 220px; overflow: auto; margin: 6px 0; }

/* Markdown answers */
.md { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.md > :first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.md > :last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.md p, .md ul, .md ol { margin: 0 0 .7em; }
.md li { margin: .2em 0; }
.md h1, .md h2, .md h3 { font-size: 1.08em; margin: 1em 0 .4em; }
.md a { color: var(--accent); }
.md code { font-family: Consolas, 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: .92em; background: var(--accent-soft); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 5px; }
.md pre { position: relative; background: var(--code-bg); color: #f2efff; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px; overflow-x: auto; margin: 0 0 .8em; }
.md pre code { background: none; padding: 0; color: inherit; }
.md table { border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0 0 .8em; font-size: .95em; display: block; overflow-x: auto; }
.md th, .md td { border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: normal; min-width: 90px; }
.md th { background: var(--paper); }
.md blockquote { margin: 0 0 .8em; padding-left: 12px; border-left: 3px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink-soft); }
.copy-code { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .15); color: #fff; font-size: 11.5px; padding: 3px 8px; }
.copy-code:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .3); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
}
/* 1.6.3: groove while music plays, hearts when thanked, notes */
:root:not([data-motion='off']) .face-groove { animation: groove 0.55s ease-in-out infinite alternate; transform-origin: 50% 90%; }
@keyframes groove { from { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-6deg); } to { transform: translateY(-5px) rotate(6deg); } }
.hearts path { animation: heart-rise 1.6s ease-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
@keyframes heart-rise { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) scale(.5); } 30% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-18px) scale(1.2); } }
.notes text { animation: heart-rise 1.4s ease-out infinite; }
.notes text:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .5s; }
[data-motion='off'] .hearts path, [data-motion='off'] .notes text { animation: none; }
/* Jarvis orb: the rings turn and the glow breathes (faster while working). */
.face.shape-orb .orb-rings { animation: orbspin 9s linear infinite; transform-box: view-box; transform-origin: 60px 50px; }
.face.shape-orb .orb-glow { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px #36e0ff); animation: orbglow 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
.face.shape-orb.face-working .orb-rings, .face.shape-orb.face-typing .orb-rings, .face.shape-orb.face-building .orb-rings,
.face.shape-orb.face-searching .orb-rings, .face.shape-orb.face-listen .orb-rings { animation-duration: 2.5s; }
@keyframes orbspin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes orbglow { 50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px #36e0ff); } }
[data-motion='off'] .face.shape-orb .orb-rings, [data-motion='off'] .face.shape-orb .orb-glow { animation: none; }
.face.shape-ghost .ghost-body { animation: ghostfloat 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes ghostfloat { 50% { transform: translateY(-3px); } }
[data-motion='off'] .face.shape-ghost .ghost-body { animation: none; }
```

### src/renderer/app/Chat.jsx

```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useAsk } from '../shared/useAsk.js';
import ToolResult from '../shared/ToolResult.jsx';
import Markdown from '../shared/Markdown.jsx';
import { AgentChecklist } from '../shared/Approvals.jsx';
import Face from '../shared/Face.jsx';
import { startRecording } from '../shared/audio.js';
import MicButton from '../shared/MicButton.jsx';

/** 👍 / 👎 on an answer. A 👎 asks what to do differently, and Maya follows that from now on. */
function Feedback({ question }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState(null); // null | 'good' | 'asking' | 'saved'
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const send = (good, text = '') => window.ather.feedback({ question, good, note: text }).then(() => setState(good ? 'good' : 'saved'));
  if (state === 'good') return <span className="muted">👍 Thanks!</span>;
  if (state === 'saved') return <span className="muted">✓ Maya will remember that</span>;
  if (state === 'asking') return (
    <form className="row" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); send(false, note); }}>
      <input className="input small" autoFocus value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="What should Maya do differently?" aria-label="What should Maya do differently?" />
      <MicButton onText={(t) => setNote((v) => `${v}${v ? ' ' : ''}${t}`)} />
      <button className="btn small primary">Save</button>
    </form>
  );
  return <>
    <button onClick={() => send(true)} title="Good answer" aria-label="Good answer">👍</button>
    <button onClick={() => setState('asking')} title="Bad answer" aria-label="Bad answer">👎</button>
  </>;
}
import { useData } from './useData.js';

const errText = (e) => e.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
const SUGGESTIONS = [
  'Explain normalization in DBMS with examples',
  'Make a 8-slide PPT on cloud computing',
  'Plot y = x² from -5 to 5 with Python',
  'Make a 7-day study plan for my operating systems exam',
];

export default function Chat({ version, arg }) {
  const conversations = useData(() => window.ather.conversations(), version);
  const modes = useData(() => window.ather.chatModes(), version);
  const allModels = useData(() => window.ather.chatModels(false), version);
  const [cid, setCid] = useState(arg ? Number(arg) : null);
  useEffect(() => { if (arg) setCid(Number(arg)); }, [arg]);
  const messages = useData(() => (cid ? window.ather.messages(cid) : Promise.resolve([])), version, [cid]);
  const docs = useData(() => (cid ? window.ather.documents(cid) : Promise.resolve([])), version, [cid]);
  const { turn, send, cancel, reset } = useAsk();
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [images, setImages] = useState([]);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('auto');
  const [busyDoc, setBusyDoc] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [recorder, setRecorder] = useState(null);
  const end = useRef(null);
  const heardRef = useRef(''); // what the mic heard, to learn the words the user corrects
  const fileRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => { window.ather.getSetting('chatMode', 'auto').then(setMode); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { end.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'end' }); }, [messages, turn?.text, turn?.tools.length, turn?.reasoning]);
  // Switching chats clears the old answer, but not one still streaming (a new chat gets its id mid-question).
  useEffect(() => { if (!turn?.thinking) reset(); setError(null); }, [cid]);

  const pickMode = (m) => { setMode(m); window.ather.setSetting('chatMode', m); };
  const ensureConversation = async () => cid || (await window.ather.newConversation().then((id) => { setCid(id); return id; }));

  const [followUps, setFollowUps] = useState([]);
  useEffect(() => setFollowUps([]), [cid]);

  /** Ask, then swap the live answer for the saved one and fetch follow-up suggestions. */
  async function run(q, pics, conv) {
    setFollowUps([]);
    const answer = await send(q, pics, { conversationId: conv, style: 'chat', mode });
    if (answer === null) return;
    reset(); // a finished answer is saved and shows up in the history list
    setFollowUps(await window.ather.followUps(q, answer));
  }

  async function submit(text = input) {
    const q = text.trim() || (images.length ? 'What is in this picture?' : '');
    if (!q || turn?.thinking) return;
    const conv = await ensureConversation();
    const pics = images;
    // Words the user fixed in what the mic heard are learned for next time.
    if (heardRef.current && text === input && q !== heardRef.current) window.ather.learnEdited(heardRef.current, q).catch(() => {});
    heardRef.current = '';
    setInput(''); setImages([]);
    await run(q, pics, conv);
  }

  async function regenerate() {
    const q = await window.ather.regenerate(cid);
    if (q) await run(q, [], cid);
  }

  async function attachDocument() {
    const path = await window.ather.pickDocument();
    if (!path) return;
    setBusyDoc(true); setError(null);
    try { await window.ather.addDocument(await ensureConversation(), path); } catch (e) { setError(errText(e)); } finally { setBusyDoc(false); }
  }

  function attachImages(files) {
    for (const f of files) {
      if (!f.type.startsWith('image/')) continue;
      const r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = () => setImages((x) => [...x, r.result].slice(0, 3));
      r.readAsDataURL(f);
    }
  }

  async function toggleMic() {
    if (!recorder) { try { setRecorder(await startRecording()); } catch { setError('Maya could not use the microphone.'); } return; }
    const audio = await recorder.stop();
    setRecorder(null);
    if (audio.length < 16000 * 0.3) return;
    const heard = await window.ather.transcribe(audio);
    setInput((v) => { const next = `${v}${v ? ' ' : ''}${heard}`; heardRef.current = next.trim(); return next; });
  }

  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null); // { id, title }
  const saveRename = () => {
    if (editing?.title.trim()) window.ather.renameConversation(editing.id, editing.title.trim());
    setEditing(null);
  };

  const lastAssistant = [...(messages || [])].reverse().find((m) => m.role === 'assistant');

  return (
    <div className="chat-page">
      <aside className="conv-list" aria-label="Conversations">
        <button className="btn primary" style={{ width: '100%' }} onClick={() => setCid(null)}>+ New chat</button>
        {(conversations || []).map((c) => (
          <div key={c.id} className={`conv ${c.id === cid ? 'active' : ''}`}>
            {editing?.id === c.id
              ? <input className="input conv-edit" autoFocus value={editing.title} aria-label="Chat name"
                  onChange={(e) => setEditing({ ...editing, title: e.target.value })} onBlur={saveRename}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') saveRename(); if (e.key === 'Escape') setEditing(null); }} />
              : <button className="conv-title" onClick={() => setCid(c.id)} title={c.title}>{c.title}</button>}
            <button className="conv-act" onClick={() => setEditing({ id: c.id, title: c.title })} aria-label={`Rename ${c.title}`} title="Rename">✎</button>
            <button className="conv-act" onClick={() => { if (confirm(`Delete "${c.title}"?`)) { window.ather.deleteConversation(c.id); if (c.id === cid) setCid(null); } }} aria-label={`Delete ${c.title}`} title="Delete">🗑</button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </aside>

      <section className="chat-main">
        <div className="chat-scroll">
          {!messages?.length && !turn && (
            <div className="chat-empty">
              <Face size={90} mood="happy" />
              <h1 className="page-title">What can I help with?</h1>
              <p className="muted">Ask anything, attach a PDF or picture, or say “remember that my exam is on 14 December”.</p>
              <div className="suggestions">{SUGGESTIONS.map((s) => <button key={s} className="suggestion" onClick={() => submit(s)}>{s}</button>)}</div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="chat-log">
            {(messages || []).map((m) => (
              <div key={m.id} className={`msg ${m.role}`}>
                {m.role === 'user'
                  ? m.content.replace(/\n\(Attached image saved at:[^)]*\)/, ' 🖼')
                  : <>
                      {m.tools && (() => { const events = JSON.parse(m.tools); return <><AgentChecklist tools={events} />{events.map((t, i) => <ToolResult key={i} event={t} />)}</>; })()}
                      <Markdown text={m.content} />
                      <div className="msg-actions">
                        <button onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText(m.content)} title="Copy answer">Copy</button>
                        {m.id === lastAssistant?.id && !turn?.thinking && <button onClick={regenerate} title="Ask again">↻ Regenerate</button>}
                        <Feedback question={messages[messages.indexOf(m) - 1]?.content || ''} />
                        {m.model && <span className="muted">{m.model}</span>}
                      </div>
                      {m.id === lastAssistant?.id && !turn && followUps.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="followups">{followUps.map((f) => <button key={f} className="suggestion small" onClick={() => submit(f)}>{f}</button>)}</div>
                      )}
                    </>}
              </div>
            ))}
            {turn && (
              <>
                <div className="msg user">{turn.question}{turn.images?.length ? ' 🖼' : ''}</div>
                <div className="msg assistant">
                  {turn.model && <div className="model-tag">{turn.model}</div>}
                  {turn.reasoning && (
                    <details className="reasoning" open={!turn.text}>
                      <summary>{turn.text ? `Thought for ${turn.thoughtFor ?? 0}s` : 'Thinking…'}</summary>
                      <div>{turn.reasoning}</div>
                    </details>
                  )}
                  <AgentChecklist tools={turn.tools} />
                  {turn.tools.map((t, i) => <ToolResult key={i} event={t} />)}
                  {turn.text && <Markdown text={turn.text} />}
                  {turn.thinking && !turn.text && !turn.reasoning && <div className="dots"><span /><span /><span /></div>}
                  {turn.error && <span className="bad">⚠ {turn.error}</span>}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
            <div ref={end} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="composer-box">
          {(docs?.length > 0 || images.length > 0 || busyDoc) && (
            <div className="attach-row">
              {(docs || []).map((d) => <span key={d.id} className="badge">📄 {d.name} <button className="x" onClick={() => window.ather.removeDocument(d.id)} aria-label={`Remove ${d.name}`}>✕</button></span>)}
              {busyDoc && <span className="badge">Reading document…</span>}
              {images.map((src, i) => <button key={i} className="thumb small" onClick={() => setImages(images.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} title="Remove"><img src={src} alt="Attached" /></button>)}
            </div>
          )}
          {error && <div className="bad" style={{ padding: '0 6px' }}>{error}</div>}
          <textarea
            className="composer-input" rows={2} value={input} placeholder={recorder ? 'Listening… press 🎤 again when done' : 'Message Maya…'} aria-label="Message"
            onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)} onPaste={(e) => attachImages(e.clipboardData.files)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); submit(); } }}
          />
          <div className="composer-bar">
            <button className="icon" onClick={attachDocument} title="Attach a PDF, Word or text file" aria-label="Attach document">📄</button>
            <button className="icon" onClick={() => fileRef.current.click()} title="Attach a picture" aria-label="Attach picture">🖼</button>
            <input type="file" accept="image/*" hidden ref={fileRef} onChange={(e) => { attachImages(e.target.files); e.target.value = ''; }} />
            <button className={`icon ${recorder ? 'rec' : ''}`} onClick={toggleMic} title="Speak instead of typing" aria-label="Voice input">🎤</button>
            <select className="mode-pick" value={mode} onChange={(e) => pickMode(e.target.value)} aria-label="AI model">
              <option value="auto">✨ Auto (best model for each question)</option>
              <optgroup label="Maya modes">
                {(modes || []).map((m) => <option key={m.key} value={m.key} disabled={!m.installed}>{m.label}{m.installed ? '' : ' (not downloaded)'}</option>)}
              </optgroup>
              {allModels?.length > 0 && (
                <optgroup label="Any model">
                  {allModels.map((m) => <option key={m.value} value={m.value}>{m.label}</option>)}
                </optgroup>
              )}
            </select>
            <span className="spacer" />
            {turn?.thinking
              ? <button className="btn" onClick={cancel}>■ Stop</button>
              : <button className="btn primary" onClick={() => submit()} disabled={!input.trim() && !images.length}>Send ↑</button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### src/renderer/app/Home.jsx

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import Face from '../shared/Face.jsx';
import { playSpeech } from '../shared/audio.js';
import { useData, tool, fmtDate } from './useData.js';
import { daysLeft } from './Timetable.jsx';
import { useAsk } from '../shared/useAsk.js';
import { useSetting } from './Settings.jsx';

const QUICK = ['What is on today?', 'Read my new emails', 'Read my new WhatsApp messages', 'Play my music', 'What did you do today?', 'Call Amma'];

/** Big one-press buttons (head mouse, dwell, one switch): Maya does it and says the answer. Editable. */
function QuickActions() {
  const [list, setList] = useSetting('quickActions', QUICK);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const { turn, send } = useAsk();
  const go = async (q) => { const answer = await send(q, [], { style: 'short' }); if (answer) { const a = await window.ather.speak(answer); if (a) playSpeech(a); } };
  return (
    <div className="panel quick" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
      <div className="row"><h2>⚡ Quick actions</h2><span className="spacer" /><button className="btn small" onClick={() => setEditing(!editing)}>{editing ? 'Done' : 'Edit'}</button></div>
      {editing
        ? <textarea className="input" rows={6} value={(list || QUICK).join('\n')} onChange={(e) => setList(e.target.value.split('\n').filter((l) => l.trim()).slice(0, 12))} aria-label="One quick action per line" />
        : <div className="quick-grid">
            {(list || QUICK).map((q) => <button key={q} className="btn quick-btn" onClick={() => go(q)} disabled={turn?.thinking}><span className="quick-icon" aria-hidden="true">{iconFor(q)}</span>{q}</button>)}
            <button className="btn danger quick-btn sos" onClick={() => window.ather.sosTrigger('pressed Help on Home')}><span className="quick-icon" aria-hidden="true">🆘</span>Help</button>
          </div>}
      {turn && <p className="muted" role="status" aria-live="polite" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{turn.thinking && !turn.text ? 'Working on it…' : (turn.text || turn.error || '').slice(0, 400)}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Briefing({ version }) {
  const saved = useData(() => window.ather.getSetting('lastBriefing', null), version);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  async function now() {
    setBusy(true); setError(null);
    try { await tool('briefing_now', {}); } catch (e) { setError(e.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '')); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  const listen = async () => { const a = await window.ather.speak(saved.text); if (a) playSpeech(a); };
  return (
    <div className="panel briefing">
      <div className="row"><h2>{saved?.kind === 'evening' ? '🌙 Your day' : '☀️ Today’s briefing'}</h2><span className="spacer" />
        {saved && <button className="btn small" onClick={listen} title="Read it to me">🔊</button>}
        <button className="btn small" onClick={now} disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Preparing…' : 'Brief me now'}</button></div>
      {saved ? <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>{saved.text}</p> : <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Every morning Maya sums up your weather, classes, tasks and emails. Set your city in Settings.</p>}
      {saved && <small className="muted">{fmtDate(saved.at)}</small>}
      {error && <p className="bad">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Work({ version, go }) {
  const mail = useData(() => window.ather.getSetting('mail', null), version);
  const triage = useData(() => window.ather.getSetting('mailTriage', null), version);
  const follow = useData(() => window.ather.getSetting('followups', []), version);
  const last = useData(() => window.ather.getSetting('weeklyReportLast', null), version);
  const auto = useData(() => window.ather.getSetting('weeklyReport', true), version);
  const day = useData(() => tool('activity_query', {}), version);
  const hm = (m) => (m >= 60 ? `${Math.floor(m / 60)} h ${m % 60} m` : `${m} m`);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  async function report() {
    setBusy(true); setError(null);
    try { const { path } = await tool('report_weekly', {}); window.ather.openPath(path); } catch (e) { setError(e.message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  const waiting = (follow || []).filter((f) => !f.done);
  return (
    <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
      <div className="row"><h2>💼 Work</h2><span className="spacer" />
        <button className="btn small" onClick={() => go('inbox')}>Inbox</button>
        <button className="btn small" onClick={report} disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Making…' : 'Weekly report'}</button></div>
      {!!day?.total_minutes && <p style={{ margin: '4px 0 8px' }}>🖥 Today: <b>{hm(day.productive_minutes)}</b> working{day.distracting_minutes ? `, ${hm(day.distracting_minutes)} distracted` : ''}{day.apps?.[0] ? ` · most in ${day.apps[0].label}` : ''}</p>}
      {!mail && <p className="muted">Connect your email on the Inbox page, then say “any emails I need to reply to?” or “remind me if Rahul doesn’t reply by Friday”.</p>}
      <ul className="list">
        {(triage?.needs_you || []).slice(0, 5).map((m) => <li className="item" key={`m${m.uid}`}><span className="item-title">✉️ <b>{m.from.split('<')[0].replace(/"/g, '')}</b> — {m.subject}</span>{m.why && <span className="badge late">{m.why}</span>}</li>)}
        {waiting.map((f) => <li className="item" key={`f${f.id}`}><span className="item-title">⏳ Waiting on <b>{f.from}</b>{f.subject ? ` — ${f.subject}` : ''}</span><span className="badge">by {fmtDate(f.by)}</span></li>)}
      </ul>
      {mail && !triage?.needs_you?.length && !waiting.length && <p className="empty">No emails waiting on you and no follow-ups.</p>}
      <label className="row muted" style={{ gap: 8 }}><input type="checkbox" key={String(auto)} defaultChecked={auto !== false} onChange={(e) => window.ather.setSetting('weeklyReport', e.target.checked)} />
        Make my weekly report every Friday at 5 pm{last ? ` · last: ${fmtDate(last.at)}` : ''}</label>
      {error && <p className="bad">{error}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

/** The first thing on Home: Maya's face in a halo that breathes while it listens for its name, and what is running. */
function Hero({ greeting }) {
  const [wake] = useSetting('wakeWord', true);
  const [lite] = useSetting('liteBrain', false);
  const [title] = useSetting('userTitle', 'boss');
  const [agent] = useSetting('agent', {});
  const name = agent?.name || 'Maya';
  return (
    <section className="hero" aria-label={`${name} status`}>
      <div className={`hero-face${wake ? ' listening' : ''}`}><Face size={96} mood="happy" /></div>
      <div className="hero-text">
        <h1 className="hero-title">{greeting}{title ? `, ${title}` : ''}</h1>
        <p className="hero-sub">{wake ? `Say “Hey ${name}” and tell me the work. No button needed.` : 'Move to the top of the screen or press Ctrl+Space to talk to me.'}</p>
        <ul className="hero-chips">
          <li>{wake ? `👂 Listening for “Hey ${name}”` : '🔇 Wake word is off'}</li>
          <li>🧠 {lite ? 'Lite brain · Qwen 3.5 2B' : 'Brain · Qwen 3.5 4B'}</li>
          <li>🔒 Runs only on this laptop</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

// A picture for each quick action, so it can be found at a glance.
const ICONS = [[/did you do|work/i, '🧾'], [/today|day|calendar/i, '📅'], [/email|mail/i, '✉️'], [/whatsapp|message/i, '💬'], [/music|song|play/i, '🎵'], [/call|phone/i, '📞'], [/weather/i, '⛅'], [/remind/i, '⏰']];
const iconFor = (q) => ICONS.find(([re]) => re.test(q))?.[1] || '✨';

export default function Home({ version, go }) {
  const p = useData(() => tool('history_query'), version);
  const todayTasks = useData(() => tool('tasks_query', { status: 'open', when: 'today' }), version);
  const overdue = useData(() => tool('tasks_query', { when: 'overdue' }), version);
  const events = useData(() => tool('calendar_query', {}), version);
  const reminders = useData(() => tool('reminders_query', {}), version);
  const exams = useData(() => tool('exams_query'), version);

  const hour = new Date().getHours();
  const greeting = hour < 12 ? 'Good morning' : hour < 17 ? 'Good afternoon' : 'Good evening';

  return (
    <>
      <Hero greeting={greeting} />

      <QuickActions />
      <Briefing version={version} />
      <Work version={version} go={go} />

      <div className="grid" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{p?.tasks_done_today ?? '–'}</div><div className="stat-label">tasks done today</div></div>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{p?.tasks_open ?? '–'}</div><div className="stat-label">tasks still open</div></div>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{p?.focus_minutes_this_week ?? '–'}</div><div className="stat-label">focus minutes this week</div></div>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{p?.habits?.length ? Math.max(...p.habits.map((h) => h.streak)) : 0}</div><div className="stat-label">best habit streak (days)</div></div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <div className="panel">
          <div className="row"><h2>Today</h2><span className="spacer" /><button className="btn small" onClick={() => go('tasks')}>All tasks</button></div>
          {[...(overdue || []), ...(todayTasks || [])].length === 0 && <p className="empty">Nothing due today 🎉</p>}
          <ul className="list">
            {(overdue || []).map((t) => <li className="item" key={`o${t.id}`}><span className="item-title">{t.title}</span><span className="badge late">overdue</span></li>)}
            {(todayTasks || []).map((t) => <li className="item" key={t.id}><span className="item-title">{t.title}</span><span className="badge">{fmtDate(t.due)}</span></li>)}
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div className="panel">
          <div className="row"><h2>Coming up</h2><span className="spacer" /><button className="btn small" onClick={() => go('calendar')}>Calendar</button></div>
          {!events?.length && !reminders?.length && !exams?.length && <p className="empty">No events or reminders this week.</p>}
          <ul className="list">
            {(exams || []).slice(0, 3).map((e) => <li className="item" key={`x${e.id}`}><span className="item-title">🎓 {e.subject}</span><span className={`badge ${e.days_left <= 7 ? 'late' : ''}`}>{daysLeft(e.days_left)}</span></li>)}
            {(events || []).slice(0, 5).map((e, i) => <li className="item" key={`e${i}`}><span className="item-title">📅 {e.title}</span><span className="badge">{fmtDate(e.start)}</span></li>)}
            {(reminders || []).slice(0, 4).map((r) => <li className="item" key={`r${r.id}`}><span className="item-title">⏰ {r.text}</span><span className="badge">{fmtDate(r.at)}</span></li>)}
          </ul>
        </div>

        <div className="panel">
          <h2>What I've noticed</h2>
          {!p ? <p className="muted">…</p> : (
            <ul className="list">
              <li className="item"><span className="item-title">You get the most done between <b>{p.most_productive_hours}</b>.</span></li>
              <li className="item"><span className="item-title">You finished <b>{p.tasks_done_this_week}</b> tasks in the last 7 days.</span></li>
              {p.habits.map((h) => <li className="item" key={h.name}><span className="item-title">{h.name}: <b>{h.this_week}/{h.target}</b> this week, streak {h.streak}</span></li>)}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```
