## 2. Supervisor Orchestration Core

### src/main/brain.js

```javascript
import { OLLAMA } from './ollama.js';
import { systemPrompt, calendarWeek } from './personality.js';
import { pickModel, liteSwap } from './models.js';
import { selectTools } from './tools/select.js';
import { now } from './store.js';
import { approvedFolders } from './services/mcp-presets.js';
import { matchSkill } from './services/skills.js';
import { logWork } from './services/worklog.js';
import { scriptLanguage } from './services/sapi.js';
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

export const BASE_MODEL = 'qwen3.5:4b';
export const BRAIN_MODEL = 'ather-brain'; // BASE_MODEL with a bigger context, see ensureBrainModel
const MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS = 6;
// Tools that read the user's screen, files or mail are not offered to cloud models without permission.
export const CLOUD_PRIVATE = /^(screen_look|files_|open_file|python_|images_(blur|remove|upscale)|mail_|fs_|computer_|clipboard_|camera_|contacts_|call_contact|whatsapp_|diary_|medical_)/;
const AGENT_ROUNDS = 25;
const BUILDER_ROUNDS = 40;
const COMPUTER_ROUNDS = 30;
// The builder's roles only need file, command, git, QA and web tools: a short list keeps the model on task.
// Actions that end or remove something, and the words that ask for them.
const DRASTIC = /^(pc_close_app|pc_power|work_timer_start|mail_archive|fs_trash)$/;
const DRASTIC_WORDS = /\b(close|quit|exit|kill|end|stop|shut|turn off|switch off|power|restart|reboot|sleep|hibernate|archive|delete|trash|remove|clean|tidy|free up|timer)\b/i;
const BUILDER_TOOLS =/^(fs_|run_command$|git_|github_publish$|qa_check_site$|agent_step$|web_search$|web_read|time_now$|open_file$|open_website$)/;
const HISTORY = 20;
// Actions that only make sense once per request, however the model rewords them.
const ONCE = /^(diary_add|whatsapp_message|call_contact|music_play|teleprompter|interpreter|pc_dark_mode|write_here)$/;
// Tools that may rightly run again with the same arguments (looking again after an action, reading data).
const REPEATABLE = /^(computer_(look|click|type|keys|scroll)|screen_look|camera_)|_(query|status|list|history|progress)$/;

/**
 * Ask the brain one question in a conversation. Streams events through onEvent:
 *   { type: 'model', key, label } | { type: 'reasoning', text } | { type: 'token', text }
 *   | { type: 'tool', name, args, result } | { type: 'done', text }
 * style: 'short' (notch, spoken) or 'chat' (ChatGPT-style window). mode: auto | fast | think | smart | coder.
 */
export async function ask({ text, images = [], store, tools, services, onEvent = () => {}, signal, conversationId = null, style = 'short', mode = 'auto' }) {
  const hybrid = store.getSetting('hybrid', false) ? store.getSetting('hybridModel', null) : null;
  let choice = await pickModel(mode, text, { images: images.length, style, hybrid });
  // A multi-step job a skill already knows ("save a WhatsApp video") follows the skill's proven steps, not a fresh plan.
  if (mode === 'auto' && choice.key === 'agent' && matchSkill(store, text)) choice = await pickModel('smart', text);
  const provider = choice.provider ? services?.providers?.get(choice.provider) : null;
  if (choice.provider && !provider) throw new Error(`The model provider "${choice.provider}" is not set up. Add it in Models.`);
  // Privacy: cloud models never get files, screenshots, documents or pictures unless the user allowed it.
  const cloudLimited = provider && !provider.local && !store.getSetting('cloudShareFiles', false);
  if (cloudLimited) images = [];
  onEvent({ type: 'model', key: choice.key, label: choice.label });

  // Agent mode: write the plan up front (structured output is reliable; asking the model to call agent_plan is not).
  let plan = null, projectDir = null;
  if (choice.builder) {
    const raw = await complete(`You are the Supervisor of a software team (Engineer, QA, DevOps). Break this request into 4 to 10 concrete steps. Start every step with its role in brackets: [Engineer] writes or fixes files, [QA] tests (open the site and check for errors, or run tests), [DevOps] Git commit, and publishing only if the user asked. Request: "${text}". Also give a short kebab-case project folder name. Reply as JSON.`,
      { model: choice.model, signal, format: { type: 'object', required: ['project', 'steps'], properties: { project: { type: 'string' }, steps: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } } } });
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    plan = parsed.steps.slice(0, 10);
    const base = approvedFolders(store).find((f) => /documents$/i.test(f)) || approvedFolders(store)[0];
    const slug = (parsed.project || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 40) || 'project';
    projectDir = join(base, 'Maya Projects', slug);
    mkdirSync(projectDir, { recursive: true });
    onEvent({ type: 'tool', name: 'agent_plan', args: { steps: plan }, result: { planned: plan.length, folder: projectDir } });
  } else if (choice.agent) {
    // The dates are given, so the plan never wastes a step (or Python) working out what day it is.
    const raw = await complete(`Dates (already known, never a step): ${calendarWeek()}. Break this goal into 2 to 8 short, concrete steps an assistant with tools (tasks, notes, reminders, calendar, web search, files, Python, study sets) can do; each step does something. Goal: "${text}". Reply as JSON.`,
      { model: choice.model, signal, format: { type: 'object', required: ['steps'], properties: { steps: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } } } });
    plan = JSON.parse(raw).steps.slice(0, 8);
    onEvent({ type: 'tool', name: 'agent_plan', args: { steps: plan }, result: { planned: plan.length } });
  }
  const history = store.all('SELECT role, content FROM messages WHERE conversation_id IS ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?', conversationId, HISTORY).reverse();
  const previous = [...history].reverse().find((m) => m.role === 'user')?.content || '';
  const everyTool = tools;
  // Agent mode picks tools from the goal and its own plan, like chat does: all ~150 at once confuse the small model.
  // The Builder still gets everything, narrowed below to its team's tools.
  const picked = selectTools(tools, text, { agent: choice.builder, previous: [previous, ...(plan || [])].join('\n'), images: images.length });
  const screenAsked = selectTools(tools, `${text}\n${previous}`).some((t) => t.name === 'computer_start');
  tools = (choice.agent && !choice.builder ? [...picked.filter((t) => screenAsked || !t.name.startsWith('computer_')), ...tools.filter((t) => t.name === 'agent_step')] : picked)
    .filter((t) => (choice.agent ? t.name !== 'agent_plan' : !t.name.startsWith('agent_')))
    .filter((t) => !choice.builder || BUILDER_TOOLS.test(t.name))
    .filter((t) => !cloudLimited || !CLOUD_PRIVATE.test(t.name));
  // A skill that fits ("research report", or one the user taught) brings its tools and its steps.
  // Closing apps, shutting down, deleting or archiving only when *this* sentence asks for it: an earlier "open
  // WhatsApp" must not let "how much RAM am I using?" end with Maya closing Chrome to free memory.
  const askedDrastic = DRASTIC_WORDS.test(text);
  const drastic = (t) => !askedDrastic && DRASTIC.test(t.name);
  tools = tools.filter((t) => !drastic(t));
  // An everyday goal in Agent mode gets no coding tools: small models reach for Python to count days.
  if (choice.agent && !choice.builder && !/\b(code|coding|project|files?|folders?|script|python|git|program|bug|tests?|build|repo)\b/i.test(text)) tools = tools.filter((t) => !/^(run_command|fs_|git_|github_|python_)/.test(t.name));
  // Agent and Builder make their own plan; a skill's steps would fight it.
  let skill = choice.agent ? null : matchSkill(store, text);
  // A cloud model never gets the private tools (screen, files, mail), so a skill made only of them is skipped.
  if (skill?.tools && cloudLimited && everyTool.filter((t) => new RegExp(skill.tools).test(t.name)).every((t) => CLOUD_PRIVATE.test(t.name))) skill = null;
  if (skill) {
    const extra = skill.tools ? everyTool.filter((t) => new RegExp(skill.tools).test(t.name) && !tools.includes(t) && (!cloudLimited || !CLOUD_PRIVATE.test(t.name))) : [];
    tools = [...tools, ...extra];
    store.run('UPDATE skills SET uses = uses + 1 WHERE id = ?', skill.id);
    onEvent({ type: 'skill', name: skill.name });
  }
  // Controlling the PC needs the stronger model: the small one mixes up controls and grid cells.
  const onScreen = tools.some((t) => t.name === 'computer_start');
  if (mode === 'auto' && choice.key === 'fast' && onScreen) {
    choice = await pickModel('smart');
    onEvent({ type: 'model', key: choice.key, label: choice.label });
  }
  // "Make me a study plan": write it out. Models tend to add tasks unasked (so they get no task tools unless the user asks)
  // or to ask questions first (so they are told plainly to write it now).
  const planRequest = !choice.agent && /\bplan\b/i.test(text) && !/\b(add|tasks?|remind|reminders?|calendar)\b/i.test(text);
  if (planRequest) tools = tools.filter((t) => !/^(tasks_create|reminders_create|calendar_create|habits_create)$/.test(t.name));
  // "Work 2 hours, then shut down": the work timer says goodbye and lets them say "wait"; a bare shutdown would not.
  if (/\b(after|then|later)\b.*\bshut ?down\b|\bshut ?down\b.*\b(after|in)\b/i.test(text) && tools.some((t) => t.name === 'work_timer_start')) tools = tools.filter((t) => t.name !== 'pc_power');
  // "Change your name to Priya", "talk slower": a real setting, not a note about one (small models pick memory_save).
  if (tools.some((t) => t.name === 'persona_set') && /\b(your name|call yourself|rename you|talk|speak|voice)\b.{0,30}\b(to|slower|faster|slowly|quickly|louder)\b|\b(slow(er)? down|speed up)\b/i.test(text)) tools = tools.filter((t) => t.name !== 'memory_save');
  // "Remind me if Rahul doesn't reply": a timed reminder would fire even after he replied; only mail_follow_up checks.
  if (/\b(doesn'?t|does not|don'?t|hasn'?t|has not|no) (reply|respond|answer|get back)/i.test(text) && tools.some((t) => t.name === 'mail_follow_up')) tools = tools.filter((t) => t.name !== 'reminders_create');
  // "Search X in Chrome", "message Rahul on WhatsApp": the user wants it done on the screen, not answered from the web.
  if (onScreen && !choice.agent) tools = tools.filter((t) => !/^web_/.test(t.name));
  const noTools = store.getSetting('noToolModels', []).includes(choice.model);
  let toolSpecs = noTools ? [] : tools.map((t) => ({ type: 'function', function: { name: t.name, description: t.description, parameters: t.parameters } }));
  const summary = conversationId ? store.get('SELECT summary FROM conversations WHERE id = ?', conversationId)?.summary : null;
  const memories = store.all("SELECT fact, category FROM memories WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY category, id").map((m) => `(${m.category || 'fact'}) ${m.fact}`);
  const documents = conversationId && services?.docs && !cloudLimited ? await services.docs.context(conversationId, text) : '';
  // Small models follow the newest message best: the user's own answer rules ride along with each question.
  const rules = memories.filter((m) => m.startsWith('(preference)')).map((m) => m.replace(/^\(preference\)\s*(How the user wants answers:\s*)?/, '').replace(/\s*\(said after.*\)$/, ''));
  const asked = rules.length ? `${text}\n\n(My standing wishes for your answers: ${rules.join('; ')})` : text;
  const userContent = images.length
    ? [{ type: 'text', text: asked }, ...images.map((url) => ({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } }))]
    : asked;
  const messages = [
    { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt(store.getSetting('personality', 'normal'), { style, memories, documents, summary, agent: !!choice.agent, builder: !!choice.builder, custom: store.getSetting('customPersonalities', []), me: { ...store.getSetting('agent', {}), callMe: store.getSetting('userTitle', '') } }) },
    ...history,
    { role: 'user', content: userContent },
  ];

  // Asked in Tamil (or another script): small models drift back to English, so say it plainly.
  const script = { ta: 'Tamil (தமிழ்)', hi: 'Hindi', te: 'Telugu', bn: 'Bengali', ar: 'Arabic', ru: 'Russian', ja: 'Japanese', ko: 'Korean', zh: 'Chinese' }[scriptLanguage(text)];
  if (script) messages[0].content += `\nThe user wrote in ${script}. Answer in ${script}, in its own script.`;
  if (skill) messages[0].content += `\nUse your skill "${skill.name}" for this request. Its steps:\n${skill.steps}`;
  if (plan) messages[0].content += `\nYour plan (already shown to the user):\n${plan.map((s, i) => `${i}. ${s}`).join('\n')}`;
  if (planRequest) messages[0].content += '\nThe user wants the plan itself in this answer: write the complete day-by-day plan now, with sensible assumptions stated in one line. Do not ask questions before it; you may offer to adjust after it.';
  if (onScreen) messages[0].content += '\nThe user wants this done ON THE SCREEN, the way a person uses the PC: computer_open the app, computer_start, computer_look, then click and type. After every step check what the window shows now; if it did not work, try another way. Do not stop until it is done or truly blocked.';
  if (projectDir) messages[0].content += `\nProject folder (use this exact path for every file, QA and Git call): ${projectDir}`;
  if (cloudLimited) messages[0].content += '\nYou are a cloud model: the user\'s files, screen and documents are not shared with you. If they are needed, say the user can switch to a local model or allow sharing in Models.';

  let answer = '';
  const toolLog = plan ? [{ name: 'agent_plan', args: { steps: plan }, result: { planned: plan.length } }] : [];
  const ctx = { store, services, conversationId };
  let checkedClaims = false, checkedRefusal = false, nudges = 0;
  const doneCalls = new Set(); // "tool args" already run in this answer
  let maxRounds = choice.builder ? BUILDER_ROUNDS : choice.agent ? AGENT_ROUNDS : MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS;
  const toolPictures = new Set(); // screenshot messages; only the newest is kept so long PC tasks fit in context
  for (let round = 0; round <= maxRounds; round++) {
    const turn = () => streamChat({
      model: choice.model, think: !!choice.think, messages, tools: toolSpecs, signal, provider, providers: services?.providers, store,
      onToken: (t) => onEvent({ type: 'token', text: t }), onReasoning: (t) => onEvent({ type: 'reasoning', text: t }),
    });
    // Ollama sometimes cannot parse a tool call the model wrote ("XML syntax error"): the same step again usually works.
    let reply;
    for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
      try { reply = await turn(); break; } catch (e) {
        if (attempt >= 2 || signal?.aborted || !/syntax error|unexpected end|failed to parse/i.test(e.message)) throw e;
        onEvent({ type: 'retry', reason: 'the model wrote a broken tool call' });
      }
    }
    let { content, toolCalls, usage } = reply;
    // Some models write the tool call as text ({"name": "fs_write", "arguments": …}) instead of making it: do it anyway.
    if (!toolCalls.length && toolSpecs.length) {
      const written = toolCallsInText(content, tools);
      if (written.length) { toolCalls = written; content = ''; onEvent({ type: 'retry', reason: 'tool written as text' }); }
    }
    services?.providers?.recordUsage(provider?.id || 'ollama', choice.model, usage);
    answer = dropRepeats(content);
    if (!toolCalls.length) {
      // "I can't control your PC": the words just missed the keywords that offer the tools. Once, with every tool.
      // Never after the user said no to an action: then "I can't" is the honest answer.
      if (!checkedRefusal && !noTools && !choice.agent && wrongRefusal(content) && tools.length < everyTool.length && !toolLog.some((t) => t.result?.denied)) {
        checkedRefusal = true;
        tools = everyTool.filter((t) => !t.name.startsWith('agent_') && !drastic(t) && (!cloudLimited || !CLOUD_PRIVATE.test(t.name)));
        toolSpecs = tools.map((t) => ({ type: 'function', function: { name: t.name, description: t.description, parameters: t.parameters } }));
        messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content }, { role: 'user', content: '(Check before answering: you DO control this PC, the user\'s email and yourself through your tools (pc_power, pc_open_app, computer_start, mail_send, mail_reply, persona_set for your own name, voice and speed, ui_set for the screens…), now all available. Do what the user asked with them; risky actions ask the user to allow first. Do not mention this check.)' });
        onEvent({ type: 'retry', reason: 'used the tools instead of refusing' });
        continue;
      }
      // Agent mode stopped with steps of its plan still open ("I'll create the sessions…" and nothing): carry on, up to 3 times.
      const stepsDone = toolLog.filter((t) => t.name === 'agent_step').length;
      const changes = toolLog.filter((t) => !/^(agent_|time_|web_)|_(query|status|progress|list|search|read)$/.test(t.name)).length;
      if (choice.agent && plan && nudges < 3 && stepsDone < plan.length && changes < plan.length && round < maxRounds - 1) {
        nudges++;
        messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content }, { role: 'user', content: `(Not finished: ${stepsDone} of ${plan.length} plan steps are marked done. Do the next step of your plan now with tools, then call agent_step. Do not mention this note.)` });
        onEvent({ type: 'retry', reason: 'plan not finished' });
        continue;
      }
      // Honesty check: "I typed / clicked / sent…" must be backed by a tool that really did it. Once per question,
      // Maya goes back to either do it now (with the PC-control tools) or say plainly what it did not do.
      // "…Let me try again:" and then nothing: give it the round it just promised itself.
      if (!checkedClaims && !noTools && (promisedRetry(content) || (!toolLog.length && promisedAction(content)))) {
        checkedClaims = true;
        messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content }, { role: 'user', content: '(Go ahead now: call the tool again with corrected arguments. Do not mention this note.)' });
        onEvent({ type: 'retry', reason: 'promised to try again' });
        continue;
      }
      const claim = !checkedClaims && unbackedClaim(content, toolLog);
      if (!claim) break;
      checkedClaims = true;
      // PC control is offered only for typing/clicking claims (a small model given it for anything else loops on it).
      if (/typed|clicked/.test(claim) && !cloudLimited && !noTools && !tools.some((t) => t.name === 'computer_start')) {
        tools = [...tools, ...everyTool.filter((t) => t.name.startsWith('computer_'))];
        toolSpecs = tools.map((t) => ({ type: 'function', function: { name: t.name, description: t.description, parameters: t.parameters } }));
      }
      const how = claim === 'called them' ? 'call_contact' : 'computer_start, then act, then look to confirm it worked';
      messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content }, { role: 'user', content: `(Check before answering: you said you ${claim}, but no tool did that. If it is still needed, do it now: ${how}. Otherwise tell the user honestly what you did and did not do. Do not mention this check.)` });
      onEvent({ type: 'retry', reason: claim });
      continue;
    }

    messages.push({ role: 'assistant', content, tool_calls: toolCalls });
    // Controlling the PC takes many small steps (look, click, type, check): give it room.
    if (toolCalls.some((c) => c.function.name.startsWith('computer_'))) maxRounds = Math.max(maxRounds, COMPUTER_ROUNDS);
    const pictures = [];
    let repeated = 0;
    for (const call of toolCalls) {
      const tool = tools.find((t) => t.name === call.function.name);
      let args = {};
      let result, started = Date.now();
      try {
        args = JSON.parse(call.function.arguments || '{}');
        if (!tool) throw new Error(`Unknown tool ${call.function.name}`);
        args = unpackArgs(args, tool.parameters);
        // Small models sometimes repeat the same action in a loop (7 diary entries for one sentence): do it once.
        const key = callKey(tool.name, args);
        if (!REPEATABLE.test(tool.name) && (doneCalls.has(key) || (ONCE.test(tool.name) && doneCalls.has(tool.name)))) {
          result = { already_done: true, note: 'You already did exactly this in this answer. Do not repeat it; answer the user now.' };
          repeated++;
        } else {
          doneCalls.add(key).add(tool.name);
          // Risky tools (running code, shutting down, closing apps) wait for the user's OK.
          const allowed = !tool.confirm || (await services?.confirm?.({ name: tool.name, args }));
          started = Date.now();
          result = allowed ? await tool.run(args, ctx) : { denied: true, message: 'The user did not allow this action. Do not retry it; ask what they want instead.' };
        }
      } catch (err) {
        result = { error: err.message };
      }
      if (!result?.already_done) {
        try { logWork(store, { source: choice.builder ? 'builder' : choice.agent ? 'agent' : 'chat', name: call.function.name, args, result, ms: Date.now() - started }); } catch { /* the monitor never breaks a task */ }
      }
      // A tool can hand the model a picture to look at (e.g. a screenshot).
      if (result?.attachImage) { pictures.push(result.attachImage); result = { ...result, attachImage: undefined, note: 'The image is attached in the next message.' }; }
      onEvent({ type: 'tool', name: call.function.name, args, result });
      toolLog.push(keepForHistory(call.function.name, args, result));
      messages.push({ role: 'tool', tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify(result).slice(0, 6000) });
    }
    // Only repeats this round: take the tools away so the next round is the answer, not another loop.
    if (repeated && repeated === toolCalls.length) toolSpecs = [];
    if (pictures.length) {
      for (const m of toolPictures) m.content = 'An older image from a tool was here (removed; the newest one is below).';
      const msg = { role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Here is the image from the tool.' }, ...pictures.map((url) => ({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } }))] };
      toolPictures.add(msg);
      messages.push(msg);
    }
  }
  // Control is for one request: give the mouse, keyboard and the Esc key back even if the model forgot computer_done.
  if (services?.computer?.active) { services.computer.stop('finished'); services.onComputerStop?.(); }

  // Rounds ran out while the model was still calling tools: one last round without tools, so the user never gets silence.
  if (!answer.trim() && toolLog.length) {
    messages.push({ role: 'user', content: '(Now answer the user in one or two sentences: what you did, using the tool results above. Do not mention this note.)' });
    const last = await streamChat({ model: choice.model, messages, tools: [], signal, provider, providers: services?.providers, store, onToken: (t) => onEvent({ type: 'token', text: t }) });
    answer = last.content.trim() || 'Done.';
  }

  const stamp = now();
  store.run('INSERT INTO messages (role, content, created_at, conversation_id) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', 'user', text, stamp, conversationId);
  store.run('INSERT INTO messages (role, content, created_at, conversation_id, model, tools) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)',
    'assistant', answer, now(), conversationId, choice.key, toolLog.length ? JSON.stringify(toolLog) : null);
  if (conversationId) store.run('UPDATE conversations SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?', now(), conversationId);
  onEvent({ type: 'done', text: answer });
  return answer;
}

// Past-tense actions an answer may claim (said in the first person), and the tools that really do them.
const I_DID = (verbs) => new RegExp(`\\bI(?:'ve| have)?\\b[^.!?\\n]{0,80}\\b(${verbs})\\b`, 'i');
const CLAIMS = [
  [I_DID('typed|entered|wrote|filled'), 'typed it', /^computer_type$/],
  // computer_type can press Enter itself (enter: true), so it backs "pressed" too.
  [I_DID('clicked|pressed|tapped'), 'clicked or pressed it', /^computer_(click|keys|type)$/],
  [I_DID('sent'), 'sent it', /^(computer_|mail_send|mail_reply)/],
  // "I'm calling Amma now" / "initiating the call" must be backed by a real call.
  [I_DID('called|calling|initiating|initiated|placed|placing|connecting|dialed|dialled|dialing|dialling|ringing'), 'called them', /^call_contact$/],
];
/** The answer ends by promising to do or retry something now ("Let me try again:"). Exported for tests. */
/** "Sure, I'll open WhatsApp with…" as the whole answer, with nothing done: a promise to act now. Exported for tests. */
export const promisedAction = (answer) => /^\s*((sure|okay|ok|alright|of course)[,!.]?\s*)?(i'?ll|i will|let me|i'?m going to)\s+(open|send|call|message|save|add|set|play|start|write|make|create|turn|remind|put)\b/i.test(answer || '');

/** Same action, written slightly differently ("safely" / "safely."): name + the main text, letters and digits only. Exported for tests. */
export function callKey(name, args) {
  const text = Object.values(args || {}).filter((v) => typeof v === 'string').sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)[0] || JSON.stringify(args || {});
  return `${name} ${text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, '').slice(0, 60)}`;
}

export const promisedRetry = (answer) => /\b(let me|i'?ll|i will)\s+(try|do|retry|fix|redo|run|make)\b[^.!?\n]{0,60}(again|now|that|it)?\s*[:.!…]*\s*$/i.test((answer || '').trim());

/** What the answer says it did on the PC that no successful tool call did, or null. Exported for tests. */
/** Small models sometimes loop and repeat whole paragraphs; keep the first copy of each (exported for tests). */
/** Tool calls a model wrote as JSON text instead of calling, for tools it was offered (exported for tests). */
export function toolCallsInText(content, tools) {
  const names = new Set(tools.map((t) => t.name));
  const calls = [];
  // Each balanced {...} block that parses as { name, arguments } for a known tool.
  for (let i = String(content).indexOf('{'); i >= 0 && calls.length < 5; i = content.indexOf('{', i + 1)) {
    let depth = 0, inStr = false, esc = false, end = -1;
    for (let j = i; j < content.length; j++) {
      const c = content[j];
      if (inStr) { if (esc) esc = false; else if (c === '\\') esc = true; else if (c === '"') inStr = false; continue; }
      if (c === '"') inStr = true; else if (c === '{') depth++; else if (c === '}' && --depth === 0) { end = j; break; }
    }
    if (end < 0) break;
    try {
      const raw = content.slice(i, end + 1);
      // Windows paths are often written with single backslashes ("C:\Users"): not valid JSON, so double them.
      const o = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return JSON.parse(raw.replace(/\\(?!["\\/bfnrtu])/g, '\\\\')); } })();
      const args = o.arguments ?? o.parameters;
      if (names.has(o.name) && args && typeof args === 'object') {
        calls.push({ id: `text_${calls.length}`, type: 'function', function: { name: o.name, arguments: JSON.stringify(args) } });
        i = end;
      }
    } catch { /* not a tool call */ }
  }
  return calls;
}

export function dropRepeats(text) {
  const seen = new Set();
  return text.split(/\n{2,}/).filter((p) => {
    const key = p.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
    if (key.length < 40) return true;
    if (seen.has(key)) return false;
    seen.add(key);
    return true;
  }).join('\n\n');
}

/**
 * "I can't turn off your computer / I don't have access to your PC": Maya can, the tool was just not offered
 * for these words. Exported for tests.
 */
export const wrongRefusal = (answer) => /\b(I )?(can(no|')t|cannot|am not able to|am unable to|don'?t have (the )?(access|ability|permission)|do not have (the )?(access|ability|permission))\b[^.]{0,80}\b(computer|pc|laptop|system|hardware|operating system|screen|apps?|email|mail|inbox|send|turn off|shut ?down|restart|control|open|click|type|name|settings?|voice|speed|myself)/i.test(answer || '');

export function unbackedClaim(answer, toolLog) {
  const ok = toolLog.filter((t) => !t.result?.error && !t.result?.denied).map((t) => t.name);
  for (const [said, what, tool] of CLAIMS) if (said.test(answer || '') && !ok.some((n) => tool.test(n))) return what;
  return null;
}

/**
 * Small models sometimes send a list or object as JSON text ("slides": "[{…}]"). Unpack those when the tool
 * expects an array/object and the text really is one; everything else is left as it came. Exported for tests.
 */
export function unpackArgs(args, schema) {
  const props = schema?.properties || {};
  const out = { ...args };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(args || {})) {
    const want = props[key]?.type;
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || (want !== 'array' && want !== 'object')) continue;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(value);
      if (want === 'array' ? Array.isArray(parsed) : parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) out[key] = parsed;
    } catch { /* not JSON: the tool reports the problem itself */ }
  }
  return out;
}

/** The part of a tool call worth showing again in chat history (files, charts, short output), not bulky data. */
export function keepForHistory(name, args, result) {
  const keep = {};
  if (Array.isArray(result)) keep.list = result.slice(0, 5);
  else if (result && typeof result === 'object') {
    for (const k of ['path', 'paths', 'images', 'files', 'exit_code', 'error', 'denied', 'prompt', 'title', 'blurred', 'model']) if (result[k] !== undefined) keep[k] = result[k];
    for (const k of ['stdout', 'stderr']) if (result[k]) keep[k] = String(result[k]).slice(0, 2000);
    if (result.mails) keep.mails = result.mails.filter((m) => m.needs_you).slice(0, 5);
  }
  const shortArgs = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(args || {}).map(([k, v]) => [k, typeof v === 'string' ? v.slice(0, 3000) : v]));
  return { name, args: shortArgs, result: keep.list ?? keep };
}

/** Long chats: summarise everything older than the recent window so the model keeps the thread. */
export async function updateSummary(store, conversationId) {
  const all = store.all('SELECT role, content FROM messages WHERE conversation_id = ? ORDER BY id', conversationId);
  if (all.length <= HISTORY) return null;
  const older = all.slice(0, -HISTORY).map((m) => `${m.role === 'user' ? 'User' : 'Maya'}: ${m.content.slice(0, 800)}`).join('\n');
  const summary = await complete(`Summarise this earlier part of a conversation in at most 150 words. Keep names, facts, decisions and open questions.\n\n${older.slice(-12000)}`);
  store.run('UPDATE conversations SET summary = ? WHERE id = ?', summary.trim(), conversationId);
  return summary;
}

/** Three short questions the user might ask next (shown as chips under a chat answer). */
export async function followUps(question, answer) {
  const raw = await complete(
    `A user asked: "${question.slice(0, 500)}"\nThe assistant answered: "${answer.slice(0, 1500)}"\nSuggest 3 short follow-up messages the USER might send next (max 8 words each, in the user's language). Reply as JSON.`,
    { format: { type: 'object', required: ['followups'], properties: { followups: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } } } });
  return JSON.parse(raw).followups.slice(0, 3);
}

/** A clear message when Ollama cannot answer; "model not found" means that brain is not downloaded yet. Exported for tests. */
export function modelError(status, text = '', model = '') {
  if (status === 404 && /not found/i.test(text)) return new Error(`My AI brain${model ? ` (${model})` : ''} is not downloaded yet. Open Settings → AI models and press Download, or run start.bat again.`);
  return new Error(`The AI model did not answer (${status}): ${text.slice(0, 300)}`);
}

/** One-shot completion without tools or history (titles, quizzes, triage). */
/** One-shot answer; images are base64 strings (no data: prefix) for vision questions. */
export async function complete(prompt, { model = BRAIN_MODEL, format, signal, images } = {}) {
  const res = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/chat`, {
    method: 'POST', signal,
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: liteSwap(model), stream: false, think: false, format, options: { temperature: 0.3 }, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt, images }] }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw modelError(res.status, await res.text(), liteSwap(model));
  return (await res.json()).message.content;
}

/** One streamed /v1/chat/completions call; collects text and tool calls. */
async function streamChat({ model, think, messages, tools, signal, onToken = () => {}, onReasoning = () => {}, provider, providers, store }) {
  const body = { model, messages, stream: true, stream_options: { include_usage: true }, temperature: think ? 0.6 : 0.5 };
  if (tools?.length) body.tools = tools;
  const send = (b) => (provider
    ? providers.request(provider, '/chat/completions', provider.preset === 'ollama' ? { ...b, reasoning_effort: think ? 'high' : 'none' } : b, signal)
    // Local Ollama: reasoning_effort none skips Qwen's slow "thinking" pass unless the user asked to think harder.
    : fetch(`${OLLAMA}/v1/chat/completions`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, signal,
      // presence_penalty: Qwen's advice against endless repetition (seen in long Tamil answers from the small model).
      body: JSON.stringify({ ...b, reasoning_effort: think ? 'high' : 'none', presence_penalty: 1 }) }));
  let res = await send(body);
  if (!res.ok && body.tools) {
    const err = await res.text();
    // Some models cannot call tools: remember that and answer without them.
    if (res.status === 400 && /tool|function/i.test(err)) {
      store?.setSetting('noToolModels', [...new Set([...store.getSetting('noToolModels', []), model])]);
      delete body.tools;
      res = await send(body);
    } else throw modelError(res.status, err, model);
  }
  if (!res.ok) throw modelError(res.status, await res.text(), model);

  let content = '';
  let usage = null;
  const calls = [];
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let buf = '';
  for await (const chunk of res.body) {
    buf += decoder.decode(chunk, { stream: true });
    let i;
    while ((i = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) {
      const line = buf.slice(0, i).trim(); buf = buf.slice(i + 1);
      if (!line.startsWith('data:') || line === 'data: [DONE]') continue;
      const chunkJson = JSON.parse(line.slice(5));
      if (chunkJson.usage) usage = chunkJson.usage;
      const delta = chunkJson.choices?.[0]?.delta || {};
      const reasoning = delta.reasoning ?? delta.reasoning_content;
      if (reasoning) onReasoning(reasoning);
      if (delta.content) { content += delta.content; onToken(delta.content); }
      for (const tc of delta.tool_calls || []) {
        const slot = (calls[tc.index ?? calls.length] ??= { id: tc.id, type: 'function', function: { name: '', arguments: '' } });
        if (tc.id) slot.id = tc.id;
        if (tc.function?.name) slot.function.name += tc.function.name;
        if (tc.function?.arguments) slot.function.arguments += tc.function.arguments;
      }
    }
  }
  return { content, toolCalls: calls.filter(Boolean), usage };
}

### src/main/models.js

```javascript
// Which LLM answers which question.
import { hasModel } from './ollama.js';

export const MODES = {
  fast: { model: 'ather-brain', label: 'Fast · Qwen 3.5 4B' },
  think: { model: 'ather-brain', think: true, label: 'Think harder · Qwen 3.5 4B + reasoning' },
  smart: { model: 'ather-smart', base: 'qwen3.5:9b', label: 'Smart · Qwen 3.5 9B' },
  coder: { model: 'qwen2.5-coder:7b', label: 'Coder · Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B' },
  // Hard reasoning (maths, logic, "step by step"): the 9B thinks before it answers. Slower, so only for these.
  deep: { model: 'ather-smart', base: 'qwen3.5:9b', think: true, label: 'Deep think · Qwen 3.5 9B + reasoning' },
  // The 4B fits fully on a 6 GB GPU; agents make many calls, so speed matters more than the 9B's extra polish.
  agent: { model: 'ather-brain', agent: true, label: 'Agent · plans and does multi-step tasks' },
  // Builds software end to end: the Supervisor plans, then Engineer, QA and DevOps steps run with their own tools.
  builder: { model: 'ather-smart', base: 'qwen3.5:9b', agent: true, builder: true, label: 'Builder · Supervisor → Engineer → QA → DevOps' },
};

const ACTION = /^\s*(please\s+)?(add|remind|note|save|set|delete|remove|start|stop|mark|complete|schedule|open|launch|find|draw|blur|undo|check|track|remember|forget|play|pause|lock|turn|mute)\b/i;
// Writing or fixing code goes to the coder model; merely mentioning a language ("compare Python and Java") does not.
const CODE = /```|\b(write|fix|debug|refactor|optimi[sz]e|review|complete) (a |an |the |my |this )?(\w+ )?(code|program|function|script|query|class|method|regex)|\b(error|exception|traceback|bug|stack ?trace|syntax|compile|segfault|not working)\b|\b(code|program|function|script) (to|that|for)\b/i;
const HARD = /\b(solve|prove|derive|step[- ]by[- ]step|puzzle|riddle|logic(al)?|reason it out|think (hard|carefully|deeply)|how many ways|probability|equation|integral|derivative)\b|\d+\s*[x×*\/^]\s*\d+.*[=?]/i;
const STEP_VERBS =/\b(open|send|download|save|move|copy|play|search|find|write|create|make|add|set|turn|close|call|reply|read|summari[sz]e|email|message|whatsapp|book|check|start|share|upload|rename|delete|remind)\b/gi;
/** Two or more different actions joined by "and / then / after that" (exported for tests). */
export const multiStep = (text) => /\b(and|then|after that|and then)\b/i.test(text) && new Set((text.match(STEP_VERBS) || []).map((v) => v.toLowerCase())).size >= 2;
const CODING =/\b(code|coding|bug|tests?|npm|pip|python|javascript|project|function|script|compile|build|error|exception|traceback|repo|\.js|\.py)\b/i;
const BUILD =/\b(build|make|create|code|develop)\b.{0,40}\b(website|web ?page|web ?app|web ?site|app|application|game|program|project|portfolio|landing page|calculator)\b/i;
const DEEP =/\b(explain|why|how (does|do|is|are)|compare|difference|essay|analy[sz]e|describe|write|plan|pros and cons|teach|in detail|step by step|summari[sz]e)\b/i;

/** Pure routing rule (tested): which mode "auto" picks for a question. */
export function autoMode(text, { images = 0, style = 'short' } = {}) {
  // "Build me a counter website" (typed or said): the Builder team, whichever window it came from.
  if (!images && BUILD.test(text)) return 'builder';
  // A job of several steps ("open WhatsApp and download the video, then move it to the desktop"): the agent plans and does each.
  if (!images && multiStep(text)) return 'agent';
  if (!images && HARD.test(text) && !ACTION.test(text)) return 'deep';
  if (images || ACTION.test(text) || style !== 'chat') return 'fast';
  if (CODE.test(text)) return 'coder';
  if (DEEP.test(text) || text.length > 160) return 'smart';
  return 'fast';
}

const seen = new Map(); // model name -> { ok, at }
async function installed(name) {
  const hit = seen.get(name);
  if (hit && Date.now() - hit.at < 60_000) return hit.ok;
  const ok = await hasModel(name).catch(() => false);
  seen.set(name, { ok, at: Date.now() });
  return ok;
}

/** "p:openai:gpt-4o-mini" → { provider: 'openai', model: 'gpt-4o-mini' }, else null. */
export function parseProviderModel(mode) {
  const m = /^p:([\w-]+):(.+)$/.exec(mode || '');
  return m ? { provider: m[1], model: m[2] } : null;
}

/**
 * Resolve a mode ("auto", "fast", …, or "p:<provider>:<model>") to a model.
 * opts.hybrid: a "p:…" choice used instead of the local smart model for big questions (cloud when allowed).
 */
// Lite brain for slower PCs (no 4 GB graphics card, or little RAM): every local Qwen model is swapped for the 2B.
export const LITE = { model: 'ather-lite', base: 'qwen3.5:2b' };
let lite = false;
export const setLite = (on) => { lite = !!on; };
export const isLite = () => lite;
/** The model to really use: Maya's local models become the lite one while Lite is on. Exported for tests. */
export const liteSwap = (model) => (lite && /^(ather-(brain|smart)|qwen)/.test(model || '') ? LITE.model : model);

export async function pickModel(mode = 'auto', text = '', opts = {}) {
  const choice = await pick(mode, text, opts);
  return choice.provider || !lite ? choice : { ...choice, model: liteSwap(choice.model), label: `${choice.label.split('·')[0].trim()} · Lite (Qwen 3.5 2B)` };
}

async function pick(mode, text, opts) {
  const direct = parseProviderModel(mode);
  if (direct) return { key: 'custom', ...direct, label: `${direct.model} · ${direct.provider}` };
  let key = mode === 'auto' || !MODES[mode] ? autoMode(text, opts) : mode;
  const hybrid = mode === 'auto' && (key === 'smart' || key === 'coder') ? parseProviderModel(opts.hybrid) : null;
  if (hybrid) return { key: 'custom', ...hybrid, label: `${hybrid.model} · ${hybrid.provider}` };
  // A coding goal (fix a bug, run the tests) needs the 9B, like the Builder: the 4B edits files with shell commands.
  if (key === 'agent') return CODING.test(text) && (await installed(MODES.smart.model)) ? { key, ...MODES.agent, model: MODES.smart.model, label: 'Agent · coding (Qwen 3.5 9B)' } : { key, ...MODES.agent };
  if (key === 'builder') return { key, ...MODES.builder, model: (await installed(MODES.builder.model)) ? MODES.builder.model : 'ather-brain' };
  if (key !== 'fast' && !(await installed(MODES[key].model))) key = mode === 'think' || key === 'deep' ? 'think' : 'fast';
  return { key, ...MODES[key] };
}

export async function availableModes() {
  return Promise.all(Object.entries(MODES).map(async ([key, m]) => ({ key, label: m.label, installed: await installed(m.model) })));
}

  brother: { label: 'Brother', voice: 'am_michael', prompt: 'You talk like a supportive older brother: casual, teasing a little, always hyping the user up. Use "bro" now and then.' },
  anime: { label: 'Anime Girl', voice: 'af_bella', prompt: 'You are a cheerful, energetic anime-style companion. Use cute expressions like "yay!" and "let\'s do our best!" but stay useful.' },

/** Built-in personalities plus the user's own (setting customPersonalities: [{ id, label, prompt, voice }]). */

  const merged = { ...personalities };
  for (const p of custom) if (p?.id && p.label && p.prompt) merged[p.id] = { label: p.label, prompt: p.prompt, voice: p.voice || 'af_heart', custom: true };
  return merged;
}

const STYLES = {
  // The notch bubble and spoken replies.

    'Use Markdown when it helps: short paragraphs, **bold** key terms, lists, tables for comparisons, fenced code blocks with the language name, LaTeX ($...$) for maths.',
    'If a word has several common meanings (python, java, mercury…), mention the main ones briefly or ask which one. When explaining a concept, include an everyday analogy or example.',

If you do not know or cannot know something, say so honestly and suggest where to find it; never invent numbers or facts. Use web_search for recent events. If the user is wrong, correct them politely and explain.',
  ].join(' '),
};

const AGENT = [
  'You are in AGENT MODE: the user gave you a goal to complete on their behalf.',
  'Your plan is listed below. Do the steps in order using tools, and call agent_step after each one (its 0-based index, done or failed, a short note).',
  'Keep going without asking until every step is done; only ask the user when you truly cannot continue. Check your work (e.g. query what you created).',

].join(' ');

const BUILDER = [
  'You are the SUPERVISOR of a small software team inside Maya, and you play every role yourself with tools:',
  '[Engineer] writes complete files with fs_write into the project folder (never placeholders like "..."; full HTML, CSS and JS).',
  '[QA] checks the work: qa_check_site for websites, run_command for "npm test" or a build. If QA finds errors, go back to Engineer, fix the files and run QA again (at most 3 rounds).',
  '[DevOps] runs git_init and git_commit when QA passes; github_publish only if the user asked to publish, deploy or put it online.',
  'Follow the plan step by step and call agent_step after each step.',
  'When it works, open it for the user (open_file for an index.html or the main file; run_command to start an app) so they see it without touching anything.',
  'Finish with two or three spoken-friendly sentences: what was built, where it is, how to use it, the QA result, and the live link if published.',
].join(' ');

/** "today = Sun 2026-11-01, tomorrow = Mon 2026-11-02, day after tomorrow = Tue 2026-11-03, Wed 2026-11-04, …" (8 days). */
export function calendarWeek(from = new Date()) {
  const names = ['today', 'tomorrow', 'day after tomorrow'];
  return Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => {
    const d = new Date(from); d.setDate(d.getDate() + i);
    const label = `${d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'short' })} ${d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA')}`;
    return names[i] ? `${names[i]} = ${label}` : label;
  }).join(', ');
}

export function systemPrompt(personalityId = 'normal', { style = 'short', memories = [], documents = '', summary = '', custom = [], agent = false, builder = false, me = {} } = {}) {
  const p = allPersonalities(custom)[personalityId] || personalities.normal;
  const nowText = new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  // "My Maya": the name, what to call the user, their rules and goals, set by the user.
  const name = (me.name || 'Maya').slice(0, 30);
  const prefs = memories.filter((m) => m.startsWith('(preference)'));
  const facts = memories.filter((m) => !m.startsWith('(preference)'));
  return [
    `You are ${name}, a smart and friendly AI assistant that lives on the user's computer.`,
    me.callMe ? `Call the user "${me.callMe.slice(0, 30)}".` : '',
    me.rules ? `The user's rules, always follow them:\n${me.rules.slice(0, 1000)}` : '',
    me.goals ? `The user's goals; help them get there and mention them when relevant:\n${me.goals.slice(0, 600)}` : '',
    p.prompt,
    `Right now it is ${nowText}. Give tools local ISO times like 2026-10-29T17:00.`,
    // Small models miscount "tomorrow"; a ready-made calendar lets them copy the date instead of computing it.
    `Dates: ${calendarWeek()}. Use these for "today", "tomorrow", "day after tomorrow", weekday names.`,
    'Use tools to actually do things (tasks, notes, reminders, habits, focus, calendar, search, web, images, screen, study sets). Never pretend an action happened without calling the tool.',
    'Look things up with a query tool before changing or deleting by id. Ask one short question only when you truly cannot go on without it.',
    'Only create tasks, reminders, habits or events when the user asks you to add, set, save or remind. When they ask you to make, write or suggest a plan or schedule, write it out in your answer right away (day by day, with times), filling in sensible assumptions instead of asking questions first; then offer to adjust it or add it as tasks.',
    'When the user shares a lasting personal fact or preference (name, college, course, exam dates, likes), save it with memory_save without being asked.',
    'When the user corrects you or says how they want things from now on ("no, I meant…", "always…", "don\'t…", "next time…", "I prefer…"), save it with memory_save (category preference) and follow it in every later answer.',
    STYLES[style] || STYLES.short,
    agent ? AGENT : '',
    builder ? BUILDER : '',
    'Always reply in the same language the user wrote in.',
    facts.length ? `What you remember about the user:\n${facts.map((m) => `- ${m}`).join('\n')}` : '',
    summary ? `Summary of the earlier part of this conversation:\n${summary}` : '',
    documents ? `The user attached documents to this conversation. Answer from them when relevant and say which document you used.\n${documents}` : '',
    // Last, where small models pay most attention: how the user told Maya to answer (corrections, 👎 notes).
    prefs.length ? `How this user wants you to answer. ALWAYS follow these in this answer; they override every other instruction above (length, style, language):\n${prefs.map((m) => `- ${m.replace(/^\(preference\)\s*/, '')}`).join('\n')}` : '',
  ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
}

### src/main/providers.js

```javascript
// Every place a model can run: local (Ollama, LM Studio) or cloud (any OpenAI-compatible API).
// All speak the OpenAI chat-completions protocol, so one client serves them all.
import { OLLAMA } from './ollama.js';
import { now } from './store.js';

export const PROVIDER_PRESETS = {
  ollama: { name: 'Ollama', baseUrl: `${OLLAMA}/v1`, local: true, keyless: true },
  lmstudio: { name: 'LM Studio', baseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1', local: true, keyless: true },
  openai: { name: 'OpenAI', baseUrl: 'https://api.openai.com/v1', local: false },
  groq: { name: 'Groq', baseUrl: 'https://api.groq.com/openai/v1', local: false },
  openrouter: { name: 'OpenRouter', baseUrl: 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1', local: false },
  gemini: { name: 'Google Gemini', baseUrl: 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai', local: false },
  anthropic: { name: 'Anthropic Claude', baseUrl: 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1', local: false },
  custom: { name: 'Custom (OpenAI-compatible)', baseUrl: '', local: false },
};

const RETRYABLE = new Set([408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504]);

export function createProviders({ store, secrets }) {
  /** Saved providers merged with the presets; Ollama is always present. */
  function list() {
    const saved = store.getSetting('providers', {});
    return Object.entries({ ollama: {}, lmstudio: {}, ...saved }).map(([id, cfg]) => {
      const preset = PROVIDER_PRESETS[cfg.preset || id] || PROVIDER_PRESETS.custom;
      return {
        id, preset: cfg.preset || id, name: cfg.name || preset.name, baseUrl: (cfg.baseUrl || preset.baseUrl).replace(/\/+$/, ''),
        local: cfg.local ?? preset.local, keyless: !!preset.keyless, enabled: cfg.enabled ?? id === 'ollama',
        timeoutMs: cfg.timeoutMs || 120_000, hasKey: secrets.has(`provider:${id}`), lastTest: cfg.lastTest || null,
      };
    });
  }
  const get = (id) => list().find((p) => p.id === id);

  function save(id, patch, apiKey) {
    const saved = store.getSetting('providers', {});
    saved[id] = { ...(saved[id] || {}), ...patch };
    store.setSetting('providers', saved);
    if (apiKey !== undefined) secrets.set(`provider:${id}`, apiKey || null);
    return get(id);
  }
  function remove(id) {
    if (id === 'ollama') throw new Error('Ollama cannot be removed');
    const saved = store.getSetting('providers', {});
    delete saved[id];
    store.setSetting('providers', saved);
    secrets.set(`provider:${id}`, null);
  }

  function headers(p) {
    const h = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' };
    const key = secrets.get(`provider:${p.id}`);
    if (key) h.Authorization = `Bearer ${key}`;
    if (p.preset === 'anthropic' && key) { h['x-api-key'] = key; h['anthropic-version'] = '2023-06-01'; }
    if (p.preset === 'openrouter') { h['HTTP-Referer'] = 'https://github.com/Achu226/ather'; h['X-Title'] = 'Maya'; }
    return h;
  }

  /** fetch with the provider's timeout, the caller's cancel signal, and one retry on rate limits / server errors. */
  async function request(p, path, body, signal) {
    for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
      const timeout = AbortSignal.timeout(p.timeoutMs);
      const res = await fetch(`${p.baseUrl}${path}`, {
        method: body ? 'POST' : 'GET', headers: headers(p), body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
        signal: signal ? AbortSignal.any([signal, timeout]) : timeout,
      }).catch((e) => {
        if (signal?.aborted) throw e;
        throw new Error(`${p.name} could not be reached at ${p.baseUrl} (${e.name === 'TimeoutError' ? 'timed out' : e.cause?.code || e.message}).`);
      });
      if (res.ok || attempt >= 1 || !RETRYABLE.has(res.status)) return res;
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500 * (attempt + 1)));
    }
  }

  async function models(id) {
    const p = get(id);
    const res = await request(p, '/models');
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${p.name}: ${res.status} ${(await res.text()).slice(0, 200)}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    return (data.data || data.models || []).map((m) => m.id || m.name).filter(Boolean).sort();
  }

  /** Connection test: list models, then a one-word chat with the first (or given) model. Saves the result. */
  async function test(id, model) {
    const p = get(id);
    const started = Date.now();
    let result;
    try {
      const names = await models(id);
      const pick = model || names.find((n) => !/embed/i.test(n)) || names[0];
      if (!pick) throw new Error('No models are available on this provider yet.');
      const res = await request(p, '/chat/completions', { model: pick, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Reply with the word OK.' }], max_tokens: 8 });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${res.status} ${(await res.text()).slice(0, 200)}`);
      const reply = (await res.json()).choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
      result = { ok: true, models: names.length, model: pick, reply: reply.trim().slice(0, 40), ms: Date.now() - started };
    } catch (e) {
      result = { ok: false, error: e.message, ms: Date.now() - started };
    }
    save(id, { lastTest: { ...result, at: now() } });
    return result;
  }

  function recordUsage(providerId, model, usage) {
    if (!usage) return;
    store.run('INSERT INTO usage (provider, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
      providerId, model, usage.prompt_tokens || 0, usage.completion_tokens || 0, now());
  }
  const usageSummary = () => store.all(`SELECT provider, model, COUNT(*) AS requests, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens,
    SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens, MAX(at) AS last FROM usage GROUP BY provider, model ORDER BY last DESC`);

  return { list, get, save, remove, models, test, request, recordUsage, usageSummary };
}

### src/main/ollama.js

```javascript
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

/**
 * OLLAMA_HOST is the address Ollama *listens* on, often "0.0.0.0:11434" with no scheme: to connect, add http://
 * and use this PC for 0.0.0.0. Exported for tests.
 */
export function ollamaUrl(host = '') {
  if (!host.trim()) return 'http://127.0.0.1:11434';
  const url = /^https?:\/\//i.test(host) ? host.trim() : `http://${host.trim()}`;
  return url.replace(/\/\/(0\.0\.0\.0|\[::\])(?=[:/]|$)/, '//127.0.0.1').replace(/\/+$/, '');
}
export const OLLAMA = ollamaUrl(process.env.OLLAMA_HOST);

async function up() {
  try { return (await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/version`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2000) })).ok; } catch { return false; }
}

/** Make sure the Ollama server is running; start it if it is installed but stopped. */
export async function ensureOllama() {
  if (await up()) return true;
  const exe = [join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA || '', 'Programs', 'Ollama', 'ollama.exe')].find(existsSync) || 'ollama';
  try {
    spawn(exe, ['serve'], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide: true }).unref();
  } catch { return false; }
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500));
    if (await up()) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export async function hasModel(name) {
  const res = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/show`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ model: name }) });
  return res.ok;
}

/** Unload every Ollama model so another GPU program (the image generator) gets the video memory. */
export async function freeGpu() {
  const res = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/ps`).catch(() => null);
  if (!res?.ok) return;
  const { models = [] } = await res.json();
  await Promise.all(models.map((m) => fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/generate`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ model: m.name, keep_alive: 0 }) }).catch(() => {})));
}

/** Pull a model, reporting progress as 0..1. */
export async function pullModel(name, onProgress = () => {}) {
  const res = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/pull`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ model: name, stream: true }) });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not download ${name}: ${res.status}`);
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let buf = '';
  for await (const chunk of res.body) {
    buf += decoder.decode(chunk, { stream: true });
    let i;
    while ((i = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) {
      const line = buf.slice(0, i); buf = buf.slice(i + 1);
      if (!line.trim()) continue;
      const msg = JSON.parse(line);
      if (msg.error) throw new Error(msg.error);
      if (msg.total) onProgress(msg.completed / msg.total, msg.status);
    }
  }
  onProgress(1, 'done');
}

/**
 * Maya's own copy of a model with a 16K context: the tool list alone is ~5.5K tokens, and Ollama's
 * default 4K context cut answers off mid-sentence. Shares the base model's files, so no extra download.
 * Re-created when an older Maya made it with a different context size.
 */
export async function ensureBrainModel(alias, base, numCtx = 16384) {
  const show = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/show`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ model: alias }) });
  if (show.ok && new RegExp(`num_ctx\\s+${numCtx}\\b`).test((await show.json()).parameters || '')) return true;
  if (!(await hasModel(base))) return false;
  const res = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/create`, {
    method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ model: alias, from: base, parameters: { num_ctx: numCtx }, stream: false }),
  });
  return res.ok;
}

export async function embed(texts, model = 'nomic-embed-text') {
  const res = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/embed`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ model, input: texts }) });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Embedding failed: ${res.status}`);
  return (await res.json()).embeddings;
}

// Give the model only the tools a request can need: ~60 tool descriptions confuse small models into
// printing tool JSON instead of answering. Agent mode still gets everything.
const ALWAYS = ['memory_save', 'web_search', 'tasks_create', 'reminders_create', 'notes_create', 'app_undo', 'history_query'];

const GROUPS = [
  // People and feelings
  [/\b(whats ?app|message (to )?\w+|text (to )?\w+|call\b|ring|phone|contacts?|number of|save .* number)/i, /^(contacts_|call_contact|whatsapp_message)/],
  [/\b(diary|journal|dear diary|how was my (week|day|month)|what did i write|i feel|i'?m feeling|my mood)/i, /^diary_/],
  // Camera eyes and interpreter (for people who cannot see well, or talk to someone in another language)
  [/\b(in front of me|am i holding|camera|webcam|look at (this|it|me)|what(?:'s| is) this (in my hand|thing)|read (this|the|my) (paper|letter|label|page|text|bill|card|book|note|notice|prescription|tablet|medicine)|what colou?r is)/i, /^camera_/],
  [/\b(interpret(er)?|translate (my|our|the) (conversation|talk)|talk to (him|her|them) in|translate what (he|she|they) say)/i, /^interpreter$/],
  // Everyday voice actions (as on heynixi.app)
  [/\b(where (is|are|'s|do i)|show me where|point (to|at)|how do i find the)\b/i, /^(screen_point|screen_look)$/],
  [/^\s*(please\s+|can you\s+)?(write|draft|compose)\b|\bwrite (a|an|the|my|me a) .*(reply|e-?mail|mail|note|message|post|letter|caption|tweet|comment)/i, /^write_here$/],
  [/\b(tele ?prompter|prompter)\b/i, /^teleprompter$/],
  [/\b(timer|countdown)\b/i, /^timer_/],
  [/\b(lists?|shopping|grocer(y|ies)|i bought|buy)\b/i, /^list_/],
  [/\b(dark|light|night) (mode|theme)\b/i, /^pc_dark_mode$/],
  [/\b(play|put on|listen to)\b/i, /^music_play$/],
  [/\b(task|to-?do|remind|reminder|note|habit|focus|pomodoro|calendar|event|schedule|meeting|class|exam|deadline|due|undo|plan my|did i|productive|streak)/i,
    /^(tasks_|notes_|reminders_|habits_|focus_|calendar_|history_|app_undo)/],
  [/\b(open|launch|start|close|quit|volume|louder|quieter|mute|brightness|lock|shutdown|shut down|(turn|switch|power) (off|down)|reboot|restart|sleep|play|pause|next song|previous|music|song|routine|mode|wifi|bluetooth|settings|screen time|spent|youtube|instagram|activity|apps? i used)/i,
    /^(pc_|routines_|activity_|focus_)/],
  [/\b(search|google|latest|news|today|current|price|weather|who won|score|website|web ?page|link|https?:|url|open .*\.com|read this page)/i, /^(web_|open_website)/],
  [/\b(find|search|where is|locate) (my|the)|\b(my )?(files?|photos?|pictures?|folder|documents?) (of|about|from|with|named)/i, /^(files_search|open_file)/],
  [/\b(draw|image|picture|photo|illustration|blur|background|upscale|sharper|generate an?)/i, /^images_/],
  [/\b(quiz|flashcards?|revise|revision|study set|test me|practice questions)/i, /^study_/],
  [/\b(calculate|compute|plot|graph|chart|python|csv|excel|spreadsheet|statistics|average|run (this|the) code)/i, /^python_/],
  [/\b(ppt|powerpoint|presentation|slides?|word (doc|file)|docx|pdf|report|assignment|document|letter)\b/i, /^files_make_/],
  // An email address in the request ("write to rahul@…") means email, whatever the verb.
  [/\b(e-?mail|inbox|mail|repl(y|ied|ies)|follow ?up|newsletters?|promotions?|unsubscribe)|[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/i, /^mail_/],
  [/\b(work timer|work (on .{1,40} )?for \d|work session|shut ?down (the |my )?(pc |computer |laptop )?(after|in|at|when)|(after|then|later)\b.{0,15}shut ?down)/i, /^work_timer_/],
  [/\b(ask|in|on|to|use) (chat ?gpt|gpt|claude)\b|\b(chat ?gpt|claude)\b/i, /^ai_ask$/],
  [/\b(skills?|teach (yourself|you)|when i say|learn (to|this|how))\b/i, /^skills_/],
  [/\b(snippets?|save my [\w ]{2,25} as|type my)\b/i, /^snippets_save$/],
  // "Every morning at 8, read my emails and today's tasks": a daily routine.
  [/\b(every (day|morning|evening|night|weekday|afternoon)|each (morning|day|evening)|daily at|routines?)\b/i, /^(routines_|briefing_now)/],
  [/\b(text|font|letters?|theme|dark|light|colou?r|bigger|smaller|compact|hide|show .{1,20}page|page|large mode|high contrast|sidebar)\b/i, /^ui_set$/],
  [/\b(your name|call you|call me|rename you|rule|always (answer|reply|speak|talk)|my goals?|(talk|speak)\b.{0,15}\b(slower|faster|slowly|quickly)|slow(er)? down|speed up|voice|sound like|chrome profile|use my .{1,15} chrome)\b/i, /^persona_set$/],
  [/\b(what (are|were) you doing|what did you do|what have you done|did (it|that) work|your (work|progress)|என்ன செய்(கிறாய்|தாய்))/i, /^monitor_status$/],
  [/\b(mishear|hear(s|d)? .{1,30} (when|instead)|spell(ed|t|ing)? |you keep (hearing|writing)|not .{1,20}, it'?s )/i, /^learn_word$/],
  [/\b(weekly report|week'?s report|report (of|for|on) (my|this|the) week|my week)\b/i, /^report_/],
  [/\b(screen|what am i looking at|this window|on my monitor)/i, /^screen_look$/],
  [/\b(remember|forget|what do you know about me|my name|about me)/i, /^memory_/],
  [/\b(personality|talk like|voice|act like|be more)/i, /^personality_set$/],
  [/\b(briefing|brief me|my day|plan for today|summary of today)/i, /^briefing_now$/],
  [/\b(animation|wave|celebrate|dance)/i, /^animations_play$/],
  [/\b(files?|folders?|downloads|desktop|documents folder|organi[sz]e|tidy|clean ?up|rename|move .* to|recycle bin|delete (the|this|that|my) )/i, /^fs_/],
  [/\b(git|commit|diff|branch|uncommitted|changes in (my|the) (project|code|repo))/i, /^git_/],
  [/\b(database|sqlite|\.db\b|\bsql\b|tables? in)/i, /^db_/],
  [/\b(what time|time in|timezone|time zone|convert .* time|how long until|how many days|countdown|days (left|until))/i, /^time_/],
  [/\b(run|npm|pip|pytest|build|compile|tests?|fix (the|this|my) (bug|code|error)|bug in|my project|codebase|refactor)\b/i, /^(run_command|fs_|git_)/],
  [/\b(timetable|time table|class(es)?|lecture timings|periods?|exams?|mid-?sems?|end-?sems?|days (left|until)|countdown)\b/i, /^(timetable_|exams_|calendar_query)/],
  [/\b(cpu|ram|memory usage|battery|gpu|graphics card|disk space|storage (left|space)|temperature|system status|how is my (pc|laptop|computer)|(pc|laptop|computer) (is )?(slow|hot|lagging))/i, /^system_status$/],
  [/\b(i cop(y|ied)|copied|clipboard|paste (the|that|what))/i, /^clipboard_/],
  [/\b(water|hydrat|eye breaks?|20-20-20|posture|stretch|health (break|reminder)s?)/i, /^health_/],
  [/\b(head mouse|hands?-free|without (a |the )?mouse|can'?t use (a |the |my )?mouse|move the (cursor|mouse) with my head|head (control|tracking))/i, /^head_mouse$/],
  [/\b(captions?|subtitles?|translate (this|the) (video|audio|call|class)|what (are|is) they saying)/i, /^captions_/],
  [/\b(wheel ?chair|accessible|ramps?|step-?free|near me|nearby|nearest|closest|around here)\b/i, /^places_accessible$/],
  [/\b(medical (id|info|details)|blood (group|type)|allerg|my (health )?conditions?|my doctor)/i, /^medical_id$/],
  [/\b((in|on|into) (whatsapp|notepad|word|excel|telegram|teams|outlook|paint|settings|chrome|edge|google|youtube|gmail|the app|the browser|this (app|window|page))|type (?!of\b)\S|write .+ (in|into|on) |click\b|select\b|open .+ (and|then) (type|search|write|click|send|play|calculate|work out|draw|drag|rename|edit)|(use|using|with) (the |my )?(mouse|keyboard)|fill (in|out|this)|(message|text|whatsapp) \w+|send (a|the|my)? ?message|(take )?control (of )?(my|the) (pc|computer|laptop)|use my (pc|computer|laptop)|do it for me|go to|scroll (up|down)|press (enter|the|ctrl)|(search|look up) .* (in|on) (chrome|google|youtube|edge))/i, /^computer_/],
];

/** Tools for this request: a few always, plus groups whose keywords appear in this or the previous user message. */
export function selectTools(tools, text, { agent = false, previous = '', images = 0 } = {}) {
  if (agent) return tools;
  const haystack = `${text}\n${previous}`;
  const patterns = GROUPS.filter(([words]) => words.test(haystack)).map(([, names]) => names);
  if (images) patterns.push(/^images_/);
  // MCP tools carry their server's keywords; only servers relevant to this request are loaded.
  return tools.filter((t) => ALWAYS.includes(t.name) || patterns.some((p) => p.test(t.name)) || t.keywords?.test(haystack));
}

// Skills: named recipes Maya follows ("when I say goodnight, turn on dark mode and read tomorrow's tasks").

import { now } from '../store.js';
import { looksLikePassword } from './clipboard.js';

export const BUILTIN = [

  ['Monthly budget', 'make a budget, track spending or plan monthly expenses', 'Collect income and expenses (ask once if missing). Use python_run to build an Excel sheet with categories, totals and a pie chart, and say how much is left to save.', '^python_'],
  ['Trip plan', 'plan a trip, holiday, travel or visit somewhere', 'Search the web for travel options, weather and places. Write a day-by-day plan with times, costs and accessible options (lifts, ramps, rest stops). Offer to add it to the calendar.', '^(web_|calendar_create)'],

Use what you know about the user (memory_list) for name, address or phone, and ask for anything else one field at a time. Type each answer into its field with computer_type.   ['Build me an app', 'build, make or code a website, app, game or program', 'Plan the files, write them with fs_write, run them (run_command), check with qa_check_site, fix errors until it works, then open it for the user (open_file / open_website) and explain how to use it in two lines.', '^(fs_|run_command|qa_|git_|open_)'],

const seeded = new WeakSet();
/** Seeds the built-in skills once per store (a user's changes to them are kept). */
export function seedSkills(store) {
  if (seeded.has(store)) return;
  seeded.add(store);
  for (const [name, when, steps, tools] of BUILTIN) {
    store.run('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO skills (name, "when", steps, tools, builtin, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,1,?)', name, when, steps, tools, now());
  }
}

const STOP = new Set('a an the and or to for of in on my me i you it is are be do make with about from this that please can could would will some'.split(' '));
const words = (s) => String(s).toLowerCase().match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu)?.filter((w) => w.length > 2 && !STOP.has(w)) || [];
const stem = (w) => w.replace(/(ing|ies|es|ed|s)$/, '');

/**
 * The enabled skill that fits this request best, or null. The skill's name said aloud wins outright
 * ("goodnight"); otherwise at least two meaningful words must match its name or description.
 */
export function matchSkill(store, text) {
  seedSkills(store);
  // "Open the Calculator app": that "app" already exists, so it must not pull in "Build me an app".
  const t = String(text).toLowerCase().replace(/\b(open|launch|start|use|in|on|into) (the |my )?([\p{L}\p{N}]+ ){0,3}app\b/gu, '$1');
  const asked = new Set(words(t).map(stem));
  let best = null, bestScore = 0;
  for (const s of store.all('SELECT * FROM skills WHERE enabled = 1')) {
    if (t.includes(s.name.toLowerCase())) return s;
    // Words of the skill's name count double: "presentation" alone should find the Presentation maker.
    const named = new Set(words(s.name).map(stem));
    const score = [...new Set([...named, ...words(s.when).map(stem)])].filter((w) => asked.has(w)).reduce((n, w) => n + (named.has(w) ? 2 : 1), 0);
    if (score > bestScore) { best = s; bestScore = score; }
  }
  return bestScore >= 2 ? best : null;
}

export function saveSkill(store, { name, when, steps, tools = '' }) {
  if (!name?.trim() || !when?.trim() || !steps?.trim()) throw new Error('A skill needs a name, when to use it, and its steps.');
  if (tools) new RegExp(tools); // throws on a broken pattern before it is saved
  const row = store.get('SELECT id FROM skills WHERE name = ?', name.trim());
  if (row) store.run('UPDATE skills SET "when" = ?, steps = ?, tools = ?, enabled = 1 WHERE id = ?', when.trim(), steps.trim(), tools, row.id);
  else store.run('INSERT INTO skills (name, "when", steps, tools, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)', name.trim(), when.trim(), steps.trim(), tools, now());
  return { saved: name.trim() };
}

const LOOKUP = /^(agent_|time_|web_)|_(query|status|progress|list|search|read|look)$/;
const secret = (s) => /\b(password|passcode|pin|otp|cvv|card number)\b/i.test(s) || String(s).split(/\s+/).some(looksLikePassword);

/** The calls of a finished job that worked: planning, failed and refused calls left out. Exported for tests. */
export const jobSteps = (toolLog) => toolLog.filter((t) => !t.name.startsWith('agent_') && !t.result?.error && !t.result?.denied);

/**
 * Hermes-style learning: a multi-step job that just worked, which no skill covered, is written up by the local
 * model as a skill the user can keep. Returns the offer (not saved) or null. Its tools are the ones the job
 * really used, never what the model writes, so a learned skill cannot reach anything new.
 */
export async function learnSkill(store, question, toolLog, complete) {
  const last = toolLog.at(-1)?.result;
  if (String(question).trim().split(/\s+/).length < 4 || secret(question) || last?.error || toolLog.some((t) => t.result?.denied)) return null;
  const steps = jobSteps(toolLog);
  const names = [...new Set(steps.map((t) => t.name))];
  if (steps.filter((t) => !LOOKUP.test(t.name)).length < 3 || names.length < 2 || matchSkill(store, question)) return null;
  const done = steps.map((t, i) => `${i + 1}. ${t.name} ${JSON.stringify(t.args).slice(0, 200)}`).join('\n');
  const raw = await complete(`The user asked their assistant Maya: "${String(question).slice(0, 500)}"\nMaya did it with these tool calls:\n${done}\n\n`
    + 'Write this as a reusable skill so Maya can do the same kind of job again. name: 2 to 5 words. when: the kinds of requests it is for, in plain words. '
    + 'steps: short numbered steps naming the tools to call. Keep it general: write "the contact the user names", "the file the user names", never the actual names, numbers, messages or paths. Reply as JSON.',
  { format: { type: 'object', required: ['name', 'when', 'steps'], properties: { name: { type: 'string' }, when: { type: 'string' }, steps: { type: 'string' } } } });
  let skill;
  try { skill = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { return null; }
  const name = String(skill.name || '').trim(), when = String(skill.when || '').trim(), how = String(skill.steps || '').trim();
  if (!name || name.length > 40 || !when || when.length > 300 || !how || how.length > 2000 || secret(how)) return null;
  if (store.get('SELECT id FROM skills WHERE lower(name) = lower(?)', name)) return null;
  return { name, when, steps: how, tools: `^(${names.map((n) => n.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')).join('|')})$` };
}

### src/main/services/learning.js

```javascript
// Learning from the user, all on this PC: words Maya keeps mishearing, and what the user liked or did not like.
import { now } from '../store.js';
import { looksLikePassword } from './clipboard.js';

const MAX_WORDS = 300;
const clean = (w) => String(w).toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}' -]/gu, '').trim();
const escape = (s) => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

/** What the user said, with the words Maya learned to fix ("mya" → "Maya"). */
export function fixHeard(store, text) {
  let out = String(text || '');
  for (const [heard, meant] of Object.entries(store.getSetting('learnedWords', {}))) {
    out = out.replace(new RegExp(`(?<![\\p{L}\\p{N}])${escape(heard)}(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}])`, 'giu'), meant);
  }
  return out;
}

export function learnWord(store, heard, meant) {
  const h = clean(heard), m = String(meant || '').trim();
  if (!h || !m || h === m.toLowerCase() || h.length > 40 || m.length > 40) return { learned: false };
  const words = { ...store.getSetting('learnedWords', {}), [h]: m };
  const keys = Object.keys(words);
  if (keys.length > MAX_WORDS) delete words[keys[0]]; // oldest first
  store.setSetting('learnedWords', words);
  return { learned: true, heard: h, meant: m };
}

/**
 * The user fixed a transcription before sending it: one or two changed words are learned
 * (more than that is a rewrite, not a mishearing). Exported for tests.
 */
export function wordFixes(heard, sent) {
  const a = String(heard).trim().split(/\s+/), b = String(sent).trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (a.length !== b.length || a.length > 40) return [];
  const pairs = a.map((w, i) => [clean(w), b[i].replace(/[.,!?;:]+$/, '')]).filter(([h, m]) => h && clean(m) && h !== clean(m));
  return pairs.length && pairs.length <= 2 ? pairs : [];
}

const words = (s) => new Set(String(s).toLowerCase().match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]{3,}/gu) || []);
/** A new fact is a repeat when most of its words are already in one saved fact (exported for tests). */
export function knownFact(fact, saved) {
  const w = words(fact);
  return saved.some((s) => { const o = words(s); const shared = [...w].filter((x) => o.has(x)).length; return w.size && shared / w.size >= 0.7; });
}

/**
 * After each exchange Maya thinks back: lasting facts about the user it heard are saved, so it does not forget.
 * complete(prompt, opts) is the local model; secrets and repeats are never saved.
 */
export async function reflect(store, question, answer, complete) {
  if (String(question).trim().split(/\s+/).length < 4 || looksLikePassword(question)) return [];
  const raw = await complete(`Read this exchange between a user and their assistant Maya.\nUser: ${String(question).slice(0, 1500)}\nMaya: ${String(answer).slice(0, 800)}\n\n`
    + 'List lasting facts about the USER worth remembering in future chats: who they are, people in their life, preferences, plans, dates, goals, health needs. '
    + 'Not small talk, not questions, not facts about Maya or the world, never passwords or codes. At most 3 facts, each under 15 words, third person ("Has a brother named Rahul"). Reply as JSON.',
  { format: { type: 'object', required: ['facts'], properties: { facts: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } } } });
  let facts = [];
  try { facts = JSON.parse(raw).facts || []; } catch { return []; }
  const saved = store.all('SELECT fact FROM memories WHERE deleted = 0').map((m) => m.fact);
  const kept = [];
  const secret = (x) => /\b(password|passcode|pin|otp|cvv|card number)\b/i.test(x) || x.split(/\s+/).some(looksLikePassword);
  for (const f of facts.map((x) => String(x).trim()).filter((x) => x.length > 5 && x.length < 160 && !secret(x))) {
    if (knownFact(f, [...saved, ...kept])) continue;
    store.insert('memories', { fact: f, category: 'fact', created_at: now(), updated_at: now() }, 'Remembered from the conversation');
    kept.push(f);
  }
  return kept;
}

/** 👍 counts; 👎 with a note becomes a preference Maya follows from now on. */
export function saveFeedback(store, { question = '', good, note = '' }) {
  const log = store.getSetting('feedback', { good: 0, bad: 0 });
  store.setSetting('feedback', { ...log, [good ? 'good' : 'bad']: (log[good ? 'good' : 'bad'] || 0) + 1 });
  if (good || !note.trim()) return { saved: true };
  // Kept general: a 👎 note ("shorter answers") is about how Maya answers, not only that one question.
  const fact = `How the user wants answers: ${note.trim().slice(0, 200)} (said after "${question.slice(0, 60)}")`;
  store.insert('memories', { fact, category: 'preference', created_at: now(), updated_at: now() }, 'Learned from feedback');
  return { saved: true, learned: fact };
}
```
