```javascript
// The work monitor: every action Maya takes, in plain words ("Wrote app.js", "Sent an email to Rahul"),
// kept 30 days on this PC. The Monitor page shows it live; "what are you doing?" reads it out.
import { now } from '../store.js';

const KEEP_DAYS = 30;
const short = (s, n = 70) => { const t = String(s ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return t.length > n ? `${t.slice(0, n - 1)}…` : t; };
const file = (p) => String(p || '').split(/[\\/]/).pop();

/** One action in everyday words (exported for tests). */
export function describe(name, args = {}, result = {}) {
  const r = result || {};
  const failed = r.error ? ` — failed: ${short(r.error, 60)}` : r.denied ? ' — you said no' : '';
  const said = {
    fs_write: () => `Wrote ${file(args.path)}`,
    fs_read: () => `Read ${file(args.path)}`,
    run_command: () => `Ran “${short(args.command, 50)}”${r.exit_code !== undefined ? ` (exit ${r.exit_code})` : ''}`,
    python_run: () => 'Ran Python code',
    web_search: () => `Searched the web for “${short(args.query, 50)}”`,
    web_read: () => `Read a web page`,
    mail_send: () => `Sent an email to ${args.to}`,
    mail_reply: () => 'Replied to an email',
    mail_search: () => 'Searched your email',
    files_make_document: () => `Made the document “${short(args.title, 40)}”`,
    files_make_presentation: () => `Made the slides “${short(args.title, 40)}”`,
    tasks_create: () => `Added the task “${short(args.title, 50)}”`,
    reminders_create: () => `Set a reminder: ${short(args.text, 50)}`,
    computer_type: () => 'Typed on the screen',
    computer_click: () => 'Clicked on the screen',
    computer_open: () => `Opened ${args.name || args.app || 'an app'}`,
    pc_open_app: () => `Opened ${args.name}`,
    pc_power: () => `Asked to ${args.action} the PC`,
    qa_check_site: () => `Checked the website${r.errors?.length ? ` — ${r.errors.length} problem(s)` : ''}`,
    git_commit: () => `Saved a Git commit: ${short(args.message, 40)}`,
    agent_plan: () => `Made a plan with ${args.steps?.length || 0} steps`,
    skills_save: () => `Learned the skill “${args.name}”`,
  }[name];
  const first = Object.values(args).find((v) => typeof v === 'string');
  return (said ? said() : `${name.replace(/_/g, ' ')}${first ? `: ${short(first, 50)}` : ''}`) + failed;
}

export function logWork(store, { source = 'chat', name, args, result, ms = 0 }) {
  const status = result?.error ? 'failed' : result?.denied ? 'denied' : 'done';
  const { lastInsertRowid } = store.run('INSERT INTO work_log (at, source, name, detail, status, ms) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)', now(), source, name, describe(name, args, result), status, Math.round(ms));
  // Old entries go now and then, not on every write.
  if (Number(lastInsertRowid) % 200 === 0) store.run('DELETE FROM work_log WHERE at < ?', new Date(Date.now() - KEEP_DAYS * 864e5).toISOString());
}

/** Today's work, newest first, with totals: what "what are you doing / what did you do today?" reads. */
export function workToday(store, limit = 50) {
  const since = new Date(new Date().setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)).toISOString();
  const items = store.all('SELECT * FROM work_log WHERE at >= ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?', since, limit);
  const totals = store.get("SELECT COUNT(*) AS actions, SUM(status = 'failed') AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(ms), 0) AS ms FROM work_log WHERE at >= ?", since);
  return { now: items[0] && Date.now() - Date.parse(items[0].at) < 15_000 ? items[0].detail : null, actions: totals.actions, failed: totals.failed || 0, minutes: Math.round(totals.ms / 60000), items };
}
```

### src/main/tools/maya.js

```javascript
// Teaching Maya: skills it can learn, what it is doing (the work monitor), and changing how it looks and behaves.
import { saveSkill, seedSkills } from '../services/skills.js';
import { learnWord } from '../services/learning.js';
import { workToday } from '../services/worklog.js';
import { chromeProfiles } from '../services/pc.js';
import { looksLikePassword } from '../services/clipboard.js';

const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });

// Pages that can be hidden from the sidebar (Home, Chat, Accessibility, My Maya and Settings always stay).
export const HIDEABLE = ['tasks', 'notes', 'habits', 'focus', 'study', 'workflows', 'activity', 'calendar', 'inbox', 'search', 'images', 'models', 'mcp', 'skills', 'monitor', 'connections', 'brain'];
const SIZES = { normal: 1, large: 1.15, larger: 1.3 };
const set = (ctx, key, value) => (ctx.services?.setSetting ? ctx.services.setSetting(key, value) : ctx.store.setSetting(key, value));

/** Safe, validated changes to how Maya looks (exported for tests). */
export function uiSet(ctx, { theme, text_size, accent, density, hide_page, show_page, large_mode }) {
  const ui = { ...ctx.store.getSetting('ui', {}) };
  const done = [];
  if (theme) { if (!['light', 'dark', 'system'].includes(theme)) throw new Error('theme is light, dark or system'); set(ctx, 'theme', theme); done.push(`theme ${theme}`); }
  if (text_size) { if (!SIZES[text_size]) throw new Error('text_size is normal, large or larger'); ui.fontScale = SIZES[text_size]; done.push(`text ${text_size}`); }
  if (accent) { if (!/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(accent)) throw new Error('accent is a colour like #12b886'); ui.accent = accent; done.push(`colour ${accent}`); }
  if (density) { if (!['comfortable', 'compact'].includes(density)) throw new Error('density is comfortable or compact'); ui.density = density; done.push(density); }
  const page = (p) => { const k = String(p).toLowerCase().replace(/^the\s+|\s+page$/g, '').replace('smart search', 'search').replace('image tools', 'images').replace('work monitor', 'monitor'); if (!HIDEABLE.includes(k)) throw new Error(`${p} cannot be hidden. Pages: ${HIDEABLE.join(', ')}`); return k; };
  if (hide_page) { ui.hidePages = [...new Set([...(ui.hidePages || []), page(hide_page)])]; done.push(`hid ${hide_page}`); }
  if (show_page) { ui.hidePages = (ui.hidePages || []).filter((p) => p !== page(show_page)); done.push(`showing ${show_page}`); }
  if (large_mode !== undefined) { set(ctx, 'a11yLarge', !!large_mode); done.push(`large mode ${large_mode ? 'on' : 'off'}`); }
  set(ctx, 'ui', ui);
  return { changed: done };
}

/** Safe, validated changes to Maya itself (exported for tests). */
export function personaSet(ctx, { name, call_me, add_rule, goals, speed, slower, faster, voice_engine, chrome_profile }, profiles = chromeProfiles()) {
  const a = { ...ctx.store.getSetting('agent', {}) };
  const done = [];
  if (name) { const n = name.trim(); if (!/^[\p{L} '-]{2,20}$/u.test(n)) throw new Error('A name is 2 to 20 letters.'); a.name = n; done.push(`name ${n}; say "Hey ${n}" to wake me`); }
  if (call_me) { set(ctx, 'userTitle', call_me.trim().slice(0, 30)); done.push(`calling you ${call_me}`); }
  if (add_rule) { a.rules = [a.rules, `- ${add_rule.trim().slice(0, 200)}`].filter(Boolean).join('\n').slice(-1000); done.push(`rule: ${add_rule}`); }
  if (goals) { a.goals = goals.trim().slice(0, 600); done.push('goals saved'); }
  let s = Number(speed) || a.speed || 1;
  if (slower) s -= 0.1;
  if (faster) s += 0.1;
  if (speed || slower || faster) { a.speed = Math.round(Math.min(1.3, Math.max(0.7, s)) * 10) / 10; done.push(`speaking speed ${a.speed}`); }
  if (voice_engine) { if (!['local', 'openai'].includes(voice_engine)) throw new Error('voice_engine is local or openai'); set(ctx, 'voiceEngine', voice_engine); done.push(`voice: ${voice_engine}`); }
  if (chrome_profile) {
    const want = chrome_profile.toLowerCase().replace(/\b(my|the|chrome|profile)\b/g, '').trim();
    const p = profiles.find((x) => [x.name, x.account, x.dir].some((n) => n && n.toLowerCase().includes(want)));
    if (!p) throw new Error(`No Chrome profile called ${chrome_profile}. Profiles: ${profiles.map((x) => x.name).join(', ')}`);
    set(ctx, 'chromeProfile', p.dir);
    done.push(`Chrome profile ${p.name}`);
  }
  set(ctx, 'agent', a);
  return { changed: done };
}

export const mayaTools = [
  {
    name: 'snippets_save',
    description: 'Save a piece of text the user often types, under a short name: "save my address as 12 Gandhi Street, Chennai". Later "type my address" types it anywhere. Never passwords or card numbers.',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Short name, e.g. "address", "email", "bank IFSC"'), text: str('The exact text to type') }, ['name', 'text']),
    run: ({ name, text }, ctx) => {
      const n = String(name).toLowerCase().replace(/^my\s+/, '').trim();
      if (!n || !text?.trim()) return { error: 'A snippet needs a name and its text.' };
      if (/\b(password|passcode|pin|otp|cvv|card number)\b/i.test(`${n} ${text}`) || String(text).split(/\s+/).some(looksLikePassword)) return { error: 'Maya does not keep passwords, PINs or card numbers.' };
      set(ctx, 'snippets', { ...ctx.store.getSetting('snippets', {}), [n]: String(text).trim().slice(0, 1000) });
      return { saved: n, say_to_use: `type my ${n}` };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'ui_set',
    description: 'Change how Maya\'s screens look: theme (light/dark/system), text_size (normal/large/larger), accent colour (#hex), density (comfortable/compact), hide_page / show_page (e.g. "study"), large_mode (big buttons, high contrast). E.g. "make the text bigger", "use dark theme", "hide the Study page".',
    parameters: obj({ theme: { type: 'string', enum: ['light', 'dark', 'system'] }, text_size: { type: 'string', enum: ['normal', 'large', 'larger'] }, accent: str('Colour like #12b886'),
      density: { type: 'string', enum: ['comfortable', 'compact'] }, hide_page: str('Page to hide'), show_page: str('Page to show again'), large_mode: { type: 'boolean' } }),
    run: (args, ctx) => uiSet(ctx, args),
  },
  {
    name: 'persona_set',
    description: 'You CAN change yourself with this, so never say you cannot. Change Maya itself: its name (the wake word follows), what to call the user, a rule to always follow ("always answer in Tamil"), the user\'s goals, speaking speed (speed 0.7-1.3, or slower/faster), voice_engine (local = free voices on this PC, openai = ChatGPT\'s voices with the user\'s key).',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('New name'), call_me: str('What to call the user'), add_rule: str('A rule'), goals: str('The user\'s goals'), speed: { type: 'number' },
      slower: { type: 'boolean' }, faster: { type: 'boolean' }, voice_engine: { type: 'string', enum: ['local', 'openai'] }, chrome_profile: str('Which Chrome profile to open websites in, e.g. "Work"') }),
    run: (args, ctx) => personaSet(ctx, args),
  },
  {
    name: 'monitor_status',
    description: 'What Maya is doing right now and what it did today (every action, failures, time spent). Use for "what are you doing?", "what did you do today?", "did that work?". Answer in a few spoken sentences.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => { const w = workToday(store, 15); return { ...w, items: w.items.map((i) => `${i.at.slice(11, 16)} ${i.detail}${i.status === 'done' ? '' : ` (${i.status})`}`) }; },
  },
  {
    name: 'learn_word',
    description: 'Learn a word Maya keeps mishearing, e.g. "you hear my when I say Maya" or "it is spelled Gowtham, not Gautam". From now on that word is fixed in everything the user says.',
    parameters: obj({ heard: str('What Maya wrongly heard or wrote'), meant: str('What the user really says / the right spelling') }, ['heard', 'meant']),
    run: ({ heard, meant }, { store }) => learnWord(store, heard, meant),
  },
  {
    name: 'skills_list',
    description: 'List the skills Maya knows (built-in and taught by the user).',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => { seedSkills(store); return store.all('SELECT name, "when", enabled, builtin, uses FROM skills ORDER BY builtin, name'); },
  },
  {
    name: 'skills_save',
    description: 'Learn a new skill the user teaches, e.g. "teach yourself: when I say goodnight, turn on dark mode and tell me tomorrow\'s tasks". name = the short trigger ("Goodnight"), when = when to use it, steps = exactly what to do, in order.',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Short name, also the words that start it'), when: str('When to use it'), steps: str('What to do, step by step, naming tools where you know them') }, ['name', 'when', 'steps']),
    run: (args, { store }) => saveSkill(store, args),
  },
  {
    name: 'skills_switch',
    description: 'Turn a skill on or off.',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Skill name'), on: { type: 'boolean' } }, ['name', 'on']),
    run: ({ name, on }, { store }) => {
      const s = store.get('SELECT id, name FROM skills WHERE lower(name) = lower(?)', name);
      if (!s) return { error: `No skill called ${name}.` };
      store.run('UPDATE skills SET enabled = ? WHERE id = ?', on ? 1 : 0, s.id);
      return { skill: s.name, on };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'skills_forget',
    description: 'Stop using a skill: the user\'s own skills are deleted, built-in ones are switched off.',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Skill name') }, ['name']),
    run: ({ name }, { store }) => {
      const s = store.get('SELECT * FROM skills WHERE lower(name) = lower(?)', name);
      if (!s) return { error: `No skill called ${name}.` };
      if (s.builtin) store.run('UPDATE skills SET enabled = 0 WHERE id = ?', s.id);
      else store.run('DELETE FROM skills WHERE id = ?', s.id);
      return { forgot: s.name };
    },
  },
];
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useData, tool } from './useData.js';
import MicButton from '../shared/MicButton.jsx';

const add = (setter) => (text) => setter((v) => `${v}${v ? ' ' : ''}${text}`);

/** Skills Maya can do and learn: the built-in ones, the user's own, and a form (or voice) to teach a new one. */
export default function Skills({ version }) {
  const skills = useData(() => tool('skills_list', {}), version) || [];
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [when, setWhen] = useState('');
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState('');
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState(null);

  async function save(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    try { await tool('skills_save', { name, when, steps }); setMsg(`✓ Maya learned “${name}”.`); setName(''); setWhen(''); setSteps(''); } catch (err) { setMsg(`⚠ ${err.message}`); }
  }
  const card = (s) => (
    <li className="item skill" key={s.name}>
      <span className="item-title"><b>{s.name}</b><br /><small className="muted">{s.when}</small></span>
      {!!s.uses && <span className="badge" title="Times used">{s.uses}×</span>}
      <label className="row"><input type="checkbox" className="check" checked={!!s.enabled} aria-label={`${s.name} on`}
        onChange={(e) => tool('skills_switch', { name: s.name, on: e.target.checked })} /> On</label>
      {!s.builtin && <button className="btn small" onClick={() => tool('skills_forget', { name: s.name })} aria-label={`Delete ${s.name}`}>Delete</button>}
    </li>
  );

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">Skills</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Ready-made skills Maya uses by itself when they fit, and skills you teach it. Say “teach yourself: when I say goodnight, turn on dark mode and tell me tomorrow’s tasks”, or fill in the form.</p>
      <div className="grid a11y-grid">
        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="sk-mine">
          <h2 id="sk-mine">✨ Teach Maya a skill</h2>
          <form onSubmit={save}>
            <div className="field"><label htmlFor="sk-n">Name (also the words that start it)</label>
              <div className="row"><input id="sk-n" className="input" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Goodnight" required /><MicButton onText={add(setName)} /></div></div>
            <div className="field"><label htmlFor="sk-w">When to use it</label>
              <div className="row"><input id="sk-w" className="input" value={when} onChange={(e) => setWhen(e.target.value)} placeholder="when I say goodnight or I'm going to sleep" required /><MicButton onText={add(setWhen)} /></div></div>
            <div className="field"><label htmlFor="sk-s">What to do, step by step</label>
              <div className="row"><textarea id="sk-s" className="input" rows={4} value={steps} onChange={(e) => setSteps(e.target.value)} placeholder="Turn on dark mode. Read tomorrow's tasks. Set an alarm for 7 am." required /><MicButton onText={add(setSteps)} /></div></div>
            <button className="btn primary">Save skill</button>
          </form>
          {msg && <p className="muted" role="status">{msg}</p>}
          <ul className="list">{skills.filter((s) => !s.builtin).map(card)}</ul>
        </section>
        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="sk-built">
          <h2 id="sk-built">📚 Built-in skills</h2>
          <ul className="list">{skills.filter((s) => s.builtin).map(card)}</ul>
        </section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Face from '../shared/Face.jsx';
import { playSpeech } from '../shared/audio.js';

const ICON = { done: '✅', failed: '❌', denied: '✋' };
const SOURCE = { chat: 'You asked', agent: 'Agent', builder: 'Builder', workflow: 'Workflow' };

/** Everything Maya does, live: what it is doing now, and each action today in plain words. */
export default function Monitor() {
  const [w, setW] = useState(null);
  const [only, setOnly] = useState('all');
  useEffect(() => {
    const load = () => window.ather.workToday().then(setW).catch(() => {});
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, 2000); // live while this page is open
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);
  const items = (w?.items || []).filter((i) => only === 'all' || (only === 'problems' ? i.status !== 'done' : i.source === only));
  const say = () => w && window.ather.speak(w.now ? `Right now I am: ${w.now}.` : `Today I did ${w.actions} things${w.failed ? `, ${w.failed} did not work` : ''}. The last one: ${w.items?.[0]?.detail || 'nothing yet'}.`).then((a) => a && playSpeech(a));

  return (
    <>
      <div className="row" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <Face size={64} mood={w?.now ? 'working' : 'happy'} />
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Work monitor</h1>
          <p className="page-sub" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Everything Maya does for you, as it happens. Ask “what are you doing?” any time.</p>
        </div>
        <span className="spacer" />
        <button className="btn" onClick={say} aria-label="Read the work out loud">🔊 Tell me</button>
      </div>
      <div className="grid">
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{w?.now ? '⚙️' : '😌'}</div><div className="stat-label">{w?.now || 'Not busy right now'}</div></div>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{w?.actions ?? '–'}</div><div className="stat-label">actions today</div></div>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{w?.failed ?? '–'}</div><div className="stat-label">did not work</div></div>
      </div>
      <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <div className="row wrap" role="group" aria-label="Show">
          {[['all', 'Everything'], ['chat', 'Asked by you'], ['builder', 'Builder'], ['workflow', 'Workflows'], ['problems', 'Problems']].map(([k, label]) => (
            <button key={k} className={`btn small ${only === k ? 'primary' : ''}`} aria-pressed={only === k} onClick={() => setOnly(k)}>{label}</button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {!items.length && <p className="empty">Nothing yet today.</p>}
        <ul className="list" aria-live="polite">
          {items.map((i) => (
            <li className="item" key={i.id}>
              <span>{ICON[i.status] || '•'}</span>
              <span className="item-title">{i.detail}<br /><small className="muted">{SOURCE[i.source] || i.source} · {new Date(i.at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}{i.ms > 1000 ? ` · ${Math.round(i.ms / 1000)} s` : ''}</small></span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useSetting } from './Settings.jsx';
import { useData, tool } from './useData.js';
import MicButton from '../shared/MicButton.jsx';
import { playSpeech } from '../shared/audio.js';

const LOCAL_VOICES = [['af_heart', 'Heart (warm, female)'], ['af_bella', 'Bella (bright, female)'], ['af_nicole', 'Nicole (soft, female)'], ['bf_emma', 'Emma (British, female)'],
  ['am_michael', 'Michael (male)'], ['am_adam', 'Adam (deep, male)'], ['bm_george', 'George (British, male)']];
const OPENAI_VOICES = ['nova', 'alloy', 'shimmer', 'coral', 'sage', 'echo', 'onyx', 'fable', 'ash', 'ballad'];
const PRESETS = {
  Calm: { theme: 'light', accent: '#12b886', face: 'mint' },
  Night: { theme: 'dark', accent: '#8b7dff', face: 'midnight' },
  Sunrise: { theme: 'light', accent: '#f76707', face: 'sunset' },
  'Tamil classic': { theme: 'light', accent: '#8b1e3f', face: 'pink' },
  'High contrast': { theme: 'dark', accent: '#ffd43b', face: 'midnight', large: true },
};
const PAGES = [['tasks', 'Tasks'], ['notes', 'Notes'], ['habits', 'Habits'], ['focus', 'Focus'], ['study', 'Study'], ['workflows', 'Workflows'], ['activity', 'Activity'], ['calendar', 'Calendar'],
  ['inbox', 'Inbox'], ['search', 'Smart search'], ['images', 'Image tools'], ['models', 'AI models'], ['mcp', 'Connected tools'], ['skills', 'Skills'], ['monitor', 'Work monitor']];

/** Saved snippets: [value, save (writes the setting), show (after the tool saved it)]. */
function useSnippets() {
  const [v, setV] = useState({});
  useEffect(() => { window.ather.getSetting('snippets', {}).then((s) => setV(s || {})); }, []);
  return [v, (next) => { setV(next); window.ather.setSetting('snippets', next); }, (s) => setV(s || {})];
}

/** My Maya: who Maya is (name, rules, goals, voice) and how it looks, plus what it has learned about the user. */
export default function Agent({ version }) {
  const [agent, setAgent] = useSetting('agent', {});
  const [callMe, setCallMe] = useSetting('userTitle', 'boss');
  const [engine, setEngine] = useSetting('voiceEngine', 'local');
  const [ui, setUi] = useSetting('ui', {});
  const [faceStyle, setFaceStyle] = useSetting('faceStyle', {});
  const [, setTheme] = useSetting('theme', 'system');
  const [, setLarge] = useSetting('a11yLarge', false);
  const [rules, setRules] = useState('');
  const [goals, setGoals] = useState('');
  const memories = useData(() => tool('memory_list', {}), version) || [];
  const [words, setWords] = useState({});
  const [snippets, setSnippets, setSnippetsLocal] = useSnippets();
  const [snipName, setSnipName] = useState('');
  const [snipText, setSnipText] = useState('');
  const [chromeProfile, setChromeProfile] = useSetting('chromeProfile', null);
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState([]);
  useEffect(() => { window.ather.chromeProfiles().then(setProfiles).catch(() => {}); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { setRules(agent?.rules || ''); setGoals(agent?.goals || ''); }, [agent?.rules, agent?.goals]);
  useEffect(() => { window.ather.getSetting('learnedWords', {}).then(setWords); }, [version]);
  const a = { name: 'Maya', speed: 1, voice: 'af_heart', openaiVoice: 'nova', ...agent };
  const setA = (patch) => setAgent({ ...a, ...patch });
  const setU = (patch) => setUi({ ...ui, ...patch });
  const hidden = ui?.hidePages || [];
  const test = async () => { const audio = await window.ather.speak(`Hi ${callMe || ''}! I am ${a.name}. This is how I sound.`); if (audio) playSpeech(audio); };
  const forgetWord = (w) => { const next = { ...words }; delete next[w]; setWords(next); window.ather.setSetting('learnedWords', next); };
  const preset = (p) => { setTheme(p.theme); setU({ accent: p.accent }); setFaceStyle({ ...faceStyle, color: p.face }); setLarge(!!p.large); };

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">My {a.name}</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Make {a.name} yours: its name, how it talks to you, your rules and goals, its voice and look. You can also just say it: “change your name to Priya”, “talk slower”, “make the text bigger”.</p>
      <div className="grid a11y-grid">
        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="ag-who">
          <h2 id="ag-who">🤖 Who {a.name} is</h2>
          <div className="row wrap">
            <div className="field" style={{ flex: 1 }}><label htmlFor="ag-n">Name (wake word: “Hey {a.name}”)</label>
              <input id="ag-n" className="input" value={a.name} maxLength={20} onChange={(e) => setA({ name: e.target.value.replace(/[^\p{L} '-]/gu, '') || 'Maya' })} /></div>
            <div className="field" style={{ flex: 1 }}><label htmlFor="ag-c">It calls you</label>
              <input id="ag-c" className="input" value={callMe} onChange={(e) => setCallMe(e.target.value)} placeholder="sir, madam, your name" /></div>
          </div>
          {profiles.length > 1 && <div className="field"><label htmlFor="ag-cp">Chrome profile {a.name} uses (Gmail, ChatGPT, WhatsApp open signed in here)</label>
            <select id="ag-cp" className="input" value={chromeProfile || profiles.find((p) => p.lastUsed)?.dir || ''} onChange={(e) => setChromeProfile(e.target.value)}>
              {profiles.map((p) => <option key={p.dir} value={p.dir}>{p.name}{p.account ? ` — ${p.account}` : ''}{p.lastUsed ? ' (used last)' : ''}</option>)}
            </select></div>}
          <div className="field"><label htmlFor="ag-r">Your rules (one per line)</label>
            <div className="row"><textarea id="ag-r" className="input" rows={3} value={rules} onChange={(e) => setRules(e.target.value)} onBlur={() => setA({ rules })} placeholder={'Always answer in Tamil\nKeep answers short\nRemind me to drink water'} />
              <MicButton onText={(t) => { const r = `${rules}${rules ? '\n' : ''}${t}`; setRules(r); setA({ rules: r }); }} /></div></div>
          <div className="field"><label htmlFor="ag-g">Your goals</label>
            <div className="row"><textarea id="ag-g" className="input" rows={2} value={goals} onChange={(e) => setGoals(e.target.value)} onBlur={() => setA({ goals })} placeholder="Finish my college project by December; walk 20 minutes a day" />
              <MicButton onText={(t) => { const g = `${goals}${goals ? ' ' : ''}${t}`; setGoals(g); setA({ goals: g }); }} /></div></div>
        </section>

        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="ag-voice">
          <h2 id="ag-voice">🗣 Voice</h2>
          <div className="row wrap" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Voice engine">
            <label className="row"><input type="radio" name="engine" checked={engine === 'local'} onChange={() => setEngine('local')} /> Free voices on this PC (English + Tamil, offline)</label>
            <label className="row"><input type="radio" name="engine" checked={engine === 'openai'} onChange={() => setEngine('openai')} /> OpenAI voices (the ones ChatGPT uses)</label>
          </div>
          {engine === 'openai' && <p className="muted">Uses your OpenAI key from AI models. Paid per use (very cheap), needs internet, and what {a.name} says is sent to OpenAI. If it fails, the free voice speaks instead.</p>}
          <div className="row wrap">
            {engine === 'local'
              ? <div className="field" style={{ flex: 1 }}><label htmlFor="ag-v">English voice</label>
                  <select id="ag-v" className="input" value={a.voice} onChange={(e) => setA({ voice: e.target.value })}>{LOCAL_VOICES.map(([id, label]) => <option key={id} value={id}>{label}</option>)}</select></div>
              : <div className="field" style={{ flex: 1 }}><label htmlFor="ag-ov">OpenAI voice</label>
                  <select id="ag-ov" className="input" value={a.openaiVoice} onChange={(e) => setA({ openaiVoice: e.target.value })}>{OPENAI_VOICES.map((v) => <option key={v}>{v}</option>)}</select></div>}
            <label className="field" style={{ flex: 1 }}>Speed: {a.speed}×
              <input type="range" min="0.7" max="1.3" step="0.1" value={a.speed} onChange={(e) => setA({ speed: Number(e.target.value) })} aria-label="Speaking speed" /></label>
          </div>
          <button className="btn" onClick={test}>🔊 Hear it</button>
        </section>

        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="ag-look">
          <h2 id="ag-look">🎨 Look</h2>
          <div className="row wrap">{Object.entries(PRESETS).map(([n, p]) => <button key={n} className="btn" onClick={() => preset(p)} style={{ borderColor: p.accent }}>{n}</button>)}</div>
          <div className="row wrap">
            <label className="field">Accent colour <input type="color" value={ui?.accent || '#6c5cff'} onChange={(e) => setU({ accent: e.target.value })} aria-label="Accent colour" /></label>
            <div className="field"><label htmlFor="ag-ts">Text size</label>
              <select id="ag-ts" className="input" value={ui?.fontScale || 1} onChange={(e) => setU({ fontScale: Number(e.target.value) })}><option value="1">Normal</option><option value="1.15">Large</option><option value="1.3">Larger</option></select></div>
            <div className="field"><label htmlFor="ag-d">Spacing</label>
              <select id="ag-d" className="input" value={ui?.density || 'comfortable'} onChange={(e) => setU({ density: e.target.value })}><option value="comfortable">Comfortable</option><option value="compact">Compact</option></select></div>
          </div>
          <fieldset className="field"><legend>Pages in the sidebar</legend>
            <div className="row wrap">{PAGES.map(([id, label]) => (
              <label key={id} className="row"><input type="checkbox" className="check" checked={!hidden.includes(id)} onChange={(e) => setU({ hidePages: e.target.checked ? hidden.filter((h) => h !== id) : [...hidden, id] })} /> {label}</label>
            ))}</div>
          </fieldset>
          <p className="muted">Face shape, colours and how lively it is: Settings → Appearance.</p>
        </section>

        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="ag-snip">
          <h2 id="ag-snip">⌨️ Things you type often</h2>
          <p className="muted">Say “type my address” in any app and {a.name} types it for you. Or say “save my email as …”. Never passwords.</p>
          <ul className="list">{Object.entries(snippets || {}).map(([k, v]) => (
            <li className="item" key={k}><span className="item-title"><b>my {k}</b><br /><small className="muted">{v.slice(0, 80)}</small></span>
              <button className="btn small" onClick={() => { const next = { ...snippets }; delete next[k]; setSnippets(next); }} aria-label={`Delete my ${k}`}>Delete</button></li>
          ))}</ul>
          <form className="row wrap" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (snipName.trim() && snipText.trim()) window.ather.tool('snippets_save', { name: snipName, text: snipText }).then((r) => { if (r.error) alert(r.error); else { setSnipName(''); setSnipText(''); window.ather.getSetting('snippets', {}).then(setSnippetsLocal); } }); }}>
            <input className="input" style={{ width: 130 }} placeholder="address" value={snipName} onChange={(e) => setSnipName(e.target.value)} aria-label="Name" />
            <input className="input" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 200 }} placeholder="12 Gandhi Street, Chennai 600001" value={snipText} onChange={(e) => setSnipText(e.target.value)} aria-label="Text" />
            <MicButton onText={(t) => setSnipText((v) => `${v}${v ? ' ' : ''}${t}`)} />
            <button className="btn primary">Save</button>
          </form>
        </section>

        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="ag-learned">
          <h2 id="ag-learned">🧠 What {a.name} learned about you</h2>
          <p className="muted">From your corrections, 👎 notes and what you share. All kept on this PC. Remove anything that is wrong.</p>
          {!memories.length && <p className="empty">Nothing yet. Tell {a.name} about yourself, or press 👎 on an answer to teach it.</p>}
          <ul className="list">{memories.map((m) => (
            <li className="item" key={m.id}><span className="badge">{m.category}</span><span className="item-title">{m.fact}</span>
              <button className="btn small" onClick={() => tool('memory_forget', { id: m.id })} aria-label={`Forget: ${m.fact}`}>Forget</button></li>
          ))}</ul>
          {!!Object.keys(words).length && <>
            <h3>Words it learned to hear right</h3>
            <ul className="list">{Object.entries(words).map(([h, m]) => (
              <li className="item" key={h}><span className="item-title">“{h}” → <b>{m}</b></span><button className="btn small" onClick={() => forgetWord(h)} aria-label={`Forget the word ${h}`}>Forget</button></li>
            ))}</ul>
          </>}
        </section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useSetting } from './Settings.jsx';

const errText = (e) => e.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');

function Card({ icon, name, on, detail, children, say }) {
  return (
    <section className="panel conn" aria-label={name}>
      <div className="row"><h2 style={{ margin: 0 }}>{icon} {name}</h2><span className="spacer" /><span className={`badge ${on ? '' : 'late'}`}>{on ? '✓ Connected' : 'Not connected'}</span></div>
      <p className="muted">{detail}</p>
      {children}
      {say && <p className="muted"><small>Say: “{say}”</small></p>}
    </section>
  );
}

/** Everything Maya can connect to, with its status: one place, each with a big button (or say it to Maya). */
export default function Connections({ go, version }) {
  const [feeds, setFeeds] = useSetting('calendarFeeds', []);
  const [feedName, setFeedName] = useState('');
  const [feedUrl, setFeedUrl] = useState('');
  const [mail, setMail] = useState(null);
  const [sos, setSos] = useState({});
  const [chrome, setChrome] = useState([]);
  const [providers, setProviders] = useState([]);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState(null);
  const [tg, setTg] = useState(null);
  const [token, setToken] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => { window.ather.telegramStatus?.().then(setTg).catch(() => {}); }, [version]);
  const connectTelegram = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setMsg('Checking the token with Telegram…');
    try { setTg(await window.ather.telegramSetToken(token)); setToken(''); setMsg(null); } catch (err) { setMsg(`⚠ ${errText(err)}`); }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    window.ather.getSetting('mail', null).then(setMail);
    window.ather.getSetting('sos', {}).then((s) => setSos(s || {}));
    window.ather.chromeProfiles().then(setChrome).catch(() => {});
    window.ather.providers?.().then(setProviders).catch(() => {});
  }, [version]);
  const open = async (name) => { setMsg(`Opening ${name}…`); try { await window.ather.tool('pc_open_app', { name }); setMsg(`✓ Opened ${name} in your browser.`); } catch (e) { setMsg(`⚠ ${errText(e)}`); } };
  const cloud = providers.filter((p) => !p.local && p.hasKey);

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">Connections</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">What Maya can use for you. Everything stays on this PC; you can ask Maya instead of clicking.</p>
      {msg && <p className="muted" role="status">{msg}</p>}
      <div className="grid a11y-grid">
        <Card icon="✉️" name="Email (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo)" on={!!mail} detail={mail ? `Signed in as ${mail.user}. Maya reads, sorts and replies (you approve each send).` : 'Connect once with an app password; Maya never sees your normal password.'} say="any emails I need to reply to?">
          <button className="btn primary" onClick={() => go('inbox')}>{mail ? 'Open Inbox' : 'Connect email'}</button>
        </Card>

        <Card icon="📅" name="Google / Outlook / Apple Calendar" on={feeds.length > 0} detail="Paste the calendar's private iCal (.ics) link. Google: Calendar settings → your calendar → “Secret address in iCal format”. Outlook: Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → Publish → ICS. iCloud: share calendar → Public calendar." say="what's on my calendar this week?">
          <ul className="list">{feeds.map((f, i) => (
            <li className="item" key={i}><span className="item-title">📅 <b>{f.name}</b> <small className="muted">{f.url.slice(0, 48)}…</small></span>
              <button className="btn small" onClick={() => setFeeds(feeds.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} aria-label={`Remove ${f.name}`}>Remove</button></li>
          ))}</ul>
          <form className="row wrap" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (/^https?:\/\/|^webcal:\/\//i.test(feedUrl)) { setFeeds([...feeds, { name: feedName || 'Calendar', url: feedUrl.replace(/^webcal:/i, 'https:') }]); setFeedName(''); setFeedUrl(''); } else setMsg('⚠ Paste the full link starting with https:// or webcal://'); }}>
            <input className="input" style={{ width: 150 }} placeholder="Name (e.g. Google)" value={feedName} onChange={(e) => setFeedName(e.target.value)} aria-label="Calendar name" />
            <input className="input" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220 }} placeholder="https://…/basic.ics" value={feedUrl} onChange={(e) => setFeedUrl(e.target.value)} aria-label="Calendar link" />
            <button className="btn primary">Add calendar</button>
          </form>
        </Card>

        <Card icon="💬" name="WhatsApp" on detail="WhatsApp Web in your Chrome. Maya opens chats, writes messages for you to send, and saves videos and photos to your Desktop." say="open my WhatsApp chat with Amma / save the video from my WhatsApp to the desktop">
          <button className="btn" onClick={() => open('WhatsApp')}>Open WhatsApp</button>
        </Card>

        <Card icon="📞" name="Phone (Windows Phone Link)" on={!!sos.phones?.length} detail={sos.phones?.length ? `Emergency number ${sos.phones[0]}. Calls go through your paired phone.` : 'Pair your phone once in the Phone Link app, then save an emergency number.'} say="call Amma">
          <div className="row wrap"><button className="btn" onClick={() => open('Phone Link')}>Open Phone Link</button><button className="btn" onClick={() => go('accessibility')}>Emergency numbers</button></div>
        </Card>

        <Card icon="🌐" name="Chrome and your accounts" on={chrome.length > 0} detail={chrome.length ? `Maya opens Gmail, YouTube, Drive, ChatGPT and more signed in, in your Chrome profile (${chrome.length} found).` : 'Google Chrome was not found.'} say="open YouTube / open my Google Drive">
          <div className="row wrap">{['YouTube', 'Gmail', 'Google Drive', 'Google Calendar', 'ChatGPT', 'Gemini'].map((s) => <button key={s} className="btn small" onClick={() => open(s)}>{s}</button>)}</div>
          <button className="btn small" onClick={() => go('agent')}>Choose Chrome profile</button>
        </Card>

        <Card icon="🧠" name="Cloud AI (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude…)" on={cloud.length > 0} detail={cloud.length ? `Using: ${cloud.map((p) => p.name).join(', ')}. Also gives Maya the ChatGPT voices.` : 'Optional. Maya works fully offline; add a key for bigger models or the ChatGPT voices.'}>
          <button className="btn" onClick={() => go('models')}>AI models</button>
        </Card>

        <Card icon="✈️" name="Telegram (Maya on your phone)" on={!!tg?.paired}
          detail={tg?.paired ? `Paired with ${tg.chat} through @${tg.bot}. Message the bot from anywhere: questions, tasks, reminders, notes. Mouse, keyboard and sending mail still need your OK on the PC.`
            : 'Talk to Maya from your phone, free, through your own Telegram bot. Only your chat is answered.'}>
          {!tg?.configured && (
            <form className="field" onSubmit={connectTelegram}>
              <ol className="muted steps"><li>On your phone, open Telegram and message <b>@BotFather</b>.</li><li>Send <code>/newbot</code>, pick a name, and copy the token it gives you.</li><li>Paste it here.</li></ol>
              <div className="row wrap">
                <input className="input" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220 }} type="password" autoComplete="off" placeholder="123456:ABC…" value={token} onChange={(e) => setToken(e.target.value)} aria-label="Telegram bot token" />
                <button className="btn primary" disabled={!token.trim()}>Connect</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}
          {tg?.configured && !tg.paired && (
            <p>Now open <b>@{tg.bot}</b> in Telegram on your phone and send this code:<br /><span className="pair-code" aria-label={`Pairing code ${tg.code.split('').join(' ')}`}>{tg.code}</span></p>
          )}
          {tg?.error && <p className="muted" role="status">⚠ {tg.error}</p>}
          {tg?.configured && <button className="btn small" onClick={async () => setTg(await window.ather.telegramForget())}>Disconnect Telegram</button>}
        </Card>

        <Card icon="🔌" name="More tools (MCP)" on detail="GitHub, files, browser automation, docs and more, as connected tools Maya can use." >
          <button className="btn" onClick={() => go('mcp')}>Connected tools</button>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### src/renderer/app/Brain.jsx

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useData, tool } from './useData.js';
import { useAsk } from '../shared/useAsk.js';
import Markdown from '../shared/Markdown.jsx';
import MicButton from '../shared/MicButton.jsx';

// Which branch lights up while Maya uses a tool ("a brain you can see").
const BRANCH_OF = [[/^(memory_|learn_word)/, 'facts'], [/^(contacts_|call_|whatsapp_|phone)/, 'people'], [/^(tasks_|reminders_|calendar_|work_timer)/, 'plans'],
  [/^skills_/, 'skills'], [/^(notes_|diary_)/, 'notes'], [/^persona_set|^ui_set/, 'goals']];
const short = (s, n = 26) => (s.length > n ? `${s.slice(0, n - 1)}…` : s);

/** Maya's second brain: a mind map of what it knows about the user, searchable, askable, glowing while it works. */
export default function Brain({ version }) {
  const memories = useData(() => tool('memory_list', {}), version) || [];
  const contacts = useData(() => tool('contacts_query', {}), version) || [];
  const tasks = useData(() => tool('tasks_query', { status: 'open' }), version) || [];
  const notes = useData(() => tool('notes_query', {}), version) || [];
  const skills = useData(() => tool('skills_list', {}), version) || [];
  const agent = useData(() => window.ather.getSetting('agent', {}), version) || {};
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [active, setActive] = useState(null);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const { turn, send } = useAsk();

  // Live: the branch for Maya's latest action glows for a few seconds.
  useEffect(() => {
    let last = null;
    const t = setInterval(async () => {
      const w = await window.ather.workToday().catch(() => null);
      const top = w?.items?.[0];
      if (!top || top.id === last || Date.now() - Date.parse(top.at) > 8000) return;
      last = top.id;
      setActive(BRANCH_OF.find(([re]) => re.test(top.name))?.[1] || 'you');
      setTimeout(() => setActive(null), 4000);
    }, 1500);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { if (turn?.thinking) setActive('you'); }, [turn?.thinking]);

  const branches = [
    ['people', '👥 People', contacts.map((c) => `${c.name}${c.relation ? ` (${c.relation})` : ''}`)],
    ['facts', '🧠 About you', memories.filter((m) => m.category !== 'preference').map((m) => m.fact)],
    ['likes', '💜 Likes & ways', memories.filter((m) => m.category === 'preference').map((m) => m.fact.replace(/^How the user wants answers: /, ''))],
    ['goals', '🎯 Goals & rules', [agent.goals, agent.rules].filter(Boolean).join('\n').split('\n').map((s) => s.replace(/^- /, '')).filter(Boolean)],
    ['plans', '📅 Plans', tasks.slice(0, 12).map((t) => `${t.title}${t.due ? ` · ${t.due.slice(5, 10)}` : ''}`)],
    ['notes', '📝 Notes', notes.slice(0, 12).map((n) => n.title)],
    ['skills', '✨ Skills', skills.filter((s) => s.enabled).map((s) => s.name)],
  ];
  const match = (s) => search && s.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
  const W = 960, H = 640, cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">{agent.name || 'Maya'}’s brain</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Everything {agent.name || 'Maya'} knows and remembers about you, linked like a mind map. It lights up while {agent.name || 'Maya'} works. All of it stays on this PC.</p>
      <div className="row wrap" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <input className="input" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220 }} placeholder="Search the brain…" value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} aria-label="Search the brain" />
        <MicButton onText={(t) => setSearch(t)} />
      </div>
      <div className="panel brain-map" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} width="100%" role="img">
          {branches.map(([id, label, items], b) => {
            const a = (b / branches.length) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
            const bx = cx + Math.cos(a) * 190, by = cy + Math.sin(a) * 175;
            const leaves = items.slice(0, 6);
            return (
              <g key={id} className={`branch ${active === id ? 'lit' : ''}`}>
                <line x1={cx} y1={cy} x2={bx} y2={by} className="link" />
                {leaves.map((it, i) => {
                  const la = a + (i - (leaves.length - 1) / 2) * 0.17;
                  const lx = cx + Math.cos(la) * 300, ly = cy + Math.sin(la) * 268;
                  return (
                    <g key={i} className={match(it) ? 'hit' : ''}>
                      <line x1={bx} y1={by} x2={lx} y2={ly} className="link thin" />
                      <circle cx={lx} cy={ly} r="5" className="leaf" />
                      <text x={lx + (Math.cos(la) < 0 ? -9 : 9)} y={ly + 4} textAnchor={Math.cos(la) < 0 ? 'end' : 'start'} className="leaf-text">{short(it)}</text>
                    </g>
                  );
                })}
                <circle cx={bx} cy={by} r="30" className="node" />
                <text x={bx} y={by + 4} textAnchor="middle" className="node-text">{label.split(' ')[0]}</text>
                <text x={bx} y={by + 46} textAnchor="middle" className="node-label">{label.slice(label.indexOf(' ') + 1)} ({items.length})</text>
              </g>
            );
          })}
          <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r="48" className={`core ${active ? 'lit' : ''}`} />
          <text x={cx} y={cy + 6} textAnchor="middle" className="core-text">You</text>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div className="grid" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <section className="panel" aria-labelledby="brain-ask">
          <h2 id="brain-ask">💬 Ask your brain</h2>
          <form className="row" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (q.trim()) send(`From what you remember about me: ${q}`, [], { style: 'chat' }); }}>
            <input className="input" style={{ flex: 1 }} value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="When is my sister's wedding? What do I like?" aria-label="Ask your brain" />
            <MicButton onText={(t) => setQ(t)} />
            <button className="btn primary">Ask</button>
          </form>
          {turn && <div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>{turn.thinking && !turn.text ? <p className="muted">Thinking…</p> : <Markdown text={turn.text || turn.error || ''} />}</div>}
        </section>
        {/* The same brain as a list, for screen readers and switch users. */}
        <section className="panel" aria-label="Everything in the brain">
          {branches.map(([id, label, items]) => (
            <details key={id} open={!!search && items.some(match)}>
              <summary>{label} ({items.length})</summary>
              <ul className="list">{items.filter((s) => !search || match(s)).map((s, i) => <li className="item" key={i}><span className="item-title">{s}</span></li>)}</ul>
            </details>
          ))}
        </section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### src/renderer/shared/work.js

```javascript
/** The face Maya makes while a tool runs, like a person at work (exported for tests). */
export function workMood(tool = '') {
  if (/^(computer_type|computer_keys|fs_write|files_make_|write_here|mail_(send|reply))/.test(tool)) return 'typing';
  if (/^(run_command|python_run|git_|github_|agent_plan)/.test(tool)) return 'building';
  if (/^(web_|files_search|fs_search|fs_list|mail_search|mail_triage|search_|screen_look|computer_look|camera_)/.test(tool)) return 'searching';
  if (/^(qa_|tests?_)/.test(tool)) return 'checking';
  return 'working';
}
```

### src/main/services/workflows.js

```javascript
// Runs saved routines as workflows: each step has a live state (waiting, running, awaiting approval,
// completed, failed, cancelled), a run can be paused, resumed, retried or cancelled, and every run is kept as history.
import { now } from '../store.js';
import { logWork } from './worklog.js';
import { localIso } from './calendar-feeds.js';

const STEP_TIMEOUT = 120_000;
const parse = (row) => row && { ...row, steps: JSON.parse(row.steps) };

/** tools() lists runnable tools; ctx is what tool.run gets; confirm({name,args}) asks the user; onChange(run) on every state change. */
export function createWorkflows({ store, tools, ctx, confirm = async () => false, onChange = () => {} }) {
  const live = new Map(); // run id -> { paused, cancelled, wake, stop }
  // Runs left open when Maya last closed cannot continue.
  store.run("UPDATE workflow_runs SET status = 'cancelled', finished_at = ? WHERE status IN ('running', 'paused', 'awaiting approval')", now());

  const save = (run) => {
    store.run('UPDATE workflow_runs SET status = ?, steps = ?, finished_at = ? WHERE id = ?', run.status, JSON.stringify(run.steps), run.finished_at ?? null, run.id);
    onChange(run);
  };
  const finish = (run, status) => {
    for (const s of run.steps) if (s.status === 'waiting' || s.status === 'running' || s.status === 'awaiting approval') s.status = 'cancelled';
    Object.assign(run, { status, finished_at: now() });
    live.delete(run.id);
    save(run);
    return run;
  };

  async function execute(run) {
    const ctl = { paused: false, cancelled: false, wake: () => {} };
    // Rejects the moment the run is cancelled, so a slow step does not hold the run open.
    ctl.stop = new Promise((_, reject) => { ctl.abort = () => reject(new Error('Cancelled')); });
    ctl.stop.catch(() => {});
    live.set(run.id, ctl);
    Object.assign(run, { status: 'running', finished_at: null });
    save(run);
    for (const step of run.steps) {
      if (step.status === 'completed') continue;
      while (ctl.paused && !ctl.cancelled) {
        run.status = 'paused'; save(run);
        await new Promise((r) => { ctl.wake = r; });
        run.status = 'running'; save(run);
      }
      if (ctl.cancelled) return finish(run, 'cancelled');
      Object.assign(step, { status: 'running', error: undefined, result: undefined, started_at: now() });
      const tool = tools().find((t) => t.name === step.tool);
      if (!tool || tool.name.startsWith('routines_')) { step.status = 'failed'; step.error = 'This tool is not available'; return finish(run, 'failed'); }
      if (tool.confirm) {
        step.status = run.status = 'awaiting approval'; save(run);
        const ok = await Promise.race([confirm({ name: tool.name, args: step.args || {} }), ctl.stop]).catch(() => false);
        if (!ok) { step.status = 'cancelled'; step.error = 'Not approved'; return finish(run, 'cancelled'); }
        step.status = run.status = 'running';
      }
      save(run);
      let timer;
      try {
        // shortcut: on cancel/timeout the step's own work is not aborted, only abandoned; add AbortSignal to tools if one runs long.
        const result = await Promise.race([
          tool.run(step.args || {}, ctx),
          ctl.stop,
          new Promise((_, reject) => { timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Step took longer than 2 minutes')), STEP_TIMEOUT); }),
        ]);
        try { logWork(store, { source: 'workflow', name: tool.name, args: step.args || {}, result, ms: Date.now() - Date.parse(step.started_at || now()) }); } catch { /* monitor only */ }
        if (result?.error || result?.denied) throw new Error(result.error || 'Not approved');
        Object.assign(step, { status: 'completed', result, finished_at: now() });
        save(run);
      } catch (e) {
        Object.assign(step, { status: ctl.cancelled ? 'cancelled' : 'failed', error: e.message, finished_at: now() });
        return finish(run, ctl.cancelled ? 'cancelled' : 'failed');
      } finally {
        clearTimeout(timer);
      }
    }
    return finish(run, 'completed');
  }

  const getRun = (id) => parse(store.get('SELECT * FROM workflow_runs WHERE id = ?', id));
  const control = (id) => {
    const ctl = live.get(id);
    if (!ctl) throw new Error(`Run ${id} is not running`);
    return ctl;
  };

  return {
    /** Starts a routine by name; resolves when the run ends (callers that should not wait can ignore the promise). */
    start(name, { trigger = 'manual' } = {}) {
      const routine = store.get('SELECT * FROM routines WHERE deleted = 0 AND name = ?', name.trim().toLowerCase());
      if (!routine) throw new Error(`No routine called "${name}". Saved: ${store.all('SELECT name FROM routines WHERE deleted = 0').map((r) => r.name).join(', ') || 'none'}`);
      const steps = JSON.parse(routine.steps).map((s) => ({ tool: s.tool, args: s.args || {}, status: 'waiting' }));
      const { id } = store.get('INSERT INTO workflow_runs (routine, trigger, status, steps, started_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING id', routine.name, trigger, 'waiting', JSON.stringify(steps), now());
      const run = { id, routine: routine.name, trigger, steps, started_at: now() };
      return { run, done: execute(run) };
    },
    pause(id) { control(id).paused = true; return getRun(id); },
    resume(id) { const c = control(id); c.paused = false; c.wake(); return getRun(id); },
    cancel(id) { const c = control(id); c.cancelled = true; c.abort(); c.wake(); return getRun(id); },
    /** Re-runs a failed or cancelled run from its first unfinished step. */
    retry(id) {
      const run = getRun(id);
      if (!run || live.has(id) || !['failed', 'cancelled'].includes(run.status)) throw new Error(`Run ${id} cannot be retried`);
      for (const s of run.steps) if (s.status !== 'completed') s.status = 'waiting';
      return { run, done: execute(run) };
    },
    get: getRun,
    runs: (limit = 30) => store.all('SELECT * FROM workflow_runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?', limit).map(parse),
    /** Starts routines whose daily time ("HH:MM") has come and that have not run today. */
    tick(date = new Date()) {
      const today = localIso(date).slice(0, 10), time = localIso(date).slice(11, 16);
      for (const r of store.all("SELECT name, schedule FROM routines WHERE deleted = 0 AND schedule != '' AND schedule <= ? AND (last_scheduled IS NULL OR last_scheduled != ?)", time, today)) {
        store.run('UPDATE routines SET last_scheduled = ? WHERE name = ?', today, r.name);
        this.start(r.name, { trigger: 'schedule' }).done.catch(() => {});
      }
    },
  };
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useData, tool } from './useData.js';

const STATE = { waiting: '○', running: '◐', 'awaiting approval': '✋', completed: '✓', failed: '✗', cancelled: '⊘', paused: '⏸' };
const label = (name) => name.replace(/^(pc|fs|images|files)_/, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
const argText = (args) => Object.values(args || {}).filter((v) => typeof v !== 'object').join(', ');

/** The steps as connected nodes; each node shows its real state. */
function Graph({ steps, onPick, picked }) {
  return (
    <div className="wf-graph">
      {steps.map((s, i) => (
        <div className="wf-cell" key={i}>
          {i > 0 && <span className={`wf-link ${s.status && s.status !== 'waiting' ? 'on' : ''}`} />}
          <button type="button" className={`wf-node s-${(s.status || 'waiting').replace(' ', '-')} ${picked === i ? 'picked' : ''}`} onClick={() => onPick?.(i)}>
            <span className="wf-state" aria-label={s.status || 'step'}>{s.status ? STATE[s.status] : i + 1}</span>
            <b>{label(s.tool)}</b>
            <small>{argText(s.args) || ' '}</small>
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function Run({ run }) {
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState(null);
  const id = run.id, act = (a) => window.ather.workflowControl(id, a);
  const active = ['running', 'paused', 'awaiting approval', 'waiting'].includes(run.status);
  const step = picked != null && run.steps[picked];
  return (
    <li className="wf-run">
      <div className="row">
        <span className={`badge s-${run.status.replace(' ', '-')}`}>{STATE[run.status]} {run.status}</span>
        <b>{run.routine}</b><small className="muted">{run.trigger === 'schedule' ? '⏰ scheduled' : ''} {new Date(run.started_at).toLocaleString()}</small>
        <span className="spacer" />
        {run.status === 'running' && <button className="btn small" onClick={() => act('pause')}>⏸ Pause</button>}
        {run.status === 'paused' && <button className="btn small primary" onClick={() => act('resume')}>▶ Resume</button>}
        {active && <button className="btn small danger" onClick={() => act('cancel')}>Cancel</button>}
        {['failed', 'cancelled'].includes(run.status) && <button className="btn small" onClick={() => act('retry')}>↻ Retry</button>}
      </div>
      <Graph steps={run.steps} onPick={(i) => setPicked(picked === i ? null : i)} picked={picked} />
      {step && (
        <pre className="wf-detail">{step.error ? `Error: ${step.error}` : JSON.stringify(step.result ?? 'Not run yet', null, 2).slice(0, 1500)}</pre>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

function Builder({ draft, setDraft, tools }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState(null);
  const steps = draft?.steps || [];
  const setSteps = (s) => setDraft({ ...draft, steps: s });
  const move = (i, d) => { const s = [...steps]; [s[i], s[i + d]] = [s[i + d], s[i]]; setSteps(s); };

  async function make() {
    setBusy(true); setMsg(null);
    try { setDraft(await window.ather.workflowDraft(text)); } catch (e) { setMsg(`Could not plan it: ${e.message}`); }
    setBusy(false);
  }
  async function save() {
    const r = await tool('routines_save', { name: draft.name, steps: steps.map(({ tool: t, args }) => ({ tool: t, args })) });
    if (r.error) return setMsg(r.error);
    setMsg(`Saved “${draft.name}”.`); setDraft(null); setText('');
  }

  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <h2>New workflow</h2>
      <p className="muted">Describe what should happen, in your own words. Maya turns it into steps you can check and change before saving.</p>
      <div className="row">
        <input className="input" value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && text && make()}
          placeholder="e.g. exam prep: add a task to revise DBMS, make a note with today's plan, start a 50 minute focus" aria-label="Describe a workflow" />
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={!text || busy} onClick={make}>{busy ? 'Planning…' : 'Make steps'}</button>
        <button className="btn" onClick={() => setDraft({ name: '', steps: [] })}>Blank</button>
      </div>
      {msg && <p className="muted">{msg}</p>}
      {draft && (
        <>
          <Graph steps={steps} />
          <input className="input" value={draft.name} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="Workflow name" aria-label="Workflow name" />
          <ol className="list wf-edit">
            {steps.map((s, i) => (
              <li className="item" key={i}>
                <select className="input" value={s.tool} onChange={(e) => setSteps(steps.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, tool: e.target.value } : x)))} aria-label={`Step ${i + 1} action`}>
                  {tools.map((t) => <option key={t.name} value={t.name} title={t.description}>{label(t.name)}</option>)}
                </select>
                <input className="input mono" defaultValue={JSON.stringify(s.args || {})} aria-label={`Step ${i + 1} details`}
                  onBlur={(e) => { try { setSteps(steps.map((x, j) => (j === i ? { ...x, args: JSON.parse(e.target.value || '{}') } : x))); } catch { setMsg(`Step ${i + 1}: details must be JSON, e.g. {"title": "Revise"}`); } }} />
                <button className="btn small" disabled={!i} onClick={() => move(i, -1)} aria-label="Move up">↑</button>
                <button className="btn small" disabled={i === steps.length - 1} onClick={() => move(i, 1)} aria-label="Move down">↓</button>
                <button className="btn small" onClick={() => setSteps(steps.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} aria-label="Remove step">✕</button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ol>
          <div className="row">
            <button className="btn" onClick={() => setSteps([...steps, { tool: tools[0]?.name, args: {} }])}>+ Step</button>
            <span className="spacer" />
            <button className="btn" onClick={() => setDraft(null)}>Discard</button>
            <button className="btn primary" disabled={!draft.name || !steps.length} onClick={save}>Save workflow</button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Workflows({ version }) {
  const saved = useData(() => tool('routines_list'), version);
  const tools = useData(() => window.ather.workflowTools(), 0) || [];
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState([]);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(null);
  const [times, setTimes] = useState({});

  useEffect(() => {
    window.ather.workflowRuns().then(setRuns);
    // Live updates: replace the changed run, or add a new one on top.
    return window.ather.onWorkflowRun((run) => setRuns((rs) => (rs.some((r) => r.id === run.id) ? rs.map((r) => (r.id === run.id ? run : r)) : [run, ...rs])));
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">Workflows</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Chains of actions Maya runs for you, step by step. Watch each step live, pause, cancel or retry, and look back at every run.</p>
      <Builder draft={draft} setDraft={setDraft} tools={tools} />
      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Saved workflows</h2>
        <p className="muted">You can also ask in chat: “make a workflow called study mode that…”, then “start study mode”.</p>
        {!saved?.length && <p className="empty">No workflows yet.</p>}
        <ul className="list">
          {(saved || []).map((r) => (
            <li className="wf-saved" key={r.id}>
              <div className="row">
                <b>{r.name}</b>{r.schedule && <span className="badge">⏰ daily {r.schedule}</span>}
                <span className="spacer" />
                <input className="input" type="time" style={{ width: 120 }} value={times[r.name] ?? r.schedule ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setTimes({ ...times, [r.name]: e.target.value })} aria-label={`Daily time for ${r.name}`} />
                <button className="btn small" disabled={(times[r.name] ?? r.schedule ?? '') === (r.schedule ?? '')} onClick={() => tool('routines_schedule', { name: r.name, time: times[r.name] })}>Set schedule</button>
                <button className="btn small" onClick={() => setDraft({ name: r.name, steps: r.steps })}>Edit</button>
                <button className="btn small primary" onClick={() => window.ather.workflowStart(r.name)}>▶ Run</button>
                <button className="btn small" onClick={() => tool('routines_delete', { name: r.name })} aria-label={`Delete ${r.name}`}>✕</button>
              </div>
              <Graph steps={r.steps} />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Runs</h2>
        {!runs.length && <p className="empty">Nothing has run yet.</p>}
        <ul className="list">{runs.slice(0, 20).map((r) => <Run key={r.id} run={r} />)}</ul>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import ModelList from './ModelList.jsx';
import { useData } from './useData.js';

const errText = (e) => e.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');

export default function Models({ version }) {
  const providers = useData(() => window.ather.providers(), version);
  const usage = useData(() => window.ather.usage(), version);
  const [presets, setPresets] = useState({});
  const [chatModels, setChatModels] = useState([]);
  const [tests, setTests] = useState({});
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState({});
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState({ preset: 'openai', name: '', baseUrl: '' });
  const [routing, setRouting] = useState({ hybrid: false, hybridModel: '', cloudShareFiles: false });
  const reload = () => window.ather.chatModels(true).then(setChatModels);

  useEffect(() => {
    window.ather.providerPresets().then(setPresets);
    reload();
    Promise.all(['hybrid', 'hybridModel', 'cloudShareFiles'].map((k) => window.ather.getSetting(k, k === 'hybridModel' ? '' : false)))
      .then(([hybrid, hybridModel, cloudShareFiles]) => setRouting({ hybrid, hybridModel, cloudShareFiles }));
  }, []);

  const setRoute = (k, v) => { setRouting((r) => ({ ...r, [k]: v })); window.ather.setSetting(k, v); };
  async function test(id) {
    setTests((t) => ({ ...t, [id]: { busy: true } }));
    const r = await window.ather.testProvider(id).catch((e) => ({ ok: false, error: errText(e) }));
    setTests((t) => ({ ...t, [id]: r }));
    reload();
  }
  async function save(p, patch) { await window.ather.saveProvider(p.id, patch, keys[p.id]); setKeys((k) => ({ ...k, [p.id]: undefined })); reload(); }
  async function add(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const id = `${adding.preset}-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
    await window.ather.saveProvider(id, { preset: adding.preset, name: adding.name || presets[adding.preset].name, baseUrl: adding.baseUrl || undefined, enabled: true });
    setAdding({ preset: 'openai', name: '', baseUrl: '' });
  }

  const cloudModels = chatModels.filter((m) => !m.local);

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">AI models</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Maya runs on your computer by default. Add LM Studio or a cloud service (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Groq, OpenRouter) if you want; you choose what goes where.</p>

      <div className="grid">
        {(providers || []).map((p) => {
          const t = tests[p.id] || p.lastTest;
          return (
            <div className="panel provider" key={p.id}>
              <div className="row"><h2 style={{ margin: 0 }}>{p.name}</h2><span className="spacer" />
                <span className={`badge ${p.local ? '' : 'late'}`}>{p.local ? 'on this PC' : '☁ cloud'}</span></div>
              <small className="muted" style={{ wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>{p.baseUrl}</small>
              <label className="row" style={{ margin: '10px 0' }}>
                <input type="checkbox" className="check" checked={p.enabled} onChange={(e) => save(p, { enabled: e.target.checked })} /> Use this provider
              </label>
              {!p.keyless && (
                <div className="row">
                  <input className="input" type="password" placeholder={p.hasKey ? 'API key saved (encrypted)' : 'Paste API key'} value={keys[p.id] || ''}
                    onChange={(e) => setKeys((k) => ({ ...k, [p.id]: e.target.value }))} aria-label={`${p.name} API key`} />
                  <button className="btn small" disabled={!keys[p.id]} onClick={() => save(p, {})}>Save</button>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
                <button className="btn small primary" onClick={() => test(p.id)} disabled={t?.busy}>{t?.busy ? 'Testing…' : 'Test connection'}</button>
                {p.id !== 'ollama' && p.id !== 'lmstudio' && <button className="btn small danger" onClick={() => window.ather.removeProvider(p.id)}>Remove</button>}
              </div>
              {t && !t.busy && (t.ok
                ? <p className="ok">✓ Works: {t.models} models, “{t.model}” replied in {(t.ms / 1000).toFixed(1)} s</p>
                : <p className="bad">✗ {t.error}</p>)}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <form className="panel" onSubmit={add} style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <h2>Add a provider</h2>
        <div className="row wrap">
          <select className="input" style={{ width: 230 }} value={adding.preset} onChange={(e) => setAdding({ ...adding, preset: e.target.value })} aria-label="Provider type">
            {Object.entries(presets).filter(([k]) => k !== 'ollama' && k !== 'lmstudio').map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v.name}</option>)}
          </select>
          <input className="input" style={{ width: 200 }} placeholder="Name (optional)" value={adding.name} onChange={(e) => setAdding({ ...adding, name: e.target.value })} aria-label="Name" />
          {adding.preset === 'custom' && <input className="input" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 240 }} placeholder="Base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8080/v1" value={adding.baseUrl} onChange={(e) => setAdding({ ...adding, baseUrl: e.target.value })} aria-label="Base URL" required />}
          <button className="btn primary">Add</button>
        </div>
        <p className="muted">Then paste its API key above and press Test connection.</p>
      </form>

      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Which model answers</h2>
        <p className="muted">In Chat you can pick any of the {chatModels.length} models found, or keep ✨ Auto (local models chosen per question).</p>
        <label className="row field"><input type="checkbox" className="check" checked={routing.hybrid} onChange={(e) => setRoute('hybrid', e.target.checked)} />
          Hybrid: send big questions (explanations, code) to a cloud model, everything else stays local</label>
        {routing.hybrid && (
          <select className="input" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }} value={routing.hybridModel} onChange={(e) => setRoute('hybridModel', e.target.value)} aria-label="Cloud model for big questions">
            <option value="">Choose a cloud model…</option>
            {cloudModels.map((m) => <option key={m.value} value={m.value}>{m.label}</option>)}
          </select>
        )}
        <label className="row field" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}><input type="checkbox" className="check" checked={routing.cloudShareFiles} onChange={(e) => setRoute('cloudShareFiles', e.target.checked)} />
          Allow cloud models to see my screen, files, documents and pictures (off = they only get the conversation)</label>
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Usage</h2>
        {!usage?.length && <p className="empty">No requests recorded yet.</p>}
        {usage?.length > 0 && (
          <table className="table">
            <thead><tr><th>Provider</th><th>Model</th><th>Requests</th><th>Tokens in</th><th>Tokens out</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{usage.map((u) => <tr key={`${u.provider}${u.model}`}><td>{u.provider}</td><td>{u.model}</td><td>{u.requests}</td><td>{u.prompt_tokens?.toLocaleString()}</td><td>{u.completion_tokens?.toLocaleString()}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Maya's own models</h2>
        <ModelList />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### src/main/approvals.js

```javascript
// Ask the user in a window before a risky tool runs. Unanswered requests are denied after 5 minutes.
import { ipcMain } from 'electron';

let seq = 0;
const waiting = new Map(); // id -> resolve

ipcMain.handle('approval:answer', (_, id, ok) => {
  waiting.get(id)?.(!!ok);
});

/**
 * Shows an approval card in `webContents`; resolves true only if the user clicks Allow.
 * `signal`: the request the card belongs to; stopping it denies the card. However it ends, the card is closed,
 * so a card can never be left behind for a request that is already over.
 */
export function requestApproval(webContents, request, signal) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (!webContents || webContents.isDestroyed() || signal?.aborted) { resolve(false); return; }
    const id = ++seq;
    const finish = (ok) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
      waiting.delete(id);
      if (!webContents.isDestroyed()) webContents.send('approval:closed', id);
      resolve(ok);
    };
    const onAbort = () => finish(false);
    const timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), 5 * 60_000);
    signal?.addEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    waiting.set(id, finish);
    webContents.send('approval:request', { id, ...request });
  });
}
```
