```javascript
// Built-in "MCP-style" capabilities: file manager, Git, SQLite, time, and approved commands.
// Every path must be inside the user's approved folders. ctx.services supplies trash (Recycle Bin).
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, renameSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, dirname, extname, isAbsolute, join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { approvedFolders, userFolder } from '../services/mcp-presets.js';

const run = promisify(execFile);
const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });

const SECRET_FILE = /(^|[\\/])(\.env(\..*)?|id_rsa|id_ed25519|.*\.(pem|key|pfx|p12|kdbx)|credentials(\.json)?|secrets?\.(json|ya?ml)|passwords?\.(txt|csv))$/i;

/** Resolve a path and refuse anything outside the approved folders (no ../ escapes). Exported for tests. */
export function safePath(store, p) {
  if (!p) throw new Error('A path is needed.');
  const full = resolve(p);
  const ok = approvedFolders(store).some((root) => { const r = relative(resolve(root), full); return r === '' || (!r.startsWith('..') && !isAbsolute(r)); });
  if (!ok) throw new Error(`"${full}" is outside your approved folders. Add the folder in Settings → Files to allow it.`);
  return full;
}

const TYPES = { Images: /\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|bmp|svg|heic)$/i, Documents: /\.(pdf|docx?|txt|md|rtf|odt|pptx?|xlsx?|csv)$/i, Videos: /\.(mp4|mkv|mov|avi|webm)$/i,
  Music: /\.(mp3|wav|flac|m4a|ogg)$/i, Archives: /\.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz)$/i, Installers: /\.(exe|msi)$/i, Code: /\.(js|ts|py|java|c|cpp|html|css|json|ipynb)$/i };
const typeOf = (f) => Object.keys(TYPES).find((k) => TYPES[k].test(f)) || 'Other';

/** How far a timezone's wall clock is ahead of UTC at a given instant, in ms. */
function tzOffset(ms, tz) {
  const v = Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: tz, hourCycle: 'h23', year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: 'numeric', second: 'numeric' })
    .formatToParts(new Date(ms)).map((p) => [p.type, p.value]));
  return Date.UTC(v.year, v.month - 1, v.day, v.hour, v.minute, v.second) - Math.floor(ms / 1000) * 1000;
}

const git = async (cwd, ...args) => (await run('git', args, { cwd, windowsHide: true, maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024 })).stdout;

/**
 * The newest finished file in Downloads (of a kind), waiting up to `wait` seconds for one still downloading
 * (.crdownload / .part). Exported for tests.
 */
export async function latestDownload({ kind = 'any', since = 0, wait = 0, dir = join(process.env.USERPROFILE || '', 'Downloads') } = {}) {
  const want = kind === 'any' ? /./ : TYPES[{ video: 'Videos', image: 'Images', photo: 'Images', document: 'Documents', music: 'Music' }[kind] || 'Other'] || /./;
  const end = Date.now() + wait * 1000;
  for (;;) {
    const files = readdirSync(dir).map((f) => ({ f, s: statSync(join(dir, f), { throwIfNoEntry: false }) })).filter(({ s }) => s?.isFile());
    const busy = files.some(({ f, s }) => /\.(crdownload|part|tmp)$/i.test(f) && s.mtimeMs >= since);
    const done = files.filter(({ f, s }) => want.test(f) && !/\.(crdownload|part|tmp)$/i.test(f) && s.mtimeMs >= since).sort((a, b) => b.s.mtimeMs - a.s.mtimeMs)[0];
    if (done && !busy) return { path: join(dir, done.f), name: done.f, bytes: done.s.size, saved: new Date(done.s.mtimeMs).toISOString() };
    if (Date.now() >= end) return busy ? { error: 'A download is still in progress.' } : { error: `No ${kind === 'any' ? '' : `${kind} `}file was downloaded${since ? ' just now' : ''}.` };
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000));
  }
}

export const devTools = [
  {
    name: 'downloads_latest', description: 'The newest file in the Downloads folder (e.g. a video just downloaded from WhatsApp or a website), to move or open it next. Set wait to wait for a download that has just started.',
    parameters: obj({ kind: { type: 'string', enum: ['any', 'video', 'image', 'document', 'music'] }, minutes: { type: 'integer', description: 'Only files from the last N minutes (default 10)' }, wait: { type: 'integer', description: 'Seconds to wait for it to finish, up to 120' } }),
    run: async ({ kind = 'any', minutes = 10, wait = 30 }) => ({ ...(await latestDownload({ kind, since: Date.now() - minutes * 60_000, wait: Math.min(120, wait), dir: userFolder('Downloads') })), desktop: userFolder('Desktop') }),
  },
  // ---------- file manager ----------
  {
    name: 'fs_list', description: 'List the files and folders in a folder (approved folders only), with sizes and dates.',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Folder path') }, ['path']),
    run: ({ path }, { store }) => {
      const dir = safePath(store, path);
      return readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).slice(0, 300).map((e) => {
        const s = statSync(join(dir, e.name), { throwIfNoEntry: false });
        return { name: e.name, folder: e.isDirectory(), kb: s && !e.isDirectory() ? Math.round(s.size / 1024) : undefined, modified: s?.mtime.toISOString().slice(0, 16) };
      });
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'fs_search', description: 'Find files by name (part of the name) inside an approved folder and its subfolders.',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Folder to search'), name: str('Part of the file name') }, ['path', 'name']),
    run: ({ path, name }, { store }) => {
      const dir = safePath(store, path);
      const q = name.toLowerCase();
      return readdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }).filter((f) => basename(String(f)).toLowerCase().includes(q) && !/node_modules|\.git[\\/]/.test(f)).slice(0, 100).map((f) => join(dir, String(f)));
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'fs_read', description: 'Read a text or code file (approved folders only; secrets like .env or keys are never read).',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('File path') }, ['path']),
    run: ({ path }, { store }) => {
      const file = safePath(store, path);
      if (SECRET_FILE.test(file)) throw new Error('That file may contain passwords or keys, so Maya does not read it.');
      const text = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
      return { path: file, text: text.slice(0, 20_000), truncated: text.length > 20_000 };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'fs_write', description: 'Create or overwrite a text/code file in an approved folder. Overwriting asks the user first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ path: str('File path'), content: str('Full new file content') }, ['path', 'content']),
    run: ({ path, content }, { store }) => {
      const file = safePath(store, path);
      mkdirSync(dirname(file), { recursive: true });
      writeFileSync(file, content);
      return { written: file, bytes: Buffer.byteLength(content) };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'fs_edit', description: 'Fix or change part of a code/text file: replace one exact piece of text (copied from fs_read) with new text. Best way to fix a bug. The user approves first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ path: str('File path'), find: str('The exact text now in the file (copy it from fs_read, including spaces)'), replace: str('The new text') }, ['path', 'find', 'replace']),
    run: ({ path, find, replace }, { store }) => {
      const file = safePath(store, path);
      if (SECRET_FILE.test(file)) throw new Error('That file may contain passwords or keys, so Maya does not change it.');
      const text = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
      // Windows files often use \r\n while the model writes \n: match either.
      const at = (t) => text.split(t).length - 1;
      const target = at(find) ? find : at(find.replace(/\r?\n/g, '\r\n')) ? find.replace(/\r?\n/g, '\r\n') : null;
      if (!target) return { error: 'That exact text is not in the file. fs_read the file again and copy the text exactly.' };
      if (at(target) > 1) return { error: `That text appears ${at(target)} times; include more of the surrounding lines so it is unique.` };
      // Small models often put the whole corrected file in "replace": then it *is* the new file, not an insertion.
      const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const kept = lines.filter((l) => replace.includes(l)).length;
      if (lines.length >= 3 && kept / lines.length >= 0.7) { writeFileSync(file, text.includes('\r\n') ? replace.replace(/\r?\n/g, '\r\n') : replace); return { edited: file, rewrote_whole_file: true }; }
      writeFileSync(file, text.replace(target, () => (target.includes('\r\n') ? replace.replace(/\r?\n/g, '\r\n') : replace)));
      return { edited: file, replaced: target.length, with: replace.length };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'fs_move', description: 'Move or rename a file or folder (both places must be in approved folders). Asks first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ from: str('Current path'), to: str('New path') }, ['from', 'to']),
    run: ({ from, to }, { store }) => {
      const a = safePath(store, from);
      // "Move it to the Desktop": into that folder, keeping the file's name.
      let b = safePath(store, to);
      if (statSync(b, { throwIfNoEntry: false })?.isDirectory() && !statSync(a).isDirectory()) b = join(b, basename(a));
      if (existsSync(b)) throw new Error(`"${b}" already exists; Maya never overwrites files when moving.`);
      mkdirSync(dirname(b), { recursive: true });
      renameSync(a, b);
      return { moved: a, to: b };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'fs_trash', description: 'Delete a file or folder by moving it to the Recycle Bin (can be restored). Asks first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Path to delete') }, ['path']),
    run: async ({ path }, { store, services }) => { const p = safePath(store, path); await services.trash(p); return { moved_to_recycle_bin: p }; },
  },
  {
    name: 'fs_organize', description: 'Tidy a folder (e.g. Downloads): move loose files into Images, Documents, Videos, Music, Archives, Installers, Code, Other subfolders. Asks first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Folder to organise') }, ['path']),
    run: ({ path }, { store }) => {
      const dir = safePath(store, path);
      const moved = {};
      for (const e of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
        if (!e.isFile() || e.name.startsWith('.')) continue;
        const type = typeOf(e.name);
        let target = join(dir, type, e.name);
        for (let i = 2; existsSync(target); i++) target = join(dir, type, `${basename(e.name, extname(e.name))} (${i})${extname(e.name)}`);
        mkdirSync(join(dir, type), { recursive: true });
        renameSync(join(dir, e.name), target);
        moved[type] = (moved[type] || 0) + 1;
      }
      return { folder: dir, moved };
    },
  },

  // ---------- Git (read-only except commit) ----------
  {
    name: 'git_status', description: 'Git status of a project folder: branch, changed, staged and untracked files.',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Project folder') }, ['path']),
    run: async ({ path }, { store }) => ({ status: await git(safePath(store, path), 'status', '--short', '--branch') }),
  },
  {
    name: 'git_diff', description: 'The current uncommitted changes (diff) of a project, to review or explain them.',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Project folder'), staged: { type: 'boolean' } }, ['path']),
    run: async ({ path, staged }, { store }) => { const d = await git(safePath(store, path), 'diff', ...(staged ? ['--staged'] : []), '--stat', '-p'); return { diff: d.slice(0, 15_000), truncated: d.length > 15_000 }; },
  },
  {
    name: 'git_log', description: 'Recent commits of a project (who, when, message).',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Project folder'), count: { type: 'integer' } }, ['path']),
    run: async ({ path, count = 15 }, { store }) => ({ log: await git(safePath(store, path), 'log', `-${Math.min(count, 50)}`, '--date=short', '--pretty=format:%h %ad %an: %s') }),
  },
  {
    name: 'git_branches', description: 'List the branches of a project.',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Project folder') }, ['path']),
    run: async ({ path }, { store }) => ({ branches: await git(safePath(store, path), 'branch', '-a') }),
  },
  {
    name: 'git_commit', description: 'Commit ALL current changes of a project with a message. Asks first. Never pushes.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Project folder'), message: str('Commit message') }, ['path', 'message']),
    run: async ({ path, message }, { store }) => { const cwd = safePath(store, path); await git(cwd, 'add', '-A'); return { committed: (await git(cwd, 'commit', '-m', message)).split('\n')[0] }; },
  },
  {
    name: 'git_init', description: 'Start Git version control in a project folder (approved folders only). Does nothing if it already has Git.',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Project folder') }, ['path']),
    run: async ({ path }, { store }) => {
      const cwd = safePath(store, path);
      if (existsSync(join(cwd, '.git'))) return { already: true };
      await git(cwd, 'init', '-b', 'main');
      return { initialised: cwd };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'github_publish',
    description: 'DevOps: create a NEW public GitHub repository from a committed project folder, push it, and optionally turn on GitHub Pages so the website is live. Only when the user asked to publish or deploy. Asks first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Project folder'), name: str('Repository name, e.g. "portfolio-site"'), pages: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Host index.html with GitHub Pages' } }, ['path', 'name']),
    run: async ({ path, name, pages = true }, { store }) => {
      const cwd = safePath(store, path);
      if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,100}$/.test(name)) return { error: 'Repository names may use letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore.' };
      const gh = (...args) => run('gh', args, { cwd, windowsHide: true, timeout: 120_000 }).then((r) => r.stdout.trim());
      const owner = await gh('api', 'user', '--jq', '.login').catch(() => null);
      if (!owner) return { error: 'The GitHub CLI is not signed in. Run "gh auth login" once, then try again.' };
      await gh('repo', 'create', name, '--public', '--source', '.', '--push');
      const out = { repo: `https://github.com/${owner}/${name}` };
      if (pages) {
        await gh('api', '-X', 'POST', `repos/${owner}/${name}/pages`, '-f', 'source[branch]=main', '-f', 'source[path]=/').catch(() => {});
        out.website = `https://${owner.toLowerCase()}.github.io/${name}/`;
        out.note = 'GitHub Pages takes about a minute to go live.';
      }
      return out;
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'qa_check_site', description: 'QA: open a website project (its index.html) in a hidden browser and report errors, missing images, empty page, title and a screenshot. Run after every change; fix what it finds.',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Project folder'), page: str('Page file, default index.html') }, ['path']),
    run: ({ path, page }, { store, services }) => services.qa.checkSite(safePath(store, path), page),
  },

  // ---------- SQLite (read-only unless approved) ----------
  {
    name: 'db_schema', description: 'Tables and columns of a SQLite database file (approved folders only).',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Path to .db/.sqlite file') }, ['path']),
    run: ({ path }, { store }) => {
      const db = new DatabaseSync(safePath(store, path), { readOnly: true });
      try {
        return db.prepare("SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view') AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'").all();
      } finally { db.close(); }
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'db_query', description: 'Run a read-only SQL query (SELECT) on a SQLite database file and return up to 200 rows.',
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Database file'), sql: str('SELECT query'), params: { type: 'array', items: {}, description: 'Values for ? placeholders' } }, ['path', 'sql']),
    run: ({ path, sql, params = [] }, { store }) => {
      // The connection itself is read-only, so even a sneaky UPDATE fails.
      const db = new DatabaseSync(safePath(store, path), { readOnly: true });
      try {
        const rows = db.prepare(sql).all(...params);
        return { rows: rows.slice(0, 200), count: rows.length };
      } finally { db.close(); }
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'db_execute', description: 'Change a SQLite database (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CREATE). Asks first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ path: str('Database file'), sql: str('SQL statement'), params: { type: 'array', items: {} } }, ['path', 'sql']),
    run: ({ path, sql, params = [] }, { store }) => {
      const db = new DatabaseSync(safePath(store, path));
      try { const r = db.prepare(sql).run(...params); return { changes: Number(r.changes) }; } finally { db.close(); }
    },
  },

  // ---------- time ----------
  {
    name: 'time_now', description: 'The exact current date and time, in the user\'s timezone or another one (e.g. "America/New_York", "Asia/Tokyo").',
    parameters: obj({ timezone: str('IANA timezone, optional') }),
    run: ({ timezone }) => {
      const tz = timezone || Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone;
      return { timezone: tz, now: new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB', { timeZone: tz, dateStyle: 'full', timeStyle: 'long' }) };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'time_convert', description: 'Convert a date-time from one timezone to another.',
    parameters: obj({ datetime: str('e.g. 2026-11-02T18:30'), from: str('IANA timezone of that time'), to: str('Target IANA timezone') }, ['datetime', 'from', 'to']),
    run: ({ datetime, from, to }) => {
      // Find the UTC instant whose wall-clock time in `from` equals `datetime`; the second pass handles daylight saving.
      const guess = Date.parse(`${datetime.length === 16 ? `${datetime}:00` : datetime}Z`);
      let instant = guess - tzOffset(guess, from);
      instant = guess - tzOffset(instant, from);
      instant = new Date(instant);
      return { [from]: datetime, [to]: instant.toLocaleString('en-GB', { timeZone: to, dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }), utc: instant.toISOString() };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'time_until', description: 'How long until (or since) a date-time: days, hours, minutes. Use for deadlines and countdowns.',
    parameters: obj({ datetime: str('Local ISO date-time, e.g. 2026-12-14T09:00') }, ['datetime']),
    run: ({ datetime }) => {
      const ms = new Date(datetime) - Date.now();
      const abs = Math.abs(ms);
      return { past: ms < 0, days: Math.floor(abs / 864e5), hours: Math.floor((abs % 864e5) / 36e5), minutes: Math.floor((abs % 36e5) / 6e4) };
    },
  },

  // ---------- commands (coding engineer) ----------
  {
    name: 'run_command', description: 'Run a command in a project folder (e.g. "npm test", "python main.py", "git status") and return its output. Always asks first. 2 minute limit. Never use it to read or change files (no type, echo >, sed, Set-Content): use fs_read, fs_edit and fs_write.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ command: str('The command line'), cwd: str('Project folder') }, ['command', 'cwd']),
    run: async ({ command, cwd }, { store }) => {
      const dir = safePath(store, cwd);
      try {
        const { stdout, stderr } = await run('cmd.exe', ['/d', '/s', '/c', command], { cwd: dir, timeout: 120_000, windowsHide: true, maxBuffer: 8 * 1024 * 1024 });
        return { exit_code: 0, stdout: stdout.slice(-8000), stderr: stderr.slice(-4000) };
      } catch (e) {
        return { exit_code: e.code ?? 1, stdout: (e.stdout || '').slice(-8000), stderr: (e.stderr || e.message).slice(-4000), timed_out: !!e.killed };
      }
    },
  },
];
```

```javascript
// PC control, routines and activity. ctx.services supplies pc and activity.
import { MEDIA_KEYS, SETTINGS_PAGES } from '../services/pc.js';
import { now } from '../store.js';

const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });
const int = (description) => ({ type: 'integer', description });
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });

export const pcTools = [
  {
    name: 'pc_open_app',
    description: 'Open an app by name, e.g. "WhatsApp", "VS Code", "Chrome", "Spotify", "Calculator". Searches the Start menu and Store apps; if the app is not installed it searches for it in Chrome. Always tell the user what happened (tell_user).',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('App name') }, ['name']),
    run: ({ name }, { services }) => services.pc.openApp(name),
  },
  {
    name: 'system_status',
    description: 'How the computer is doing right now: CPU and GPU load, RAM, disk space, battery, temperature and the apps using the most memory. Use for "why is my PC slow", "battery level", "how much storage is left".',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: async () => (await import('../services/sysmon.js')).systemStatus(),
  },
  {
    name: 'pc_media',
    description: 'Control music/video playback and sound: play/pause, next, previous, stop, mute, volume up/down a step.',
    parameters: obj({ action: { type: 'string', enum: Object.keys(MEDIA_KEYS) } }, ['action']),
    run: async ({ action }, { services }) => { await services.pc.key(action); return { done: action }; },
  },
  {
    name: 'pc_volume',
    description: 'Set the computer volume to a level 0-100, or read it (no level). "Volume 30", "mute" = 0.',
    parameters: obj({ level: int('0 to 100') }),
    run: async ({ level }, { services }) => ({ volume: await services.pc.volume(level) }),
  },
  {
    name: 'pc_brightness',
    description: 'Set the laptop screen brightness 0-100, or read it (no level).',
    parameters: obj({ level: int('0 to 100') }),
    run: async ({ level }, { services }) => ({ brightness: await services.pc.brightness(level) }),
  },
  {
    name: 'pc_lock',
    description: 'Lock the computer (Windows lock screen).',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: async (_, { services }) => { await services.pc.lock(); return { locked: true }; },
  },
  {
    name: 'pc_settings_page',
    description: 'Open a Windows Settings page.',
    parameters: obj({ page: { type: 'string', enum: Object.keys(SETTINGS_PAGES) } }, ['page']),
    run: async ({ page }, { services }) => { await services.pc.startUri(SETTINGS_PAGES[page]); return { opened: page }; },
  },
  {
    name: 'pc_power',
    description: 'Shut down, restart or sleep the computer (optionally after some minutes), or cancel a planned shutdown. The user approves first. For "I\'ll work 2 hours, then shut down" use work_timer_start instead (it says goodbye and lets them say wait).',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ action: { type: 'string', enum: ['shutdown', 'restart', 'sleep', 'cancel'] }, minutes: int('Delay in minutes, default 0') }, ['action']),
    run: ({ action, minutes }, { services }) => services.pc.power(action, minutes),
  },
  {
    name: 'work_timer_start',
    description: 'Start a work timer, e.g. "I will work for 2 hours, then shut down the PC". When it ends Maya sums up the day, says goodbye, gives 1 minute to say "wait", then shuts down. shutdown false = only tell the user. The user approves first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ minutes: int('Length in minutes (2 hours = 120)'), task: str('What they are working on, optional'), shutdown: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Shut the PC down at the end (default true)' } }, ['minutes']),
    run: ({ minutes, task, shutdown = true }, { services }) => services.session.start(minutes, task || 'work', shutdown),
  },
  {
    name: 'work_timer_status',
    description: 'Is a work timer running, when does it end, will the PC shut down?',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { services }) => services.session.status(),
  },
  {
    name: 'work_timer_cancel',
    description: 'Stop the work timer, so the PC will not shut down. "Give me 15 more minutes" = work_timer_more.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { services }) => services.session.cancel(),
  },
  {
    name: 'work_timer_more',
    description: 'Add minutes to the running work timer.',
    parameters: obj({ minutes: int('Minutes to add, default 15') }),
    run: ({ minutes = 15 }, { services }) => services.session.extend(minutes),
  },
  {
    name: 'pc_close_app',
    description: 'Close a running app by its program name, e.g. "chrome", "spotify", only when the user asks to close it. Never on your own to free memory. The user approves first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Program name without .exe') }, ['name']),
    run: ({ name }, { services }) => services.pc.closeApp(name),
  },
  {
    name: 'routines_save',
    description: 'Save a routine: a named list of actions run together, e.g. "study mode" = open VS Code + start 50 min focus + open a lo-fi music website. Each step is a tool name with its arguments. With time ("every morning at 8" = "08:00") it also runs by itself every day; to have things read out, use briefing_now as a step.',
    parameters: obj({
      name: str('Routine name, e.g. "study mode"'),
      steps: { type: 'array', items: obj({ tool: str('Tool name, e.g. pc_open_app'), args: { type: 'object', description: 'Arguments for that tool' } }, ['tool']) },
      time: str('Run every day at this time, 24-hour HH:MM, optional'),
    }, ['name', 'steps']),
    run: async ({ name, steps, time }, { store }) => {
      const { allTools } = await import('./index.js');
      const unknown = steps.filter((s) => !allTools.some((t) => t.name === s.tool) || s.tool.startsWith('routines_'));
      if (unknown.length) return { error: `Unknown or not allowed step tools: ${unknown.map((s) => s.tool).join(', ')}` };
      if (time && !/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(time)) return { error: 'time must be 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 08:00' };
      const key = name.trim().toLowerCase();
      const schedule = time || '';
      const existing = store.get('SELECT id FROM routines WHERE name = ?', key);
      if (existing) return store.update('routines', existing.id, { steps: JSON.stringify(steps), deleted: 0, ...(time ? { schedule } : {}) }, `Updated routine ${key}`);
      return store.insert('routines', { name: key, steps: JSON.stringify(steps), schedule, created_at: now() }, `Saved routine ${key}${time ? `, every day at ${time}` : ''}`);
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'routines_run',
    description: 'Run a saved routine (workflow) by name, e.g. "start study mode". Each step runs in order and shows live in Workflows.',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Routine name') }, ['name']),
    run: async ({ name }, ctx) => {
      const { allTools } = await import('./index.js');
      const { createWorkflows } = await import('../services/workflows.js');
      const workflows = ctx.services?.workflows ?? createWorkflows({ store: ctx.store, tools: () => allTools, ctx, confirm: ctx.services?.confirm });
      let started;
      try { started = workflows.start(name); } catch (e) { return { error: e.message }; }
      const run = await started.done;
      return { routine: run.routine, run_id: run.id, status: run.status, steps: run.steps.map(({ tool, status, result, error }) => ({ tool, status, result, error })) };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'routines_history',
    description: 'Recent workflow/routine runs with the state of each step (completed, failed, cancelled...).',
    parameters: obj({ limit: { type: 'integer', description: 'Default 10' } }),
    run: ({ limit = 10 }, { services }) => services.workflows.runs(limit).map(({ id, routine, status, trigger, started_at, steps }) =>
      ({ id, routine, status, trigger, started_at, steps: steps.map((s) => `${s.tool}: ${s.status}${s.error ? ` (${s.error})` : ''}`) })),
  },
  {
    name: 'routines_control',
    description: 'Pause, resume, cancel or retry a workflow run (find run ids with routines_history).',
    parameters: obj({ run_id: { type: 'integer' }, action: { type: 'string', enum: ['pause', 'resume', 'cancel', 'retry'] } }, ['run_id', 'action']),
    run: ({ run_id, action }, { services }) => {
      const r = services.workflows[action](run_id);
      return r.run ? { run_id, status: 'running again' } : { run_id, status: r.status };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'routines_schedule',
    description: 'Run a saved routine automatically every day at a time, e.g. "08:00". Empty time removes the schedule. The user approves first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Routine name'), time: str('HH:MM 24-hour, or "" to stop') }, ['name', 'time']),
    run: ({ name, time }, { store }) => {
      if (time && !/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(time)) return { error: 'Time must be HH:MM, e.g. 08:00' };
      const r = store.get('SELECT id FROM routines WHERE deleted = 0 AND name = ?', name.trim().toLowerCase());
      return r ? store.update('routines', r.id, { schedule: time, last_scheduled: null }, time ? `Scheduled ${name} daily at ${time}` : `Unscheduled ${name}`) : { error: `No routine called "${name}"` };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'routines_list',
    description: 'List saved routines and their steps.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => store.all('SELECT id, name, steps, schedule FROM routines WHERE deleted = 0').map((r) => ({ ...r, steps: JSON.parse(r.steps) })),
  },
  {
    name: 'briefing_now',
    description: 'Give the daily briefing now: weather, today\'s classes/events, tasks, reminders, emails (morning), or a review of the day (evening). Read the returned text to the user.',
    parameters: obj({ kind: { type: 'string', enum: ['morning', 'evening'] } }),
    run: ({ kind = new Date().getHours() < 16 ? 'morning' : 'evening' }, { services }) => services.briefing.generate(kind),
  },
  {
    name: 'routines_delete',
    description: 'Delete a saved routine by name (can be undone).',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Routine name') }, ['name']),
    run: ({ name }, { store }) => {
      const r = store.get('SELECT id FROM routines WHERE deleted = 0 AND name = ?', name.trim().toLowerCase());
      return r ? store.update('routines', r.id, { deleted: 1 }, `Deleted routine ${name}`) : { error: `No routine called "${name}"` };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'activity_query',
    description: 'How the user spent time on the computer: minutes per app/website, productive vs distracting, for a day (default today) or the week. Use for "how much time did I spend on YouTube", "was I productive today".',
    parameters: obj({ day: str('YYYY-MM-DD, default today'), week: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Last 7 days instead' } }),
    run: ({ day, week }, { services }) => (week ? services.activity.week() : services.activity.summary(day)),
  },
];
```

```javascript
// PC control and activity sensing through one long-running PowerShell helper (Win32 + Core Audio via C#).
import { spawn, execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, renameSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dataDir } from '../paths.js';
import { createInterface } from 'node:readline';
import { join, basename } from 'node:path';

const HELPER = String.raw`
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Add-Type @"
using System; using System.Text; using System.Diagnostics; using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct AtherKeyInput { public ushort vk; public ushort scan; public uint flags; public uint time; public IntPtr extra; }
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct AtherMouseInput { public int dx; public int dy; public uint data; public uint flags; public uint time; public IntPtr extra; }
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit)] public struct AtherInputUnion { [FieldOffset(0)] public AtherMouseInput mi; [FieldOffset(0)] public AtherKeyInput ki; }
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct AtherInput { public uint type; public AtherInputUnion u; }
public static class AtherPc {
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern uint SendInput(uint n, AtherInput[] inputs, int size);
  // Real Unicode keystrokes: web pages, chat apps and Tamil text receive them like a person typing.
  public static void TypeText(string text) {
    foreach (char ch in text) {
      var down = new AtherInput { type = 1 }; down.u.ki = new AtherKeyInput { scan = ch, flags = 0x0004 };
      var up = new AtherInput { type = 1 }; up.u.ki = new AtherKeyInput { scan = ch, flags = 0x0006 };
      SendInput(2, new[] { down, up }, Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(AtherInput)));
      System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(3);
    }
  }
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
  [DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)] static extern int GetWindowText(IntPtr h, StringBuilder s, int n);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern uint GetWindowThreadProcessId(IntPtr h, out uint pid);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern void keybd_event(byte vk, byte scan, uint flags, UIntPtr extra);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool ShowWindow(IntPtr h, int cmd);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool LockWorkStation();
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(IntPtr h);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool SetCursorPos(int x, int y);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern void mouse_event(uint flags, int dx, int dy, int data, UIntPtr extra);
  public static IntPtr Fg() { return GetForegroundWindow(); }
  public static string Foreground() {
    var h = GetForegroundWindow(); var sb = new StringBuilder(512); GetWindowText(h, sb, 512);
    uint pid; GetWindowThreadProcessId(h, out pid); string name = "";
    try { name = Process.GetProcessById((int)pid).ProcessName; } catch {}
    return name + "\t" + sb.ToString() + "\t" + h.ToInt64();
  }
  public static bool Activate(long h) { ShowWindow((IntPtr)h, 9); return SetForegroundWindow((IntPtr)h); }
  public static void Click(int x, int y, bool right) {
    SetCursorPos(x, y); System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(40);
    if (right) { mouse_event(0x08, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); mouse_event(0x10, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); }
    else { mouse_event(0x02, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); mouse_event(0x04, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); }
  }
  public static void Move(int x, int y) { SetCursorPos(x, y); }
  // Press, glide in small steps (apps need to see the movement to start a drag), release.
  public static void Drag(int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
    SetCursorPos(x1, y1); System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(60);
    mouse_event(0x02, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(120);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) { SetCursorPos(x1 + (x2 - x1) * i / 20, y1 + (y2 - y1) * i / 20); System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(15); }
    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(120); mouse_event(0x04, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero);
  }
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern bool SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(IntPtr ctx);
  [DllImport("user32.dll")] static extern IntPtr SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext(IntPtr ctx);
  // Real pixels for everything (cursor and UI Automation alike); otherwise Windows switches modes once UI Automation is used.
  public static void RealPixels() { SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext((IntPtr)(-4)); SetThreadDpiAwarenessContext((IntPtr)(-4)); }
  public static void ClickHere(bool right) {
    if (right) { mouse_event(0x08, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); mouse_event(0x10, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); }
    else { mouse_event(0x02, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); mouse_event(0x04, 0, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); }
  }
  public static void Scroll(int amount) { mouse_event(0x0800, 0, 0, amount, UIntPtr.Zero); }
  public static void Key(byte vk) { keybd_event(vk, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); keybd_event(vk, 0, 2, UIntPtr.Zero); }
  // Key combinations SendKeys cannot send (anything with the Windows key): all down, then up in reverse.
  public static void Chord(byte[] vks) { foreach (var k in vks) keybd_event(k, 0, 0, UIntPtr.Zero); for (int i = vks.Length - 1; i >= 0; i--) keybd_event(vks[i], 0, 2, UIntPtr.Zero); }
  public static void MinimizeForeground() { ShowWindow(GetForegroundWindow(), 6); }
}
[Guid("5CDF2C82-841E-4546-9722-0CF74078229A"), InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
interface IAudioEndpointVolume { int f(); int g(); int h(); int i(); int SetMasterVolumeLevelScalar(float level, Guid ctx); int j();
  int GetMasterVolumeLevelScalar(out float level); int k(); int l(); int m(); int n(); int SetMute([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] bool mute, Guid ctx); int GetMute(out bool mute); }
[Guid("D666063F-1587-4E43-81F1-B948E807363F"), InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
interface IMMDevice { int Activate(ref Guid id, int clsCtx, int p, out IAudioEndpointVolume aev); }
[Guid("A95664D2-9614-4F35-A746-DE8DB63617E6"), InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
interface IMMDeviceEnumerator { int f(); int GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(int dataFlow, int role, out IMMDevice endpoint); }
[ComImport, Guid("BCDE0395-E52F-467C-8E3D-C4579291692E")] class MMDeviceEnumeratorComObject { }
public static class AtherAudio {
  static IAudioEndpointVolume Vol() {
    var e = new MMDeviceEnumeratorComObject() as IMMDeviceEnumerator; IMMDevice d = null;
    Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(e.GetDefaultAudioEndpoint(0, 1, out d));
    IAudioEndpointVolume v = null; var id = typeof(IAudioEndpointVolume).GUID;
    Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(d.Activate(ref id, 23, 0, out v)); return v;
  }
  public static int Get() { float v; Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(Vol().GetMasterVolumeLevelScalar(out v)); return (int)Math.Round(v * 100); }
  public static void Set(int p) { Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(Vol().SetMasterVolumeLevelScalar(Math.Max(0, Math.Min(100, p)) / 100f, Guid.Empty)); }
  public static void Mute(bool m) { Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(Vol().SetMute(m, Guid.Empty)); }
}
"@
[AtherPc]::RealPixels()
Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient, UIAutomationTypes, System.Windows.Forms, WindowsBase
$global:els = @()
$wanted = 'Button','Edit','Hyperlink','MenuItem','ListItem','TabItem','CheckBox','RadioButton','ComboBox','Document','TreeItem','SplitButton','Text','DataItem'
# This helper works in real pixels; Maya (Electron) uses Windows' scaled pixels (e.g. at 125%).
# Positions are converted here, with the scale Maya sends ('dpi' command).
$global:dpi = 1.0
function Get-Dpi { $global:dpi }
function Click-Center($r) { [AtherPc]::Click([int]($r.X + $r.Width / 2), [int]($r.Y + $r.Height / 2), $false) }
# Chrome, Edge and Electron apps (WhatsApp, Teams…) only expose their page after a first look,
# so a nearly empty result is looked at once more.
function Get-Elements {
  $json = Collect-Elements
  if ($global:els.Count -lt 25) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 900; $json = Collect-Elements }
  $json
}
# Visible, named controls of the active window (breadth-first, capped), remembered by index for click/type.
function Collect-Elements {
  $root = [System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::FromHandle([AtherPc]::Fg())
  $walker = [System.Windows.Automation.TreeWalker]::ControlViewWalker
  $queue = New-Object System.Collections.Queue; $queue.Enqueue($root)
  $global:els = @(); $out = @(); $seen = 0; $d = Get-Dpi
  $clock = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew() # huge apps can take a long time to walk; 4 s is enough to act
  while ($queue.Count -gt 0 -and $seen -lt 4000 -and $global:els.Count -lt 200 -and $clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -lt 4000) {
    $e = $queue.Dequeue(); $seen++
    try { $c = $e.Current } catch { continue }
    $t = $c.ControlType.ProgrammaticName -replace 'ControlType\.', ''
    $r = $c.BoundingRectangle
    if (-not $c.IsOffscreen -and $r.Width -gt 2 -and $wanted -contains $t -and ($c.Name -or $t -eq 'Edit' -or $t -eq 'Document')) {
      $global:els += $e
      $n = if ($c.Name) { $c.Name.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(70, $c.Name.Length)) } else { '' }
      $out += [pscustomobject]@{ i = $global:els.Count - 1; type = $t; name = $n; x = [int](($r.X + $r.Width / 2) / $d); y = [int](($r.Y + $r.Height / 2) / $d); w = [int]($r.Width / $d); h = [int]($r.Height / $d); password = [bool]$c.IsPassword }
    }
    try { $child = $walker.GetFirstChild($e); while ($child) { $queue.Enqueue($child); $child = $walker.GetNextSibling($child) } } catch {}
  }
  ConvertTo-Json -InputObject @($out) -Compress -Depth 3
}
function Get-El($i) { $e = $global:els[[int]$i]; if (-not $e) { throw "No element $i; look at the window again first." }; $e }
# Text to read aloud: the whole document where the app offers it (Chrome pages, Notepad, Word), else the visible text pieces.
function Read-Text {
  $root = [System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::FromHandle([AtherPc]::Fg())
  $isDoc = New-Object System.Windows.Automation.PropertyCondition([System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::ControlTypeProperty, [System.Windows.Automation.ControlType]::Document)
  $doc = $root.FindFirst([System.Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Descendants, $isDoc)
  if ($doc) { try { $t = $doc.GetCurrentPattern([System.Windows.Automation.TextPattern]::Pattern).DocumentRange.GetText(20000); if ($t.Trim()) { return $t } } catch {} }
  $isText = New-Object System.Windows.Automation.PropertyCondition([System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::ControlTypeProperty, [System.Windows.Automation.ControlType]::Text)
  $parts = foreach ($e in $root.FindAll([System.Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Descendants, $isText)) { if (-not $e.Current.IsOffscreen -and $e.Current.Name) { $e.Current.Name } }
  $all = $parts -join [char]10
  $all.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(20000, $all.Length))
}
# UTF-8 both ways: the console default (an old DOS code page) garbles Tamil, Hindi, accents and emoji.
$utf8 = New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false
$stdin = New-Object IO.StreamReader([Console]::OpenStandardInput(), $utf8)
$stdout = New-Object IO.StreamWriter([Console]::OpenStandardOutput(), $utf8); $stdout.AutoFlush = $true
while ($true) {
  $line = $stdin.ReadLine(); if ($null -eq $line) { break }
  $id, $cmd, $arg = $line -split "\t", 3
  try {
    $r = switch ($cmd) {
      'fg' { [AtherPc]::Foreground() }
      'key' { [AtherPc]::Key([byte]$arg); 'ok' }
      'move' { $x, $y = $arg -split ','; [AtherPc]::Move([int]([double]$x * $global:dpi), [int]([double]$y * $global:dpi)); 'ok' }
      'clickhere' { [AtherPc]::ClickHere($arg -eq 'right'); 'ok' }
      'vol' { if ($arg -ne '') { [AtherAudio]::Set([int]$arg) }; [AtherAudio]::Get() }
      'mute' { [AtherAudio]::Mute($arg -eq '1'); 'ok' }
      'min' { [AtherPc]::MinimizeForeground(); 'ok' }
      'lock' { [void][AtherPc]::LockWorkStation(); 'ok' }
      'bright' {
        if ($arg -ne '') { Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/WMI -ClassName WmiMonitorBrightnessMethods | Invoke-CimMethod -MethodName WmiSetBrightness -Arguments @{ Timeout = 1; Brightness = [byte]$arg } | Out-Null }
        (Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/WMI -ClassName WmiMonitorBrightness).CurrentBrightness }
      'activate' { [AtherPc]::Activate([long]$arg) }
      'elements' { Get-Elements }
      'readtext' { Read-Text }
      'invoke' {
        $e = Get-El $arg
        # A text field must get the typing cursor: Chrome accepts "invoke" on one without focusing it.
        $t = $e.Current.ControlType.ProgrammaticName
        if ($t -match 'Edit|ComboBox|Document') { try { $e.SetFocus() } catch {}; Click-Center $e.Current.BoundingRectangle; 'focused' }
        else { try { $e.GetCurrentPattern([System.Windows.Automation.InvokePattern]::Pattern).Invoke(); 'invoked' }
        catch { Click-Center $e.Current.BoundingRectangle; 'clicked' } } }
      'settext' {
        $i, $text = $arg -split "\x1f", 2; $e = Get-El $i
        if ($e.Current.IsPassword) { throw 'That is a password field; Maya never types passwords.' }
        $how = 'typed'
        # A document (Notepad, Word…) is added to at the end; replacing it would destroy the user's text.
        $isDoc = $e.Current.ControlType -eq [System.Windows.Automation.ControlType]::Document
        if (-not $isDoc) { try { $vp = $e.GetCurrentPattern([System.Windows.Automation.ValuePattern]::Pattern); $vp.SetValue($text); if ($vp.Current.Value -eq $text) { $how = 'set' } } catch {} }
        # Some apps ignore or refuse a programmatic value: focus the field and type for real.
        if ($how -ne 'set') {
          try { $e.SetFocus() } catch { Click-Center $e.Current.BoundingRectangle }
          Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
          if ($isDoc) { [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait('^{END}'); $how = 'added at the end' } else { [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait('^a') }
          [AtherPc]::TypeText($text)
        }
        $how }
      'type' { [AtherPc]::TypeText($arg); 'typed' }
      'dpi' { $global:dpi = [double]::Parse($arg, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture); 'ok' }
      'drag' { $a = $arg -split ',' | ForEach-Object { [int]([double]$_ * $global:dpi) }; [AtherPc]::Drag($a[0], $a[1], $a[2], $a[3]); 'dragged' }
      'click' { $x, $y, $b = $arg -split ','; [AtherPc]::Click([int]([double]$x * $global:dpi), [int]([double]$y * $global:dpi), $b -eq 'right'); 'clicked' }
      'keys' { [System.Windows.Forms.SendKeys]::SendWait($arg); 'sent' }
      'chord' { [AtherPc]::Chord([byte[]]($arg -split ',' | ForEach-Object { [byte]$_ })); 'sent' }
      'scroll' { [AtherPc]::Scroll([int]$arg); 'scrolled' }
      # What is under the mouse pointer (for "what is this?"): its kind, name, value and hint.
      'atpoint' {
        $p = [System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position
        $e = [System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::FromPoint((New-Object System.Windows.Point($p.X, $p.Y)))
        $c = $e.Current; $v = ''
        try { $v = $e.GetCurrentPattern([System.Windows.Automation.ValuePattern]::Pattern).Current.Value } catch {}
        $kind = $c.ControlType.ProgrammaticName -replace '^ControlType\.', ''
        (@($kind, $c.Name, $v, $c.HelpText) | ForEach-Object { "$_" -replace '\s+', ' ' }) -join [char]9 }
      default { throw "unknown command $cmd" }
    }
    $stdout.WriteLine((@{ id = $id; ok = $true; result = "$r" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
  } catch {
    $stdout.WriteLine((@{ id = $id; ok = $false; error = $_.Exception.Message } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
  }
}
`;

  'whatsapp web': 'https://web.whatsapp.com/', whatsapp: 'https://web.whatsapp.com/', youtube: 'https://www.youtube.com/',
  'google drive': 'https://drive.google.com/', drive: 'https://drive.google.com/', 'google docs': 'https://docs.google.com/document/',
  'google sheets': 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/', 'google calendar': 'https://calendar.google.com/', 'google meet': 'https://meet.google.com/',
  'google classroom': 'https://classroom.google.com/', 'google photos': 'https://photos.google.com/', 'google maps': 'https://maps.google.com/', maps: 'https://maps.google.com/',
  outlook: 'https://outlook.live.com/mail/', instagram: 'https://www.instagram.com/', facebook: 'https://www.facebook.com/', linkedin: 'https://www.linkedin.com/',
  twitter: 'https://x.com/', x: 'https://x.com/', github: 'https://github.com/', netflix: 'https://www.netflix.com/', spotify: 'https://open.spotify.com/',
  amazon: 'https://www.amazon.in/', flipkart: 'https://www.flipkart.com/', 'google translate': 'https://translate.google.com/', canva: 'https://www.canva.com/',
};
/** The user's Chrome profiles: folder, name, signed-in account, and which was used last (exported for the My Maya page). */
export function chromeProfiles(localState = join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA || '', 'Google', 'Chrome', 'User Data', 'Local State')) {
  try {
    const { profile } = JSON.parse(readFileSync(localState, 'utf8'));
    return Object.entries(profile?.info_cache || {}).map(([dir, p]) => ({ dir, name: p.name || dir, account: p.gaia_name || p.user_name || '', lastUsed: dir === profile.last_used }));
  } catch { return []; }
}

/** The website for an app name that is really a website, or null (exported for tests). */
export const webAppUrl = (name) => WEB_APPS[norm(String(name)).replace(/^(the|my) (?!mail|email)/, '').replace(/ (website|site|web|app|account)$/, '')] || null;
const ALIASES = { 'vs code': 'visual studio code', vscode: 'visual studio code', code: 'visual studio code', chrome: 'google chrome',
  edge: 'microsoft edge', ppt: 'powerpoint', teams: 'microsoft teams', 'ms word': 'word', 'ms excel': 'excel',
  // How Whisper often hears "WhatsApp".
  'what s up': 'whatsapp', 'whats up': 'whatsapp', 'what s app': 'whatsapp', 'whats app': 'whatsapp', 'watsapp': 'whatsapp' };
/** The app name the user meant ("what's up" → "whatsapp"). */
export const appName = (spoken) => ALIASES[norm(spoken)] || spoken;

/** Best Start Menu shortcut for a spoken app name (exported for tests). */
export function matchApp(query, names) {
  const q = ALIASES[norm(query)] || norm(query);
  const scored = names.map((name) => {
    const n = norm(name);
    let score = 0;
    if (n === q) score = 100;
    else if (n.startsWith(q)) score = 80;
    else if (n.includes(q)) score = 60;
    else {
      const words = q.split(' ');
      score = (words.filter((w) => w.length > 1 && n.includes(w)).length / words.length) * 50;
    }
    if (/uninstall|readme|help|documentation|release notes/.test(n)) score -= 40;
    return { name, score: score - n.length / 100 };
  }).filter((s) => s.score >= 25).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return scored[0]?.name ?? null;
}

const BROWSERS = new Set(['chrome', 'msedge', 'firefox', 'brave', 'opera', 'vivaldi', 'arc']);
const FRIENDLY = { Code: 'VS Code', WINWORD: 'Word', EXCEL: 'Excel', POWERPNT: 'PowerPoint', msedge: 'Edge', chrome: 'Chrome', firefox: 'Firefox', explorer: 'File Explorer', WindowsTerminal: 'Terminal', idea64: 'IntelliJ IDEA', pycharm64: 'PyCharm', Spotify: 'Spotify', Maya: 'Maya', Discord: 'Discord', WhatsApp: 'WhatsApp', Telegram: 'Telegram', ONENOTE: 'OneNote' };

/** "Lecture 5 - YouTube - Google Chrome" → { app: 'Chrome', label: 'YouTube' }. Exported for tests. */
export function describeWindow(process, title) {
  const app = FRIENDLY[process] || process;
  if (!BROWSERS.has(process)) return { app, label: app };
  const parts = title.replace(/ and \d+ more pages?/, '').split(/ [-–—|] /).map((p) => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  parts.pop(); // the browser's own name
  if (process === 'msedge' && parts.length >= 2) parts.pop(); // Edge adds the profile name ("Personal")
  const site = parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : parts[0];
  return { app, label: site && site.length < 40 ? site.replace(/^\(\d+\)\s*/, '') : app };
}

/** scale() is the main screen's scale factor (1.25 at 125%), from Electron; control positions come back in scaled pixels. */
export function createPc({ shell, scale = () => 1, chromeChoice = () => null }) {
  let child = null;
  let seq = 0;
  const pending = new Map();

  function start() {
    // The helper is too long for a command line (Windows allows 32,767 characters), so it runs from a file.
    // The BOM makes Windows PowerShell 5.1 read it as UTF-8.
    const script = join(dataDir, 'pc-helper.ps1');
    const body = `﻿${HELPER}`;
    // Written only when it changed, and atomically: several Maya processes (or tests) may start helpers at once.
    if (!existsSync(script) || readFileSync(script, 'utf8') !== body) {
      const tmp = `${script}.${process.pid}.tmp`;
      writeFileSync(tmp, body);
      renameSync(tmp, script);
    }
    child = spawn('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', script], { windowsHide: true, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'ignore'] });
    child.stdin.write(`0\tdpi\t${scale()}\n`); // before any move or click (id 0: no reply awaited)
    createInterface({ input: child.stdout }).on('line', (line) => {
      let msg;
      try { msg = JSON.parse(line); } catch { return; }
      const p = pending.get(msg.id);
      if (!p) return;
      pending.delete(msg.id);
      msg.ok ? p.resolve(msg.result) : p.reject(new Error(msg.error));
    });
    child.on('exit', () => {
      child = null;
      for (const p of pending.values()) p.reject(new Error('PC helper stopped'));
      pending.clear();
    });
  }

  function send(cmd, arg = '') {
    if (!child) start();
    const id = String(++seq);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      pending.set(id, { resolve, reject });
      child.stdin.write(`${id}\t${cmd}\t${arg}\n`);
      setTimeout(() => { if (pending.delete(id)) reject(new Error('PC helper timed out')); }, 15_000);
    });
  }

  const startMenu = [join(process.env.ProgramData || 'C:\\ProgramData', 'Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs'), join(process.env.APPDATA || '', 'Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs')];
  function shortcuts() {
    const found = {};
    for (const dir of startMenu) {
      try {
        for (const f of readdirSync(dir, { recursive: true })) if (f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.lnk')) found[basename(f, '.lnk')] ??= join(dir, f);
      } catch { /* folder missing */ }
    }
    return found;
  }

  const startUri = (target) => new Promise((resolve) => execFile('cmd.exe', ['/c', 'start', '""', target], { windowsHide: true }, () => resolve()));

  const quiet = (exe, args) => new Promise((resolve) => execFile(exe, args, { windowsHide: true, timeout: 20_000 }, (e, out) => resolve(e ? '' : out)));
  // Every app in the Start menu, including Store apps (WhatsApp, Spotify…) that have no .lnk file. Cached 10 minutes.
  let startApps = null, startAppsAt = 0;
  async function storeApps() {
    if (startApps && Date.now() - startAppsAt < 600_000) return startApps;
    const out = await quiet('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', 'Get-StartApps | ConvertTo-Json -Compress']);
    try { startApps = Object.fromEntries([].concat(JSON.parse(out)).map((a) => [a.Name, a.AppID])); } catch { startApps = {}; }
    startAppsAt = Date.now();
    return startApps;
  }
  async function chromePath() {
    for (const hive of ['HKCU', 'HKLM']) {
      const m = (await quiet('reg.exe', ['query', `${hive}\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\App Paths\\chrome.exe`, '/ve'])).match(/REG_SZ\s+(.+\.exe)/i);
      if (m) return m[1].trim();
    }
    return null;
  }
  // Chrome shows a profile picker when there are several profiles: Maya opens the one the user chose
  // (My Maya), else the one used last, and clicks it in the picker itself if the picker still appears.
  function chromeProfile() {
    const profiles = chromeProfiles();
    const wanted = chromeChoice();
    return profiles.find((p) => p.dir === wanted) || profiles.find((p) => p.lastUsed) || profiles[0] || null;
  }
  async function startChrome(args = []) {
    const chrome = await chromePath();
    if (!chrome) return false;
    const profile = chromeProfile();
    spawn(chrome, [...(profile ? [`--profile-directory=${profile.dir}`] : []), ...args], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref();
    if (profile) pickChromeProfile(profile).catch(() => {});
    return true;
  }
  /** "Who's using Chrome?": click the user's profile, like a person would. */
  async function pickChromeProfile(profile) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700));
      const fg = await send('fg').catch(() => '');
      if (!/^chrome\t/i.test(fg)) continue;
      const items = JSON.parse((await send('elements').catch(() => '[]')) || '[]');
      if (!items.some((e) => /who.s using chrome|guest mode/i.test(e.name || ''))) return;
      const card = items.find((e) => [profile.name, profile.account].filter(Boolean).some((n) => (e.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(n.toLowerCase())));
      if (card) { await send('invoke', card.i); return; }
    }
  }

  /** Start menu shortcut → Start menu/Store app → otherwise search for it in Chrome (or the default browser). */
  async function openApp(name) {
    const builtin = BUILTIN_APPS[norm(name)];
    if (builtin) { await startUri(builtin); return { opened: name }; }
    name = appName(name);
    const links = shortcuts();
    let match = matchApp(name, Object.keys(links));
    if (match === 'Google Chrome' && await startChrome()) return { opened: match };
    if (match) {
      const err = await shell.openPath(links[match]);
      return err ? { error: err } : { opened: match };
    }
    const apps = await storeApps();
    match = matchApp(name, Object.keys(apps));
    if (match) { execFile('explorer.exe', [`shell:AppsFolder\\${apps[match]}`]); return { opened: match }; }
    // Gmail, ChatGPT, WhatsApp Web…: the site itself, in Chrome where the user is signed in.
    const site = webAppUrl(name);
    if (site) {
      if (!(await startChrome([site]))) await shell.openExternal(site);
      return { opened: name, website: site, tell_user: `I opened ${name} in your browser.` };
    }
    const url = `https://www.google.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`;
    const chrome = await startChrome([url]);
    if (!chrome) await shell.openExternal(url);
    const browser = chrome ? 'Chrome' : 'your browser';
    return { not_installed: name, opened: browser, searched_for: name,
      tell_user: `${name} is not installed on this PC, so I opened ${browser} and searched for "${name}".` };
  }

  async function power(action, minutes = 0) {
    const seconds = String(Math.max(0, Math.round(minutes * 60)));
    const args = { shutdown: ['/s', '/t', seconds], restart: ['/r', '/t', seconds], cancel: ['/a'] }[action];
    if (action === 'sleep') { execFile('rundll32.exe', ['powrprof.dll,SetSuspendState', '0,1,0']); return { done: 'sleep' }; }
    if (!args) throw new Error('action must be shutdown, restart, sleep or cancel');
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => execFile('shutdown.exe', args, { windowsHide: true }, (e) => (e && action !== 'cancel' ? reject(e) : resolve())));
    return { done: action, minutes };
  }

  async function closeApp(name) {
    if (!/^[\w .-]{1,60}$/.test(name)) throw new Error('Invalid app name');
    const exe = name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.exe') ? name : `${name}.exe`;
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => execFile('taskkill.exe', ['/IM', exe], { windowsHide: true }, (e, out, errOut) => (e ? reject(new Error(errOut || e.message)) : resolve())));
    return { closed: name };
  }

  return {
    foreground: async () => { const [proc, title = '', hwnd] = (await send('fg')).split('\t'); return { process: proc, title, hwnd: Number(hwnd), ...describeWindow(proc, title) }; },
    activate: (hwnd) => send('activate', hwnd),
    elements: async () => JSON.parse((await send('elements')) || '[]'),
    readText: () => send('readtext'),
    invoke: (i) => send('invoke', i),
    // One command per line: newlines in typed text become spaces.
    setText: (i, text) => send('settext', `${i}\x1f${String(text).replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ')}`),
    /** Type into whatever has the keyboard focus. */
    type: (text) => send('type', String(text).replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ')),
    click: (x, y, button = 'left') => send('click', `${Math.round(x)},${Math.round(y)},${button}`),
    drag: (x1, y1, x2, y2) => send('drag', [x1, y1, x2, y2].map(Math.round).join(',')),
    /** What is under the mouse pointer: { kind, name, value, hint }. */
    async atPointer() { const [kind = '', name = '', value = '', hint = ''] = String(await send('atpoint')).split('\t'); return { kind, name, value, hint }; },
    // Head mouse: many moves a second, so no reply is awaited (id 0 is never pending).
    move(x, y) { if (!child) start(); child.stdin.write(`0\tmove\t${Math.round(x)},${Math.round(y)}\n`); },
    clickHere: (button = 'left') => send('clickhere', button),
    keys: (seq) => send('keys', seq),
    /** Virtual-key codes pressed together, e.g. Win + Plus for the Magnifier. */
    chord: (...vks) => send('chord', vks.join(',')),
    scroll: (amount) => send('scroll', amount),
    key: (k) => send('key', MEDIA_KEYS[k] ?? k),
    volume: (level) => send('vol', level ?? '').then(Number),
    mute: (on) => send('mute', on ? '1' : '0'),
    brightness: (level) => send('bright', level ?? '').then(Number),
    minimizeForeground: () => send('min'),
    lock: () => send('lock'),
    /** Windows dark mode for apps and the taskbar (the user's own setting, HKCU). */
    async darkMode(on) {
      const key = 'HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Themes\\Personalize';
      for (const name of ['AppsUseLightTheme', 'SystemUsesLightTheme']) await quiet('reg.exe', ['add', key, '/v', name, '/t', 'REG_DWORD', '/d', on ? '0' : '1', '/f']);
    },
    openApp, power, closeApp, startUri, shortcuts,
    /** A website in the user's Chrome profile (signed in to Gmail, ChatGPT…), else the default browser. */
    async openUrl(url) { if (!(await startChrome([url]))) await shell.openExternal(url); }, storeApps,
    stop: () => child?.kill(),
  };
}
```

### src/main/tools/computer.js

```javascript
// Computer control: Maya works in other apps through Windows UI Automation (named buttons and fields),
// after the user allows it once per task. Esc stops it. ctx.services.computer holds the session and log.
const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });
const int = (description) => ({ type: 'integer', description });
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });

const SESSION_MS = 10 * 60_000;
const SPECIAL = { enter: '{ENTER}', tab: '{TAB}', esc: '{ESC}', escape: '{ESC}', backspace: '{BACKSPACE}', delete: '{DELETE}', up: '{UP}', down: '{DOWN}',
  left: '{LEFT}', right: '{RIGHT}', home: '{HOME}', end: '{END}', pageup: '{PGUP}', pagedown: '{PGDN}', space: ' ', f5: '{F5}', f4: '{F4}', f2: '{F2}' };

/** "ctrl+s" → "^s", "alt+f4" → "%{F4}", "enter" → "{ENTER}" (SendKeys syntax). Exported for tests. */
export function toSendKeys(combo) {
  return String(combo).split(/\s+/).map((part) => {
    const keys = part.toLowerCase().split('+');
    const key = keys.pop();
    const mods = keys.map((m) => ({ ctrl: '^', control: '^', alt: '%', shift: '+', win: '^{ESC}' }[m] || '')).join('');
    const k = SPECIAL[key] || (/^f\d{1,2}$/.test(key) ? `{${key.toUpperCase()}}` : key.length === 1 ? key.replace(/[+^%~(){}[\]]/g, '{$&}') : `{${key.toUpperCase()}}`);
    return mods + k;
  }).join('');
}

// A lettered grid over the screen, so Maya (or a user speaking) can point anywhere: "D7".
const COLS = 16, ROWS = 10;
/** "D7" → centre of that grid cell in screen coordinates, or null. Exported for tests. */
export function cellCenter(cell, { x = 0, y = 0, width, height }) {
  const m = /^([A-P])\s*(10|[1-9])$/i.exec(String(cell).trim());
  if (!m) return null;
  const col = m[1].toUpperCase().charCodeAt(0) - 65, row = Number(m[2]) - 1;
  return { x: Math.round(x + ((col + 0.5) * width) / COLS), y: Math.round(y + ((row + 0.5) * height) / ROWS) };
}

/** Screenshot with the grid and every control's number drawn on it, scaled for the model. */
export async function annotate(dataUrl, elements, bounds) {
  const { default: sharp } = await import('sharp');
  const img = Buffer.from(dataUrl.split(',')[1], 'base64');
  const { width: W, height: H } = await sharp(img).metadata();
  const sx = W / bounds.width, sy = H / bounds.height;
  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[<&>]/g, (c) => ({ '<': '&lt;', '&': '&amp;', '>': '&gt;' })[c]);
  let svg = '';
  for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
    const x = (c * W) / COLS;
    svg += `<line x1="${x}" y1="0" x2="${x}" y2="${H}" stroke="#00b7ff" stroke-opacity=".35"/><text x="${x + 4}" y="14" font-size="13" font-family="Arial" font-weight="700" fill="#00b7ff">${String.fromCharCode(65 + c)}</text>`;
  }
  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    const y = (r * H) / ROWS;
    svg += `<line x1="0" y1="${y}" x2="${W}" y2="${y}" stroke="#00b7ff" stroke-opacity=".35"/><text x="3" y="${y + 28}" font-size="13" font-family="Arial" font-weight="700" fill="#00b7ff">${r + 1}</text>`;
  }
  for (const e of elements.slice(0, 120)) {
    const x = (e.x - (e.w || 0) / 2 - bounds.x) * sx, y = (e.y - (e.h || 0) / 2 - bounds.y) * sy;
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x > W || y > H) continue;
    const label = esc(e.i), w = 8 + label.length * 8;
    svg += `<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${(e.w || 0) * sx}" height="${(e.h || 0) * sy}" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc00" stroke-opacity=".8"/><rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="16" fill="#ffcc00"/><text x="${x + 4}" y="${y + 12}" font-size="12" font-family="Arial" font-weight="700" fill="#000">${label}</text>`;
  }
  // Two steps: sharp would otherwise resize before compositing, and the full-size overlay would not fit.
  const marked = await sharp(img).composite([{ input: Buffer.from(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${W}" height="${H}">${svg}</svg>`) }]).png().toBuffer();
  const out = await sharp(marked).resize({ width: Math.min(W, 1280) }).jpeg({ quality: 70 }).toBuffer();
  return `data:image/jpeg;base64,${out.toString('base64')}`;
}

const controlList = (elements) => elements.map((e) => `${e.i} ${e.type}${e.password ? ' (password)' : ''}: ${e.name}`).join('\n');

/** After an action: wait for the screen to settle, then report what the window shows now (Maya "looks back"). */
async function lookAgain(pc) {
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700));
  const fg = await pc.foreground();
  const elements = await pc.elements();
  return { window_now: fg.title, controls_now: controlList(elements).slice(0, 2500) || 'No named controls; use computer_look for a picture.' };
}

export function createComputerSession() {
  const s = { until: 0, task: '', target: null, lastExternal: null, log: [] };
  return {
    get active() { return Date.now() < s.until; },
    start(task) {
      s.until = Date.now() + SESSION_MS; s.task = task; s.target ??= s.lastExternal;
      s.log.unshift({ at: new Date().toISOString(), action: 'start', detail: task });
    },
    stop(reason = 'stopped') { if (Date.now() < s.until) s.log.unshift({ at: new Date().toISOString(), action: reason, detail: s.task }); s.until = 0; s.target = null; },
    noteForeground(fg) { if (fg?.hwnd && !/^(Ather|Maya|electron)$/i.test(fg.process)) s.lastExternal = fg; },
    lastExternal: () => s.lastExternal,
    /** The window this task works in: the app Maya opened, or the one the user was in when they asked. */
    get target() { return s.target; },
    setTarget(fg) { if (fg?.hwnd && !/^(Ather|Maya|electron)$/i.test(fg.process)) s.target = fg; },
    record(action, detail) { s.log.unshift({ at: new Date().toISOString(), action, detail: String(detail).slice(0, 160) }); s.log.length = Math.min(s.log.length, 200); },
    log: () => s.log,
  };
}

/**
 * Throws unless the user allowed control for this task, and brings the task's app back to the front first:
 * an approval card or another app taking focus must never make Maya act in the wrong window.
 * A dialog of the same app (Save as…, a pop-up) is followed instead.
 */
async function ready({ services }) {
  const c = services.computer;
  // computer_start shows the permission card itself (click or spoken "yes"), so asking in text first only adds a step.
  if (!c?.active) throw new Error('Computer control is not on. Call computer_start right now: it asks the user for permission itself. Do not ask in text first.');
  let fg = await services.pc.foreground();
  const target = c.target || c.lastExternal();
  if (target && fg.process !== target.process) {
    await services.pc.activate(target.hwnd);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
    fg = await services.pc.foreground();
    if (fg.process !== target.process) throw new Error(`Could not bring ${target.app || target.process} back to the front. Use computer_open to open it again.`);
  }
  c.setTarget(fg);
  return services.pc;
}

export const computerTools = [
  {
    name: 'computer_start',
    description: 'Ask to control the mouse and keyboard to do a task in other apps (e.g. "open WhatsApp and message Rahul", "fill this form"). The user approves once; control ends after 10 minutes, when done, or when they press Esc. Never use it for payments, passwords or posting publicly without asking.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ task: str('What you are going to do, in one sentence') }, ['task']),
    run: ({ task }, { services }) => {
      services.computer.start(task);
      services.onComputerStart?.(task);
      return { allowed: true, minutes: 10, how: 'Work like a careful person. computer_look shows a screenshot with numbered controls and a lettered grid. '
        + 'Act with computer_click / computer_type / computer_keys; each one looks again and tells you what the window shows now. '
        + 'If a step did not work, try another way (another control, a grid cell, a keyboard shortcut, computer_open), up to 3 tries, '
        + 'then tell the user what blocked you. The user asked for this to happen on the screen: do not answer with web_search instead. '
        + 'Grid cells go from A1 to P10. Never delete, clear or replace text or files that were already there unless the user asked. '
        + 'Call computer_done at the end.' };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'computer_look',
    description: 'See the active window: a screenshot (yellow numbers mark controls, a blue lettered grid covers the screen) plus the numbered list of buttons, fields and links. Use the numbers, or a grid cell like "D7", with computer_click and computer_type.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: async (_, ctx) => {
      const pc = await ready(ctx);
      const fg = await pc.foreground();
      const elements = await pc.elements();
      ctx.services.computer.record('look', `${fg.title} (${elements.length} controls)`);
      const shot = ctx.services.screen?.capture ? await ctx.services.screen.capture() : null;
      const bounds = ctx.services.screen?.bounds?.();
      return {
        window: fg.title, app: fg.app,
        controls: controlList(elements) || 'No named controls in this app: use the picture and click grid cells, or keyboard shortcuts.',
        ...(shot && bounds ? { attachImage: await annotate(shot, elements, bounds) } : {}),
      };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'computer_click',
    description: 'Click a control by its number from computer_look (best), or a grid cell from the picture (e.g. "D7"). Afterwards you get what the window shows now.',
    parameters: obj({ element: int('Control number from computer_look'), cell: str('Grid cell, e.g. "D7", when the thing has no number'),
      right: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Right-click' }, double: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Double-click' } }),
    run: async ({ element, cell, right, double }, ctx) => {
      const pc = await ready(ctx);
      let r;
      if (element !== undefined && element !== null) r = await pc.invoke(element);
      else {
        const p = cell && ctx.services.screen?.bounds ? cellCenter(cell, ctx.services.screen.bounds()) : null;
        if (!p) return { error: 'Give a control number, or a grid cell from A1 to P10.' };
        r = await pc.click(p.x, p.y, right ? 'right' : 'left');
        if (double) r = await pc.click(p.x, p.y, 'left');
      }
      ctx.services.computer.record('click', element ?? `cell ${cell}`);
      return { done: r, ...(await lookAgain(pc)) };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'computer_type',
    description: 'Type text like a person (any language, e.g. Tamil): into a field by its number, or, without a number, wherever the cursor is (click the field first). Never types into password fields. Afterwards you get what the window shows now.',
    parameters: obj({ element: int('Field number from computer_look (optional)'), text: str('Text to type'), enter: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Press Enter after typing (send/search)' } }, ['text']),
    run: async ({ element, text, enter }, ctx) => {
      const pc = await ready(ctx);
      const r = element !== undefined && element !== null ? await pc.setText(element, text) : await pc.type(text);
      if (enter) await pc.keys('{ENTER}');
      ctx.services.computer.record('type', `${text.length} characters${element !== undefined ? ` into control ${element}` : ''}${enter ? ' + Enter' : ''}`);
      return { done: r, ...(await lookAgain(pc)) };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'computer_keys',
    description: 'Press keys in the active app, e.g. "enter", "ctrl+s", "ctrl+f", "alt+tab", "tab tab enter". Afterwards you get what the window shows now.',
    parameters: obj({ keys: str('Keys separated by spaces; combine with +') }, ['keys']),
    run: async ({ keys }, ctx) => {
      const pc = await ready(ctx);
      await pc.keys(toSendKeys(keys));
      ctx.services.computer.record('keys', keys);
      return { pressed: keys, ...(await lookAgain(pc)) };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'computer_scroll',
    description: 'Scroll the active window up or down.',
    parameters: obj({ direction: { type: 'string', enum: ['up', 'down'] }, amount: int('Notches, default 5') }, ['direction']),
    run: async ({ direction, amount = 5 }, ctx) => { const pc = await ready(ctx); await pc.scroll((direction === 'up' ? 120 : -120) * amount); ctx.services.computer.record('scroll', direction); return { scrolled: direction }; },
  },
  {
    name: 'computer_open',
    description: 'Open an app and make it the active window for computer control.',
    parameters: obj({ app: str('App name') }, ['app']),
    run: async ({ app }, ctx) => {
      // Opening an app needs no permission (same as pc_open_app); only acting inside it does.
      const r = await ctx.services.pc.openApp(app);
      await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 2500));
      const fg = await ctx.services.pc.foreground();
      ctx.services.computer.noteForeground(fg);
      ctx.services.computer.setTarget(fg);
      ctx.services.computer.record('open', app);
      return { ...r, active_window: fg.title };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'computer_done',
    description: 'Finish computer control and give the mouse and keyboard back to the user.',
    parameters: obj({ summary: str('What was done') }),
    run: ({ summary = 'done' }, { services }) => { services.computer.record('done', summary); services.computer.stop('done'); services.onComputerStop?.(); return { ended: true }; },
  },
];
```
