### src/main/services/sysmon.js

```javascript
// "This PC" monitor: CPU, memory, disk, GPU (NVIDIA), battery and the busiest apps.
import os from 'node:os';
import { statfs } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';

const run = (exe, args) => new Promise((resolve) => execFile(exe, args, { windowsHide: true, timeout: 8000 }, (e, out) => resolve(e ? '' : out)));
const gb = (bytes) => Math.round((bytes / 1024 ** 3) * 10) / 10;

/** CPU busy % over a short sample. */
async function cpuPercent(ms = 400) {
  const totals = () => os.cpus().reduce((t, c) => { const all = Object.values(c.times).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); return { idle: t.idle + c.times.idle, all: t.all + all }; }, { idle: 0, all: 0 });
  const a = totals();
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
  const b = totals();
  return Math.round(100 * (1 - (b.idle - a.idle) / Math.max(1, b.all - a.all)));
}

async function gpu() {
  const out = await run('nvidia-smi', ['--query-gpu=name,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total,temperature.gpu', '--format=csv,noheader,nounits']);
  const [name, load, used, total, temp] = out.split('\n')[0]?.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()) ?? [];
  return name ? { name, load_percent: Number(load), memory_used_gb: gb(Number(used) * 1024 ** 2), memory_total_gb: gb(Number(total) * 1024 ** 2), temperature_c: Number(temp) } : null;
}

async function battery() {
  const out = await run('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', 'Get-CimInstance Win32_Battery | Select-Object EstimatedChargeRemaining,BatteryStatus | ConvertTo-Json -Compress']);
  try {
    const b = [].concat(JSON.parse(out))[0];
    // BatteryStatus 2 = on mains power (charging or full)
    return b ? { percent: b.EstimatedChargeRemaining, charging: b.BatteryStatus === 2 || b.BatteryStatus >= 6 } : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

async function topApps() {
  const out = await run('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command',
    'Get-Process | Group-Object ProcessName | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{ name = $_.Name; mb = [math]::Round(($_.Group | Measure-Object WorkingSet64 -Sum).Sum / 1MB) } } | Sort-Object mb -Descending | Select-Object -First 6 | ConvertTo-Json -Compress']);
  try { return [].concat(JSON.parse(out)).map((p) => ({ app: p.name, memory_mb: p.mb })); } catch { return []; }
}

export async function systemStatus({ apps = true } = {}) {
  const [cpu, g, bat, top, disk] = await Promise.all([cpuPercent(), gpu(), battery(), apps ? topApps() : [], statfs('C:\\').catch(() => null)]);
  const total = os.totalmem(), free = os.freemem();
  return {
    cpu: { load_percent: cpu, model: os.cpus()[0]?.model.trim(), cores: os.cpus().length },
    memory: { used_gb: gb(total - free), total_gb: gb(total), percent: Math.round((100 * (total - free)) / total) },
    disk: disk && { drive: 'C:', free_gb: gb(disk.bavail * disk.bsize), total_gb: gb(disk.blocks * disk.bsize), percent: Math.round(100 * (1 - disk.bavail / disk.blocks)) },
    gpu: g,
    battery: bat,
    uptime_hours: Math.round(os.uptime() / 360) / 10,
    busiest_apps: top,
  };
}
```

### src/main/services/activity.js

```javascript
// Which apps/sites the user spends time in (local only, app/site names, never full window titles),
// and focus blocking: distracting apps get a nudge (and are minimised) during a focus session.
const SAMPLE_SECONDS = 5;
const IDLE_AFTER = 120; // seconds without input = away, not counted

export const DEFAULT_CATEGORIES = {
  YouTube: 'distracting', Instagram: 'distracting', Netflix: 'distracting', Facebook: 'distracting', X: 'distracting', Twitter: 'distracting',
  Reddit: 'distracting', 'Prime Video': 'distracting', Hotstar: 'distracting', 'JioCinema': 'distracting', Steam: 'distracting', Twitch: 'distracting',
  'VS Code': 'productive', Word: 'productive', Excel: 'productive', PowerPoint: 'productive', 'IntelliJ IDEA': 'productive', PyCharm: 'productive',
  Maya: 'productive', OneNote: 'productive', Terminal: 'productive', GitHub: 'productive', 'Google Docs': 'productive', 'Stack Overflow': 'productive',
  'Google Classroom': 'productive', Coursera: 'productive', LeetCode: 'productive', GeeksforGeeks: 'productive',
};

export const categoryOf = (label, custom = {}) => custom[label] ?? DEFAULT_CATEGORIES[label] ?? 'neutral';

const today = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA');

export function createActivity({ store, pc, idleSeconds, onDistracted = () => {}, onSample = () => {} }) {
  const lastNudge = new Map();

  function record({ app, label }, seconds = SAMPLE_SECONDS, at = new Date()) {
    store.run(`INSERT INTO activity (day, hour, app, label, seconds) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)
      ON CONFLICT(day, hour, app, label) DO UPDATE SET seconds = seconds + excluded.seconds`,
    at.toLocaleDateString('en-CA'), at.getHours(), app, label, seconds);
  }

  function activeFocus() {
    const s = store.get('SELECT * FROM focus_sessions WHERE deleted = 0 AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1');
    return s && Date.now() - Date.parse(s.started_at) < s.minutes * 60_000 ? s : null;
  }

  async function tick() {
    if (!store.getSetting('activityTracking', true) || idleSeconds() > IDLE_AFTER) return;
    const sample = await pc.foreground().catch(() => null);
    if (!sample?.process || sample.process === 'LockApp') return;
    onSample(sample);
    record(sample);
    const focus = activeFocus();
    if (focus && categoryOf(sample.label, store.getSetting('appCategories', {})) === 'distracting') {
      if (Date.now() - (lastNudge.get(sample.label) || 0) < 60_000) return;
      lastNudge.set(sample.label, Date.now());
      onDistracted(sample, focus);
    }
  }

  /** Minutes per app/site for a day, with productive / distracting totals. */
  function summary(day = today()) {
    const custom = store.getSetting('appCategories', {});
    const rows = store.all('SELECT label, app, SUM(seconds) AS s FROM activity WHERE day = ? GROUP BY label ORDER BY s DESC', day);
    const items = rows.map((r) => ({ label: r.label, app: r.app, minutes: Math.round(r.s / 60), category: categoryOf(r.label, custom) }));
    const total = (c) => items.filter((i) => !c || i.category === c).reduce((n, i) => n + i.minutes, 0);
    const byHour = Array(24).fill(0);
    for (const r of store.all('SELECT hour, SUM(seconds) AS s FROM activity WHERE day = ? GROUP BY hour', day)) byHour[r.hour] = Math.round(r.s / 60);
    return { day, total_minutes: total(), productive_minutes: total('productive'), distracting_minutes: total('distracting'), apps: items.slice(0, 15), minutes_by_hour: byHour };
  }

  /** Last 7 days: productive vs distracting minutes per day. */
  function week() {
    return [...Array(7)].map((_, i) => {
      const day = new Date(Date.now() - (6 - i) * 864e5).toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
      const s = summary(day);
      return { day, productive: s.productive_minutes, distracting: s.distracting_minutes, total: s.total_minutes };
    });
  }

  let timer = null;
  return {
    record, summary, week, tick,
    start() { timer ??= setInterval(() => tick().catch(() => {}), SAMPLE_SECONDS * 1000); },
    stop() { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; },
  };
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Markdown from './Markdown.jsx';

const TITLES = {
  python_run: 'Run this Python code on your computer?',
  pc_power: 'Change your computer\'s power state?',
  pc_close_app: 'Close this app?',
  computer_start: 'Let Maya use your mouse and keyboard for this?',
  run_command: 'Run this command on your computer?',
  github_publish: 'Publish this project on GitHub (public)?',
  work_timer_start: 'Start this work timer?',
  fs_edit: 'Change this file?',
  mail_reply: 'Send this reply?',
  mail_send: 'Send this email?',
  mail_archive: 'Move these emails out of your inbox?',
  mail_add_tasks: 'Add these to your tasks and calendar?',
};

/** The question on the card (also spoken when the user answers by voice). */
export const approvalTitle = (r) => (r.name === 'mail_send' && r.args?.to ? `Send this email to ${r.args.to}?`
  : r.name === 'skills_learn' ? `I learned how to do this. Shall I remember it as the skill "${r.args?.name}"?`
  : TITLES[r.name] || `Allow ${r.name.replace(/_/g, ' ')}?`);

function details(name, args) {
  if (name === 'python_run') return `\`\`\`python\n${args.code}\n\`\`\``;
  if (name === 'pc_power') return `**${args.action}**${args.minutes ? ` in ${args.minutes} minute(s)` : ''}`;
  if (name === 'pc_close_app') return `**${args.name}** (unsaved work in it may be lost)`;
  if (name === 'computer_start') return `**${args.task}**\n\nPress Esc at any time to take control back.`;
  if (name === 'fs_edit') return `**${args.path}**\n\nReplace:\n\`\`\`\n${args.find}\n\`\`\`\nwith:\n\`\`\`\n${args.replace}\n\`\`\``;
  if (name === 'work_timer_start') {
    const end = new Date(Date.now() + args.minutes * 60_000).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' });
    return `**${args.task || 'Work'}** until **${end}**${args.shutdown === false ? '' : ', then the PC **shuts down** (you get a 1 minute warning and can say "wait")'}.`;
  }
  if (name === 'mail_send') return `**To:** ${args.to}\n**Subject:** ${args.subject}\n\n${args.text}`;
  if (name === 'mail_reply') return args.text;
  if (name === 'skills_learn') return `**When:** ${args.when}\n\n${args.steps}\n\nYou can switch it off or delete it on the Skills page.`;
  if (name === 'mail_archive') return `**${args.uids?.length || 0}** email(s). They stay in your archive; nothing is deleted.`;
  if (name === 'mail_add_tasks') return args.items?.map((i) => `- ${i.kind}: **${i.title}**${i.when ? ` (${i.when.replace('T', ' ')})` : ''}`).join('\n');
  return `\`\`\`json\n${JSON.stringify(args, null, 2)}\n\`\`\``;
}

/** Cards asking the user to allow risky actions; nothing runs until they click Allow. */
export default function Approvals({ onPending = () => {} }) {
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  useEffect(() => window.ather.onApprovalRequest((r) => setRequests((list) => [...list, r])), []);
  // Answered elsewhere, timed out, or its request ended: the card goes away.
  useEffect(() => window.ather.onApprovalClosed((id) => setRequests((list) => list.filter((r) => r.id !== id))), []);
  // Nod = Allow, shake = Cancel (head mouse users who cannot speak or click): the oldest card here.
  const latest = useRef([]);
  latest.current = requests;
  useEffect(() => window.ather.onApprovalGesture((yes) => {
    const first = latest.current[0];
    if (!first) return;
    window.ather.answerApproval(first.id, yes);
    setRequests((list) => list.filter((r) => r.id !== first.id));
  }), []);
  useEffect(() => onPending(requests.length > 0), [requests.length]);

  const answer = (id, ok) => {
    window.ather.answerApproval(id, ok);
    setRequests((list) => list.filter((r) => r.id !== id));
  };

  return requests.map((r) => (
    <div key={r.id} className="approval" role="alertdialog" aria-label={approvalTitle(r)}>
      <b>{r.name === 'skills_learn' ? '💡' : '⚠'} {approvalTitle(r)}</b>
      <div className="approval-body"><Markdown text={details(r.name, r.args || {})} /></div>
      <div className="row">
        <button className="btn small primary" onClick={() => answer(r.id, true)}>{r.name === 'python_run' ? '▶ Run' : r.name === 'skills_learn' ? 'Keep it' : 'Allow'}</button>
        <button className="btn small" onClick={() => answer(r.id, false)}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  ));
}

/** Live checklist for agent mode, built from agent_plan / agent_step tool events. */
export function AgentChecklist({ tools }) {
  const plan = [...tools].reverse().find((t) => t.name === 'agent_plan');
  if (!plan) return null;
  const status = {};
  for (const t of tools) if (t.name === 'agent_step') status[t.args.index] = t.args;
  return (
    <div className="agent-plan">
      <b>🤖 Plan</b>
      <ol>
        {(plan.args.steps || []).map((s, i) => (
          <li key={i} className={status[i]?.status || 'todo'}>
            {status[i]?.status === 'done' ? '✅' : status[i]?.status === 'failed' ? '❌' : '⬜'} {s}
            {status[i]?.note && <small className="muted"> — {status[i].note}</small>}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useData, tool } from './useData.js';

const CATS = { productive: '🟢 Productive', neutral: '⚪ Neutral', distracting: '🔴 Distracting' };
const fmt = (m) => (m >= 60 ? `${Math.floor(m / 60)} h ${m % 60} min` : `${m} min`);

const Meter = ({ label, percent, detail }) => (
  <div className="meter">
    <div className="row"><b>{label}</b><span className="spacer" /><small className="muted">{detail}</small></div>
    <div className="meter-bar" role="meter" aria-label={label} aria-valuenow={percent ?? 0} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100}>
      <span style={{ width: `${percent ?? 0}%` }} className={percent >= 90 ? 'hot' : percent >= 70 ? 'warm' : ''} />
    </div>
  </div>
);

/** Live CPU, memory, GPU, disk and battery; the busiest apps refresh less often. */
function ThisPc() {
  const [s, setS] = useState(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let n = 0, live = true;
    const load = () => window.ather.systemStatus(n++ % 5 === 0).then((x) => live && setS((old) => ({ ...x, busiest_apps: x.busiest_apps.length ? x.busiest_apps : old?.busiest_apps || [] }))).catch(() => {});
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, 3000);
    return () => { live = false; clearInterval(t); };
  }, []);
  if (!s) return <div className="panel"><h2>This PC</h2><p className="muted">Checking…</p></div>;
  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="row"><h2>This PC</h2><span className="spacer" /><small className="muted">{s.cpu.model} · on for {s.uptime_hours} h</small></div>
      <div className="meters">
        <Meter label="CPU" percent={s.cpu.load_percent} detail={`${s.cpu.load_percent}% · ${s.cpu.cores} threads`} />
        <Meter label="Memory" percent={s.memory.percent} detail={`${s.memory.used_gb} of ${s.memory.total_gb} GB`} />
        {s.gpu && <Meter label="GPU" percent={s.gpu.load_percent} detail={`${s.gpu.load_percent}% · ${s.gpu.memory_used_gb}/${s.gpu.memory_total_gb} GB · ${s.gpu.temperature_c}°C`} />}
        {s.disk && <Meter label="Disk C:" percent={s.disk.percent} detail={`${s.disk.free_gb} GB free of ${s.disk.total_gb} GB`} />}
        {s.battery && <Meter label={`Battery${s.battery.charging ? ' ⚡' : ''}`} percent={s.battery.percent} detail={`${s.battery.percent}%${s.battery.charging ? ' charging' : ''}`} />}
      </div>
      {!!s.busiest_apps?.length && <p className="muted" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>Using the most memory: {s.busiest_apps.map((a) => `${a.app} ${a.memory_mb >= 1024 ? `${(a.memory_mb / 1024).toFixed(1)} GB` : `${a.memory_mb} MB`}`).join(' · ')}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Everything Maya did while controlling the PC (computer control), newest first. */
function ActionLog({ version, tick }) {
  const log = useData(() => window.ather.computerLog(), version, [tick]);
  return (
    <div className="panel">
      <div className="row"><h2>Maya's actions on your PC</h2><span className="spacer" />
        <button className="btn small danger" onClick={() => window.ather.computerStop()}>Stop control now</button></div>
      {!log?.length && <p className="empty">Maya has not controlled your PC yet. It only does after you allow it, once per task.</p>}
      <ul className="list" style={{ maxHeight: 220, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
        {(log || []).slice(0, 60).map((l, i) => <li className="item" key={i}><span className="badge">{l.at.slice(11, 19)}</span><span className="item-title"><b>{l.action}</b> {l.detail}</span></li>)}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Activity({ version }) {
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => { const t = setInterval(() => setTick((n) => n + 1), 30_000); return () => clearInterval(t); }, []);
  const today = useData(() => tool('activity_query', {}), version, [tick]);
  const week = useData(() => tool('activity_query', { week: true }), version, [tick]);
  const [tracking, setTracking] = useState(true);
  const [focusAction, setFocusAction] = useState('minimize');
  const [cats, setCats] = useState({});

  useEffect(() => {
    window.ather.getSetting('activityTracking', true).then(setTracking);
    window.ather.getSetting('focusAction', 'minimize').then(setFocusAction);
    window.ather.getSetting('appCategories', {}).then(setCats);
  }, []);

  const setCategory = (label, c) => { const next = { ...cats, [label]: c }; setCats(next); window.ather.setSetting('appCategories', next).then(() => setTick((n) => n + 1)); };
  const maxWeek = Math.max(1, ...(week || []).map((d) => d.total));
  const share = (m) => (today?.total_minutes ? `${(m / today.total_minutes) * 100}%` : '0%');

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">Activity</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Where your computer time goes. Only app and site names are saved, on this computer. Ask “how long was I on YouTube today?”</p>

      <div className="grid">
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{fmt(today?.total_minutes ?? 0)}</div><div className="stat-label">on the computer today</div></div>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat ok">{fmt(today?.productive_minutes ?? 0)}</div><div className="stat-label">productive</div></div>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat bad">{fmt(today?.distracting_minutes ?? 0)}</div><div className="stat-label">distracting</div></div>
      </div>

      <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <h2>Today</h2>
        <div className="split-bar" aria-label="Productive, neutral and distracting share">
          <div className="seg good" style={{ width: share(today?.productive_minutes ?? 0) }} />
          <div className="seg bad" style={{ width: share(today?.distracting_minutes ?? 0) }} />
        </div>
        {!today?.apps?.length && <p className="empty">Nothing recorded yet today. Keep Maya running and check back soon.</p>}
        <ul className="list">
          {(today?.apps || []).map((a) => (
            <li className="item" key={a.label}>
              <span className="item-title"><b>{a.label}</b>{a.label !== a.app && <small className="muted"> · {a.app}</small>}</span>
              <span className="badge">{fmt(a.minutes)}</span>
              <select className="input" style={{ width: 160 }} value={a.category} onChange={(e) => setCategory(a.label, e.target.value)} aria-label={`Category for ${a.label}`}>
                {Object.entries(CATS).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v}</option>)}
              </select>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Last 7 days</h2>
        <div className="week-chart">
          {(week || []).map((d) => (
            <div key={d.day} className="week-col" title={`${d.day}: ${fmt(d.productive)} productive, ${fmt(d.distracting)} distracting`}>
              <div className="bars" style={{ height: 140 }}>
                <div className="seg bad" style={{ height: `${(d.distracting / maxWeek) * 100}%` }} />
                <div className="seg good" style={{ height: `${(d.productive / maxWeek) * 100}%` }} />
              </div>
              <small className="muted">{new Date(`${d.day}T12:00`).toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short' })}</small>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <ThisPc />
      <ActionLog version={version} tick={tick} />

      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Focus blocking</h2>
        <p className="muted">During a focus session, when you open something marked 🔴 Distracting, Maya nudges you and:</p>
        <select className="input" style={{ maxWidth: 380 }} value={focusAction} onChange={(e) => { setFocusAction(e.target.value); window.ather.setSetting('focusAction', e.target.value); }} aria-label="Focus blocking action">
          <option value="minimize">Minimises it (safe, nothing is lost)</option>
          <option value="close">Closes the app (browsers are only minimised)</option>
          <option value="nudge">Only reminds me</option>
        </select>
        <label className="row" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <input type="checkbox" className="check" checked={tracking} onChange={(e) => { setTracking(e.target.checked); window.ather.setSetting('activityTracking', e.target.checked); }} />
          Track which apps and sites I use
        </label>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### src/renderer/headmouse.jsx

```jsx
// Hands-free mouse: the webcam follows your head to move the cursor; open your mouth to click, smile to right-click,
// or (dwell) simply hold the pointer still to click.
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FaceLandmarker } from '@mediapipe/tasks-vision';
import wasmLoader from '../../node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/wasm/vision_wasm_internal.js?url';
import wasmBinary from '../../node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/wasm/vision_wasm_internal.wasm?url';
import { headDirection, createPointer, createGestures, createDwell, createBlink, createHeadGesture } from './shared/headpose.js';

const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const speed = Number(query.get('speed')) || 1;
const dwellMs = Number(query.get('dwell')) || 0; // 0 = dwell click off
const blinkOn = query.get('blink') === '1';

function HeadMouse() {
  const video = useRef(null);
  const pointer = useRef(createPointer({ speed }));
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('Starting the camera…');
  const [state, setState] = useState(''); // '' | 'on' | 'click'
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const pausedRef = useRef(false);
  pausedRef.current = paused;

  useEffect(() => {
    let stop = false, stream, landmarker;
    const gestures = createGestures();
    const dwell = dwellMs ? createDwell({ ms: dwellMs }) : null;
    const blink = blinkOn ? createBlink() : null;
    const nod = createHeadGesture(); // nod = yes, shake = no on an approval card
    let lastRing = 0;
    (async () => {
      try {
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { width: 640, height: 480, facingMode: 'user' } });
        video.current.srcObject = stream;
        await video.current.play();
        setStatus('Loading the face tracker…');
        const model = await window.ather.headMouseModel();
        landmarker = await FaceLandmarker.createFromOptions({ wasmLoaderPath: new URL(wasmLoader, location.href).href, wasmBinaryPath: new URL(wasmBinary, location.href).href }, {
          baseOptions: { modelAssetBuffer: new Uint8Array(model), delegate: 'GPU' },
          runningMode: 'VIDEO', numFaces: 1, outputFaceBlendshapes: true,
        });
        setStatus('Look at the screen centre…');
        let lastFrame = -1;
        const loop = () => {
          if (stop) return;
          const v = video.current;
          if (v.currentTime !== lastFrame) {
            lastFrame = v.currentTime;
            const now = performance.now();
            const r = landmarker.detectForVideo(v, now);
            const lm = r.faceLandmarks?.[0];
            if (!lm) { setState(''); setStatus('No face found: sit in front of the camera.'); }
            else if (!pausedRef.current) {
              const scores = Object.fromEntries((r.faceBlendshapes?.[0]?.categories || []).map((c) => [c.categoryName, c.score]));
              const g = gestures(scores, now);
              const b = blink?.(scores, now);
              const yesNo = nod(headDirection(lm), now);
              if (yesNo) window.ather.headMouseGesture(yesNo);
              if (b?.click && !g.click) g.click = b.click;
              const p = g.freeze || b?.freeze ? null : pointer.current.update(headDirection(lm));
              if (p && !pointer.current.calibrating) {
                window.ather.headMouseMove(p.x, p.y);
                const d = dwell?.(p, now);
                // The ring at the cursor is redrawn in steps of 5% (enough to look smooth, few messages).
                const ring = d ? Math.round(d.progress * 20) / 20 : 0;
                if (ring !== lastRing) { lastRing = ring; window.ather.headMouseDwell(ring < 1 ? ring : 0); }
                if (d?.click) { window.ather.headMouseClick('left'); setState('click'); setTimeout(() => setState('on'), 300); }
              }
              if (g.click) { window.ather.headMouseClick(g.click); setState('click'); setTimeout(() => setState('on'), 300); }
              else setState((s) => (s === 'click' ? s : 'on'));
              setStatus(pointer.current.calibrating ? 'Look at the screen centre…' : (dwellMs ? 'Turn your head to move · hold still to click · smile = right-click' : 'Turn your head to move · open mouth = click · smile = right-click'));
            }
          }
          requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        };
        loop();
      } catch (e) {
        setStatus(e.name === 'NotAllowedError' || e.name === 'NotFoundError' ? 'No camera available (check Windows camera privacy).' : `Head mouse stopped: ${e.message}`);
      }
    })();
    return () => { stop = true; stream?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop()); landmarker?.close(); };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="hm">
      <video ref={video} muted playsInline />
      <span className={`dot ${paused ? '' : state}`} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="bar">
        <span role="status">{paused ? 'Paused' : status}</span>
        <button onClick={() => pointer.current.recenter()} title="Look at the screen centre, then press">Center</button>
        <button onClick={() => setPaused(!paused)}>{paused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause'}</button>
        <button onClick={() => window.ather.headMouseSet(false)} aria-label="Turn off head mouse">✕</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<HeadMouse />);
```

### src/renderer/shared/headpose.js

```javascript
// Head mouse maths: face landmarks → cursor position, face expressions → clicks. Pure, so it is unit tested.

// MediaPipe face mesh indices.
const NOSE = 1, LEFT_EYE = 33, RIGHT_EYE = 263, FOREHEAD = 10, CHIN = 152;

/** Where the head points: nose offset from between the eyes, scaled by face size (0,0 ≈ looking at the camera). */
export function headDirection(lm) {
  const midX = (lm[LEFT_EYE].x + lm[RIGHT_EYE].x) / 2, midY = (lm[LEFT_EYE].y + lm[RIGHT_EYE].y) / 2;
  const eyes = Math.hypot(lm[RIGHT_EYE].x - lm[LEFT_EYE].x, lm[RIGHT_EYE].y - lm[LEFT_EYE].y) || 1;
  const height = Math.hypot(lm[CHIN].x - lm[FOREHEAD].x, lm[CHIN].y - lm[FOREHEAD].y) || 1;
  return { x: (lm[NOSE].x - midX) / eyes, y: (lm[NOSE].y - midY) / height };
}

/**
 * Turns head directions into a smooth cursor position (0..1 of the screen).
 * The first `calibrate` frames set "straight ahead" = screen centre. speed 1 = normal.
 */
export function createPointer({ speed = 1, smooth = 0.35, calibrate = 15 } = {}) {
  let neutral = null, samples = [], pos = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 };
  return {
    recenter() { neutral = null; samples = []; pos = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }; },
    get calibrating() { return !neutral; },
    update(dir) {
      if (!neutral) {
        samples.push(dir);
        if (samples.length >= calibrate) neutral = { x: samples.reduce((a, s) => a + s.x, 0) / samples.length, y: samples.reduce((a, s) => a + s.y, 0) / samples.length };
        return pos;
      }
      // The camera image is mirrored: turning right moves the nose left in the picture.
      const target = { x: 0.5 - (dir.x - neutral.x) * 3.2 * speed, y: 0.5 + (dir.y - neutral.y) * 5 * speed };
      const clamp = (v) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v));
      pos = { x: clamp(pos.x + (target.x - pos.x) * smooth), y: clamp(pos.y + (target.y - pos.y) * smooth) };
      return pos;
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Dwell click, for people who cannot open their mouth on purpose: hold the pointer still for `ms` and it clicks once.
 * It must move away (more than `radius` of the screen) before it can click again. progress 0..1 draws the ring.
 */
export function createDwell({ ms = 1000, radius = 0.015 } = {}) {
  let anchor = null, since = 0, done = false;
  return (p, t) => {
    if (!anchor || Math.hypot(p.x - anchor.x, p.y - anchor.y) > radius) { anchor = p; since = t; done = false; return { progress: 0, click: false }; }
    if (done) return { progress: 0, click: false };
    const progress = Math.min(1, (t - since) / ms);
    done = progress >= 1;
    return { progress, click: done };
  };
}

/**
 * Nod = yes, shake = no (answering approval cards without speaking or clicking): the head swings past `amp`
 * and back at least 3 times within `ms` (down-up-down, or left-right-left). Returns 'yes', 'no' or null.
 */
export function createHeadGesture({ amp = 0.05, ms = 1600, swings = 3 } = {}) {
  let hist = [], last = -Infinity;
  const count = (k) => {
    let n = 0, dir = 0, ref = hist[0][k];
    for (const h of hist) {
      const d = h[k] - ref;
      if (Math.abs(d) > amp && Math.sign(d) !== dir) { n++; dir = Math.sign(d); ref = h[k]; } else if (Math.sign(d) === dir && Math.abs(d) > 0) ref = dir > 0 ? Math.max(ref, h[k]) : Math.min(ref, h[k]);
    }
    return n;
  };
  return (p, t) => {
    hist.push({ t, x: p.x, y: p.y });
    hist = hist.filter((h) => t - h.t <= ms);
    if (t - last < 1500 || hist.length < 5) return null;
    const y = count('y'), x = count('x');
    const g = y >= swings && y > x ? 'yes' : x >= swings && x > y ? 'no' : null;
    if (g) { last = t; hist = []; }
    return g;
  };
}

/**
 * Blink to click, for people who can barely move their head: eyes closed `hold` ms or longer = left click,
 * `long` ms or longer = right click, decided when the eyes open again. Natural blinks (well under `hold`) do nothing.
 * freeze: the pointer stays put while the eyes are closed, so the click lands where you were looking.
 */
export function createBlink({ hold = 450, long = 1500, closed = 0.5 } = {}) {
  let since = null;
  return (s, t) => {
    const shut = (s.eyeBlinkLeft ?? 0) > closed && (s.eyeBlinkRight ?? 0) > closed;
    if (shut) { since ??= t; return { click: null, freeze: t - since > 150 }; }
    const d = since === null ? 0 : t - since;
    since = null;
    return { click: d >= long ? 'right' : d >= hold ? 'left' : null, freeze: false };
  };
}

/**
 * Expressions → clicks: open mouth = left click, big smile = right click.
 * An expression must be held `hold` ms, fires once, and must be released before it can fire again.
 * While the mouth is opening the cursor should stay still (`freeze`), so the click lands where you aimed.
 */
export function createGestures({ hold = 220, cooldown = 700 } = {}) {
  const since = {}, fired = {};
  let last = -Infinity;
  return (s, t) => {
    const active = {
      left: (s.jawOpen ?? 0) > 0.45,
      right: (((s.mouthSmileLeft ?? 0) + (s.mouthSmileRight ?? 0)) / 2) > 0.65 && (s.jawOpen ?? 0) < 0.3,
    };
    let click = null;
    for (const k of Object.keys(active)) {
      if (!active[k]) { since[k] = null; fired[k] = false; continue; }
      since[k] ??= t;
      if (!fired[k] && t - since[k] >= hold && t - last >= cooldown) { fired[k] = true; last = t; click = k; }
    }
    return { click, freeze: (s.jawOpen ?? 0) > 0.2 || active.right };
  };
}
```

### src/main/services/python.js

```javascript
// Code interpreter: runs AI-written Python (after the user approves) in a per-conversation work folder.
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { promisify } from 'node:util';
import { dataDir } from '../paths.js';

const run = promisify(execFile);
const TIMEOUT = 120_000;

// Charts are saved automatically so the chat can show them, even if the code only calls plt.show().
const PRELUDE = `
import os as _os, atexit as _atexit
try:
    import matplotlib as _mpl
    _mpl.use('Agg')
    import matplotlib.pyplot as _plt
    def _ather_save_charts():
        for _i in _plt.get_fignums():
            _plt.figure(_i).savefig(f'chart_{_os.getpid()}_{_i}.png', dpi=110, bbox_inches='tight')
    _atexit.register(_ather_save_charts)
except Exception:
    pass
`;

export function createPython({ root = join(dataDir, 'python'), workRoot = join(dataDir, 'work'), base = 'python' } = {}) {
  const exe = join(root, 'Scripts', 'python.exe');
  let ready = null;

  /** One-time venv on top of the user's Python (keeps numpy/pandas/matplotlib), plus openpyxl for Excel. */
  function ensure() {
    ready ??= (async () => {
      if (existsSync(exe)) return exe;
      try {
        await run(base, ['-m', 'venv', '--system-site-packages', root], { windowsHide: true, timeout: 120_000 });
      } catch {
        throw new Error('Python is not installed. Install Python 3 from python.org (tick "Add to PATH"), then try again.');
      }
      await run(exe, ['-m', 'pip', 'install', '--quiet', 'openpyxl'], { windowsHide: true, timeout: 300_000 }).catch(() => {});
      return exe;
    })().catch((e) => { ready = null; throw e; });
    return ready;
  }

  const workDir = (cid) => { const d = join(workRoot, String(cid ?? 'scratch')); mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true }); return d; };
  const listing = (dir) => Object.fromEntries(readdirSync(dir).map((f) => [f, statSync(join(dir, f)).mtimeMs]));

  async function execute(code, cid) {
    const python = await ensure();
    const dir = workDir(cid);
    const before = listing(dir);
    const script = join(dir, '_ather_run.py');
    writeFileSync(script, `${PRELUDE}\n${code}\n`);
    let stdout = '', stderr = '', exitCode = 0;
    try {
      ({ stdout, stderr } = await run(python, ['-I', script], { cwd: dir, timeout: TIMEOUT, windowsHide: true, maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024, env: { ...process.env, PYTHONIOENCODING: 'utf-8', MPLBACKEND: 'Agg' } }));
    } catch (err) {
      stdout = err.stdout || ''; stderr = err.killed ? `Stopped after ${TIMEOUT / 1000} seconds.` : (err.stderr || err.message);
      exitCode = err.code ?? 1;
    }
    const after = listing(dir);
    const changed = Object.keys(after).filter((f) => f !== '_ather_run.py' && after[f] !== before[f]).map((f) => join(dir, f));
    return {
      exit_code: exitCode,
      stdout: stdout.slice(0, 8000),
      stderr: stderr.slice(-4000),
      files: changed.filter((f) => !/\.png$/i.test(f)),
      images: changed.filter((f) => /\.png$/i.test(f)),
      folder: dir,
    };
  }

  /** Put a user's file (CSV, Excel…) in the conversation's work folder so code can open it by name. */
  function addFile(cid, path) {
    const target = join(workDir(cid), basename(path));
    copyFileSync(path, target);
    return target;
  }

  const files = (cid) => readdirSync(workDir(cid)).filter((f) => f !== '_ather_run.py');
  return { ensure, execute, addFile, files, workDir };
}
```

### src/main/services/files.js

```javascript
// Makes real Office/PDF files from AI output: PowerPoint (.pptx), Word (.docx) and PDF.
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import PptxGenJS from 'pptxgenjs';
import { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, HeadingLevel, Table, TableRow, TableCell, WidthType } from 'docx';
import { marked } from 'marked';

const safeName = (s) => (s || 'Maya').replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\n]+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 60) || 'Maya';

/** "**bold** text" → docx runs. */
const runs = (text) => text.split(/(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)/).filter(Boolean)
  .map((part) => (part.startsWith('**') ? new TextRun({ text: part.slice(2, -2), bold: true }) : new TextRun(part.replace(/[*_`]/g, ''))));

/** Simple Markdown (headings, bullets, numbers, tables, paragraphs) → docx blocks. Exported for tests. */
export function markdownToDocx(markdown) {
  const blocks = [];
  let table = [];
  const flushTable = () => {
    if (!table.length) return;
    const rows = table.filter((r) => !/^\|?\s*:?-{2,}/.test(r)).map((r) => r.replace(/^\||\|$/g, '').split('|').map((c) => c.trim()));
    blocks.push(new Table({
      width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
      rows: rows.map((cells, i) => new TableRow({ children: cells.map((c) => new TableCell({ children: [new Paragraph({ children: i === 0 ? [new TextRun({ text: c, bold: true })] : runs(c) })] })) })),
    }));
    table = [];
  };
  for (const raw of markdown.split('\n')) {
    const line = raw.trimEnd();
    if (line.trim().startsWith('|')) { table.push(line.trim()); continue; }
    flushTable();
    if (!line.trim()) continue;
    const h = line.match(/^(#{1,3})\s+(.*)/);
    if (h) blocks.push(new Paragraph({ text: h[2], heading: [HeadingLevel.HEADING_1, HeadingLevel.HEADING_2, HeadingLevel.HEADING_3][h[1].length - 1] }));
    else if (/^\s*[-*•]\s+/.test(line)) blocks.push(new Paragraph({ children: runs(line.replace(/^\s*[-*•]\s+/, '')), bullet: { level: 0 } }));
    else if (/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/.test(line)) blocks.push(new Paragraph({ children: runs(line.replace(/^\s*\d+[.)]\s+/, '')), bullet: { level: 0 } }));
    else blocks.push(new Paragraph({ children: runs(line), spacing: { after: 120 } }));
  }
  flushTable();
  return blocks;
}

export function createFiles({ outDir, imaging, printPdf }) {
  const out = (name, ext) => { mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true }); return join(outDir, `${safeName(name)}-${Date.now().toString(36)}.${ext}`); };

  /** slides: [{ title, bullets: [], notes }]. images: draw a picture for up to 5 slides with SD-Turbo. */
  async function presentation({ title, subtitle = '', slides = [], images = false, theme = 'purple' }) {
    if (!slides.length) throw new Error('A presentation needs at least one slide.');
    const colors = theme === 'dark' ? { bg: '111114', title: 'FFFFFF', text: 'D8D8E0', accent: '8B7DFF' } : { bg: 'FFFFFF', title: '1D1638', text: '3D3858', accent: '6C5CFF' };
    const pptx = new PptxGenJS();
    pptx.layout = 'LAYOUT_WIDE';
    pptx.title = title;

    const cover = pptx.addSlide();
    cover.background = { color: colors.accent };
    cover.addText(title, { x: 0.6, y: 2.3, w: 12, h: 1.4, fontSize: 40, bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF', fontFace: 'Segoe UI' });
    if (subtitle) cover.addText(subtitle, { x: 0.6, y: 3.7, w: 12, h: 0.8, fontSize: 20, color: 'EDEBFF', fontFace: 'Segoe UI' });

    for (const [i, s] of slides.entries()) {
      const slide = pptx.addSlide();
      slide.background = { color: colors.bg };
      slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, { x: 0, y: 0, w: 0.18, h: 7.5, fill: { color: colors.accent } });
      slide.addText(s.title || `Slide ${i + 1}`, { x: 0.6, y: 0.35, w: 12, h: 0.9, fontSize: 30, bold: true, color: colors.title, fontFace: 'Segoe UI' });
      let picture = null;
      if (images && i < 5 && imaging) picture = await imaging.generate(`${s.title}, ${title}, clean illustration`).catch(() => null);
      const textWidth = picture ? 7.2 : 12;
      slide.addText((s.bullets || []).map((b) => ({ text: b, options: { bullet: true, breakLine: true } })),
        { x: 0.7, y: 1.4, w: textWidth, h: 5.4, fontSize: 20, color: colors.text, fontFace: 'Segoe UI', valign: 'top', paraSpaceAfter: 10 });
      if (picture) slide.addImage({ path: picture.path, x: 8.2, y: 1.5, w: 4.6, h: 4.6 });
      if (s.notes) slide.addNotes(s.notes);
    }
    const path = out(title, 'pptx');
    await pptx.writeFile({ fileName: path });
    return { path, slides: slides.length + 1 };
  }

  async function document({ title, markdown }) {
    const doc = new Document({
      creator: 'Maya', title,
      sections: [{ children: [new Paragraph({ text: title, heading: HeadingLevel.TITLE }), ...markdownToDocx(markdown)] }],
    });
    const path = out(title, 'docx');
    writeFileSync(path, await Packer.toBuffer(doc));
    return { path };
  }

  async function pdf({ title: rawTitle, markdown }) {
    const title = String(rawTitle).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' })[c]);
    const html = `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${title}</title><style>
      body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #1d1638; margin: 40px 48px; line-height: 1.5; font-size: 12pt; }
      h1 { color: #4a3ad6; border-bottom: 3px solid #6c5cff; padding-bottom: 6px; }
      h2 { color: #4a3ad6; margin-top: 1.4em; } table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; }
      th, td { border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left; } th { background: #efecff; }
      code { background: #f2f0fb; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; } pre { background: #1d1638; color: #fff; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; white-space: pre-wrap; }
    </style></head><body><h1>${title}</h1>${marked.parse(markdown)}</body></html>`;
    const path = out(rawTitle, 'pdf');
    writeFileSync(path, await printPdf(html));
    return { path };
  }

  return { presentation, document, pdf };
}
```

```javascript
// Agent mode, code interpreter and file maker tools. ctx.services supplies python and files.
const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });
const strings = (description) => ({ type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description });

export const powerTools = [
  {
    name: 'agent_plan',
    description: 'AGENT MODE ONLY: write the plan before starting, as 2 to 8 short concrete steps.',
    parameters: obj({ steps: strings('The steps, in order') }, ['steps']),
    run: ({ steps }) => ({ planned: steps.length }),
  },
  {
    name: 'agent_step',
    description: 'AGENT MODE ONLY: report a plan step finished (status done or failed) with a short note.',
    parameters: obj({ index: { type: 'integer', description: '0-based step number' }, status: { type: 'string', enum: ['done', 'failed'] }, note: str('What happened') }, ['index', 'status']),
    run: ({ index, status }) => ({ index, status }),
  },
  {
    name: 'python_run',
    description: 'Run Python 3 code to calculate exactly, analyse data files (CSV/Excel in the working folder, open them by file name with pandas) or draw charts with matplotlib. print() the results. The user approves before it runs. Only for real computation, data or charts: never just to print, list or format text you could write yourself.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ code: str('Complete Python code') }, ['code']),
    run: async ({ code }, { services, conversationId }) => {
      const r = await services.python.execute(code, conversationId);
      return { ...r, images: r.images, note: r.images.length ? 'Charts were saved and are shown to the user.' : undefined };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'python_files',
    description: 'List the files in this conversation\'s Python working folder (attached CSV/Excel files and files your code made).',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { services, conversationId }) => ({ files: services.python.files(conversationId) }),
  },
  {
    name: 'files_make_presentation',
    description: 'Create a real PowerPoint (.pptx) file. Write good slide content: 5 to 12 slides, 3 to 6 short bullets each, optional speaker notes.',
    parameters: obj({
      title: str('Presentation title'), subtitle: str('Subtitle, e.g. name and college'),
      slides: { type: 'array', items: obj({ title: str('Slide title'), bullets: strings('Bullet points'), notes: str('Speaker notes') }, ['title', 'bullets']) },
      images: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Draw a picture on the first 5 slides (slower)' },
    }, ['title', 'slides']),
    run: (args, { services }) => services.files.presentation(args),
  },
  {
    name: 'files_make_document',
    description: 'Create a Word (.docx) document, e.g. a report, assignment or letter. Content in Markdown (headings #, bullets -, tables |, **bold**).',
    parameters: obj({ title: str('Document title'), markdown: str('Full document content in Markdown') }, ['title', 'markdown']),
    run: (args, { services }) => services.files.document(args),
  },
  {
    name: 'files_make_pdf',
    description: 'Create a PDF file from Markdown content, e.g. notes, a cheat sheet or a report.',
    parameters: obj({ title: str('Title'), markdown: str('Full content in Markdown') }, ['title', 'markdown']),
    run: (args, { services }) => services.files.pdf(args),
  },
];
```

## 5. Quality Assurance (QA) Sub-Agent

### src/main/services/qa.js

```javascript
// QA for websites the Builder makes: loads the page in a hidden window and reports what a tester would see.
import { existsSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, basename } from 'node:path';
import { imagesDir } from '../paths.js';

/** BrowserWindow is passed in so tests can run this inside Electron only. */
export function createQa({ BrowserWindow }) {
  return {
    async checkSite(dir, page = 'index.html') {
      const file = join(dir, page);
      if (!existsSync(file)) return { ok: false, errors: [`${page} does not exist in ${dir}`] };
      const win = new BrowserWindow({ show: false, width: 1280, height: 800, webPreferences: { sandbox: true, javascript: true } });
      const errors = [], warnings = [];
      win.webContents.on('console-message', ({ level, message, lineNumber, sourceId }) => {
        const where = sourceId ? ` (${sourceId.split('/').pop()}:${lineNumber})` : '';
        if (level === 'error') errors.push(`${message}${where}`);
        else if (level === 'warning') warnings.push(`${message}${where}`);
      });
      win.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (_, code, desc, url) => errors.push(`Could not load ${url}: ${desc}`));
      try {
        await win.loadFile(file);
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200)); // let scripts run
        const facts = await win.webContents.executeJavaScript(`({
          title: document.title,
          text_chars: document.body ? document.body.innerText.trim().length : 0,
          headings: [...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2')].slice(0, 8).map((h) => h.innerText.trim()),
          images_missing: [...document.images].filter((i) => !i.complete || i.naturalWidth === 0).map((i) => i.getAttribute('src')),
          links: document.links.length,
          has_viewport: !!document.querySelector('meta[name=viewport]'),
        })`);
        // Outside the project, so the screenshot never ends up in the user's Git commit.
        const shot = join(imagesDir, `qa-${basename(dir)}-${Date.now()}.png`);
        writeFileSync(shot, (await win.webContents.capturePage()).toPNG());
        if (!facts.title) warnings.push('The page has no <title>.');
        if (!facts.has_viewport) warnings.push('No <meta name="viewport">: it will look tiny on phones.');
        if (facts.text_chars < 40) errors.push('The page is (almost) empty.');
        for (const src of facts.images_missing) errors.push(`Image not found: ${src}`);
        return { ok: errors.length === 0, errors: errors.slice(0, 20), warnings: warnings.slice(0, 10), ...facts, screenshot: shot };
      } finally {
        win.destroy();
      }
    },
  };
}
```

```javascript
// End-to-end check of the real app with Playwright: launches Electron, talks to Maya, saves screenshots.
// Usage: npm run build:ui && node scripts/e2e.mjs [path-to-Maya.exe]
import { _electron as electron } from 'playwright';
import { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const shots = join(process.cwd(), 'docs', 'screenshots');
mkdirSync(shots, { recursive: true });
const exe = process.argv[2];
const env = {
  ...process.env,
  ATHER_DATA: mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-e2e-')),
  ATHER_MODELS: join(process.env.APPDATA, 'Ather', 'models'),
};

/** A minimal one-page PDF containing `text`. */
function makePdf(text) {
  const content = `BT /F1 14 Tf 40 700 Td (${text}) Tj ET`;
  const objs = ['<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>', '<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>',
    '<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>',
    `<< /Length ${content.length} >>\nstream\n${content}\nendstream`, '<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>'];
  let pdf = '%PDF-1.4\n';
  const offsets = objs.map((o, i) => { const at = pdf.length; pdf += `${i + 1} 0 obj\n${o}\nendobj\n`; return at; });
  const xref = pdf.length;
  pdf += `xref\n0 ${objs.length + 1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n${offsets.map((o) => `${String(o).padStart(10, '0')} 00000 n \n`).join('')}`;
  return `${pdf}trailer\n<< /Size ${objs.length + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n${xref}\n%%EOF`;
}

const app = await electron.launch(exe ? { executablePath: exe, env } : { args: ['.'], env });
app.process().stdout.on('data', (d) => process.stdout.write(`[app] ${d}`));
app.process().stderr.on('data', (d) => process.stdout.write(`[app:err] ${d}`));
app.on('window', (w) => {
  w.on('console', (m) => m.type() === 'error' && console.log(`[${w.url().split('/').pop()}] ${m.text()}`));
  w.on('crash', () => console.log(`[crash] ${w.url()}`));
  w.on('pageerror', (e) => console.log(`[pageerror ${w.url().split('/').pop()}] ${e.message}`));
  w.on('close', () => console.log(`[closed] ${w.url()}`));
});
const results = [];
const check = (name, ok, detail = '') => { results.push({ name, ok }); console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${name} ${detail}`); };
const page = async (name) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    const found = app.windows().find((w) => w.url().includes(`${name}.html`));
    if (found) return found;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
  }
  throw new Error(`${name} window did not open`);
};

  for (const [section, file] of [['Home', '05-home'], ['Tasks', '06-tasks'], ['Notes', '07-notes'], ['Habits', '08-habits'], ['Focus', '09-focus'],

  }
  check('all sections render', true);
} catch (err) {
  check('run', false, err.stack);
} finally {
  await app.close();
}

const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.ok).length;
console.log(`\n${results.length - failed}/${results.length} checks passed. Screenshots in ${shots}`);
process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
```

### scripts/voice-e2e.mjs

```javascript
// Voice-only control, end to end, with no keyboard or mouse: spoken commands (Kokoro's voice → Whisper → command parser)
// drive a test page in Chrome. Safety: it acts only while its own test window is in front, never in the user's windows.
// Usage: npm run build:ui && node scripts/voice-e2e.mjs   (needs Chrome; close the installed Maya first)
import { _electron as electron } from 'playwright';
import { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { spawn, execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { parseCommand } from '../src/renderer/shared/voicecommands.js';
import { createPc } from '../src/main/services/pc.js';

const shots = join('docs', 'screenshots');
const dir = join(tmpdir(), 'ather-voice-test');
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
writeFileSync(join(dir, 'page.html'), `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Maya voice test</title>
<style>body{font:20px Segoe UI;margin:0;display:grid;place-items:center;height:100vh}input{font:inherit;width:520px;padding:12px}button{font:inherit;padding:10px 20px;margin:10px}</style></head>
<body><form onsubmit="document.title='Searched: '+q.value;return false"><div><input id="q" aria-label="Search box" placeholder="Search"></div>
<div style="text-align:center"><button>Search</button><button type="button" onclick="document.title='Clicked: Lucky'">Lucky</button></div></form></body></html>`);

const app = await electron.launch({ args: ['.'], env: { ...process.env, ATHER_DATA: mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-vc-')), ATHER_MODELS: join(process.env.APPDATA, 'Ather', 'models') } });
const page = async (name) => { for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const w = app.windows().find((x) => !x.isClosed() && x.url().includes(`${name}.html`)); if (w) return w; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); } throw new Error(name); };
const screenshot = async (file) => {
  const png = await app.evaluate(async ({ desktopCapturer, screen }) => {
    const [s] = await desktopCapturer.getSources({ types: ['screen'], thumbnailSize: screen.getPrimaryDisplay().size });
    return s.thumbnail.toPNG().toString('base64');
  });
  writeFileSync(join(shots, file), Buffer.from(png, 'base64'));
};
const pc = createPc({ shell: {} });
let ok = false;
try {
  const notch = await page('notch');
  spawn('C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe', [`--user-data-dir=${join(dir, 'profile')}`, '--no-first-run', '--start-maximized',
    `file:///${join(dir, 'page.html').replace(/\\/g, '/')}`], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref();
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 14000)); // Chrome and the PC helper start; the activity sampler notes Chrome
  const hwnd = Number(execFileSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command',
    "(Get-Process chrome | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -like 'Maya voice test*' } | Select-Object -First 1).MainWindowHandle"]).toString().trim());
  if (!hwnd) throw new Error('Test page window not found; stopping before acting.');
  const front = async () => {
    await pc.activate(hwnd);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
    const fg = await pc.foreground();
    if (fg.hwnd !== hwnd || !/Maya voice test|Searched/.test(fg.title)) throw new Error(`Another window took the front (${fg.process}: ${fg.title}); stopping.`);
  };
  const hear = (sentence) => notch.evaluate(async (s) => {
    const a = await window.ather.speak(s);
    const out = new Float32Array(Math.floor((a.samples.length * 16000) / a.sampleRate));
    for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = a.samples[Math.floor((i * a.sampleRate) / 16000)];
    return window.ather.transcribe(out);
  }, sentence);
  const say = async (spoken) => {
    await front();
    const heard = await hear(spoken);
    await front();
    const c = parseCommand(heard);
    const r = c ? await notch.evaluate((cmd) => window.ather.voiceCommand(cmd), c) : { error: 'not a command' };
    console.log(`said "${spoken}" → heard "${heard}" → ${JSON.stringify(r)}`);
    if (r.error) throw new Error(r.error);
  };
  await say('Show grid.');
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
  await screenshot('48-voice-grid.png');
  await say('Show numbers.');
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
  await screenshot('47-voice-numbers.png');
  // Read the search box's number off the overlay, as a person reads it off the screen.
  const n = await (await page('overlay')).evaluate(() => document.querySelector('.box[data-name="Search box"]')?.nextElementSibling?.textContent);
  await say(`Click ${n}.`);
  await say('Type weather in Chennai.');
  await say('Press enter.');
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000));
  const title = (await pc.foreground()).title;
  ok = title.startsWith('Searched: weather in Chennai');
  console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} voice-only search: the page shows "${title}"`);
  await say('Hide numbers.');
} catch (e) {
  console.log('FAIL', e.message);
} finally {
  pc.stop();
  await app.close();
  // Close the test page's Chrome (its own profile only), so it never sits in front of the next test or the user.
  try { execFileSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='chrome.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*${join(dir, 'profile')}*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }`]); } catch { /* already closed */ }
}
process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);
```

### scripts/a11y-e2e.mjs

```javascript
// Accessibility features end to end, acting only in its own test window: the Accessibility page and large mode,
// the on-screen keyboard, switch scanning, read-aloud, and the SOS countdown / cancel / alarm.
// Usage: npm run build:ui && node scripts/a11y-e2e.mjs   (needs Chrome; close the installed Maya first)
import { _electron as electron } from 'playwright';
import { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { spawn, execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createPc } from '../src/main/services/pc.js';

const shots = join('docs', 'screenshots');
const dir = join(tmpdir(), 'ather-a11y-test');
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
writeFileSync(join(dir, 'page.html'), `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Maya a11y test</title>
<style>body{font:20px Segoe UI;margin:0;display:grid;place-items:center;height:100vh}input{font:inherit;width:520px;padding:12px}button{font:inherit;padding:10px 20px;margin:10px}</style></head>
<body><main><p>Welcome to the Maya accessibility test page. This sentence should be read aloud.</p>
<form onsubmit="document.title='Searched: '+q.value;return false"><div><input id="q" aria-label="Search box" placeholder="Search"></div>
<div style="text-align:center"><button>Search</button></div></form></main></body></html>`);

const app = await electron.launch({ args: ['.'], env: { ...process.env, ATHER_DATA: mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-a11y-')), ATHER_MODELS: join(process.env.APPDATA, 'Ather', 'models') } });
const page = async (name, tries = 60) => { for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) { const w = app.windows().find((x) => !x.isClosed() && x.url().includes(`${name}.html`)); if (w) return w; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); } throw new Error(`${name} window did not open`); };
const results = [];
const check = (name, ok, detail = '') => { results.push(ok); console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${name} ${detail}`); };
const shot = async (file) => {
  const png = await app.evaluate(async ({ desktopCapturer, screen }) => (await desktopCapturer.getSources({ types: ['screen'], thumbnailSize: screen.getPrimaryDisplay().size }))[0].thumbnail.toPNG().toString('base64'));
  writeFileSync(join(shots, file), Buffer.from(png, 'base64'));
};
let scale = 1; // the screen's scale factor (e.g. 1.25 at 125%), read from Electron once the app is up
const pc = createPc({ shell: {}, scale: () => scale });
try {
  const main = await page('app');
  scale = await app.evaluate(({ screen }) => screen.getPrimaryDisplay().scaleFactor);
  await main.waitForSelector("text=Hi, I'm Maya!");
  if (await main.$('text=Start using Maya')) await main.click('text=Start using Maya');

  // Accessibility page + large mode.
  await main.click('nav >> text=Accessibility');
  await main.waitForSelector('h1:has-text("Accessibility")');
  await main.check('text=Large and high contrast');
  await main.waitForTimeout(400);
  check('large mode switches on', (await main.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.dataset.a11y)) === 'large');
  await main.screenshot({ path: join(shots, '51-accessibility-large.png') });
  await main.uncheck('text=Large and high contrast');

  // The test page, in its own Chrome profile; everything below acts only while it is in front.
  spawn('C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe', [`--user-data-dir=${join(dir, 'profile')}`, '--no-first-run', '--start-maximized',
    `file:///${join(dir, 'page.html').replace(/\\/g, '/')}`], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref();
  let hwnd = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < 30 && !hwnd; i++) {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000));
    hwnd = Number(execFileSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command',
      "(Get-Process chrome | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -like 'Maya a11y test*' } | Select-Object -First 1).MainWindowHandle"]).toString().trim());
  }
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); // the PC helper's first look
  if (!hwnd) throw new Error('Test page window not found; stopping before acting.');
  const front = async () => {
    await pc.activate(hwnd);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
    const fg = await pc.foreground();
    if (fg.hwnd !== hwnd) throw new Error(`Another window took the front (${fg.process}: ${fg.title}); stopping.`);
  };
  const title = async () => (await pc.foreground()).title;
  const cmd = (c) => main.evaluate((x) => window.ather.voiceCommand(x), c);

  // Read aloud: the page's text comes back to be spoken.
  await front();
  const read = await cmd({ cmd: 'read' });
  check('read the screen', /read aloud/.test(read.read || ''), JSON.stringify(read).slice(0, 120));

  // Switch scanning: wait for the search box's group to light up, press; wait for the box itself, press.
  await front();
  await cmd({ cmd: 'scan', on: true });
  const overlay = await page('overlay');
  const litBox = () => overlay.evaluate(() => !!document.querySelector('.box.lit[data-name="Search box"]'));
  const waitLit = async (single) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
      const n = await overlay.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('.box.lit').length);
      if (await litBox() && (!single || n === 1)) return true;
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150));
    }
    return false;
  };
  await shot('52-scanning.png');
  const group = await waitLit(false);
  await front(); await cmd({ cmd: 'switch' });
  const single = group && await waitLit(true);
  await front(); await cmd({ cmd: 'switch' });
  await cmd({ cmd: 'scan', on: false });
  await front();
  await cmd({ cmd: 'type', text: 'scan works' });
  await cmd({ cmd: 'keys', keys: 'enter' });
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
  check('switch scanning picks the search box', group && single && (await title()).startsWith('Searched: scan works'), await title());

  // On-screen keyboard: click its keys; they reach the focused page.
  await cmd({ cmd: 'keyboard', on: true });
  const kb = await page('keyboard');
  await front();
  await pc.keys('^a');
  // Real mouse clicks on the keys, like a head-mouse or dwell click: the keyboard window must not steal the focus.
  const kbBounds = await app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().find((w) => w.webContents.getURL().includes('keyboard.html')).getBounds());
  const press = async (label) => {
    const box = await kb.locator(`button[aria-label="${label}"]`).boundingBox();
    await pc.click(kbBounds.x + box.x + box.width / 2, kbBounds.y + box.y + box.height / 2);
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250));
  };
  await front();
  for (const k of ['h', 'e', 'l', 'l', 'o']) await press(k);
  await shot('53-keyboard.png');
  await press('⏎');
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
  check('on-screen keyboard types into the app', (await title()).startsWith('Searched: hello'), await title());
  await cmd({ cmd: 'keyboard', on: false });

  // SOS: countdown, cancelled by voice; then a real alarm, stopped by the "help is here" button.
  await cmd({ cmd: 'sos' });
  const sos = await page('sos');
  await sos.waitForSelector('[role=timer]');
  await shot('54-sos-countdown.png');
  await cmd({ cmd: 'cancel' });
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
  check('SOS countdown cancels by voice', !app.windows().some((w) => w.url().includes('sos.html') && !w.isClosed()));
  await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.sosTrigger('test of the alarm'));
  const sos2 = await page('sos');
  await sos2.waitForSelector('text=I NEED HELP', { timeout: 20000 });
  await sos2.waitForSelector('text=/No caregiver|emailed|not connected/', { timeout: 15000 });
  await shot('55-sos-alarm.png');
  const info = await sos2.textContent('.info:last-of-type');
  await sos2.click('text=Help is here');
  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800));
  check('SOS alarm shows the sign, says why no email went out, and stops', !app.windows().some((w) => w.url().includes('sos.html') && !w.isClosed()), info);
} catch (e) {
  check('run', false, e.message);
} finally {
  pc.stop();
  await app.close();
  // Close the test page's Chrome (its own profile only), so it never sits in front of the next test or the user.
  try { execFileSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='chrome.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*${join(dir, 'profile')}*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }`]); } catch { /* already closed */ }
}
const failed = results.filter((ok) => !ok).length;
console.log(`\n${results.length - failed}/${results.length} accessibility checks passed.`);
process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
```

### scripts/work-e2e.mjs

```javascript
// 1.6 features end to end, with the real app but a throwaway data folder. The PC is never shut down
// (ATHER_NO_SHUTDOWN), and ChatGPT is asked in a separate test Chrome profile, never in the user's browser.
// Usage: npm run build:ui && node scripts/work-e2e.mjs   (close the installed Maya first)
import { _electron as electron } from 'playwright';
import { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { spawn, execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createPc } from '../src/main/services/pc.js';
import { askChatbot } from '../src/main/services/chatbots.js';

const shots = join('docs', 'screenshots');
const results = [];
const check = (name, ok, detail = '') => { results.push(ok); console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${name} ${detail}`); };
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const logs = [];
const app = await electron.launch({ args: ['.'], env: { ...process.env, ATHER_NO_SHUTDOWN: '1', ATHER_DATA: mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-work-')), ATHER_MODELS: join(process.env.APPDATA, 'Ather', 'models') } });
app.process().stdout.on('data', (d) => logs.push(String(d)));
const page = async (name) => { for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) { const w = app.windows().find((x) => !x.isClosed() && x.url().includes(`${name}.html`)); if (w) return w; await sleep(250); } throw new Error(`${name} window did not open`); };
const scale = () => 1;
const pc = createPc({ shell: {}, scale });
try {
  const main = await page('app');
  await main.waitForSelector("text=Hi, I'm Maya!");
  if (await main.$('text=Start using Maya')) await main.click('text=Start using Maya');
  const notch = await page('notch');

  // Work timer over → goodbye card; "I'm still working" gives 15 minutes.
  const soon = () => main.evaluate(() => window.ather.setSetting('workSession', { ends: Date.now() + 3000, task: 'project', shutdown: true }));
  await soon();
  await notch.waitForSelector('text=Shutting down in a minute', { timeout: 20_000 });
  await notch.screenshot({ path: join(shots, '57-goodbye.png'), omitBackground: true });
  await notch.click("text=I'm still working");
  await sleep(500);
  const status = await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.tool('work_timer_status', {}));
  check('goodbye card, then 15 more minutes', status.running && status.minutes_left >= 14 && !status.saying_goodbye, JSON.stringify(status));

  // The whole countdown: "shutdown" happens (as a log line only).
  await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.setSetting('workSession', { ends: Date.now() + 2000, task: 'project', shutdown: true }));
  for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !logs.join('').includes('would shutdown'); i++) await sleep(1000);
  check('after the minute it shuts down (test: not really)', logs.join('').includes('would shutdown now'));

  // Magnifier by voice command: Magnify.exe starts, then stops.
  await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.voiceCommand({ cmd: 'magnify', action: 'in' }));
  await sleep(2500);
  const running = () => { try { return execFileSync('tasklist', ['/FI', 'IMAGENAME eq Magnify.exe']).toString().includes('Magnify.exe'); } catch { return false; } };
  const on = running();
  await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.voiceCommand({ cmd: 'magnify', action: 'off' }));
  await sleep(2000);
  const fg = await pc.foreground();
  check('magnifier on and off by voice; the taskbar does not keep the focus', on && !running() && fg.process !== 'explorer', `front: ${fg.process}`);

  // Accessibility page shows the new sections.
  await main.click('nav >> text=Accessibility');
  await main.waitForSelector('text=Work timer');
  await main.waitForSelector('text=Medicine and care');
  await main.screenshot({ path: join(shots, '58-accessibility-1.6.png'), fullPage: true });
  check('Accessibility page: work timer, medicine, phone, blink', !!(await main.$('#sos-p')) && !!(await main.$('text=Blink to click')));
} catch (e) {
  check('run', false, e.message);
} finally {
  await app.close();
}

// Ask ChatGPT in its own test profile (logged out), then read the answer.
const dir = join(tmpdir(), 'ather-chatgpt-test');
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
const open = async (url) => spawn('C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe', [`--user-data-dir=${join(dir, 'profile')}`, '--no-first-run', '--start-maximized', '--new-window', url], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref();
const r = await askChatbot({ pc, open, site: 'chatgpt', prompt: 'What is the capital of Tamil Nadu? Answer in one word.', timeoutMs: 90_000 });
check('ask ChatGPT and read the answer', /chennai/i.test(r.answer || ''), JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 200));
writeFileSync(join(dir, 'last.json'), JSON.stringify(r, null, 2));
pc.stop();
try { execFileSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='chrome.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*${join(dir, 'profile')}*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }`]); } catch { /* already closed */ }
const failed = results.filter((ok) => !ok).length;
console.log(`\n${results.length - failed}/${results.length} checks passed.`);
process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
```

### scripts/maya-e2e.mjs

```javascript
// Maya 1.7 by voice, end to end: every request is spoken with Maya's own voice, heard by Whisper, then answered
// by the real app in a throwaway data folder. Nothing is shut down, sent or published; the Builder writes into a temp folder.
// Usage: npm run build:ui && node scripts/maya-e2e.mjs   (close the installed Maya first)
import { _electron as electron } from 'playwright';
import { mkdtempSync, existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { parseCommand } from '../src/renderer/shared/voicecommands.js';

const shots = join('docs', 'screenshots');
const results = [];
const check = (name, ok, detail = '') => { results.push(ok); console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${name} ${String(detail).slice(0, 220)}`); };
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const work = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'maya-17-work-'));
const app = await electron.launch({ args: ['.'], env: { ...process.env, ATHER_NO_SHUTDOWN: '1', ATHER_DATA: mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'maya-17-')), ATHER_MODELS: join(process.env.APPDATA, 'Ather', 'models') } });
const page = async (name) => { for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) { const w = app.windows().find((x) => !x.isClosed() && x.url().includes(`${name}.html`)); if (w) return w; await sleep(250); } throw new Error(`${name} window did not open`); };
try {
  const main = await page('app');
  await main.waitForSelector("text=Hi, I'm Ather!, text=Hi, I'm Maya!", { timeout: 60_000 }).catch(() => {});
  if (await main.$('text=Start using Maya')) await main.click('text=Start using Maya');
  if (await main.$('text=Start using Ather')) await main.click('text=Start using Ather');
  await main.evaluate((dir) => window.ather.setSetting('approvedFolders', [dir]), work);
  const notch = await page('notch');
  await app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => {
    const w = BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().find((x) => x.webContents.getURL().includes('notch.html'));
    w.setIgnoreMouseEvents(false);
    w.webContents.send('notch:expand', { focus: true });
  });
  await notch.waitForSelector('textarea');

  // Maya says it, Whisper hears it: the words go through the same ears a user's voice does.
  const hear = (sentence) => notch.evaluate(async (s) => {
    const a = await window.ather.speak(s);
    const out = new Float32Array(Math.floor((a.samples.length * 16000) / a.sampleRate));
    for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = a.samples[Math.floor((i * a.sampleRate) / 16000)];
    return window.ather.transcribe(out);
  }, sentence);
  const ask = async (spoken, timeout = 240_000) => {
    const heard = await hear(spoken);
    // The face folds away when idle; open it again, as moving to the top of the screen does.
    await app.evaluate(({ BrowserWindow }) => BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().find((x) => x.webContents.getURL().includes('notch.html')).webContents.send('notch:expand', { focus: true }));
    await notch.waitForSelector('textarea', { timeout: 10_000 });
    await notch.fill('textarea', heard);
    await notch.press('textarea', 'Enter');
    await notch.waitForSelector('.icon-btn.stop', { timeout: 10_000 }).catch(() => {});
    // Only the Builder's own file writes and commands inside the test folder are allowed; every other card
    // (closing an app, shutting down, sending) is refused, so a test can never act on the user's PC.
    const end = Date.now() + timeout;
    while (await notch.$('.icon-btn.stop') && Date.now() < end) {
      const card = await notch.$('.approval');
      if (card) {
        const text = (await card.textContent()) || '';
        const ours = /fs write|Run this command/i.test(text) && text.includes(work.split(/[\\/]/).pop());
        await card.$(`button:has-text("${ours ? 'Allow' : 'Cancel'}")`).then((b) => b?.click()).catch(() => {});
        if (!ours) console.log(`  refused a card: ${text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 100)}`);
      }
      await sleep(500);
    }
    const answer = (await notch.textContent('.answer').catch(() => '')) || '';
    console.log(`  said "${spoken}" → heard "${heard}" → ${answer.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 160)}`);
    return { heard, answer };
  };
  const setting = (k, f = null) => main.evaluate(([key, fb]) => window.ather.getSetting(key, fb), [k, f]);

  // 1. Teach a skill by voice, then use it by saying its name.
  await ask('Teach yourself a new skill called Goodnight: when I say goodnight, make the text bigger and tell me my tasks for tomorrow.');
  const skills = await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.tool('skills_list', {}));
  check('a skill taught by voice is saved', skills.some((s) => /goodnight/i.test(s.name)), skills.filter((s) => !s.builtin).map((s) => s.name));
  await ask('Goodnight.');
  check('saying its name runs the skill', ((await setting('ui', {}))?.fontScale || 1) > 1, JSON.stringify(await setting('ui', {})));

  // 2. Change Maya by voice.
  await ask('Change your name to Priya.');
  check('"change your name to Priya"', (await setting('agent', {}))?.name === 'Priya', JSON.stringify(await setting('agent', {})));
  await ask('Talk a little slower please.');
  check('"talk slower"', ((await setting('agent', {}))?.speed || 1) < 1, JSON.stringify(await setting('agent', {})));

  // 3. The work monitor, by voice and on its page.
  const doing = await ask('What did you do today?');
  check('"what did you do today?" tells the work', /name|priya|skill|text|slower|speed/i.test(doing.answer), doing.answer);

  // 4. A 👎 by voice teaches Maya; a fresh question follows it.
  const bad = parseCommand(await hear('Bad answer.'));
  const note = await hear('Answer in one short sentence only.');
  await main.evaluate(([n]) => window.ather.feedback({ question: 'explain things', good: false, note: n }), [note]);
  const prefs = await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.tool('memory_list', {}));
  check('"bad answer" + a note is remembered', bad?.cmd === 'feedback' && prefs.some((m) => m.category === 'preference' && /one short sentence/i.test(m.fact)), JSON.stringify(prefs.map((m) => m.fact)));
  const short = await ask('What is photosynthesis?');
  check('the next answer follows it', short.answer.split(/[.!?]\s/).filter((s) => s.trim()).length <= 2, short.answer);

  // 5. Tamil: heard in Tamil, answered in Tamil, spoken with the Tamil voice.
  await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.setSetting('listenLanguage', 'tamil'));
  const ta = await ask('வணக்கம், நீ யார்?');
  const taVoice = await notch.evaluate(async (t) => { const a = await window.ather.speak(t); return a ? a.samples.length : 0; }, ta.answer || 'வணக்கம்');
  check('Tamil question → Tamil answer → Tamil voice', /[஀-௿]/.test(ta.answer) && taVoice > 8000, ta.answer);
  await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.setSetting('listenLanguage', null));

  // 6. Build something by voice (Builder): a working page in the test folder.
  const built = await ask('Build me a simple counter web page with plus, minus and reset buttons.', 600_000);
  const projects = join(work, 'Maya Projects');
  const dir = existsSync(projects) ? readdirSync(projects).map((d) => join(projects, d)).find((d) => existsSync(join(d, 'index.html'))) : null;
  const html = dir ? readFileSync(join(dir, 'index.html'), 'utf8') : '';
  check('"build me a counter page" makes a working page', /<button/i.test(html) && /<script/i.test(html) && /reset/i.test(html), dir || built.answer);

  // 7. The new pages, for the guide.
  for (const [nav, file] of [['Skills', '60-skills.png'], ['My Priya', '61-my-maya.png'], ['Work monitor', '62-work-monitor.png'], ['Connections', '63-connections.png']]) {
    await main.click(`nav >> text=${nav}`).catch(() => main.click(`nav >> text=My Maya`));
    await sleep(1200);
    await main.screenshot({ path: join(shots, file) });
  }
  const log = await main.evaluate(() => window.ather.workToday());
  check('the work monitor lists the actions', log.actions >= 4, `${log.actions} actions: ${log.items.slice(0, 4).map((i) => i.detail).join(' | ')}`);
} catch (e) {
  check('run', false, e.message);
} finally {
  await app.close();
}
const failed = results.filter((ok) => !ok).length;
console.log(`\n${results.length - failed}/${results.length} Maya 1.7 checks passed.`);
process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
```
