### scripts/wake-e2e.mjs

```javascript
// "Hey Maya" through the real microphone path: the app hears a recording (8 s of quiet room, then "Hey Maya" in
// Maya's own voice) as its mic, and must wake up and greet. Runs in a throwaway data folder.
// Usage: npm run build:ui && node scripts/wake-e2e.mjs
import { _electron as electron } from 'playwright';
import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const env = () => ({ ...process.env, ATHER_NO_SHUTDOWN: '1', ATHER_DATA: mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'maya-wake-')), ATHER_MODELS: join(process.env.APPDATA, 'Ather', 'models') });
const windowOf = async (app, name) => { for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) { const w = app.windows().find((x) => !x.isClosed() && x.url().includes(`${name}.html`)); if (w) return w; await sleep(250); } throw new Error(`${name} window did not open`); };

// 1. Maya's voice says "Hey Maya" → a 16-bit WAV with quiet before and after.
let app = await electron.launch({ args: ['.'], env: env() });
const voice = await (await windowOf(app, 'notch')).evaluate(async () => { const a = await window.ather.speak('Hey Maya.'); return { samples: Array.from(a.samples), rate: a.sampleRate }; });
await app.close();
const quiet = (s) => new Array(Math.round(s * voice.rate)).fill(0);
const samples = [...quiet(8), ...voice.samples, ...quiet(6)];
const wav = Buffer.alloc(44 + samples.length * 2);
wav.write('RIFF', 0); wav.writeUInt32LE(36 + samples.length * 2, 4); wav.write('WAVEfmt ', 8);
wav.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); wav.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); wav.writeUInt16LE(1, 22); wav.writeUInt32LE(voice.rate, 24);
wav.writeUInt32LE(voice.rate * 2, 28); wav.writeUInt16LE(2, 32); wav.writeUInt16LE(16, 34); wav.write('data', 36); wav.writeUInt32LE(samples.length * 2, 40);
samples.forEach((v, i) => wav.writeInt16LE(Math.max(-32768, Math.min(32767, Math.round(v * 32767))), 44 + i * 2));
const file = join(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'maya-wake-wav-')), 'hey-maya.wav');
writeFileSync(file, wav);

// 2. The app with that recording as its microphone.
app = await electron.launch({ args: ['.', '--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream', '--use-fake-device-for-media-stream', `--use-file-for-fake-audio-capture=${file}`], env: env() });
let ok = false;
try {
  const notch = await windowOf(app, 'notch');
  const spoken = [];
  // Woken = the notch opens for voice and Maya greets ("Good morning, boss! What's the work?").
  for (let i = 0; i < 80 && !ok; i++) {
    await sleep(500);
    const text = (await notch.textContent('body').catch(() => '')) || '';
    if (/boss|what's the work|Listening… just talk|Speaking…|Thinking…/i.test(text)) { ok = true; spoken.push(text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 160)); }
  }
  console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} "Hey Maya" after 8 s of quiet wakes Maya ${spoken[0] || ''}`);
} finally {
  await app.close();
}
process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);
```

## 8. Productivity

### src/main/tools/productivity.js

```javascript
import { classesBetween } from './student.js';
import { now } from '../store.js';
import { localIso } from '../services/calendar-feeds.js';

const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });
const int = (description) => ({ type: 'integer', description });
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });

const today = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA'); // YYYY-MM-DD in local time
const like = (q) => `%${(q || '').toLowerCase()}%`;

export const productivityTools = [
  // ---------- tasks ----------
  {
    name: 'tasks_create',
    description: 'Create a to-do task. Use for "add a task", "remind me to do X" without a specific alert time, "I need to...".',
    parameters: obj({ title: str('Short task title'), due: str('Due date/time as local ISO, e.g. 2026-10-29T17:00, optional'),
      priority: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'normal', 'high'] }, notes: str('Extra details, optional') }, ['title']),
    run: ({ title, due, priority, notes }, { store }) =>
      store.insert('tasks', { title, due, priority: priority || 'normal', notes, created_at: now() }, `Added task "${title}"`),
  },
  {
    name: 'tasks_query',
    description: 'List tasks. Filter by status (open/done/all), text search, or due today/overdue.',
    parameters: obj({ status: { type: 'string', enum: ['open', 'done', 'all'] }, search: str('Text to match, optional'),
      when: { type: 'string', enum: ['any', 'today', 'overdue', 'upcoming'] } }),
    run: ({ status = 'open', search, when = 'any' }, { store }) => {
      let sql = 'SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE deleted = 0 AND lower(title) LIKE ?';
      if (status === 'open') sql += ' AND done = 0';
      if (status === 'done') sql += ' AND done = 1';
      if (when === 'today') sql += ` AND substr(due,1,10) = '${today()}'`;
      if (when === 'overdue') sql += ` AND done = 0 AND due IS NOT NULL AND due < '${today()}'`;
      if (when === 'upcoming') sql += ` AND due >= '${today()}'`;
      return store.all(`${sql} ORDER BY done, due IS NULL, due, id LIMIT 50`, like(search));
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'tasks_update',
    description: 'Change a task: title, due date, priority or notes. Find the id with tasks_query first.',
    parameters: obj({ id: int('Task id'), title: str('New title'), due: str('New due local ISO'),
      priority: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'normal', 'high'] }, notes: str('New notes') }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id, ...changes }, { store }) => store.update('tasks', id, changes, `Changed task ${id}`),
  },
  {
    name: 'tasks_complete',
    description: 'Mark a task done (or not done with done=false).',
    parameters: obj({ id: int('Task id'), done: { type: 'boolean' } }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id, done = true }, { store }) =>
      store.update('tasks', id, { done: done ? 1 : 0, completed_at: done ? now() : null }, `Completed task ${id}`),
  },
  {
    name: 'tasks_delete',
    description: 'Delete a task (can be undone).',
    parameters: obj({ id: int('Task id') }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => store.update('tasks', id, { deleted: 1 }, `Deleted task ${id}`),
  },

  // ---------- notes ----------
  {
    name: 'notes_create',
    description: 'Save a note. Use for "note that...", "write down...", "remember that...".',
    parameters: obj({ title: str('Short title'), body: str('The note text') }, ['title']),
    run: ({ title, body = '' }, { store }) =>
      store.insert('notes', { title, body, created_at: now(), updated_at: now() }, `Saved note "${title}"`),
  },
  {
    name: 'notes_query',
    description: 'Find notes by text, or list recent notes.',
    parameters: obj({ search: str('Words to find, optional') }),
    run: ({ search }, { store }) =>
      store.all('SELECT * FROM notes WHERE deleted = 0 AND (lower(title) LIKE ? OR lower(body) LIKE ?) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 30',
        like(search), like(search)),
  },
  {
    name: 'notes_update',
    description: 'Change a note title or text. append=true adds text to the end instead of replacing.',
    parameters: obj({ id: int('Note id'), title: str('New title'), body: str('Text'), append: { type: 'boolean' } }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id, title, body, append }, { store }) => {
      const old = store.row('notes', id);
      const newBody = body === undefined ? undefined : append && old ? `${old.body}\n${body}` : body;
      return store.update('notes', id, { title, body: newBody, updated_at: now() }, `Changed note ${id}`);
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'notes_delete',
    description: 'Delete a note (can be undone).',
    parameters: obj({ id: int('Note id') }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => store.update('notes', id, { deleted: 1 }, `Deleted note ${id}`),
  },

  // ---------- reminders ----------
  {
    name: 'reminders_create',
    description: 'Set a reminder that pops up and plays a sound at an exact time. repeat: daily, weekdays or weekly. Not for "if someone does not reply" (use mail_follow_up).',
    parameters: obj({ text: str('What to remind about'), at: str('Local ISO date-time, e.g. 2026-10-28T18:30'),
      in_days: { type: 'integer', description: 'Instead of at: this many days from today, at 9 am (e.g. 2 for "in 2 days")' },
      repeat: { type: 'string', enum: ['none', 'daily', 'weekdays', 'weekly'], description: 'Only when the user said every day / every weekday / every week; otherwise none' },
      care: { type: 'boolean', description: 'true for medicine, tablets, insulin, injections, physio, drinking water for health: Maya waits for "done" and emails a caregiver if not confirmed' } }, ['text']),
    run: ({ text, at, in_days, repeat, care }, { store }) => {
      // Days ahead are counted here: small models get date maths wrong (a refill set for the day the tablets run out).
      if (!at && Number.isInteger(in_days)) { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + Math.max(0, in_days)); d.setHours(9, 0, 0, 0); at = localIso(d); }
      if (!at) throw new Error('Give the reminder a time: at or in_days.');
      return store.insert('reminders', { text, at, repeat: repeat === 'none' ? null : repeat, care: care ? 1 : 0, created_at: now() }, `Set reminder "${text}"`);
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'reminders_query',
    description: 'List upcoming (or all) reminders.',
    parameters: obj({ include_done: { type: 'boolean' } }),
    run: ({ include_done }, { store }) =>
      store.all(`SELECT * FROM reminders WHERE deleted = 0 ${include_done ? '' : 'AND done = 0'} ORDER BY at LIMIT 50`),
  },
  {
    name: 'reminders_delete',
    description: 'Cancel a reminder (can be undone).',
    parameters: obj({ id: int('Reminder id') }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => store.update('reminders', id, { deleted: 1 }, `Cancelled reminder ${id}`),
  },

  // ---------- habits ----------
  {
    name: 'habits_create',
    description: 'Start tracking a habit, e.g. "drink water", "gym 3 times a week".',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Habit name'), per_week: int('Target days per week, 1-7') }, ['name']),
    run: ({ name, per_week = 7 }, { store }) =>
      store.insert('habits', { name, per_week, created_at: now() }, `Started habit "${name}"`),
  },
  {
    name: 'habits_checkin',
    description: 'Mark a habit as done for a day (default today).',
    parameters: obj({ id: int('Habit id'), day: str('YYYY-MM-DD, optional') }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id, day = today() }, { store }) => {
      const existing = store.get('SELECT * FROM habit_checkins WHERE habit_id = ? AND day = ?', id, day);
      if (existing) return store.update('habit_checkins', existing.id, { deleted: 0 }, `Checked in habit ${id}`);
      return store.insert('habit_checkins', { habit_id: id, day }, `Checked in habit ${id}`);
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'habits_progress',
    description: 'Show habits with this week\'s check-ins, target and current streak.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => habitProgress(store),
  },
  {
    name: 'habits_delete',
    description: 'Stop tracking a habit (can be undone).',
    parameters: obj({ id: int('Habit id') }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => store.update('habits', id, { deleted: 1 }, `Removed habit ${id}`),
  },

  // ---------- focus ----------
  {
    name: 'focus_start',
    description: 'Start a focus timer (Pomodoro). Default 25 minutes.',
    parameters: obj({ minutes: int('Length in minutes'), label: str('What you are focusing on') }),
    run: ({ minutes = 25, label = 'Focus' }, { store }) => {
      const running = activeFocus(store);
      if (running) return { error: `A focus session is already running: ${running.label}`, session: running };
      return store.insert('focus_sessions', { minutes, label, started_at: now() }, `Started ${minutes} min focus`);
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'focus_status',
    description: 'Is a focus timer running, and how much time is left?',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => {
      const s = activeFocus(store);
      if (!s) return { running: false };
      const left = s.minutes * 60 - (Date.now() - Date.parse(s.started_at)) / 1000;
      return { running: true, label: s.label, seconds_left: Math.max(0, Math.round(left)), session: s };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'focus_stop',
    description: 'Stop the running focus timer early.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => {
      const s = activeFocus(store);
      if (!s) return { running: false };
      return store.update('focus_sessions', s.id, { ended_at: now() }, 'Stopped focus');
    },
  },

  // ---------- local calendar ----------
  {
    name: 'calendar_create',
    description: 'Add an event to the calendar, e.g. "haircut Tuesday at 11".',
    parameters: obj({ title: str('Event title'), start: str('Local ISO start'), end: str('Local ISO end, optional'),
      location: str('Where, optional') }, ['title', 'start']),
    run: ({ title, start, end, location }, { store }) =>
      store.insert('events', { title, start, end, location, created_at: now() }, `Added event "${title}"`),
  },
  {
    name: 'calendar_query',
    description: 'List calendar events between two dates (includes timetable classes and connected Google/Outlook/Apple calendar feeds).',
    parameters: obj({ from: str('YYYY-MM-DD, default today'), to: str('YYYY-MM-DD, default 7 days later') }),
    run: async ({ from = today(), to }, { store, services }) => {
      const end = to || new Date(Date.parse(from) + 7 * 864e5).toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
      const local = store.all('SELECT * FROM events WHERE deleted = 0 AND substr(start,1,10) BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY start',
        from, end).map((e) => ({ ...e, source: 'Maya' }));
      const feeds = services?.calendarFeeds ? await services.calendarFeeds.events(from, end) : [];
      return [...local, ...classesBetween(store, from, end), ...feeds].sort((a, b) => a.start.localeCompare(b.start));
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'calendar_delete',
    description: 'Delete an Maya calendar event (can be undone).',
    parameters: obj({ id: int('Event id') }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => store.update('events', id, { deleted: 1 }, `Deleted event ${id}`),
  },

  // ---------- patterns and undo ----------
  {
    name: 'history_query',
    description: 'What Maya has noticed about the user: tasks done today/this week, when they usually get things done, focus time, habit streaks. Use for "how many tasks did I do today", "when am I most active", "what have you noticed about me".',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => patterns(store),
  },
  {
    name: 'app_undo',
    description: 'Undo the last change Maya made.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => {
      const label = store.undo();
      return label ? { undone: label } : { undone: null, message: 'Nothing to undo' };
    },
  },
];

function activeFocus(store) {
  const s = store.get('SELECT * FROM focus_sessions WHERE deleted = 0 AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1');
  if (s && Date.now() - Date.parse(s.started_at) > s.minutes * 60_000) {
    store.run('UPDATE focus_sessions SET ended_at = ?, completed = 1 WHERE id = ?', now(), s.id);
    return null;
  }
  return s;
}

export function habitProgress(store) {
  const weekStart = new Date();
  weekStart.setDate(weekStart.getDate() - ((weekStart.getDay() + 6) % 7)); // Monday
  const from = weekStart.toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
  return store.all('SELECT * FROM habits WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id').map((h) => {
    const days = new Set(store.all('SELECT day FROM habit_checkins WHERE habit_id = ? AND deleted = 0', h.id).map((r) => r.day));
    let streak = 0;
    for (const d = new Date(); days.has(d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA')); d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1)) streak++;
    const thisWeek = [...days].filter((d) => d >= from).length;
    const last7 = [...Array(7)].map((_, i) => days.has(new Date(Date.now() - (6 - i) * 864e5).toLocaleDateString('en-CA')));
    return { ...h, this_week: thisWeek, done_today: days.has(today()), streak, last7 };
  });
}

export function patterns(store) {
  const done = store.all('SELECT completed_at FROM tasks WHERE done = 1 AND deleted = 0 AND completed_at IS NOT NULL');
  const byHour = Array(24).fill(0);
  for (const t of done) byHour[new Date(t.completed_at).getHours()]++;
  const best = byHour.indexOf(Math.max(...byHour));
  const weekAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5).toISOString();
  const focus = store.get('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(minutes),0) AS m, COUNT(*) AS n FROM focus_sessions WHERE completed = 1 AND started_at >= ?', weekAgo);
  return {
    tasks_done_today: done.filter((t) => new Date(t.completed_at).toLocaleDateString('en-CA') === today()).length,
    tasks_done_this_week: done.filter((t) => t.completed_at >= weekAgo).length,
    tasks_open: store.get('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks WHERE done = 0 AND deleted = 0').n,
    most_productive_hours: done.length >= 3 ? `${best}:00 to ${best + 2}:00` : 'not enough history yet',
    tasks_done_by_hour: byHour,
    focus_minutes_this_week: focus.m,
    focus_sessions_this_week: focus.n,
    habits: habitProgress(store).map((h) => ({ name: h.name, streak: h.streak, this_week: h.this_week, target: h.per_week })),
    computer_time_today: store.all('SELECT label, ROUND(SUM(seconds) / 60.0) AS minutes FROM activity WHERE day = ? GROUP BY label ORDER BY minutes DESC LIMIT 5', today()),
  };
}
```

### src/main/services/scheduler.js

```javascript
// Fires reminders and finishes focus timers. notify(title, body, kind) shows the alert.
import { localIso } from './calendar-feeds.js';
import { now } from '../store.js';
import { classesBetween } from '../tools/student.js';

const classAlerts = new Set(); // "start#id" of classes already announced

export function nextRepeat(at, repeat) {
  const d = new Date(at);
  do d.setDate(d.getDate() + (repeat === 'weekly' ? 7 : 1));
  while (repeat === 'weekdays' && (d.getDay() === 0 || d.getDay() === 6));
  return localIso(d);
}

export function tick(store, notify) {
  const due = store.all('SELECT * FROM reminders WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 0 AND at <= ?', `${localIso(new Date())}:59`);
  for (const r of due) {
    // Medicine and care: Maya waits for a spoken "done" (see careTick).
    if (r.care) notify('Medicine time', `${r.text}. Say done when you have finished.`, 'care', r.id);
    else notify('Reminder', r.text, 'reminder');
    if (r.repeat) store.run('UPDATE reminders SET at = ?, fired_at = ?, confirmed_at = NULL, escalated_at = NULL WHERE id = ?', nextRepeat(r.at, r.repeat), now(), r.id);
    else store.run('UPDATE reminders SET done = 1, fired_at = ?, confirmed_at = NULL, escalated_at = NULL WHERE id = ?', now(), r.id);
  }
  // A heads-up 10 minutes before each timetable class.
  const soon = localIso(new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000));
  for (const c of classesBetween(store, soon.slice(0, 10), soon.slice(0, 10)).filter((x) => x.start === soon)) {
    const key = `${c.start}#${c.timetable_id}`;
    if (classAlerts.has(key)) continue;
    classAlerts.add(key);
    notify('Class in 10 minutes', `${c.title}${c.location ? ` in ${c.location}` : ''}`, 'reminder');
  }
  const focus = store.all('SELECT * FROM focus_sessions WHERE deleted = 0 AND ended_at IS NULL');
  for (const s of focus) {
    if (Date.now() - Date.parse(s.started_at) < s.minutes * 60_000) continue;
    store.run('UPDATE focus_sessions SET ended_at = ?, completed = 1 WHERE id = ?', now(), s.id);
    notify('Focus done', `${s.minutes} minutes of ${s.label}. Nice work! Take a short break.`, 'focus');
  }
}

/** A care reminder not confirmed within `wait` ms: caregivers get one quiet email (alert(reason) = sos.notify). */
export async function careTick(store, alert, wait = 15 * 60_000, at = Date.now()) {
  const late = store.all('SELECT * FROM reminders WHERE deleted = 0 AND care = 1 AND fired_at IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_at IS NULL AND escalated_at IS NULL AND fired_at <= ?',
    new Date(at - wait).toISOString());
  for (const r of late) {
    store.run('UPDATE reminders SET escalated_at = ? WHERE id = ?', now(), r.id);
    await alert(`has not confirmed a care reminder: "${r.text}" (due ${new Date(r.fired_at).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })})`).catch(() => {});
  }
  return late.length;
}

export const careDone = (store, id) => store.run('UPDATE reminders SET confirmed_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND care = 1', now(), id);

export function startScheduler(store, notify) {
  const timer = setInterval(() => tick(store, notify), 15_000);
  tick(store, notify);
  return () => clearInterval(timer);
}
```

### src/main/services/calendar-feeds.js

```javascript
// Read-only Google / Outlook / Apple calendars through their private iCal (.ics) links.
import ical from 'node-ical';

export const localIso = (d) => new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);

export function createCalendarFeeds({ store }) {
  let cache = { at: 0, key: '', items: [] };

  async function load() {
    const feeds = store.getSetting('calendarFeeds', []);
    const key = JSON.stringify(feeds);
    if (cache.key === key && Date.now() - cache.at < 10 * 60_000) return cache.items;
    const items = [];
    for (const feed of feeds) {
      try {
        const data = await ical.async.fromURL(feed.url.replace(/^webcal:/i, 'https:'));
        for (const ev of Object.values(data)) if (ev.type === 'VEVENT') items.push({ ev, source: feed.name || 'Calendar' });
      } catch { /* one broken feed should not hide the others */ }
    }
    cache = { at: Date.now(), key, items };
    return items;
  }

  /** Events between two YYYY-MM-DD dates, recurring ones expanded. */
  async function events(from, to) {
    const start = new Date(`${from}T00:00`), end = new Date(`${to}T23:59`);
    const out = [];
    for (const { ev, source } of await load()) {
      const length = ev.end ? ev.end - ev.start : 0;
      const starts = ev.rrule ? ev.rrule.between(start, end, true) : [ev.start];
      for (const s of starts) {
        if (s < start || s > end) continue;
        out.push({ title: ev.summary || '(busy)', start: localIso(s), end: length ? localIso(new Date(s.getTime() + length)) : null,
          location: ev.location || null, source });
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  return { events, refresh: () => { cache.at = 0; } };
}
```

### src/main/services/mail.js

```javascript
// "Your inbox, sorted": read, search, reply to and tidy emails over IMAP/SMTP, and let the brain pick what needs the user.
// Sending, moving and bulk changes are tools with confirm: true, so nothing leaves or moves without an approval card.
import { ImapFlow } from 'imapflow';
import { simpleParser } from 'mailparser';
import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';
import { OLLAMA } from '../ollama.js';
import { BRAIN_MODEL } from '../brain.js';
import { liteSwap } from '../models.js';

export const MAIL_PRESETS = {
  gmail: { host: 'imap.gmail.com', port: 993 },
  outlook: { host: 'outlook.office365.com', port: 993 },
  yahoo: { host: 'imap.mail.yahoo.com', port: 993 },
};

// The IMAP account also sends: the matching SMTP servers.
const SMTP = { 'imap.gmail.com': 'smtp.gmail.com', 'outlook.office365.com': 'smtp.office365.com', 'imap.mail.yahoo.com': 'smtp.mail.yahoo.com' };
export const smtpHost = (imapHost) => SMTP[imapHost] || imapHost.replace(/^imap\./, 'smtp.');

/** The short form the brain and the Inbox page see (exported for tests). */
export function summary(uid, parsed, flags = new Set()) {
  return {
    uid,
    from: parsed.from?.text || '',
    subject: parsed.subject || '(no subject)',
    date: parsed.date?.toISOString(),
    unread: !flags.has('\\Seen'),
    snippet: (parsed.text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 300),
    promo: !!parsed.headers?.get?.('list')?.unsubscribe,
  };
}

/** IMAP search criteria from the tool's plain arguments (exported for tests). */
export function criteria({ from, subject, text, since, unread } = {}) {
  const c = {};
  if (from) c.from = from;
  if (subject) c.subject = subject;
  if (text) c.body = text;
  if (since) c.since = new Date(since);
  if (unread) c.seen = false;
  return Object.keys(c).length ? c : { all: true };
}

/** imap / transport: tests pass fakes. */
export function createMail({ store, secrets, imap, transport }) {
  const account = () => {
    const cfg = store.getSetting('mail');
    const pass = secrets.get('mail-password');
    if (!cfg?.user || !pass) throw new Error('Email is not connected. Add it on the Inbox page.');
    return { ...cfg, pass };
  };

  async function withInbox(fn, folder = 'INBOX') {
    const cfg = account();
    const client = imap ? imap() : new ImapFlow({ host: cfg.host, port: cfg.port || 993, secure: true, auth: { user: cfg.user, pass: cfg.pass }, logger: false });
    await client.connect();
    const lock = await client.getMailboxLock(folder);
    try { return await fn(client); } finally { lock.release(); await client.logout(); }
  }

  // source fetches use BODY.PEEK, so looking does not mark anything read.
  async function fetchList(client, range, uid) {
    const mails = [];
    for await (const msg of client.fetch(range, { flags: true, source: true }, { uid })) mails.push(summary(msg.uid, await simpleParser(msg.source), msg.flags));
    return mails.reverse();
  }

  const recent = (limit = 15) => withInbox((client) => {
    const total = client.mailbox.exists;
    return total > 0 ? fetchList(client, `${Math.max(1, total - limit + 1)}:*`, false) : [];
  });

  /** Newest matching emails first. */
  const search = (query = {}, limit = 10) => withInbox(async (client) => {
    const uids = (await client.search(criteria(query), { uid: true })) || [];
    return uids.length ? fetchList(client, uids.slice(-limit), true) : [];
  });

  /** One whole email (text capped), with what a reply needs. */
  const read = (uid) => withInbox(async (client) => {
    const msg = await client.fetchOne(String(uid), { flags: true, source: true }, { uid: true });
    if (!msg) throw new Error(`No email with id ${uid}.`);
    const parsed = await simpleParser(msg.source);
    return { ...summary(msg.uid, parsed, msg.flags), to: parsed.to?.text || '', reply_to: parsed.replyTo?.text || parsed.from?.text || '',
      message_id: parsed.messageId, references: parsed.references, text: (parsed.text || '').slice(0, 4000),
      attachments: parsed.attachments.map((a) => a.filename).filter(Boolean) };
  });

  async function send({ to, subject, text, inReplyTo, references }) {
    const cfg = account();
    const mailer = transport || nodemailer.createTransport({ host: smtpHost(cfg.host), port: 465, secure: true, auth: { user: cfg.user, pass: cfg.pass } });
    const info = await mailer.sendMail({ from: cfg.user, to, subject, text, inReplyTo, references });
    return { sent: true, to, subject, id: info.messageId };
  }

  async function reply(uid, text) {
    const m = await read(uid);
    const refs = [m.references, m.message_id].flat().filter(Boolean);
    return send({ to: m.reply_to, subject: /^re:/i.test(m.subject) ? m.subject : `Re: ${m.subject}`, text, inReplyTo: m.message_id, references: refs });
  }

  const ids = (uids) => [].concat(uids).map(String).join(',');
  const markRead = (uids) => withInbox(async (c) => { await c.messageFlagsAdd(ids(uids), ['\\Seen'], { uid: true }); return { marked_read: [].concat(uids).length }; });
  const folders = () => withInbox(async (c) => (await c.list()).map((f) => ({ path: f.path, use: f.specialUse || '' })));
  const move = (uids, folder) => withInbox(async (c) => { await c.messageMove(ids(uids), folder, { uid: true }); return { moved: [].concat(uids).length, to: folder }; });
  /** Archive = out of the inbox, never deleted (Gmail: All Mail). */
  async function archive(uids) {
    const list = await folders();
    const dest = list.find((f) => f.use === '\\Archive') || list.find((f) => f.use === '\\All');
    if (!dest) throw new Error('This mail account has no Archive folder.');
    return move(uids, dest.path);
  }
  /** Newsletters and ads (they carry List-Unsubscribe) among the recent emails. */
  const promotions = async (limit = 50) => (await recent(limit)).filter((m) => m.promo);

  /** Recent emails, each marked needs_you true/false with a short reason. */
  async function triage(limit = 15) {
    const mails = await recent(limit);
    if (!mails.length) return { mails: [], needs_you: 0 };
    const list = mails.map((m, i) => `${i}. From: ${m.from} | Subject: ${m.subject} | ${m.snippet.slice(0, 160)}`).join('\n');
    const res = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/v1/chat/completions`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: liteSwap(BRAIN_MODEL), reasoning_effort: 'none', temperature: 0,
        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: `Which of these emails need the reader to act or reply (bills, deadlines, questions from real people, check-ins)? Newsletters, ads and notifications do not. Answer only JSON: [{"i":0,"needs_you":true,"why":"Due Friday"}] with "why" at most 5 words.\n\n${list}` }],
      }),
    });
    const content = (await res.json()).choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '[]';
    let marks = [];
    try { marks = JSON.parse(content.match(/\[[\s\S]*\]/)?.[0] || '[]'); } catch { /* keep unmarked */ }
    for (const m of marks) if (mails[m.i]) Object.assign(mails[m.i], { needs_you: !!m.needs_you, why: m.why || '' });
    const result = { mails, needs_you: mails.filter((m) => m.needs_you).length };
    store.setSetting('mailTriage', { at: new Date().toISOString(), needs_you: result.mails.filter((m) => m.needs_you).map(({ uid, from, subject, why }) => ({ uid, from, subject, why })) });
    return result;
  }

  return { recent, search, read, send, reply, markRead, archive, move, folders, promotions, triage };
}
```

### src/main/services/work.js

```javascript
// Managing the user's work: email follow-ups ("remind me if Rahul doesn't reply by Friday") and the Friday weekly report.
// Both live in settings, so they need no new tables.
import { now } from '../store.js';

const day = (d) => d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA');

export function addFollowUp(store, { from, subject = '', by }) {
  if (!from || !by || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(by))) throw new Error('A follow-up needs who (from) and a date (by).');
  const list = store.getSetting('followups', []);
  const item = { id: Date.now(), from, subject, by, created: now(), done: false };
  store.setSetting('followups', [...list, item]);
  return { following_up: item };
}

/**
 * For each open follow-up: a reply from that person since it was made → tell the user, done;
 * past its date with no reply → tell the user and add a task to chase it, done.
 */
export async function checkFollowUps({ store, mail, notify, at = new Date() }) {
  const list = store.getSetting('followups', []);
  const open = list.filter((f) => !f.done);
  if (!open.length || !store.getSetting('mail')) return [];
  const changed = [];
  for (const f of open) {
    const replies = await mail.search({ from: f.from, since: f.created.slice(0, 10) }, 1).catch(() => null);
    if (replies === null) continue; // offline: try again next time
    if (replies.length) {
      notify('They replied', `${f.from} replied${f.subject ? ` about ${f.subject}` : ''}: ${replies[0].subject}`, 'mail');
      Object.assign(f, { done: true, replied: true });
    } else if (at >= new Date(f.by)) {
      notify('No reply yet', `${f.from} has not replied${f.subject ? ` about ${f.subject}` : ''}. I added a task to follow up.`, 'mail');
      store.insert('tasks', { title: `Follow up with ${f.from}${f.subject ? `: ${f.subject}` : ''}`, due: day(at), priority: 'high', created_at: now() }, 'Follow-up task');
      Object.assign(f, { done: true, replied: false });
    } else continue;
    changed.push(f);
  }
  if (changed.length) store.setSetting('followups', list);
  return changed;
}

/** The week in Markdown: done, still open, coming up, focus time, follow-ups, emails waiting. */
export function weeklyMarkdown(store, end = new Date()) {
  const from = day(new Date(end - 7 * 864e5));
  const to = day(end);
  const next = day(new Date(+end + 7 * 864e5));
  const done = store.all('SELECT title, completed_at FROM tasks WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 1 AND completed_at >= ? ORDER BY completed_at', from);
  const open = store.all('SELECT title, due FROM tasks WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 0 ORDER BY due IS NULL, due');
  const events = store.all('SELECT title, start FROM events WHERE deleted = 0 AND start > ? AND start <= ? ORDER BY start', `${to}T23:59`, `${next}T23:59`);
  const focus = store.get('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(minutes), 0) AS m FROM focus_sessions WHERE deleted = 0 AND completed = 1 AND started_at >= ?', from).m;
  const follow = store.getSetting('followups', []).filter((f) => !f.done);
  const waiting = store.getSetting('mailTriage', null)?.needs_you || [];
  const apps = store.all('SELECT label, SUM(seconds) AS s FROM activity WHERE day > ? AND day <= ? GROUP BY label ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 8', from, to);
  const hm = (s) => `${Math.floor(s / 3600)} h ${Math.round((s % 3600) / 60)} min`;
  const list = (rows, line, empty) => (rows.length ? rows.map((r) => `- ${line(r)}`).join('\n') : `- ${empty}`);
  return [
    `Week of ${from} to ${to}.`,
    `## Done (${done.length})`, list(done, (t) => `${t.title} (${t.completed_at.slice(0, 10)})`, 'Nothing marked done this week.'),
    `## Still open (${open.length})`, list(open, (t) => `${t.title}${t.due ? ` (due ${t.due.slice(0, 10)}${t.due.slice(0, 10) < to ? ', overdue' : ''})` : ''}`, 'No open tasks.'),
    '## Coming up next week', list(events, (e) => `${e.title} (${e.start.replace('T', ' ')})`, 'No events saved.'),
    '## Waiting on replies', list(follow, (f) => `${f.from}${f.subject ? `: ${f.subject}` : ''} (by ${f.by})`, 'No follow-ups.'),
    '## Emails that need you', list(waiting, (m) => `${m.from.split('<')[0].trim()}: ${m.subject}${m.why ? ` (${m.why})` : ''}`, 'None at the last inbox check.'),
    `## Focus time\n${focus} minutes of focus sessions.`,
    '## Time on the computer', list(apps, (a) => `${a.label}: ${hm(a.s)}`, 'Not tracked this week (Settings → Activity).'),
  ].join('\n\n');
}

export async function weeklyReport({ store, files, end = new Date() }) {
  const { path } = await files.document({ title: `Weekly report ${day(end)}`, markdown: weeklyMarkdown(store, end) });
  store.setSetting('weeklyReportLast', { at: now(), path, week: day(end) });
  return { path };
}

/** Fridays from 5 pm, once per Friday, unless switched off. */
export async function weeklyTick({ store, files, notify, at = new Date() }) {
  if (!store.getSetting('weeklyReport', true) || at.getDay() !== 5 || at.getHours() < 17) return null;
  if (store.getSetting('weeklyReportLast', null)?.week === day(at)) return null;
  const { path } = await weeklyReport({ store, files, end: at });
  notify('Weekly report ready', `Your week is summed up in ${path}`, 'report');
  return path;
}
```

### src/main/services/briefing.js

```javascript
// Morning briefing, evening review and gentle nudges.
import { complete } from '../brain.js';
import { patterns } from '../tools/productivity.js';
import { localIso } from './calendar-feeds.js';

const WMO = { 0: 'clear sky', 1: 'mostly clear', 2: 'partly cloudy', 3: 'cloudy', 45: 'foggy', 48: 'foggy', 51: 'light drizzle', 53: 'drizzle', 55: 'heavy drizzle',
  61: 'light rain', 63: 'rain', 65: 'heavy rain', 71: 'light snow', 73: 'snow', 75: 'heavy snow', 80: 'rain showers', 81: 'rain showers', 82: 'heavy showers', 95: 'thunderstorms', 96: 'thunderstorms with hail', 99: 'thunderstorms with hail' };

/** Today's weather for a city from Open-Meteo (free, no key). */
export async function weather(city) {
  const geo = await (await fetch(`https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?count=1&name=${encodeURIComponent(city)}`)).json();
  const place = geo.results?.[0];
  if (!place) throw new Error(`Couldn't find the city "${city}"`);
  const url = `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${place.latitude}&longitude=${place.longitude}&timezone=auto`
    + '&current=temperature_2m,weather_code&daily=temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max,weather_code&forecast_days=1';
  const w = await (await fetch(url)).json();
  return {
    place: `${place.name}${place.admin1 ? `, ${place.admin1}` : ''}`,
    now_c: Math.round(w.current.temperature_2m),
    high_c: Math.round(w.daily.temperature_2m_max[0]),
    low_c: Math.round(w.daily.temperature_2m_min[0]),
    rain_chance: w.daily.precipitation_probability_max[0],
    sky: WMO[w.daily.weather_code[0]] ?? 'mixed',
  };
}

const today = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA');

export function createBriefing({ store, services }) {
  async function gather(kind) {
    const run = (name, args = {}) => import('../tools/index.js').then(({ allTools }) => allTools.find((t) => t.name === name).run(args, { store, services }));
    const data = {
      today: new Date().toDateString(),
      tasks_due_today: (await run('tasks_query', { when: 'today' })).map((t) => ({ title: t.title, due: t.due })),
      overdue_tasks: (await run('tasks_query', { when: 'overdue' })).map((t) => t.title),
      events_today: (await run('calendar_query', { from: today(), to: today() }).catch(() => [])).map((e) => `${e.start.slice(11) || 'all day'} ${e.title}`),
      exams_soon: (await run('exams_query', {})).filter((e) => e.days_left <= 14).map((e) => `${e.subject} in ${e.days_left} days`),
      reminders: (await run('reminders_query', {})).filter((r) => r.at.startsWith(today())).map((r) => `${r.at.slice(11)} ${r.text}`),
      progress: patterns(store),
    };
    const city = store.getSetting('city', '');
    if (city) data.weather = await weather(city).catch(() => null);
    if (kind === 'morning' && services.mail && store.getSetting('mail')) data.emails_need_you = await services.mail.triage().then((m) => m.mails.filter((x) => x.needs_you).map((x) => x.subject)).catch(() => undefined);
    if (kind === 'evening' && services.activity) data.computer_time = services.activity.summary();
    return data;
  }

  /** kind: morning (plan the day) or evening (review the day). Returns the text, also saved for the Home screen. */
  async function generate(kind = 'morning') {
    const data = await gather(kind);
    const ask = kind === 'morning'
      ? 'Write a friendly spoken morning briefing (60 to 110 words): greet, weather in one line if given, what is on today (classes, events, due tasks, reminders, important emails), any exam coming up soon, and one practical tip for the day. No lists, no markdown, natural sentences.'
      : 'Write a friendly spoken end-of-day review (60 to 110 words): what got done today (tasks, focus, habits), honest note on computer time if given, what is still open, and one encouraging suggestion for tomorrow. No lists, no markdown.';
    const text = (await complete(`${ask}\nUse only these facts, never invent any:\n${JSON.stringify(data)}`)).trim();
    store.setSetting('lastBriefing', { kind, text, at: localIso(new Date()) });
    return { kind, text };
  }

  // Nudges once per day each; returns { title, body } or null.
  function nudge(kind) {
    if (kind === 'overdue') {
      const n = store.get("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 0 AND due IS NOT NULL AND due < ?", today()).n;
      return n ? { title: 'Overdue tasks', body: `You have ${n} overdue task${n > 1 ? 's' : ''}. Want to pick one and finish it now?` } : null;
    }
    if (kind === 'habits') {
      const left = patterns(store).habits.filter((h) => h.this_week < h.target);
      const notToday = store.all("SELECT h.name FROM habits h WHERE h.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM habit_checkins c WHERE c.habit_id = h.id AND c.day = ? AND c.deleted = 0)", today());
      return notToday.length && left.length ? { title: 'Habits', body: `Still to do today: ${notToday.map((h) => h.name).join(', ')}.` } : null;
    }
    if (kind === 'distracted' && services.activity) {
      const m = services.activity.summary().distracting_minutes;
      return m >= 60 ? { title: 'Screen time', body: `You've spent ${m} minutes on distracting apps today. Maybe take a real break, or start a focus session?` } : null;
    }
    return null;
  }

  return { gather, generate, nudge };
}

/** Called every minute: fires the briefing, review and nudges at their times, once a day each. */
export async function briefingTick({ store, briefing, notify, isAway }) {
  if (isAway()) return; // wait until the user is back at the computer
  const now = new Date();
  const hhmm = now.toTimeString().slice(0, 5);
  const done = store.getSetting('briefingsDone', {});
  const day = today();
  const due = (key, time, on = true) => on && hhmm >= time && done[key] !== day;
  const mark = (key) => { done[key] = day; store.setSetting('briefingsDone', done); };

  if (due('morning', store.getSetting('briefingTime', '08:00'), store.getSetting('briefingEnabled', true)) && hhmm < '12:00') {
    mark('morning');
    const { text } = await briefing.generate('morning');
    notify('Good morning ☀️', text, 'briefing');
    return;
  }
  if (due('evening', store.getSetting('reviewTime', '21:00'), store.getSetting('eveningReview', true))) {
    mark('evening');
    const { text } = await briefing.generate('evening');
    notify('Your day 🌙', text, 'briefing');
    return;
  }
  if (!store.getSetting('nudges', true)) return;
  for (const [key, time] of [['overdue', '17:00'], ['habits', '20:00'], ['distracted', '00:00']]) {
    if (!due(key, time)) continue;
    const n = briefing.nudge(key);
    if (n) { mark(key); notify(n.title, n.body, 'nudge'); return; }
    if (key !== 'distracted') mark(key); // nothing to say today; the screen-time check keeps watching
  }
}
```

### src/renderer/app/useData.js

```javascript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

/** Load data with fn(); reload whenever `version` changes (any Maya data changed). */
export function useData(fn, version, deps = []) {
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    fn().then((d) => live && setData(d)).catch(() => live && setData(null));
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [version, ...deps]);
  return data;
}

export const tool = (name, args) => window.ather.tool(name, args);
export const today = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
export const fmtDate = (iso) => {
  if (!iso) return '';
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const sameDay = d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA') === today();
  const time = iso.length > 10 ? d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' }) : '';
  return sameDay ? `Today ${time}` : `${d.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })} ${time}`;
};
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useData, tool, fmtDate } from './useData.js';

export default function Notes({ version }) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const notes = useData(() => tool('notes_query', { search }), version, [search]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState({ title: '', body: '' });
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(true);

  const current = notes?.find((n) => n.id === selected);
  useEffect(() => { if (current && saved) setDraft({ title: current.title, body: current.body }); }, [current?.id, current?.updated_at]);

  async function create() {
    const n = await tool('notes_create', { title: 'New note', body: '' });
    setSelected(n.id);
    setDraft({ title: n.title, body: '' });
  }
  async function save() {
    await tool('notes_update', { id: selected, title: draft.title || 'Untitled', body: draft.body });
    setSaved(true);
  }
  const edit = (patch) => { setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, ...patch })); setSaved(false); };

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">Notes</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Say “note that the lab exam is in room 204” and Maya saves it here.</p>
      <div className="split">
        <div className="panel">
          <div className="row" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            <input className="input" placeholder="Search notes…" value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} aria-label="Search notes" />
            <button className="btn primary" onClick={create}>New</button>
          </div>
          {notes?.length === 0 && <p className="empty">No notes yet.</p>}
          {(notes || []).map((n) => (
            <button key={n.id} className={`note-pick ${n.id === selected ? 'active' : ''}`} onClick={() => { setSelected(n.id); setSaved(true); setDraft({ title: n.title, body: n.body }); }}>
              <b>{n.title}</b><small>{fmtDate(n.updated_at)} · {n.body.slice(0, 60)}</small>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="panel">
          {!current ? <p className="empty">Pick a note or make a new one.</p> : (
            <>
              <div className="field"><label htmlFor="nt">Title</label><input id="nt" className="input" value={draft.title} onChange={(e) => edit({ title: e.target.value })} /></div>
              <div className="field"><label htmlFor="nb">Note</label><textarea id="nb" className="input" style={{ minHeight: 320 }} value={draft.body} onChange={(e) => edit({ body: e.target.value })} /></div>
              <div className="row">
                <button className="btn primary" onClick={save} disabled={saved}>{saved ? 'Saved' : 'Save'}</button>
                <span className="spacer" />
                <button className="btn danger" onClick={async () => { await tool('notes_delete', { id: current.id }); setSelected(null); }}>Delete</button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useData, tool } from './useData.js';

export default function Focus({ version }) {
  const status = useData(() => tool('focus_status'), version);
  const stats = useData(() => tool('history_query'), version);
  const [label, setLabel] = useState('');
  const [left, setLeft] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!status?.running) { setLeft(0); return; }
    const end = Date.now() + status.seconds_left * 1000;
    const t = setInterval(() => setLeft(Math.max(0, Math.round((end - Date.now()) / 1000))), 500);
    setLeft(status.seconds_left);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [status]);

  const mm = String(Math.floor(left / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
  const ss = String(left % 60).padStart(2, '0');

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">Focus</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Say “help me focus for 25 minutes on maths”. Maya pings you when time is up.</p>
      <div className="panel" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
        {status?.running ? (
          <>
            <div className="muted">Focusing on <b>{status.label}</b></div>
            <div className="timer" role="timer" aria-live="off">{mm}:{ss}</div>
            <button className="btn" onClick={() => tool('focus_stop')}>Stop early</button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="timer">--:--</div>
            <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'center', marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <input className="input" style={{ maxWidth: 320 }} placeholder="What are you working on?" value={label} onChange={(e) => setLabel(e.target.value)} aria-label="Focus label" />
            </div>
            <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'center' }}>
              {[15, 25, 50].map((m) => <button key={m} className="btn primary" onClick={() => tool('focus_start', { minutes: m, label: label || 'Focus' })}>{m} min</button>)}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="grid" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{stats?.focus_minutes_this_week ?? 0}</div><div className="stat-label">focus minutes in the last 7 days</div></div>
        <div className="panel"><div className="stat">{stats?.focus_sessions_this_week ?? 0}</div><div className="stat-label">sessions finished</div></div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
function MailConnect({ onDone }) {
  const [presets, setPresets] = useState({});
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState('gmail');
  const [user, setUser] = useState('');
  const [pass, setPass] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => { window.ather.mailPresets().then(setPresets); }, []);

  async function save(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    await window.ather.setSetting('mail', { ...presets[provider], user });
    await window.ather.setSecret('mail-password', pass);

  }

  return (
    <form className="panel" onSubmit={save} style={{ maxWidth: 520 }}>
      <h2>Connect your email</h2>

        </select>
      </div>

      <div className="field"><label htmlFor="mpw">App password</label><input id="mpw" className="input" type="password" required value={pass} onChange={(e) => setPass(e.target.value)} /></div>
      <button className="btn primary">Connect</button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

### src/main/services/docs.js

```javascript
// "Chat with your PDFs": extract text, split into chunks, embed, and pull the relevant parts into each answer.
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { basename, extname } from 'node:path';
import { embed } from '../ollama.js';
import { now } from '../store.js';

const CHUNK = 1200;
const OVERLAP = 200;
const WHOLE_DOC_LIMIT = 7000; // smaller documents go to the model whole

const toBlob = (v) => Buffer.from(new Float32Array(v).buffer);
const fromBlob = (b) => new Float32Array(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength / 4);
const unit = (v) => { const n = Math.hypot(...v) || 1; return v.map((x) => x / n); };
const dot = (a, b) => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) s += a[i] * b[i]; return s; };

export async function extractText(path) {
  const ext = extname(path).toLowerCase();
  if (ext === '.pdf') {
    const { extractText: pdfText, getDocumentProxy } = await import('unpdf');
    const pdf = await getDocumentProxy(new Uint8Array(await readFile(path)));
    const { text } = await pdfText(pdf, { mergePages: true });
    return text;
  }
  if (ext === '.docx') {
    const mammoth = await import('mammoth');
    return (await mammoth.extractRawText({ path })).value;
  }
  return readFile(path, 'utf8');
}

export function chunk(text) {
  const clean = text.replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < clean.length; i += CHUNK - OVERLAP) out.push(clean.slice(i, i + CHUNK));
  return out;
}

export function createDocs({ store }) {
  async function add(conversationId, path) {
    const text = (await extractText(path)).trim();
    if (!text) throw new Error('No readable text in that file (scanned PDFs are pictures; try a text PDF).');
    return addText(conversationId, basename(path), text, path);
  }

  async function addText(conversationId, name, text, path = null) {
    const { lastInsertRowid } = store.run('INSERT INTO documents (conversation_id, name, path, text, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
      conversationId, name, path, text, now());
    const id = Number(lastInsertRowid);
    const pieces = chunk(text);
    for (let i = 0; i < pieces.length; i += 16) {
      const vecs = await embed(pieces.slice(i, i + 16).map((p) => `search_document: ${p}`));
      vecs.forEach((v, j) => store.run('INSERT INTO doc_chunks (document_id, text, embedding) VALUES (?,?,?)', id, pieces[i + j], toBlob(unit(v))));
    }
    return { id, name, chars: text.length, chunks: pieces.length };
  }

  const list = (conversationId) => store.all('SELECT id, name, length(text) AS chars FROM documents WHERE conversation_id = ?', conversationId);

  function remove(id) {
    store.run('DELETE FROM doc_chunks WHERE document_id = ?', id);
    store.run('DELETE FROM documents WHERE id = ?', id);
  }

  /** Text to put in the prompt for this question: whole small documents, otherwise the best-matching chunks. */
  async function context(conversationId, question, maxChunks = 6) {
    const docs = store.all('SELECT * FROM documents WHERE conversation_id = ?', conversationId);
    if (!docs.length) return '';
    const total = docs.reduce((n, d) => n + d.text.length, 0);
    if (total <= WHOLE_DOC_LIMIT) return docs.map((d) => `### ${d.name}\n${d.text}`).join('\n\n');

    const [q] = await embed([`search_query: ${question}`]);
    const qv = unit(q);
    const names = Object.fromEntries(docs.map((d) => [d.id, d.name]));
    const rows = store.all(`SELECT document_id, text, embedding FROM doc_chunks WHERE document_id IN (${docs.map(() => '?').join(',')})`, ...docs.map((d) => d.id));
    return rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, score: dot(qv, fromBlob(r.embedding)) }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, maxChunks)
      .map((r) => `### ${names[r.document_id]} (excerpt)\n${r.text}`).join('\n\n');
  }

  return { add, addText, list, remove, context };
}
```

### src/main/services/study.js

```javascript
// Study tools: quizzes, flashcards and summaries from a topic, a note or a file.
import { complete } from '../brain.js';
import { now } from '../store.js';

const str = { type: 'string' };
const SCHEMAS = {
  quiz: { type: 'object', required: ['title', 'questions'], properties: { title: str, questions: { type: 'array', items: {
    type: 'object', required: ['question', 'options', 'answer', 'explanation'],
    properties: { question: str, options: { type: 'array', items: str }, answer: { type: 'integer' }, explanation: str } } } } },
  flashcards: { type: 'object', required: ['title', 'cards'], properties: { title: str, cards: { type: 'array', items: {
    type: 'object', required: ['front', 'back'], properties: { front: str, back: str } } } } },
  summary: { type: 'object', required: ['title', 'summary', 'key_points'], properties: { title: str, summary: str, key_points: { type: 'array', items: str } } },
};

const ASK = {
  quiz: (n) => `Write a ${n}-question multiple-choice quiz for a college student. Each question has exactly 4 options; "answer" is the 0-based index of the correct option; "explanation" says briefly why it is right. Mix easy and hard questions.`,
  flashcards: (n) => `Write ${n} flashcards for a college student. "front" is a short question or term, "back" is a clear, short answer or definition.`,
  summary: () => 'Write a clear study summary in Markdown ("summary", with headings and bullet points) and 5 to 8 one-line "key_points" to memorise.',
};

/** Drop malformed items so the practice screen never breaks. */
export function cleanItems(kind, data) {
  if (kind === 'quiz') return (data.questions || []).filter((q) => q.question && q.options?.length >= 2 && Number.isInteger(q.answer) && q.answer >= 0 && q.answer < q.options.length);
  if (kind === 'flashcards') return (data.cards || []).filter((c) => c.front && c.back);
  return { summary: data.summary || '', key_points: data.key_points || [] };
}

export function createStudy({ store, docs }) {
  async function create({ kind = 'quiz', topic, note_id, path, text, count = 8 }) {
    if (!SCHEMAS[kind]) throw new Error('kind must be quiz, flashcards or summary');
    let material = '';
    if (note_id) {
      const note = store.row('notes', note_id);
      if (!note) throw new Error(`No note with id ${note_id}`);
      material = `${note.title}\n${note.body}`;
      topic ||= note.title;
    }
    if (path) material = await docs.extractText(path);
    if (text) material = text;
    if (!material && !topic) throw new Error('Give a topic, a note or a file to study from.');

    const source = material ? `Use only this material:\n"""\n${material.slice(0, 12000)}\n"""` : `Topic: ${topic}`;
    const raw = await complete(`${ASK[kind](Math.min(Math.max(count, 3), 20))}\n${source}\nReply as JSON.`, { format: SCHEMAS[kind] });
    const data = JSON.parse(raw);
    const items = cleanItems(kind, data);
    if (Array.isArray(items) && !items.length) throw new Error('The AI could not make that study set. Try again or give more detail.');
    return store.insert('study_sets', { title: data.title || topic || 'Study set', kind, items: JSON.stringify(items), created_at: now() }, `Made ${kind} "${data.title}"`);
  }

  const list = () => store.all(`SELECT s.id, s.title, s.kind, s.created_at,
      (SELECT MAX(score * 100 / total) FROM study_attempts a WHERE a.set_id = s.id) AS best
    FROM study_sets s WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC`);
  const get = (id) => { const s = store.row('study_sets', id); return s && { ...s, items: JSON.parse(s.items) }; };
  const attempt = (setId, score, total) => store.run('INSERT INTO study_attempts (set_id, score, total, created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', setId, score, total, now());

  return { create, list, get, attempt };
}
```

### src/main/services/lectures.js

```javascript
// Lecture recorder: live transcript in 30-second pieces, then study notes written by the smart model.
import { complete } from '../brain.js';
import { MODES } from '../models.js';
import { hasModel } from '../ollama.js';
import { now } from '../store.js';

const PART = 18000; // characters per notes pass; long lectures are summarised part by part first

const NOTES_PROMPT = `Turn this lecture transcript into clear study notes in Markdown:
## Summary (3-5 sentences)
## Key points (bullets)
## Important terms (term: short definition)
## Questions to revise (3-5)
Only use what the lecture says. The transcript comes from speech recognition, so fix obvious mis-heard words.`;

export function createLectures({ store }) {
  const model = async () => ((await hasModel(MODES.smart.model).catch(() => false)) ? MODES.smart.model : MODES.fast.model);

  const start = (title, source) => Number(store.run('INSERT INTO lectures (title, source, started_at) VALUES (?,?,?)',
    title || `Lecture ${new Date().toLocaleString()}`, source, now()).lastInsertRowid);

  function append(id, text) {
    if (!text?.trim()) return;
    store.run("UPDATE lectures SET transcript = trim(transcript || ' ' || ?) WHERE id = ?", text.trim(), id);
  }

  /** Write notes (part by part for long lectures), save them on the lecture and as a note. */
  async function finish(id, minutes) {
    const lecture = store.get('SELECT * FROM lectures WHERE id = ?', id);
    if (!lecture) throw new Error('Lecture not found');
    store.run('UPDATE lectures SET minutes = ? WHERE id = ?', minutes, id);
    if (lecture.transcript.split(/\s+/).length < 20) {
      store.run('UPDATE lectures SET notes = ? WHERE id = ?', '_Too little speech was recorded to write notes._', id);
      return store.get('SELECT * FROM lectures WHERE id = ?', id);
    }
    const m = await model();
    let text = lecture.transcript;
    if (text.length > PART) {
      const parts = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += PART) parts.push(await complete(`Summarise this part of a lecture in detailed bullet points, keeping every fact, term and example:\n\n${text.slice(i, i + PART)}`, { model: m }));
      text = parts.join('\n\n');
    }
    const notes = (await complete(`${NOTES_PROMPT}\n\nLecture: ${lecture.title}\n\n${text}`, { model: m })).trim();
    store.run('UPDATE lectures SET notes = ? WHERE id = ?', notes, id);
    store.run('INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?)', `Lecture notes: ${lecture.title}`, notes, now(), now());
    return store.get('SELECT * FROM lectures WHERE id = ?', id);
  }

  return {
    start, append, finish,
    list: () => store.all('SELECT id, title, source, started_at, minutes, length(transcript) AS chars, notes IS NOT NULL AS has_notes FROM lectures WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC'),
    get: (id) => store.get('SELECT * FROM lectures WHERE id = ?', id),
    remove: (id) => store.run('UPDATE lectures SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = ?', id),
  };
}
```

```javascript
// Timetable, exam countdown, clipboard history, health breaks and live captions.
import { now } from '../store.js';

const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });
export const DAYS = ['sunday', 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday'];
const HHMM = /^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/;
const dateOf = (d) => d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA');

/** Timetable classes as calendar events for every date from..to (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). */
export function classesBetween(store, from, to) {
  const classes = store.all('SELECT * FROM timetable WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY start');
  const out = [];
  for (let d = new Date(`${from}T00:00`); dateOf(d) <= to; d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1)) {
    for (const c of classes.filter((x) => x.day === DAYS[d.getDay()])) {
      out.push({ title: c.subject, start: `${dateOf(d)}T${c.start}`, end: c.end ? `${dateOf(d)}T${c.end}` : null, location: c.room, source: 'Timetable', timetable_id: c.id });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export const daysUntil = (date, today = new Date()) => Math.round((new Date(`${date}T00:00`) - new Date(`${dateOf(today)}T00:00`)) / 864e5);

export const studentTools = [
  {
    name: 'timetable_add',
    description: 'Add weekly classes to the user\'s timetable. Also use to import a timetable from an attached photo or PDF: read it and add every class in one call.',
    parameters: obj({
      classes: { type: 'array', items: obj({ day: { type: 'string', enum: DAYS }, start: str('HH:MM 24-hour'), end: str('HH:MM 24-hour'), subject: str('Subject or class name'), room: str('Room, optional') }, ['day', 'start', 'subject']) },
    }, ['classes']),
    run: ({ classes }, { store }) => {
      const bad = classes.filter((c) => !DAYS.includes(c.day?.toLowerCase()) || !HHMM.test(c.start) || (c.end && !HHMM.test(c.end)));
      if (bad.length) return { error: `Day must be a weekday name and times HH:MM. Check: ${bad.map((c) => `${c.subject} ${c.day} ${c.start}`).join('; ')}` };
      const added = classes.map((c) => store.insert('timetable', { day: c.day.toLowerCase(), start: c.start, end: c.end || null, subject: c.subject, room: c.room || null, created_at: now() }, `Added class ${c.subject}`));
      return { added: added.length };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'timetable_query',
    description: 'The user\'s classes for a weekday (default today), or the whole week.',
    parameters: obj({ day: { type: 'string', enum: [...DAYS, 'week'] } }),
    run: ({ day = DAYS[new Date().getDay()] }, { store }) => (day === 'week'
      ? store.all('SELECT * FROM timetable WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY start')
      : store.all('SELECT * FROM timetable WHERE deleted = 0 AND day = ? ORDER BY start', day)),
  },
  {
    name: 'timetable_delete',
    description: 'Remove one class from the timetable (find the id with timetable_query).',
    parameters: obj({ id: { type: 'integer' } }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => store.update('timetable', id, { deleted: 1 }, `Removed class ${id}`),
  },
  {
    name: 'exams_add',
    description: 'Save an exam (or test/assignment deadline) whenever the user mentions its date, so Maya counts down to it. Returns days_left: tell the user that number (do not count days yourself).',
    parameters: obj({ subject: str('e.g. "DBMS end-sem"'), date: str('YYYY-MM-DD'), notes: str('Syllabus or room, optional') }, ['subject', 'date']),
    run: ({ subject, date, notes }, { store }) => {
      if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)) return { error: 'Date must be YYYY-MM-DD' };
      return { ...store.insert('exams', { subject, date, notes: notes || null, created_at: now() }, `Added exam ${subject}`), days_left: daysUntil(date) };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'exams_query',
    description: 'Upcoming exams the user saved, with how many days are left. If none are saved, carry on with what the user said; do not stop to ask for dates.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => store.all('SELECT * FROM exams WHERE deleted = 0 AND date >= ? ORDER BY date', dateOf(new Date()))
      .map((e) => ({ ...e, days_left: daysUntil(e.date) })),
  },
  {
    name: 'exams_delete',
    description: 'Remove an exam (find the id with exams_query).',
    parameters: obj({ id: { type: 'integer' } }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => store.update('exams', id, { deleted: 1 }, `Removed exam ${id}`),
  },
  {
    name: 'clipboard_history',
    description: 'Text the user copied recently (newest first). Use for "what did I copy earlier", "paste the link I copied before". Passwords are never kept.',
    parameters: obj({ limit: { type: 'integer', description: 'Default 10' } }),
    run: ({ limit = 10 }, { services }) => services.clipboard.list().slice(0, limit),
  },
  {
    name: 'health_settings',
    description: 'Turn health break reminders on or off, or change how often: drink water, 20-20-20 eye breaks, stretch/posture. Minutes 0 turns one off.',
    parameters: obj({ water_minutes: { type: 'integer' }, eyes_minutes: { type: 'integer' }, stretch_minutes: { type: 'integer' } }),
    run: (args, { store }) => {
      const next = { ...store.getSetting('health', HEALTH_DEFAULTS) };
      for (const k of ['water', 'eyes', 'stretch']) if (args[`${k}_minutes`] != null) next[k] = Math.max(0, args[`${k}_minutes`]);
      store.setSetting('health', next);
      return next;
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'head_mouse',
    description: 'Turn hands-free head mouse control on or off: the webcam follows the head to move the cursor; open mouth = click, smile = right-click. For users who cannot use a mouse.',
    parameters: obj({ on: { type: 'boolean' } }, ['on']),
    run: ({ on }, { services }) => services.headMouse.set(on),
  },
  {
    name: 'captions_toggle',
    description: 'Show or hide live captions of the computer\'s sound (videos, online classes, calls), optionally translated to English.',
    parameters: obj({ on: { type: 'boolean' }, translate: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Translate any language into English' } }, ['on']),
    run: ({ on, translate = false }, { services }) => services.captions.set(on, { translate }),
  },
];

export const HEALTH_DEFAULTS = { water: 60, eyes: 20, stretch: 45 };
```

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import Markdown from '../shared/Markdown.jsx';
import { useData, tool, fmtDate } from './useData.js';
import Lectures from './Lectures.jsx';
import Timetable from './Timetable.jsx';

const errText = (e) => e.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
const KINDS = { quiz: '❓ Quiz', flashcards: '🃏 Flashcards', summary: '📄 Summary' };

export default function Study({ version, go }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('sets');
  const sets = useData(() => window.ather.studySets(), version);
  const notes = useData(() => tool('notes_query', {}), version);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ kind: 'quiz', source: 'topic', topic: '', note_id: '', path: '', count: 8 });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  async function create(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const args = { kind: form.kind, count: Number(form.count) };
    if (form.source === 'topic') { if (!form.topic.trim()) return; args.topic = form.topic.trim(); }
    if (form.source === 'note') { if (!form.note_id) return; args.note_id = Number(form.note_id); }
    if (form.source === 'file') { if (!form.path) return; args.path = form.path; }
    setBusy(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const set = await window.ather.createStudy(args);
      setOpen(await window.ather.studySet(set.id));
    } catch (err) { setError(errText(err)); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  if (open) return <Player set={open} onBack={() => setOpen(null)} />;

  const tabs = (
    <div className="tabs" role="tablist">
      <button role="tab" aria-selected={tab === 'sets'} className={`btn small ${tab === 'sets' ? 'primary' : ''}`} onClick={() => setTab('sets')}>❓ Quizzes & flashcards</button>
      <button role="tab" aria-selected={tab === 'lectures'} className={`btn small ${tab === 'lectures' ? 'primary' : ''}`} onClick={() => setTab('lectures')}>🎙 Lectures</button>
      <button role="tab" aria-selected={tab === 'timetable'} className={`btn small ${tab === 'timetable' ? 'primary' : ''}`} onClick={() => setTab('timetable')}>🗓 Timetable & exams</button>
    </div>
  );
  if (tab === 'timetable') {
    return (
      <>
        <h1 className="page-title">Study</h1>
        <p className="page-sub">Your weekly classes and a countdown to every exam. Import a timetable from a photo or PDF.</p>
        {tabs}
        <Timetable version={version} />
      </>
    );
  }
  if (tab === 'lectures') {
    return (
      <>
        <h1 className="page-title">Study</h1>
        <p className="page-sub">Record a class or an online lecture. Maya writes the transcript live, then makes notes, flashcards and a quiz.</p>
        {tabs}
        <Lectures version={version} go={go} />
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">Study</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Turn a topic, a note or a PDF into a quiz, flashcards or a summary. Or ask Maya: “make a quiz on DBMS joins”.</p>
      {tabs}

      <form className="panel" onSubmit={create}>
        <div className="row wrap">
          <select className="input" style={{ width: 160 }} value={form.kind} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, kind: e.target.value })} aria-label="What to make">
            {Object.entries(KINDS).map(([k, l]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{l}</option>)}
          </select>
          <span className="muted">from</span>
          <select className="input" style={{ width: 130 }} value={form.source} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, source: e.target.value })} aria-label="Source">
            <option value="topic">a topic</option><option value="note">a note</option><option value="file">a file</option>
          </select>
          {form.source === 'topic' && <input className="input" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220 }} placeholder="e.g. Operating system scheduling algorithms" value={form.topic} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, topic: e.target.value })} aria-label="Topic" />}
          {form.source === 'note' && (
            <select className="input" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220 }} value={form.note_id} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, note_id: e.target.value })} aria-label="Note">
              <option value="">Choose a note…</option>
              {(notes || []).map((n) => <option key={n.id} value={n.id}>{n.title}</option>)}
            </select>
          )}
          {form.source === 'file' && (
            <button type="button" className="btn" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220, textAlign: 'left' }} onClick={async () => { const p = await window.ather.pickDocument(); if (p) setForm({ ...form, path: p }); }}>
              {form.path ? `📄 ${form.path.split(/[\\/]/).pop()}` : 'Choose a PDF, Word or text file…'}
            </button>
          )}
          {form.kind !== 'summary' && <input className="input" type="number" min="3" max="20" style={{ width: 80 }} value={form.count} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, count: e.target.value })} aria-label="How many" />}
          <button className="btn primary" disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Making…' : 'Make it'}</button>
        </div>
        {busy && <p className="muted">The AI is writing your study set. This takes 10 to 40 seconds.</p>}
        {error && <p className="bad">{error}</p>}
      </form>

      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Your study sets</h2>
        {sets?.length === 0 && <p className="empty">Nothing yet. Make your first quiz above.</p>}
        <ul className="list">
          {(sets || []).map((s) => (
            <li className="item" key={s.id}>
              <span>{KINDS[s.kind].split(' ')[0]}</span>
              <span className="item-title"><b>{s.title}</b> <small className="muted">· {fmtDate(s.created_at)}</small></span>
              {s.best !== null && <span className={`badge ${s.best >= 70 ? '' : 'late'}`}>best {s.best}%</span>}
              <button className="btn small primary" onClick={async () => setOpen(await window.ather.studySet(s.id))}>{s.kind === 'quiz' ? 'Practice' : 'Open'}</button>
              <button className="btn small" onClick={() => window.ather.deleteStudySet(s.id)} aria-label={`Delete ${s.title}`}>✕</button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function Player({ set, onBack }) {
  return (
    <>
      <div className="row"><button className="btn" onClick={onBack}>← Back</button><h1 className="page-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{set.title}</h1></div>
      <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 16, maxWidth: 760 }}>
        {set.kind === 'quiz' && <Quiz set={set} />}
        {set.kind === 'flashcards' && <Cards cards={set.items} />}
        {set.kind === 'summary' && (
          <>
            <Markdown text={set.items.summary} />
            <h2 style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>Key points to remember</h2>
            <ul>{set.items.key_points.map((k, i) => <li key={i}>{k}</li>)}</ul>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

function Quiz({ set }) {
  const questions = set.items;
  const [i, setI] = useState(0);
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState(null);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const q = questions[i];

  function choose(k) {
    if (picked !== null) return;
    setPicked(k);
    if (k === q.answer) setScore((s) => s + 1);
  }
  function next() {
    if (i + 1 < questions.length) { setI(i + 1); setPicked(null); return; }
    setDone(true);
    window.ather.studyAttempt(set.id, score, questions.length);
  }
  const restart = () => { setI(0); setPicked(null); setScore(0); setDone(false); };

  if (done) {
    const pct = Math.round((score / questions.length) * 100);
    return (
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
        <div className="timer">{pct}%</div>
        <p>You got <b>{score}</b> of {questions.length} right. {pct >= 80 ? 'Excellent! 🎉' : pct >= 50 ? 'Good, keep practising 💪' : 'Review the topic and try again 📚'}</p>
        <button className="btn primary" onClick={restart}>Try again</button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      <div className="row"><span className="muted">Question {i + 1} of {questions.length}</span><span className="spacer" /><span className="badge">Score {score}</span></div>
      <div className="progress" style={{ margin: '8px 0 14px' }}><div style={{ width: `${(i / questions.length) * 100}%` }} /></div>
      <h2 style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>{q.question}</h2>
      {q.options.map((o, k) => (
        <button key={k} className={`quiz-option ${picked !== null && k === q.answer ? 'right' : ''} ${picked === k && k !== q.answer ? 'wrong' : ''}`} onClick={() => choose(k)} disabled={picked !== null}>
          {String.fromCharCode(65 + k)}. {o}
        </button>
      ))}
      {picked !== null && (
        <>
          <p className={picked === q.answer ? 'ok' : 'bad'}>{picked === q.answer ? 'Correct!' : `Not quite. The answer is ${String.fromCharCode(65 + q.answer)}.`}</p>
          {q.explanation && <p className="muted">{q.explanation}</p>}
          <button className="btn primary" onClick={next}>{i + 1 < questions.length ? 'Next →' : 'See score'}</button>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function Cards({ cards }) {
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState(() => cards.map((_, k) => k));
  const [flipped, setFlipped] = useState(false);
  const [known, setKnown] = useState(0);
  if (!queue.length) {
    return <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}><p>You know all {cards.length} cards! 🎉</p><button className="btn primary" onClick={() => { setQueue(cards.map((_, k) => k)); setKnown(0); }}>Start again</button></div>;
  }
  const card = cards[queue[0]];
  const answer = (gotIt) => {
    setFlipped(false);
    if (gotIt) setKnown((n) => n + 1);
    setQueue(([first, ...rest]) => (gotIt ? rest : [...rest, first])); // missed cards come back later
  };
  return (
    <>
      <div className="row"><span className="muted">{known} of {cards.length} learned · {queue.length} left</span></div>
      <button className={`flashcard ${flipped ? 'back' : ''}`} onClick={() => setFlipped(!flipped)} aria-label={flipped ? 'Show question' : 'Show answer'} style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
        {flipped ? card.back : card.front}
      </button>
      <p className="muted" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>{flipped ? 'Did you know it?' : 'Click the card to see the answer'}</p>
      {flipped && <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: 'center' }}><button className="btn" onClick={() => answer(false)}>↺ Again</button><button className="btn primary" onClick={() => answer(true)}>✓ I knew it</button></div>}
    </>
  );
}
```
