### src/renderer/app/Lectures.jsx

```jsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Markdown from '../shared/Markdown.jsx';
import { startRecording } from '../shared/audio.js';
import { useData, fmtDate } from './useData.js';

const errText = (e) => e.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
const CHUNK_MS = 30_000;

export default function Lectures({ version, go }) {
  const list = useData(() => window.ather.lectures(), version);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [source, setSource] = useState('mic');
  const [state, setState] = useState('idle'); // idle | recording | finishing
  const [transcript, setTranscript] = useState('');
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const [lecture, setLecture] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(null);
  const rec = useRef(null);
  const chain = useRef(Promise.resolve());
  const idRef = useRef(null);
  const timers = useRef([]);
  const box = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => { box.current?.scrollTo(0, box.current.scrollHeight); }, [transcript]);
  useEffect(() => () => timers.current.forEach(clearInterval), []);

  // Transcribe pieces one after another so the transcript stays in order.
  const transcribe = (audio) => {
    if (audio.length < 16000) return chain.current;
    chain.current = chain.current.then(async () => {
      const text = await window.ather.transcribe(audio).catch(() => '');
      if (!text) return;
      setTranscript((t) => `${t} ${text}`.trim());
      await window.ather.lectureAppend(idRef.current, text);
    });
    return chain.current;
  };

  async function start() {
    setError(null); setLecture(null); setTranscript(''); setElapsed(0);
    try {
      let stream = null;
      if (source === 'computer') {
        const display = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ audio: true, video: true });
        display.getVideoTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        if (!display.getAudioTracks().length) throw new Error('No computer sound was shared.');
        stream = new MediaStream(display.getAudioTracks());
      }
      rec.current = await startRecording(stream);
      idRef.current = await window.ather.lectureStart(title.trim(), source);
      const began = Date.now();
      timers.current = [
        setInterval(() => transcribe(rec.current.take()), CHUNK_MS),
        setInterval(() => setElapsed(Math.floor((Date.now() - began) / 1000)), 1000),
      ];
      setState('recording');
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.name === 'NotAllowedError' ? 'Maya was not allowed to record. Check Windows microphone privacy settings.' : errText(e));
    }
  }

  async function stop() {
    timers.current.forEach(clearInterval);
    setState('finishing');
    await transcribe(await rec.current.stop());
    try {
      setLecture(await window.ather.lectureFinish(idRef.current, Math.round(elapsed / 60)));
    } catch (e) { setError(errText(e)); }
    setState('idle');
  }

  async function study(kind) {
    setBusy(kind);
    try { await window.ather.lectureStudy(lecture.id, kind); go('study'); } catch (e) { setError(errText(e)); } finally { setBusy(null); }
  }
  async function chat() { go(`chat:${await window.ather.lectureChat(lecture.id)}`); }

  const mm = String(Math.floor(elapsed / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
  const ss = String(elapsed % 60).padStart(2, '0');

  return (
    <>
      <div className="panel">
        <h2>🎙 Record a lecture</h2>
        {state === 'idle' && (
          <div className="row wrap">
            <input className="input" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220 }} placeholder="Lecture title, e.g. OS Unit 3: Deadlocks" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} aria-label="Lecture title" />
            <select className="input" style={{ width: 230 }} value={source} onChange={(e) => setSource(e.target.value)} aria-label="Record from">
              <option value="mic">Microphone (class in the room)</option>
              <option value="computer">Computer sound (online class)</option>
            </select>
            <button className="btn primary" onClick={start}>● Start recording</button>
          </div>
        )}
        {state !== 'idle' && (
          <div className="row">
            <span className="rec-dot" aria-hidden /> <b>{state === 'recording' ? `Recording ${mm}:${ss}` : 'Writing your notes…'}</b>
            <span className="spacer" />
            {state === 'recording' && <button className="btn danger" onClick={stop}>■ Stop and make notes</button>}
          </div>
        )}
        {error && <p className="bad">{error}</p>}
        {(state !== 'idle' || transcript) && (
          <div className="transcript" ref={box} aria-live="polite">{transcript || <span className="muted">The transcript appears here every 30 seconds…</span>}</div>
        )}
      </div>

      {lecture?.notes && (
        <div className="panel">
          <div className="row wrap"><h2>📒 {lecture.title}</h2><span className="spacer" />
            <button className="btn small" onClick={() => study('flashcards')} disabled={!!busy}>{busy === 'flashcards' ? 'Making…' : '🃏 Flashcards'}</button>
            <button className="btn small" onClick={() => study('quiz')} disabled={!!busy}>{busy === 'quiz' ? 'Making…' : '❓ Quiz'}</button>
            <button className="btn small primary" onClick={chat}>💬 Ask about it</button>
          </div>
          <Markdown text={lecture.notes} />
          <p className="muted">Also saved in Notes.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Past lectures</h2>
        {!list?.length && <p className="empty">No lectures yet.</p>}
        <ul className="list">
          {(list || []).map((l) => (
            <li className="item" key={l.id}>
              <span className="item-title"><b>{l.title}</b> <small className="muted">· {fmtDate(l.started_at)} · {l.minutes} min · {l.source === 'computer' ? 'computer sound' : 'microphone'}</small></span>
              <button className="btn small" onClick={async () => setLecture(await window.ather.lecture(l.id))} disabled={!l.has_notes}>Open</button>
              <button className="btn small" onClick={() => window.ather.deleteLecture(l.id)} aria-label={`Delete ${l.title}`}>✕</button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### src/renderer/app/Timetable.jsx

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useData, tool } from './useData.js';

const DAYS = ['monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday', 'sunday'];
const errText = (e) => e.message.replace(/^Error invoking remote method '[^']+': (Error: )?/, '');
const cap = (s) => s[0].toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);

/** Days left as words: "today", "tomorrow", "in 12 days". */
export const daysLeft = (n) => (n === 0 ? 'today' : n === 1 ? 'tomorrow' : `in ${n} days`);

export default function Timetable({ version }) {
  const classes = useData(() => tool('timetable_query', { day: 'week' }), version) || [];
  const exams = useData(() => tool('exams_query'), version) || [];
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ day: 'monday', start: '09:00', end: '09:50', subject: '', room: '' });
  const [exam, setExam] = useState({ subject: '', date: '' });
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const todayName = DAYS[(new Date().getDay() + 6) % 7];

  async function importFile(kind) {
    const path = kind === 'image' ? await window.ather.pickImage() : await window.ather.pickDocument();
    if (!path) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(null);
    try { setPreview(await window.ather.importTimetable(path)); } catch (e) { setError(errText(e)); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  async function add(list) {
    const r = await tool('timetable_add', { classes: list });
    if (r.error) setError(r.error); else { setPreview(null); setForm({ ...form, subject: '', room: '' }); }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="panel">
        <div className="row"><h2>Exam countdown</h2></div>
        {!exams.length && <p className="empty">No exams added. Add one below or tell Maya “my DBMS exam is on 14 December”.</p>}
        <div className="exam-grid">
          {exams.map((e) => (
            <div className={`exam ${e.days_left <= 7 ? 'soon' : ''}`} key={e.id}>
              <div className="exam-days">{e.days_left}</div>
              <div className="exam-label">{e.days_left === 1 ? 'day' : 'days'} left</div>
              <b>{e.subject}</b>
              <small className="muted">{new Date(`${e.date}T00:00`).toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })}</small>
              <button className="btn small" onClick={() => tool('exams_delete', { id: e.id })} aria-label={`Remove ${e.subject}`}>✕</button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <form className="row wrap" style={{ marginTop: 10 }} onSubmit={(ev) => { ev.preventDefault(); if (exam.subject && exam.date) tool('exams_add', exam).then(() => setExam({ subject: '', date: '' })); }}>
          <input className="input" style={{ flex: 2 }} placeholder="Exam, e.g. DBMS end-sem" value={exam.subject} onChange={(e) => setExam({ ...exam, subject: e.target.value })} aria-label="Exam name" />
          <input className="input" style={{ width: 170 }} type="date" value={exam.date} onChange={(e) => setExam({ ...exam, date: e.target.value })} aria-label="Exam date" />
          <button className="btn primary" disabled={!exam.subject || !exam.date}>Add exam</button>
        </form>
      </div>

      <div className="panel">
        <div className="row wrap"><h2>Weekly timetable</h2><span className="spacer" />
          <button className="btn small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => importFile('image')}>📷 From photo</button>
          <button className="btn small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => importFile('doc')}>📄 From PDF</button></div>
        <p className="muted">Classes show on Home and in your briefing, and Maya reminds you 10 minutes before each one.</p>
        {busy && <p className="muted">Reading your timetable…</p>}
        {error && <p className="bad">{error}</p>}
        {preview && (
          <div className="wf-detail" style={{ whiteSpace: 'normal' }}>
            <b>Found {preview.length} classes. Check them, then add:</b>
            <ul className="list">
              {preview.map((c, i) => (
                <li className="item" key={i}><span className="item-title">{cap(c.day)} {c.start}–{c.end} <b>{c.subject}</b> {c.room}</span>
                  <button className="btn small" onClick={() => setPreview(preview.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} aria-label="Leave out">✕</button></li>
              ))}
            </ul>
            <div className="row"><button className="btn primary" disabled={!preview.length} onClick={() => add(preview)}>Add {preview.length} classes</button>
              <button className="btn" onClick={() => setPreview(null)}>Discard</button></div>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="timetable">
          {DAYS.filter((d) => d !== 'sunday' || classes.some((c) => c.day === 'sunday')).map((d) => (
            <div className={`tt-day ${d === todayName ? 'today' : ''}`} key={d}>
              <h3>{cap(d).slice(0, 3)}</h3>
              {classes.filter((c) => c.day === d).map((c) => (
                <div className="tt-class" key={c.id} title={c.room || ''}>
                  <small>{c.start}{c.end ? `–${c.end}` : ''}</small><b>{c.subject}</b>{c.room && <small>{c.room}</small>}
                  <button className="tt-x" onClick={() => tool('timetable_delete', { id: c.id })} aria-label={`Remove ${c.subject} on ${d}`}>✕</button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <form className="row wrap" style={{ marginTop: 12 }} onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (form.subject) add([form]); }}>
          <select className="input" style={{ width: 130 }} value={form.day} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, day: e.target.value })} aria-label="Day">
            {DAYS.map((d) => <option key={d} value={d}>{cap(d)}</option>)}
          </select>
          <input className="input" style={{ width: 110 }} type="time" value={form.start} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, start: e.target.value })} aria-label="Starts" />
          <input className="input" style={{ width: 110 }} type="time" value={form.end} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, end: e.target.value })} aria-label="Ends" />
          <input className="input" style={{ flex: 2 }} placeholder="Subject" value={form.subject} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, subject: e.target.value })} aria-label="Subject" />
          <input className="input" style={{ flex: 1 }} placeholder="Room" value={form.room} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, room: e.target.value })} aria-label="Room" />
          <button className="btn primary" disabled={!form.subject}>Add class</button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### src/main/tools/assistant.js

```javascript
import { now } from '../store.js';

const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });

// Passwords, PINs, OTPs, API keys/tokens and card numbers must never be stored.
export const SECRET = /\b(password|passwd|pwd|passcode|pin|otp|cvv|api[ -]?key|secret|token)\b.{0,12}(is|:|=)|\b(sk-|ghp_|gho_|github_pat_|xox[bp]-|AKIA)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}|\b(?:\d[ -]?){13,19}\b/i;
const normalize = (s) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9 ]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
/** Share of the shorter fact's words that also appear in the other (0..1). */
const overlap = (a, b) => {
  const wa = new Set(a.split(' ').filter((w) => w.length > 2)), wb = new Set(b.split(' ').filter((w) => w.length > 2));
  const small = wa.size < wb.size ? wa : wb, big = small === wa ? wb : wa;
  return small.size ? [...small].filter((w) => big.has(w)).length / small.size : 0;
};
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });

// Memory, screen and study tools. ctx.services supplies screen and study.
export const assistantTools = [
  {
    name: 'memory_save',
    description: 'Remember a lasting fact for future chats: a user preference ("likes short answers"), a project detail ("Maya uses Electron"), or a fact ("exam on 14 Dec"). One short fact per call. Never passwords, keys or codes. Not for changing Maya itself (its name, voice, speaking speed, rules) or the screens: use persona_set / ui_set, which really change them.',
    parameters: obj({ fact: str('The fact in third person, e.g. "Studies CSE at VIT, 3rd year"'), category: { type: 'string', enum: ['preference', 'project', 'fact'] } }, ['fact']),
    run: ({ fact, category = 'fact' }, { store }) => {
      if (SECRET.test(fact)) return { refused: 'That looks like a password, key or code. Maya never stores secrets.' };
      const norm = normalize(fact);
      const existing = store.all('SELECT id, fact FROM memories WHERE deleted = 0');
      const same = existing.find((m) => normalize(m.fact) === norm || normalize(m.fact).includes(norm));
      if (same) return { already_known: same.fact };
      // A newer version of an old fact ("exam on 14 Dec" → "exam on 16 Dec") updates it instead of piling up.
      const older = existing.find((m) => overlap(normalize(m.fact), norm) >= 0.6);
      if (older) return store.update('memories', older.id, { fact, category, updated_at: now() }, `Updated memory "${fact}"`);
      return store.insert('memories', { fact, category, created_at: now(), updated_at: now() }, `Remembered "${fact}"`);
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'memory_list',
    description: 'List what Maya remembers about the user, by category.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store }) => store.all('SELECT id, fact, category, updated_at FROM memories WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY category, id'),
  },
  {
    name: 'memory_update',
    description: 'Correct a remembered fact (find its id with memory_list).',
    parameters: obj({ id: { type: 'integer' }, fact: str('Corrected fact'), category: { type: 'string', enum: ['preference', 'project', 'fact'] } }, ['id', 'fact']),
    run: ({ id, fact, category }, { store }) => {
      if (SECRET.test(fact)) return { refused: 'Maya never stores secrets.' };
      return store.update('memories', id, { fact, category, updated_at: now() }, `Updated memory ${id}`);
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'memory_forget',
    description: 'Forget a remembered fact (find its id with memory_list).',
    parameters: obj({ id: { type: 'integer' } }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => store.update('memories', id, { deleted: 1 }, `Forgot memory ${id}`),
  },
  {
    name: 'screen_look',
    description: 'Take a screenshot of the user\'s screen and look at it. Use for "what\'s on my screen", "explain this error on my screen", "help me with what I\'m looking at".',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: async (_, { services }) => ({ captured: true, attachImage: await services.screen.capture() }),
  },
  {
    name: 'study_create',
    description: 'Make a study set: a multiple-choice quiz, flashcards or a summary, from a topic or from one of the user\'s notes. It appears in the Study section.',
    parameters: obj({ kind: { type: 'string', enum: ['quiz', 'flashcards', 'summary'] }, topic: str('Topic, e.g. "DBMS normalization"'),
      note_id: { type: 'integer', description: 'Use this note as the material (find it with notes_query)' }, count: { type: 'integer', description: 'Number of questions or cards, default 8' } }, ['kind']),
    run: async (args, { services }) => {
      const set = await services.study.create(args);
      return { id: set.id, title: set.title, kind: set.kind, items: JSON.parse(set.items).length ?? 1 };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'study_list',
    description: 'List the user\'s study sets (quizzes, flashcards, summaries) with best quiz scores.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { services }) => services.study.list(),
  },
];
```

```javascript
  {
    name: 'mail_archive',
    description: 'Move emails out of the inbox into the archive (not deleted). The user must allow it.',
    parameters: obj({ uids: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'number' } } }, ['uids']),
    confirm: true,
    run: ({ uids }, { services }) => services.mail.archive(uids),
  },
  {
    name: 'mail_add_tasks',
    description: 'Add the to-dos, deadlines and meetings found in an email to tasks, reminders or the calendar. The user must allow it.',
    parameters: obj({ items: { type: 'array', items: obj({ kind: { type: 'string', enum: ['task', 'reminder', 'event'] }, title: str('What'), when: str('Local ISO date-time, optional for tasks') }, ['kind', 'title']) } }, ['items']),
    confirm: true,
    run: ({ items }, { store }) => items.map(({ kind, title, when }) => {
      if (kind === 'event' && when) return store.insert('events', { title, start: when, created_at: now() }, `Added event "${title}"`);
      if (kind === 'reminder' && when) return store.insert('reminders', { text: title, at: when, created_at: now() }, `Set reminder "${title}"`);
      return store.insert('tasks', { title, due: when, priority: 'normal', created_at: now() }, `Added task "${title}"`);
    }),
  },
  {
    name: 'mail_follow_up',
    description: 'Use for "remind me if X doesn\'t reply (by a date)" / "follow up if no answer". Watches the inbox: tells the user when X replies, or on that date (if no reply) reminds them and adds a task. No need to read emails first.',
    parameters: obj({ from: str('Their name or email address'), subject: str('What it is about, optional'), by: str('Local ISO date-time to wait until') }, ['from', 'by']),
    run: (args, { store }) => addFollowUp(store, args),
  },
  {
    name: 'ai_ask',
    description: 'Ask ChatGPT or Claude (in the user\'s browser, their own account) and get its answer, e.g. "ask ChatGPT to write a poem", "ask Claude about my essay". site both = ask both and compare. Read the answer to the user, saying which one answered.',
    parameters: obj({ site: { type: 'string', enum: ['chatgpt', 'claude', 'both'] }, prompt: str('Exactly what to ask, in the user\'s words') }, ['site', 'prompt']),
    run: async ({ site, prompt }, { services }) => {
      const ask = (s) => askChatbot({ pc: services.pc, open: (u) => (services.pc?.openUrl ? services.pc.openUrl(u) : services.openExternal(u)), site: s, prompt });
      if (site !== 'both') return ask(site);
      return { chatgpt: await ask('chatgpt'), claude: await ask('claude'), note: 'Compare the two answers briefly for the user.' };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'report_weekly',
    description: 'Make the weekly work report now (Word document): tasks done and open, next week\'s events, follow-ups, emails waiting, focus time. Maya also makes it every Friday evening.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { store, services }) => weeklyReport({ store, files: services.files }),
  },
  {
    name: 'personality_set',
    description: `Change how Maya talks. Built-in: ${Object.entries(personalities).map(([id, p]) => `${id} (${p.label})`).join(', ')}; the user may also have custom ones (pass their name).`,
    parameters: obj({ id: str('Personality id or name') }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => {
      const all = allPersonalities(store.getSetting('customPersonalities', []));
      const key = all[id] ? id : Object.keys(all).find((k) => all[k].label.toLowerCase() === String(id).toLowerCase());
      if (!key) return { error: `No personality called ${id}. Options: ${Object.values(all).map((p) => p.label).join(', ')}` };
      store.setSetting('personality', key);
      return { personality: all[key].label };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'animations_play',
    description: 'Play a face animation on Maya: happy, wave, love, think, surprised, sleepy, celebrate. Useful for agents to signal "done".',
    parameters: obj({ name: { type: 'string', enum: ['happy', 'wave', 'love', 'think', 'surprised', 'sleepy', 'celebrate'] }, message: str('Optional short text to show') }, ['name']),
    run: ({ name, message }, { services }) => { services.face.play(name, message); return { played: name }; },
  },
];
```

### src/main/services/web.js

```javascript
const UA = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140 Safari/537.36';

const decode = (s) => s.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&#x27;|&#39;/g, "'")
  .replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>').replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ').trim();

/** Top web results from DuckDuckGo's HTML page: [{ title, url, snippet }]. */
export async function webSearch(query, limit = 6) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`, { headers: { 'User-Agent': UA } });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Web search failed (${res.status})`);
  const html = await res.text();
  const links = [...html.matchAll(/class="result__a" href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/g)];
  const snippets = [...html.matchAll(/class="result__snippet"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/g)];
  return links.slice(0, limit).map((m, i) => {
    const raw = decode(m[1]);
    const url = raw.includes('uddg=') ? decodeURIComponent(raw.split('uddg=')[1].split('&')[0]) : raw;
    return { title: decode(m[2]), url, snippet: decode(snippets[i]?.[1] || '') };
  });
}

/** Readable text of a web page, trimmed for the AI. */
export async function readPage(url, maxChars = 6000) {
  if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)) throw new Error('Only http(s) pages can be read');
  const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': UA }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Could not open the page (${res.status})`);
  const html = await res.text();
  const title = decode(html.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i)?.[1] || url);
  const body = html
    .replace(/<(script|style|noscript|svg|nav|footer|header)[\s\S]*?<\/\1>/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/<\/(p|div|li|h\d|br|tr)>/gi, '\n');
  const text = decode(body).replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\n\s*\n+/g, '\n').trim();
  return { title, url, text: text.slice(0, maxChars) };
}
```

### src/main/services/search.js

```javascript
// Smart search: "find my photo of the beach", "the note about DBMS", "my resume file".
// Text files and notes use nomic-embed-text (Ollama); photos use CLIP (ML worker).
import { readdirSync, statSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, extname, basename } from 'node:path';
import { embed } from '../ollama.js';

const TEXT = new Set(['.txt', '.md', '.csv', '.json', '.html', '.js', '.py', '.java', '.c', '.cpp', '.ts', '.log', '.xml', '.yml', '.sql']);
const IMAGE = new Set(['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.webp', '.bmp']);
const OTHER = new Set(['.pdf', '.docx', '.pptx', '.xlsx', '.doc', '.ppt', '.xls', '.zip', '.mp4', '.mp3']);
const MAX_FILES = 5000;

const toBlob = (v) => Buffer.from(new Float32Array(v).buffer);
const fromBlob = (b) => new Float32Array(b.buffer, b.byteOffset, b.byteLength / 4);
const cosine = (a, b) => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) s += a[i] * b[i]; return s; };
const unit = (v) => { const n = Math.hypot(...v) || 1; return v.map((x) => x / n); };

function* walk(dir, depth = 0) {
  if (depth > 6) return;
  let entries;
  try { entries = readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }
  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.name.startsWith('.') || e.name === 'node_modules' || e.name === 'AppData') continue;
    const full = join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) yield* walk(full, depth + 1);
    else yield full;
  }
}

export function createSearch({ store, ml }) {
  /** Index (or refresh) the chosen folders. onProgress(done, total). */
  async function index(folders, onProgress = () => {}) {
    const files = [];
    for (const f of folders) for (const file of walk(f)) {
      const ext = extname(file).toLowerCase();
      if (TEXT.has(ext) || IMAGE.has(ext) || OTHER.has(ext)) files.push(file);
      if (files.length >= MAX_FILES) break;
    }
    let done = 0;
    for (const file of files) {
      onProgress(done++, files.length);
      let mtime;
      try { mtime = statSync(file).mtimeMs; } catch { continue; }
      const old = store.get('SELECT mtime FROM search_index WHERE path = ?', file);
      if (old && old.mtime === mtime) continue;
      const ext = extname(file).toLowerCase();
      try {
        let kind, text, vector;
        if (IMAGE.has(ext)) {
          kind = 'image'; text = basename(file); vector = await ml.call('clipImage', file);
        } else {
          kind = TEXT.has(ext) ? 'text' : 'file';
          const content = TEXT.has(ext) ? readFileSync(file, 'utf8').slice(0, 2000) : '';
          text = `${basename(file)}\n${content}`;
          [vector] = await embed([`search_document: ${text}`]);
        }
        store.run('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO search_index (path, kind, mtime, text, embedding) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)',
          file, kind, mtime, text.slice(0, 500), toBlob(unit(vector)));
      } catch { /* unreadable file: skip it, keep indexing the rest */ }
    }
    onProgress(files.length, files.length);
    return { indexed: files.length };
  }

  /** Best matches across files, photos and notes. */
  async function query(q, limit = 8) {
    const [textVec] = await embed([`search_query: ${q}`]);
    const tq = unit(textVec);
    let iq = null;
    try { iq = await ml.call('clipText', q); } catch { /* photo model not ready: text results only */ }

    const results = store.all('SELECT path, kind, text, embedding FROM search_index').map((r) => {
      const v = fromBlob(r.embedding);
      // CLIP text-image similarity is on a smaller scale than text-text, so lift it to compare fairly.
      const score = r.kind === 'image' ? (iq ? cosine(iq, v) * 2.5 : 0) : cosine(tq, v);
      return { path: r.path, kind: r.kind, preview: r.text.slice(0, 160), score };
    });

    const notes = store.all('SELECT id, title, body FROM notes WHERE deleted = 0');
    if (notes.length) {
      const vecs = await embed(notes.map((n) => `search_document: ${n.title}\n${n.body}`.slice(0, 2000)));
      notes.forEach((n, i) => results.push({ note_id: n.id, kind: 'note', preview: `${n.title}: ${n.body}`.slice(0, 160), score: cosine(tq, unit(vecs[i])) }));
    }
    return results.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, limit).map((r) => ({ ...r, score: Math.round(r.score * 100) / 100 }));
  }

  const stats = () => store.all('SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS n FROM search_index GROUP BY kind');
  return { index, query, stats };
}
```

### src/main/services/clipboard.js

```javascript
// Recent copied text, kept in memory only (never written to disk). Passwords and anything a password
// manager marks as private are skipped. Electron 45's clipboard is async, so reads are awaited.
import { SECRET } from '../tools/assistant.js';

// Windows formats password managers set so clipboard history tools ignore the copy.
const PRIVATE_FORMATS = ['ExcludeClipboardContentFromMonitorProcessing'];
/** One "word" of 8-64 chars mixing 3+ of upper/lower/digit/symbol looks like a password. */
export const looksLikePassword = (t) => !/\s/.test(t) && t.length >= 8 && t.length <= 64 && !/^https?:/.test(t)
  && [/[a-z]/, /[A-Z]/, /\d/, /[^A-Za-z0-9]/].filter((r) => r.test(t)).length >= 3;

export function createClipboardHistory({ clipboard, max = 40, every = 1000, enabled = () => true }) {
  let items = [];
  let last = null;
  let timer = null;
  const isPrivate = async () => (await Promise.all(PRIVATE_FORMATS.map((f) => clipboard.has(f)))).some(Boolean);

  async function check() {
    if (!enabled()) { items = []; return; }
    const text = await clipboard.readText();
    if (!text || text === last) return;
    last = text;
    if (await isPrivate() || SECRET.test(text) || looksLikePassword(text.trim()) || text.length > 20_000) return;
    items = [{ text, at: new Date().toISOString() }, ...items.filter((i) => i.text !== text)].slice(0, max);
  }

  return {
    check,
    start() { timer ??= setInterval(() => check().catch(() => {}), every); },
    stop() { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; },
    list: () => items,
    clear() { items = []; return true; },
  };
}
```

### src/main/services/health.js

```javascript
// Health breaks: water, 20-20-20 eye breaks and stretching, counted only in minutes the user is actually
// at the computer (idle time resets nothing but does not count).
import { HEALTH_DEFAULTS } from '../tools/student.js';

const MESSAGES = {
  water: ['Water break 💧', 'Time for a glass of water.'],
  eyes: ['Eye break 👀', 'Look at something 20 feet (6 m) away for 20 seconds.'],
  stretch: ['Stretch break 🧘', 'Stand up, roll your shoulders and straighten your back.'],
};

/** Call tick() once a minute. notify(title, body, kind) shows the nudge. */
export function createHealth({ store, idleSeconds, notify, quiet = () => false }) {
  const active = { water: 0, eyes: 0, stretch: 0 };
  return {
    tick() {
      if (idleSeconds() > 120) return; // away from the PC: nothing to count
      const every = store.getSetting('health', HEALTH_DEFAULTS);
      for (const kind of Object.keys(active)) {
        if (!every[kind]) continue;
        active[kind] += 1;
        if (active[kind] < every[kind]) continue;
        active[kind] = 0;
        if (!quiet()) notify(...MESSAGES[kind], 'health');
      }
    },
  };
}
```

```jsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { fileUrl } from '../shared/audio.js';
import { useData } from './useData.js';

export default function Search({ version }) {
  const [folders, setFolders] = useState([]);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(null);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const stats = useData(() => window.ather.searchStats(), version, [progress?.done === progress?.total]);

  useEffect(() => {
    window.ather.getSetting('searchFolders', []).then(setFolders);
    return window.ather.onSearchProgress(setProgress);
  }, []);

  const saveFolders = (list) => { setFolders(list); window.ather.setSetting('searchFolders', list); };
  async function addFolder() {
    const f = await window.ather.pickFolder();
    if (f && !folders.includes(f)) saveFolders([...folders, f]);
  }
  async function index() {
    setProgress({ done: 0, total: 1 });
    await window.ather.indexFolders(folders);
  }
  async function find(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!query.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try { setResults(await window.ather.tool('files_search', { query })); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  const indexing = progress && progress.done < progress.total;
  const count = (kind) => stats?.find((s) => s.kind === kind)?.n || 0;

  return (
    <>
      <h1 className="page-title">Smart search</h1>
      <p className="page-sub">Find photos, notes and files by just asking: “my photo at the beach”, “the PDF about operating systems”.</p>

      <form className="panel row" onSubmit={find}>
        <input className="input" placeholder="Describe what you're looking for…" value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} aria-label="Search" />
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={busy}>{busy ? 'Searching…' : 'Search'}</button>
      </form>

      {results && (
        <div className="panel">
          {results.length === 0 && <p className="empty">Nothing found. Add folders below and index them first.</p>}
          <div className="grid">
            {results.map((r, i) => (
              <button key={i} className="panel" style={{ textAlign: 'left' }} onClick={() => (r.path ? window.ather.openPath(r.path) : null)}>
                {r.kind === 'image' && <img src={fileUrl(r.path)} alt="" style={{ width: '100%', height: 140, objectFit: 'cover', borderRadius: 10 }} />}
                <div><b>{r.kind === 'note' ? '📝 Note' : r.path.split(/[\\/]/).pop()}</b></div>
                <small className="muted">{r.kind === 'note' ? r.preview : r.path}</small>
                <div><span className="badge">match {Math.round(r.score * 100)}%</span></div>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="panel">
        <h2>Folders Maya can search</h2>
        <p className="muted">Indexed: {count('image')} photos, {count('text')} text files, {count('file')} other files. Notes are always included.</p>
        <ul className="list">
          {folders.map((f) => (
            <li className="item" key={f}><span className="item-title">📁 {f}</span>
              <button className="btn small" onClick={() => saveFolders(folders.filter((x) => x !== f))} aria-label={`Remove ${f}`}>✕</button></li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
          <button className="btn" onClick={addFolder}>Add folder…</button>
          <button className="btn primary" onClick={index} disabled={!folders.length || indexing}>{indexing ? 'Indexing…' : 'Index now'}</button>
          {indexing && <div className="progress" style={{ flex: 1 }}><div style={{ width: `${(progress.done / progress.total) * 100}%` }} /></div>}
          {indexing && <small className="muted">{progress.done}/{progress.total}</small>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

// Fullscreen frozen screenshot: drag a box to send that part to Maya, Esc to cancel.
function Snip() {
  const [image, setImage] = useState(null);
  const [start, setStart] = useState(null);
  const [rect, setRect] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const off = window.ather.onSnipImage(setImage);
    const onKey = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') window.ather.snipDone(null); };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => { off(); window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); };
  }, []);

  const box = (a, b) => ({ x: Math.min(a.x, b.x), y: Math.min(a.y, b.y), width: Math.abs(a.x - b.x), height: Math.abs(a.y - b.y) });
  const down = (e) => { setStart({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }); setRect(null); };
  const move = (e) => { if (start) setRect(box(start, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY })); };
  const up = (e) => {
    if (!start) return;
    const r = box(start, { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
    setStart(null);
    if (r.width > 8 && r.height > 8) window.ather.snipDone(r);
  };

  return (
    <div onMouseDown={down} onMouseMove={move} onMouseUp={up}
      style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: image ? `url(${image}) 0 0 / 100% 100% no-repeat` : '#000' }}>
      <div style={{ position: 'fixed', inset: 0, background: 'rgba(10,8,30,.45)', clipPath: rect ? `polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 0 0, ${rect.x}px ${rect.y}px, ${rect.x}px ${rect.y + rect.height}px, ${rect.x + rect.width}px ${rect.y + rect.height}px, ${rect.x + rect.width}px ${rect.y}px, ${rect.x}px ${rect.y}px)` : 'none' }} />
      {rect && <div style={{ position: 'fixed', left: rect.x, top: rect.y, width: rect.width, height: rect.height, border: '2px solid #8b7dff', boxShadow: '0 0 0 1px #fff' }} />}
      <div style={{ position: 'fixed', top: 18, left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', background: '#1d1638', color: '#fff', padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: 999, font: '14px Segoe UI' }}>
        Drag a box around what you want to ask about · Esc to cancel
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<Snip />);
```

### src/renderer/captions.jsx

```jsx
// Live captions of the computer's sound (videos, online classes, calls), optionally translated to English.
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { startRecording } from './shared/audio.js';

const translate = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('translate') === '1';
const CHUNK_MS = 4000;
// Whisper invents these on silence or music.
const NOISE = /^\s*(\[.*\]|\(.*\)|♪.*|thank you\.?|thanks for watching!?|you|\.+)\s*$/i;
const rms = (pcm) => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < pcm.length; i += 8) s += pcm[i] * pcm[i]; return Math.sqrt(s / Math.max(1, pcm.length / 8)); };

function Captions() {
  const [lines, setLines] = useState([]);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('Listening to your computer…');

  useEffect(() => {
    let rec, timer, busy = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        // Maya's display-media handler answers with the screen plus Windows loopback sound (video is dropped).
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ audio: true, video: true });
        stream.getVideoTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
        rec = await startRecording(new MediaStream(stream.getAudioTracks()));
        timer = setInterval(async () => {
          if (busy) return; // audio keeps collecting until the last chunk is done
          const pcm = rec.take();
          if (rms(pcm) < 0.004) return;
          busy = true;
          try {
            const text = await window.ather.captionsTranscribe(pcm, translate);
            if (text && !NOISE.test(text)) { setLines((l) => [...l, text].slice(-2)); setStatus(null); }
          } catch (e) { setStatus(e.message); } finally { busy = false; }
        }, CHUNK_MS);
      } catch (e) {
        setStatus(`Could not hear the computer sound: ${e.message}`);
      }
    })();
    return () => { clearInterval(timer); rec?.stop(); };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="cap" role="log" aria-live="polite">
      {translate && <span className="tag">TRANSLATING TO ENGLISH</span>}
      <button className="x" onClick={() => window.ather.captionsSet(false)} aria-label="Close captions">✕</button>
      {status && <p className="status">{status}</p>}
      {lines.map((l, i) => <p key={i} className={i === lines.length - 1 ? 'now' : ''}>{l}</p>)}
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<Captions />);
```

### src/main/tools/everyday.js

```javascript
// Everyday voice actions (as on heynixi.app): point at things on screen, write at the cursor, teleprompter,
// timers, named lists, Windows dark mode and playing music. ctx.services provides the PC, windows and AI.
import { now } from '../store.js';
import { matchApp } from '../services/pc.js';
import { INTERPRETER_LANGUAGES } from '../services/interpreter.js';
import { KINDS, findAccessible } from '../services/places.js';

const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const SELF = /^(Ather|Maya|electron)$/i;

/** Brings back the app the user was working in (asking Maya can put Maya in front). */
async function userApp(services) {
  const fg = await services.pc.foreground();
  const last = services.computer?.lastExternal?.();
  if (SELF.test(fg.process) && last) { await services.pc.activate(last.hwnd); await sleep(350); return last; }
  return fg;
}

/** "top left", "bottom right", "middle"… for a point on the screen. Exported for tests. */
export function whereOnScreen({ x, y }, b) {
  const col = ['left', 'middle', 'right'][Math.min(2, Math.floor(((x - b.x) / b.width) * 3))];
  const row = ['top', 'middle', 'bottom'][Math.min(2, Math.floor(((y - b.y) / b.height) * 3))];
  return row === 'middle' && col === 'middle' ? 'in the middle' : row === 'middle' ? `on the ${col}` : col === 'middle' ? `at the ${row}` : `at the ${row} ${col}`;
}

/** First YouTube video id in a search results page. Exported for tests. */
export const firstVideoId = (html) => /"videoId":"([\w-]{11})"/.exec(html)?.[1] ?? null;

export const everydayTools = [
  {
    name: 'places_accessible',
    description: 'Find wheelchair-accessible places near a town or area (hospital, pharmacy, accessible toilets, restaurant…) from OpenStreetMap. '
      + 'Accessible ones come first. Read out the top 3 with distance and access; say "unknown" places should be called first.',
    parameters: obj({
      kind: { type: 'string', enum: Object.keys(KINDS), description: 'Kind of place' },
      near: str('Town, city or area. Leave empty for the user\'s saved city.'),
      radius_km: { type: 'number', description: 'Search radius in km (default 3, at most 10)' },
    }, ['kind']),
    run: async ({ kind, near, radius_km }, { store, services }) => {
      const where = String(near || '').trim() || store.getSetting('city', '');
      if (!where) return { ask_user: 'Ask the user which town or area to search near (they can also save their city in Settings).' };
      return findAccessible({ kind, near: where, radiusKm: radius_km }, { fetchFn: services?.fetch || fetch });
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'screen_point',
    description: 'Show the user where something is in the window they are using: "where is the Save button?", "where do I click to attach?". Draws an arrow at it on screen.',
    parameters: obj({ target: str('What to find, e.g. "Save", "attach", "search box"') }, ['target']),
    run: async ({ target }, { services }) => {
      const app = await userApp(services);
      const elements = await services.pc.elements();
      const name = matchApp(target, elements.map((e) => e.name).filter(Boolean));
      const hit = name && elements.find((e) => e.name === name);
      if (!hit) return { found: false, window: app.title, note: 'It is not a named control here. Use screen_look to see the screen and describe where it is.' };
      services.point({ x: hit.x, y: hit.y, w: hit.w, h: hit.h, label: hit.name });
      return { found: true, name: hit.name, kind: hit.type, where: whereOnScreen(hit, services.screen.bounds()), shown: 'An arrow points at it for 6 seconds.' };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'write_here',
    description: 'Write something (a reply, email, note, post, message) and type it where the user\'s cursor is, in the app they are working in. Use for "write a reply saying…", "write a thank-you note to Sam". Not for sending, and not when an email address is given (that is mail_send).',
    parameters: obj({ instruction: str('What to write, with any details the user gave') }, ['instruction']),
    run: async ({ instruction }, { store, services }) => {
      // "In your own voice": the user's recent messages show how they write.
      const samples = store.all("SELECT content FROM messages WHERE role = 'user' AND length(content) BETWEEN 25 AND 400 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 8").map((m) => `- ${m.content}`).join('\n');
      const prefs = store.all("SELECT fact FROM memories WHERE deleted = 0 AND category = 'preference'").map((m) => m.fact).join('; ');
      const text = (await services.complete(`Write this for the user: ${instruction}\n\nWrite it as the user, in their own simple, natural style${samples ? `. How they write:\n${samples}` : ''}${prefs ? `\nTheir preferences: ${prefs}` : ''}\n\nReply with only the text to type: no title, no quotes, no notes.`)).trim();
      const app = await userApp(services);
      await services.pasteText(text);
      return { typed: true, into: app.title || app.app, text };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'camera_look',
    description: 'Look through the webcam and describe what is in front of the user: "what\'s in front of me?", "what am I holding?", "what colour is this shirt?", "is the light on?". For people who cannot see well.',
    parameters: obj({ question: str('What the user wants to know, optional') }),
    run: async ({ question }, { services }) => ({
      photo: 'taken just now with the webcam (not saved)',
      how: `Describe it simply and briefly, most important thing first${question ? `, answering: ${question}` : ''}. Say if the picture is too dark or blurry.`,
      attachImage: await services.camera(),
    }),
  },
  {
    name: 'camera_read',
    description: 'Read printed text the user holds up to the webcam: a letter, notice, bill, book page, medicine label, card. Read the text to them.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: async (_, { services }) => {
      const photo = await services.camera();
      const text = (await services.ocr(photo)).replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
      // Too little text found: the AI looks at the photo instead (handwriting, curved labels).
      if (text.split(/\s+/).length < 4) return { text: '', note: 'Little printed text found; read what you can see in the photo, or ask the user to hold it closer and steady.', attachImage: photo };
      return { text: text.slice(0, 4000), how: 'Read this text to the user as it is (fix obvious OCR mistakes only). Medicine labels: read name, dose and warnings first.' };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'interpreter',
    description: 'Start (or stop) interpreter mode: the user and another person talk, and Maya says each sentence aloud in the other language (English ↔ Tamil, Hindi…). "be my interpreter in Tamil", "translate my conversation with him".',
    parameters: obj({ on: { type: 'boolean' }, language: { type: 'string', enum: Object.keys(INTERPRETER_LANGUAGES), description: 'The other language (besides English)' } }, ['on']),
    run: ({ on, language = 'ta' }, { services }) => {
      services.interpreter(on ? language : null);
      return on ? { on: true, language: INTERPRETER_LANGUAGES[language], how: 'Started. Each person just talks; say "stop" to end.' } : { on: false };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'teleprompter',
    description: 'Start (or stop) a teleprompter that scrolls with the user\'s voice while they read a script aloud. Uses the copied text unless a script is given.',
    parameters: obj({ on: { type: 'boolean', description: 'false to close it' }, script: str('Script text (optional; default: the clipboard)') }),
    run: async ({ on = true, script }, { services }) => services.prompter.set(on, script),
  },
  {
    name: 'timer_set',
    description: 'Start a countdown timer, e.g. "set a timer for 10 minutes", "timer 30 seconds for the pasta". It rings and speaks when done.',
    parameters: obj({ minutes: { type: 'number', description: 'Length in minutes (0.5 = 30 seconds)' }, label: str('What it is for, optional') }, ['minutes']),
    run: ({ minutes, label }, { services }) => services.timers.start(minutes, label),
  },
  {
    name: 'timer_status',
    description: 'Running timers and how much time is left. Also "cancel the timer" via timer_cancel.',
    parameters: obj({}),
    run: (_, { services }) => services.timers.list(),
  },
  {
    name: 'timer_cancel',
    description: 'Cancel a running timer (the newest one if no id is given).',
    parameters: obj({ id: { type: 'integer' } }),
    run: ({ id }, { services }) => services.timers.cancel(id),
  },
  {
    name: 'list_add',
    description: 'Add items to one of the user\'s lists, e.g. "add milk and eggs to my shopping list", "add mangoes to the list". Lists are made as needed.',
    parameters: obj({ list: str('List name, default "shopping"'), items: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } }, ['items']),
    run: ({ list = 'shopping', items }, { store }) => {
      const name = list.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+list$/, '') || 'shopping';
      for (const item of items) store.insert('lists', { list: name, item: item.trim(), done: 0, created_at: now() }, `Added ${item} to ${name}`);
      return { list: name, added: items, total: store.get('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM lists WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 0 AND list = ?', name).n };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'list_query',
    description: 'Read one of the user\'s lists ("what is on my shopping list?"), or all list names.',
    parameters: obj({ list: str('List name; empty = all lists') }),
    run: ({ list }, { store }) => (list
      ? store.all('SELECT id, item FROM lists WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 0 AND list = ? ORDER BY id', list.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+list$/, ''))
      : store.all('SELECT list, COUNT(*) AS items FROM lists WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 0 GROUP BY list')),
  },
  {
    name: 'list_remove',
    description: 'Tick off / remove items from a list ("I bought the milk", "clear my shopping list").',
    parameters: obj({ list: str('List name'), items: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Items to remove; empty = the whole list' } }, ['list']),
    run: ({ list, items = [] }, { store }) => {
      const name = list.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+list$/, '');
      const rows = store.all('SELECT id, item FROM lists WHERE deleted = 0 AND done = 0 AND list = ?', name)
        .filter((r) => !items.length || items.some((i) => r.item.toLowerCase().includes(i.toLowerCase()) || i.toLowerCase().includes(r.item.toLowerCase())));
      for (const r of rows) store.update('lists', r.id, { done: 1 }, `Removed ${r.item} from ${name}`);
      return { list: name, removed: rows.map((r) => r.item) };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'pc_dark_mode',
    description: 'Turn Windows dark mode on or off (apps and the taskbar).',
    parameters: obj({ on: { type: 'boolean' } }, ['on']),
    run: async ({ on }, { services }) => { await services.pc.darkMode(on); return { dark_mode: on }; },
  },
  {
    name: 'music_play',
    description: 'Play a song, artist or video: "play Billie Jean", "play lo-fi on YouTube", "play Arijit Singh on Spotify". YouTube starts playing by itself; Spotify opens the search for it.',
    parameters: obj({ query: str('What to play'), app: { type: 'string', enum: ['youtube', 'spotify'], description: 'Default youtube unless the user says Spotify' } }, ['query']),
    run: async ({ query, app = 'youtube' }, { services }) => {
      if (app === 'spotify') {
        await services.openExternal(`spotify:search:${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
        return { opened: 'Spotify', searched: query, note: 'Spotify shows the results; the user (or computer_click) picks the song.' };
      }
      // Open the first result straight away, so it plays without another click.
      const html = await fetch(`https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`, { headers: { 'Accept-Language': 'en' } }).then((r) => r.text()).catch(() => '');
      const id = firstVideoId(html);
      const url = id ? `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${id}` : `https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`;
      await services.openExternal(url);
      return { playing: !!id, url };
    },
  },
];
```

### src/main/services/places.js

```javascript
// Wheelchair-accessible places nearby, from OpenStreetMap's own search (Nominatim: free, no key; one request per
// question, as its usage policy asks). Only the area name and the kind of place leave the PC. OSM's wheelchair tag
// is trusted as it is: an untagged place is "unknown", never "accessible". (The Overpass servers were tried first
// but timed out from here on 2026-11-09; Nominatim answered in about a second with the same tags.)

/** Kinds of place: the words searched for, and the OSM category/type a real result must have. */
export const KINDS = {
  hospital: ['hospital', 'amenity', /^hospital$/],
  clinic: ['clinic', 'amenity', /^(clinic|doctors)$/],
  pharmacy: ['pharmacy', 'amenity', /^pharmacy$/],
  toilets: ['toilets', 'amenity', /^toilets$/],
  restaurant: ['restaurant', 'amenity', /^restaurant$/],
  cafe: ['cafe', 'amenity', /^cafe$/],
  atm: ['atm', 'amenity', /^atm$/],
  bank: ['bank', 'amenity', /^bank$/],
  bus_stop: ['bus stop', 'highway', /^bus_stop$/],
  train_station: ['railway station', 'railway', /^(station|halt)$/],
  supermarket: ['supermarket', 'shop', /^supermarket$/],
  police: ['police', 'amenity', /^police$/],
  park: ['park', 'leisure', /^park$/],
};

const RANK = { yes: 0, limited: 1, unknown: 2 };
const HEADERS = { 'User-Agent': 'Maya-assistant (accessible places)' };

/** Nominatim search for one kind of place in a box radiusKm around a point. Exported for tests. */
export function searchUrl(kind, lat, lon, radiusKm) {
  if (!KINDS[kind]) throw new Error(`Unknown kind of place "${kind}". Use one of: ${Object.keys(KINDS).join(', ')}.`);
  const dLat = radiusKm / 111, dLon = radiusKm / (111 * Math.cos((lat * Math.PI) / 180));
  const box = [lon - dLon, lat + dLat, lon + dLon, lat - dLat].map((n) => n.toFixed(5)).join(',');
  return `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=jsonv2&extratags=1&addressdetails=1&limit=40&bounded=1&viewbox=${box}&q=${encodeURIComponent(KINDS[kind][0])}`;
}

function distanceKm(a, b) {
  const rad = (d) => (d * Math.PI) / 180;
  const h = Math.sin(rad(b.latitude - a.latitude) / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos(rad(a.latitude)) * Math.cos(rad(b.latitude)) * Math.sin(rad(b.longitude - a.longitude) / 2) ** 2;
  return 6371 * 2 * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(h));
}

/**
 * Real places of this kind within radiusKm, wheelchair access first (yes, limited, unknown), nearest first.
 * "no", nameless results and look-alikes (a street called "Pharmacy Road") are left out. Exported for tests.
 */
export function rankPlaces(results, origin, kind, radiusKm, limit = 8) {
  const [, category, type] = KINDS[kind];
  return results
    .filter((r) => r.name && r.category === category && type.test(r.type) && r.extratags?.wheelchair !== 'no')
    .map((r) => {
      const t = r.extratags || {}, a = r.address || {}, at = { latitude: Number(r.lat), longitude: Number(r.lon) };
      const address = [a.house_number, a.road].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || a.suburb || '';
      return {
        name: r.name, wheelchair: RANK[t.wheelchair] === undefined ? 'unknown' : t.wheelchair,
        distance_km: Math.round(distanceKm(origin, at) * 100) / 100,
        ...(address && { address }), ...(t.phone && { phone: t.phone }), ...(t.opening_hours && { opening_hours: t.opening_hours }),
        map: `https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=${at.latitude}&mlon=${at.longitude}#map=18/${at.latitude}/${at.longitude}`,
      };
    })
    .filter((p) => p.distance_km <= radiusKm)
    .sort((a, b) => RANK[a.wheelchair] - RANK[b.wheelchair] || a.distance_km - b.distance_km)
    .slice(0, limit);
}

const plural = (w) => (w === 'police' ? 'police stations' : /s$/.test(w) ? w : w.endsWith('y') ? `${w.slice(0, -1)}ies` : `${w}s`);
const named = (list) => list.map((p) => `${p.name} (${p.distance_km} km)`).join(', ');

/**
 * What the data says, in plain words, for Maya to read out. The small model once "remembered" a famous hospital
 * with step-free access that the map did not have, so the answer is built here, from the results only. Exported for tests.
 */
export function placesSummary(places, kind, where, radiusKm) {
  const pl = plural(KINDS[kind][0]);
  if (!places.length) return `No ${pl} found within ${radiusKm} km of ${where} on OpenStreetMap. Offer a bigger radius.`;
  const yes = places.filter((p) => p.wheelchair === 'yes'), part = places.filter((p) => p.wheelchair === 'limited');
  let s = `Found ${places.length} ${places.length === 1 ? KINDS[kind][0] : pl} within ${radiusKm} km of ${where}.`;
  if (yes.length) s += ` ${yes.length} ${yes.length === 1 ? 'has' : 'have'} step-free (wheelchair) access recorded: ${named(yes)}.`;
  if (part.length) s += ` ${named(part)} ${part.length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are'} partly accessible.`;
  if (!yes.length && !part.length) return `${s} None has wheelchair access recorded in OpenStreetMap, so call ahead to check. Nearest: ${named(places.slice(0, 3))}.`;
  return yes.length + part.length < places.length ? `${s} The others have no access information: call ahead.` : s;
}

/** Up to 8 places of this kind near a named place, wheelchair-accessible ones first. */
export async function findAccessible({ kind, near, radiusKm = 3 }, { fetchFn = fetch } = {}) {
  const geo = await (await fetchFn(`https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?count=1&name=${encodeURIComponent(near)}`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000) })).json();
  const spot = geo.results?.[0];
  if (!spot) throw new Error(`Couldn't find the place "${near}". Ask the user for a nearby town or city name.`);
  const radius = Math.min(Math.max(Number(radiusKm) || 3, 0.5), 10);
  const res = await fetchFn(searchUrl(kind, spot.latitude, spot.longitude, radius), { headers: HEADERS, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20_000) });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`The map service is busy (error ${res.status}). Try again in a minute.`);
  const places = rankPlaces(await res.json(), spot, kind, radius);
  const where = [spot.name, spot.admin1].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
  return {
    summary: placesSummary(places, kind, where, radius), places,
    how: 'Answer from "summary" only. Never add a place that is not in "places", even one you know; never call a place (or a list) "wheelchair-accessible" unless its wheelchair is "yes", even if the user asked for accessible ones. Distances are straight-line; "unknown" access = call ahead.',
  };
}
```

### src/main/services/timers.js

```javascript
// Countdown timers ("set a timer for 10 minutes"). notify() rings and speaks when one ends; onChange(list) keeps the
// timer badge on Maya's pill up to date.
// shortcut: timers live in memory, so restarting Maya forgets them; use reminders for anything longer than a few hours.

const fmt = (ms) => { const s = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1000)); return s >= 3600 ? `${Math.floor(s / 3600)} h ${Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60)} min` : `${Math.floor(s / 60)}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`; };
/** "10 minutes", "30 seconds", "1 hour 30 minutes". Exported for tests. */
export const spoken = (minutes) => {
  const s = Math.round(minutes * 60), h = Math.floor(s / 3600), m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60), sec = s % 60;
  return [h && `${h} hour${h > 1 ? 's' : ''}`, m && `${m} minute${m > 1 ? 's' : ''}`, sec && `${sec} second${sec > 1 ? 's' : ''}`].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || '0 seconds';
};

export function createTimers({ notify, onChange = () => {}, now = Date.now, setTimer = setTimeout, clearTimer = clearTimeout }) {
  const timers = new Map();
  let next = 1;
  const list = () => [...timers.values()].map(({ id, label, ends }) => ({ id, label, ends, left: fmt(ends - now()) }));
  return {
    start(minutes, label = '') {
      if (!(minutes > 0) || minutes > 24 * 60) return { error: 'A timer can run from a few seconds up to 24 hours.' };
      const id = next++;
      const ends = now() + minutes * 60_000;
      const handle = setTimer(() => {
        timers.delete(id);
        notify('Timer done', `${label ? `${label}: ` : ''}your ${spoken(minutes)} timer is up.`, 'timer');
        onChange(list());
      }, minutes * 60_000);
      timers.set(id, { id, label, ends, handle });
      onChange(list());
      return { id, label, minutes, ends_at: new Date(ends).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', second: minutes < 1 ? '2-digit' : undefined }) };
    },
    cancel(id) {
      const t = id ? timers.get(id) : [...timers.values()].at(-1);
      if (!t) return { error: 'No timer is running.' };
      clearTimer(t.handle);
      timers.delete(t.id);
      onChange(list());
      return { cancelled: t.id, label: t.label };
    },
    list,
  };
}
```

```jsx
// Teleprompter that listens: the script scrolls along as you read it aloud, and waits when you pause.
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { startRecording } from './shared/audio.js';
import { words, align } from './shared/prompter.js';

const CHECK_MS = 2000; // how often Whisper listens to the last stretch
const rms = (pcm) => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < pcm.length; i += 8) s += pcm[i] * pcm[i]; return Math.sqrt(s / Math.max(1, pcm.length / 8)); };

function Prompter() {
  const [script, setScript] = useState('');
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(0); // index of the next word to read
  const [hearing, setHearing] = useState(false);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const box = useRef(null);
  const posRef = useRef(0), pausedRef = useRef(false);
  posRef.current = pos; pausedRef.current = paused;

  useEffect(() => window.ather.onPrompterScript(setScript), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!script) return undefined;
    const list = words(script);
    let rec, timer, busy = false, recent = [], keep = new Float32Array(0);
    (async () => {
      rec = await startRecording();
      timer = setInterval(async () => {
        const chunk = rec.take();
        const talking = rms(chunk) > 0.01;
        setHearing(talking);
        if (busy || pausedRef.current) return;
        // Listen to the last ~4 s, so a phrase cut in half still matches.
        const both = new Float32Array(keep.length + chunk.length); both.set(keep); both.set(chunk, keep.length);
        keep = both.slice(-16000 * 4);
        if (!talking) return;
        busy = true;
        try {
          const heard = words(await window.ather.transcribeQuick(keep));
          recent = heard.slice(-8);
          const next = align(list, recent, posRef.current);
          if (next > posRef.current) setPos(next);
        } catch { /* a missed check just waits for the next one */ } finally { busy = false; }
      }, CHECK_MS);
    })().catch(() => {});
    return () => { clearInterval(timer); rec?.stop(); };
  }, [script]);

  // Keep the next words about a third of the way down.
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = box.current?.querySelector('.w.next');
    if (el) box.current.style.transform = `translateY(${-(el.offsetTop - 70)}px)`;
  }, [pos, script]);

  if (!script) return <div className="tp"><div className="scroll" style={{ padding: 40, fontSize: 22 }}>Copy your script first, then say “start teleprompter”.</div></div>;
  let k = 0;
  return (
    <div className="tp">
      <div className="bar">
        <span className={`mic ${hearing ? 'on' : ''}`} aria-hidden="true" />{paused ? 'Paused' : hearing ? 'Following you' : 'Waiting for you'}
        <button onClick={() => setPos(0)}>Restart</button>
        <button onClick={() => setPaused(!paused)}>{paused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause'}</button>
        <button onClick={() => window.ather.prompterSet(false)} aria-label="Close teleprompter">✕</button>
      </div>
      <div className="fade top" /><div className="fade bottom" />
      <div className="scroll" ref={box} aria-live="off">
        {script.split(/\n+/).map((para, p) => (
          <p key={p}>{para.split(/(\s+)/).map((part, i) => {
            if (!words(part).length) return part;
            const index = k; k += words(part).length;
            return <span key={i} className={`w ${index < pos - 3 ? '' : index < pos ? 'now' : index < pos + 12 ? 'next' : ''}`}>{part}</span>;
          })}</p>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<Prompter />);
```

### src/renderer/shared/prompter.js

```javascript
// Teleprompter maths: find where the reader is in the script from the last words they said.

/** Lower-case words without punctuation. */
export const words = (text) => text.toLowerCase().replace(/[’']/g, '').match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu) || [];

/**
 * The script position (index of the next word to read) after the words just heard, searching from `from`
 * up to `ahead` words further. Returns `from` when nothing matches well enough (2+ of the last words).
 */
export function align(script, heard, from = 0, ahead = 80) {
  const tail = heard.slice(-6);
  if (!tail.length) return from;
  let best = { score: 1, at: from };
  for (let end = from; end < Math.min(script.length, from + ahead); end++) {
    // How many of the heard words appear, in order, in the stretch of script ending here.
    let score = 0, j = end;
    for (let k = tail.length - 1; k >= 0 && j >= Math.max(0, end - 9); k--) {
      let found = -1;
      for (let s = j; s >= Math.max(0, end - 9); s--) if (script[s] === tail[k]) { found = s; break; }
      if (found >= 0) { score++; j = found - 1; }
    }
    if (score > best.score) best = { score, at: end + 1 };
  }
  return best.at;
}
```

```javascript
// Camera eyes: one photo from the webcam, taken only when Maya is asked ("what's in front of me?", "read this paper").
// The main process loads this hidden page, calls grab(), and closes it again; nothing is saved here.
window.grab = async () => {
  const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { width: { ideal: 1920 }, height: { ideal: 1080 } } });
  try {
    const video = document.createElement('video');
    video.muted = true;
    video.srcObject = stream;
    await video.play();
    // Webcams start dark and blurry: let exposure and focus settle first.
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(video, 0, 0);
    return canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.9);
  } finally {
    stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
  }
};
```

### src/main/services/interpreter.js

```javascript
// Interpreter mode: two people talk, Maya says each sentence in the other language (English ↔ another language).
// Whisper hears either language; which way to translate follows from the script of what was heard.
import { scriptLanguage } from './sapi.js';

// Languages whose script tells them apart from English (Maya speaks Tamil itself; the others use a Windows voice if installed).
export const INTERPRETER_LANGUAGES = { ta: 'Tamil', hi: 'Hindi', te: 'Telugu', bn: 'Bengali', ar: 'Arabic', ru: 'Russian', ja: 'Japanese', ko: 'Korean', zh: 'Chinese' };

/** Which way to translate what was heard. Exported for tests. */
export const direction = (heard, lang) => (scriptLanguage(heard) === lang ? { from: lang, to: 'en' } : { from: 'en', to: lang });

// Common English words: Whisper sometimes writes Tamil/Hindi speech in English letters ("Varya maruthuva…").
const ENGLISH = new Set(`the a an and or but is are was were be been am i you he she it we they me my your his her our their this that these those
what where when why how who which whom whose do does did done have has had not no yes can could will would shall should may might must
to of in on at for from with by about as into over after before up down out off again here there now then very so just also please thank
thanks hello hi sorry okay ok go come get give take make know think want need help like see look find call tell say said let one two three
some any all more most much many good bad big small near nearest far today tomorrow time day night home bus train hospital doctor water
food money where's what's i'm it's don't can't won't let's`.split(/\s+/));
/** Share of words that are common English words (0..1). Exported for tests. */
export const englishShare = (text) => {
  const words = (text.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z']+/g) || []);
  return words.length ? words.filter((w) => ENGLISH.has(w)).length / words.length : 0;
};

/** One turn: audio → { heard, said, from, to }. ml transcribes, complete(prompt) translates. */
export async function interpretTurn(audio, lang, { ml, complete }) {
  let heard = await ml.call('transcribe', audio, null); // auto-detect the language
  if (!heard) return null;
  // Not the other script and hardly any English words: it was the other language written in English letters.
  const spokeOther = scriptLanguage(heard) === lang || englishShare(heard) < 0.25;
  // Listen again in that language (the dedicated Tamil listener for Tamil) to get its own script.
  if (spokeOther) heard = (await ml.call('transcribe', audio, lang).catch(() => '')) || heard;
  const { from, to } = spokeOther ? { from: lang, to: 'en' } : { from: 'en', to: lang };
  const target = to === 'en' ? 'English' : INTERPRETER_LANGUAGES[to];
  const said = (await complete(`Translate into natural spoken ${target}${to === 'en' ? '' : ` written in ${target} script`}. Keep the meaning, names and numbers. Reply with the translation only.\n\n${heard}`))
    .trim().replace(/^["“]|["”]$/g, '');
  return { heard, said, from, to };
}
```

### src/main/tools/people.js

```javascript
// People and feelings: a contact book for calls and WhatsApp by voice, and a spoken diary with moods.
import { now } from '../store.js';
import { matchApp } from '../services/pc.js';
import { SOS_DEFAULTS, MEDICAL_FIELDS, medicalLines } from '../services/sos.js';

const str = (description) => ({ type: 'string', description });
const obj = (properties, required = []) => ({ type: 'object', properties, required });
export const MOODS = ['happy', 'calm', 'excited', 'grateful', 'tired', 'sad', 'worried', 'angry', 'lonely', 'in pain'];

/** Digits for WhatsApp/phone links: a 10-digit number gets the country code (India by default). Exported for tests. */
export function intlNumber(phone, country = '91') {
  const digits = String(phone).replace(/[^\d+]/g, '');
  if (digits.startsWith('+')) return digits.slice(1);
  if (digits.startsWith('00')) return digits.slice(2);
  const local = digits.replace(/^0+/, '');
  return local.length === 10 ? `${country}${local}` : local;
}

/** The contact the user means: by name or relation ("Amma", "my brother"). */
export function findContact(store, who) {
  const all = store.all('SELECT * FROM contacts WHERE deleted = 0');
  // Small models write things like "Lakshmi (amma)" or "my amma": try every word as a name or a relation.
  const words = String(who).toLowerCase().replace(/[()"'.,]/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter((w) => w && !['my', 'to', 'the', 'dear'].includes(w));
  const q = words.join(' ');
  const byRelation = all.find((c) => c.relation && (c.relation.toLowerCase() === q || words.includes(c.relation.toLowerCase())));
  if (byRelation) return byRelation;
  const exact = all.find((c) => words.includes(c.name.toLowerCase()) || c.name.toLowerCase() === q);
  if (exact) return exact;
  const name = matchApp(q, all.map((c) => c.name)) || words.map((w) => matchApp(w, all.map((c) => c.name))).find(Boolean);
  return name ? all.find((c) => c.name === name) : null;
}

const notFound = (store, who) => ({ error: `No contact called "${who}". Saved: ${store.all('SELECT name FROM contacts WHERE deleted = 0').map((c) => c.name).join(', ') || 'none yet'}. Add one with contacts_add.` });

export const peopleTools = [
  {
    name: 'medical_id',
    description: 'The user\'s Medical ID (blood group, allergies, conditions, medicines, doctor): shown on the SOS help sign and emailed to caregivers in an emergency. '
      + 'Call with the fields the user just told you to save them; call with nothing to read it out.',
    parameters: obj(Object.fromEntries(MEDICAL_FIELDS.map(([k, label]) => [k, str(`${label} as the user said it${k === 'doctor' ? ' (name and phone)' : ''}`)]))),
    run: (args, { store }) => {
      const sos = { ...SOS_DEFAULTS, ...store.getSetting('sos', SOS_DEFAULTS) };
      const given = Object.fromEntries(MEDICAL_FIELDS.map(([k]) => [k, args[k]]).filter(([, v]) => String(v ?? '').trim()));
      if (Object.keys(given).length) store.setSetting('sos', { ...sos, medical: { ...sos.medical, ...given } });
      const medical = medicalLines({ ...sos.medical, ...given });
      return { medical, ...(Object.keys(given).length && { saved: Object.keys(given) }),
        note: medical.length ? 'Shown on the SOS help sign and sent to caregivers in an emergency. Read it back to the user.' : 'Nothing saved yet: ask for blood group, allergies, conditions, medicines and doctor.' };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'contacts_add',
    description: 'Save a contact (name, phone, optional email and relation like "amma", "brother", "doctor") so the user can call or WhatsApp them by voice. Only saves: never call or message them unless the user asked.',
    parameters: obj({ name: str('Name'), phone: str('Phone number'), email: str('Email, optional'), relation: str('Relation, optional: amma, appa, brother, friend, doctor…') }, ['name']),
    run: ({ name, phone, email, relation }, { store }) => {
      if (phone && String(phone).replace(/\D/g, '').length < 6) return { error: 'That phone number looks too short.' };
      const old = store.get('SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE deleted = 0 AND lower(name) = lower(?)', name.trim());
      const row = { name: name.trim(), phone: phone || null, email: email || null, relation: relation?.toLowerCase() || null };
      return old ? store.update('contacts', old.id, row, `Updated contact ${name}`) : store.insert('contacts', { ...row, created_at: now() }, `Saved contact ${name}`);
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'contacts_query',
    description: 'Find the user\'s saved contacts (by name or relation), or list them all.',
    parameters: obj({ who: str('Name or relation; empty = all') }),
    run: ({ who }, { store }) => (who ? [findContact(store, who)].filter(Boolean) : store.all('SELECT id, name, phone, email, relation FROM contacts WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY name')),
  },
  {
    name: 'contacts_delete',
    description: 'Delete a saved contact (can be undone).',
    parameters: obj({ id: { type: 'integer' } }, ['id']),
    run: ({ id }, { store }) => store.update('contacts', id, { deleted: 1 }, `Deleted contact ${id}`),
  },
  {
    name: 'call_contact',
    description: 'Phone call a saved contact (or a number) through the user\'s paired phone (Windows Phone Link): "call Amma", "call Rahul". Call it right away when asked: Maya shows the approval card herself, so do not ask in text first.',
    confirm: true,
    parameters: obj({ who: str('Contact name / relation, or a phone number') }, ['who']),
    run: async ({ who }, { store, services }) => {
      const c = /\d{6,}/.test(who.replace(/\D/g, '')) ? { name: who, phone: who } : findContact(store, who);
      if (!c) return notFound(store, who);
      if (!c.phone) return { error: `${c.name} has no phone number saved.` };
      const r = await services.phoneCall(c.phone);
      return r.error ? r : { calling: c.name };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'whatsapp_message',
    description: 'Open WhatsApp with a message to a saved contact ready to send: "WhatsApp Amma that I reached home". Maya does not press Send; the user sends it (or says "press enter").',
    parameters: obj({ who: str('Contact name / relation, or a phone number'), message: str('The message, in the user\'s words') }, ['who', 'message']),
    run: async ({ who, message }, { store, services }) => {
      const c = /\d{6,}/.test(who.replace(/\D/g, '')) ? { name: who, phone: who } : findContact(store, who);
      if (!c) return notFound(store, who);
      if (!c.phone) return { error: `${c.name} has no phone number saved.` };
      const phone = intlNumber(c.phone, store.getSetting('phoneCountry', '91'));
      const text = encodeURIComponent(message);
      // The WhatsApp app if it is installed, otherwise WhatsApp Web in the browser.
      const app = (await services.pc.storeApps?.().catch(() => ({})))?.WhatsApp;
      const web = `https://web.whatsapp.com/send?phone=${phone}&text=${text}`;
      await (app ? services.openExternal(`whatsapp://send?phone=${phone}&text=${text}`) : services.pc?.openUrl ? services.pc.openUrl(web) : services.openExternal(web)); // the user's signed-in Chrome
      return { opened: app ? 'WhatsApp' : 'WhatsApp Web', to: c.name, message, sent: false, tell_user: `The message to ${c.name} is ready in WhatsApp. Press Send, or say "press enter".` };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'whatsapp_open_chat',
    description: 'Open a WhatsApp chat in the user\'s signed-in browser (WhatsApp Web): by phone number, saved contact, or "me" for the user\'s own chat (messages to yourself). Use it before reading or downloading things from a chat.',
    parameters: obj({ who: str('Phone number, contact name, or "me"') }, ['who']),
    run: async ({ who }, { store, services }) => {
      const mine = /^(me|myself|my (own )?(number|chat|whatsapp))$/i.test(who.trim());
      const c = /\d{6,}/.test(who.replace(/\D/g, '')) ? { name: who, phone: who } : findContact(store, mine ? 'me' : who);
      if (!c) return mine ? { error: 'I do not know your own number yet. Say "save my number as 98400 12345" (contact name: Me) once.' } : notFound(store, who);
      if (!c.phone) return { error: `${c.name} has no phone number saved.` };
      const phone = intlNumber(c.phone, store.getSetting('phoneCountry', '91'));
      if (phone.length < 10) return { error: `${c.phone} looks too short for a phone number. Check the digits.` };
      const url = `https://web.whatsapp.com/send?phone=${phone}`;
      await (services.pc?.openUrl ? services.pc.openUrl(url) : services.openExternal(url));
      return { opened: 'WhatsApp Web', chat: c.name, phone: `+${phone}`, next: 'computer_start, then computer_look to see the chat' };
    },
  },
  {
    name: 'diary_add',
    description: 'Save a spoken diary entry: "dear diary…", "note in my diary that…", or when the user shares how their day went and asks to keep it. Choose the mood that fits.',
    parameters: obj({ text: str('The entry, in the user\'s own words'), mood: { type: 'string', enum: MOODS } }, ['text']),
    run: ({ text, mood }, { store }) => store.insert('diary', { text: text.trim(), mood: MOODS.includes(mood) ? mood : null, created_at: now() }, 'Saved a diary entry'),
  },
  {
    name: 'diary_query',
    description: 'Read the user\'s diary for the last days, with a count of moods: "how was my week?", "what did I write yesterday?". Summarise gently.',
    parameters: obj({ days: { type: 'integer', description: 'How many days back, default 7' } }),
    run: ({ days = 7 }, { store }) => {
      const since = new Date(Date.now() - days * 864e5).toISOString();
      const entries = store.all('SELECT id, text, mood, created_at FROM diary WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= ? ORDER BY id', since);
      const moods = {};
      for (const e of entries) if (e.mood) moods[e.mood] = (moods[e.mood] || 0) + 1;
      return { days, entries: entries.map((e) => ({ ...e, when: new Date(e.created_at).toLocaleString('en-GB', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) })), moods };
    },
  },
];
```
