### test/coding-agent.test.js

```javascript
// Acceptance test (master prompt, feature 2): the agent fixes a reproducible bug so the project's tests pass.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-code-'));
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { ask } = await import('../src/main/brain.js');
const { allTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/index.js');
const { OLLAMA } = await import('../src/main/ollama.js');
const running = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/version`).then((r) => r.ok, () => false);

test('agent finds and fixes a bug until the tests pass', { skip: !running && 'Ollama not running', timeout: 900_000 }, async () => {
  const proj = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-bugproj-'));
  writeFileSync(join(proj, 'package.json'), JSON.stringify({ name: 'calc', version: '1.0.0', type: 'module', scripts: { test: 'node test.js' } }));
  writeFileSync(join(proj, 'calc.js'), 'export function add(a, b) {\n  return a - b;\n}\n\nexport function multiply(a, b) {\n  return a * b;\n}\n');
  writeFileSync(join(proj, 'test.js'), "import assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport { add, multiply } from './calc.js';\nassert.equal(add(2, 3), 5);\nassert.equal(multiply(4, 5), 20);\nconsole.log('all tests passed');\n");
  assert.throws(() => execFileSync('npm.cmd', ['test'], { cwd: proj, stdio: 'pipe', shell: true }));

  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  store.setSetting('approvedFolders', [proj]);
  const used = [];
  const answer = await ask({
    text: `The project in ${proj} has a failing test. Run "npm test" there, read the code, fix the bug in calc.js, then run the tests again to confirm they pass.`,
    store, tools: allTools, style: 'chat', mode: 'agent',
    services: { confirm: async () => true, trash: async () => {} },
    onEvent: (e) => e.type === 'tool' && used.push(e.name),
  });
  console.log('tools used:', used.join(', '));
  console.log('calc.js:', JSON.stringify(readFileSync(join(proj, 'calc.js'), 'utf8')), 'test.js:', JSON.stringify(readFileSync(join(proj, 'test.js'), 'utf8')));
  assert.match(readFileSync(join(proj, 'calc.js'), 'utf8'), /return a \+ b/);
  assert.match(readFileSync(join(proj, 'test.js'), 'utf8'), /assert\.equal\(add\(2, 3\), 5\)/, 'the test itself must not be changed to pass');
  assert.match(execFileSync('npm.cmd', ['test'], { cwd: proj, shell: true }).toString(), /all tests passed/);
  assert.ok(used.filter((n) => n === 'run_command').length >= 2, 'should run the tests before and after the fix');
  assert.ok(answer.length > 0);
});

test('agent finds a bug in a Python project without being told which file', { skip: !running && 'Ollama not running', timeout: 900_000 }, async () => {
  const proj = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'maya-pyproj-'));
  writeFileSync(join(proj, 'shop.py'), 'from prices import total\n\ndef bill(items):\n    return round(total(items), 2)\n');
  writeFileSync(join(proj, 'prices.py'), 'def total(items):\n    s = 0\n    for name, price, qty in items:\n        s += price + qty\n    return s\n');
  writeFileSync(join(proj, 'test_shop.py'), 'from shop import bill\nassert bill([("pen", 10.0, 2), ("book", 50.0, 1)]) == 70.0, bill([("pen", 10.0, 2), ("book", 50.0, 1)])\nprint("all tests passed")\n');
  assert.throws(() => execFileSync('python', ['test_shop.py'], { cwd: proj, stdio: 'pipe' }));
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  store.setSetting('approvedFolders', [proj]);
  const used = [];
  await ask({
    text: `The Python project in ${proj} has a failing test (run "python test_shop.py"). Find the bug and fix it, then run the test again to confirm it passes.`,
    store, tools: allTools, style: 'chat', mode: 'agent',
    services: { confirm: async () => true, trash: async () => {} },
    onEvent: (e) => e.type === 'tool' && used.push(e.name),
  });
  console.log('tools used:', used.join(', '));
  assert.match(execFileSync('python', ['test_shop.py'], { cwd: proj }).toString(), /all tests passed/);
  assert.match(readFileSync(join(proj, 'prices.py'), 'utf8'), /price \* qty|qty \* price/, 'the real bug is fixed');
  assert.match(readFileSync(join(proj, 'test_shop.py'), 'utf8'), /== 70\.0/, 'the test itself must not be changed to pass');
});
```

### test/computer.test.js

```javascript
// Computer control through Windows UI Automation on a real app: Notepad.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFile, execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

/** Notepad process ids now (the user's own Notepad must never be typed into or closed). */
const notepadPids = () => execFileSync('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', '(Get-Process notepad -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Id'], { encoding: 'utf8' })
  .split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).map(Number);
import { createPc } from '../src/main/services/pc.js';
import { computerTools, createComputerSession, toSendKeys, cellCenter, annotate } from '../src/main/tools/computer.js';

test('grid cells map to the middle of their part of the screen', () => {
  const screen = { x: 0, y: 0, width: 1600, height: 1000 };
  assert.deepEqual(cellCenter('A1', screen), { x: 50, y: 50 });
  assert.deepEqual(cellCenter('p10', screen), { x: 1550, y: 950 });
  assert.deepEqual(cellCenter(' D 7', screen), { x: 350, y: 650 });
  assert.equal(cellCenter('Q1', screen), null);
  assert.equal(cellCenter('A11', screen), null);
});

test('the screenshot gets the grid and control numbers drawn on it', async () => {
  const { default: sharp } = await import('sharp');
  const blank = await sharp({ create: { width: 1536, height: 960, channels: 3, background: '#ffffff' } }).jpeg().toBuffer();
  const url = await annotate(`data:image/jpeg;base64,${blank.toString('base64')}`, [{ i: 7, x: 768, y: 480, w: 192, h: 76 }], { x: 0, y: 0, width: 1536, height: 960 });
  const { width, height } = await sharp(Buffer.from(url.split(',')[1], 'base64')).metadata();
  assert.deepEqual([width, height], [1280, 800]); // scaled down for the model
  // The yellow number box covers the control's top-left corner.
  const { data } = await sharp(Buffer.from(url.split(',')[1], 'base64')).extract({ left: 563, top: 371, width: 1, height: 1 }).raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
  assert.ok(data[0] > 200 && data[1] > 170 && data[2] < 90, `pixel ${[...data]}`);
});

test('key combos translate to SendKeys', () => {
  assert.equal(toSendKeys('ctrl+s'), '^s');
  assert.equal(toSendKeys('alt+f4'), '%{F4}');
  assert.equal(toSendKeys('tab tab enter'), '{TAB}{TAB}{ENTER}');
  assert.equal(toSendKeys('ctrl+shift+t'), '^+t');
});

test('computer tools refuse to act before the user allows it', async () => {
  const services = { computer: createComputerSession(), pc: {} };
  const look = computerTools.find((t) => t.name === 'computer_look');
  await assert.rejects(look.run({}, { services }), /Call computer_start/);
  assert.ok(computerTools.find((t) => t.name === 'computer_start').confirm);
});

test('controls Notepad: finds the text area by UI Automation and types into it', { timeout: 120_000 }, async (t) => {
  // Windows 11 opens a new Notepad as a tab of the open one, so with the user's Notepad open the test would type into it.
  if (notepadPids().length) { t.skip('Notepad is already open (the user\'s): not touching it'); return; }
  const pc = createPc({ shell: { openPath: async () => '' } });
  const services = { pc, computer: createComputerSession() };
  const run = (name, args = {}) => computerTools.find((t) => t.name === name).run(args, { services });
  const notepad = execFile('notepad.exe');
  try {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500));
    run('computer_start', { task: 'test typing in Notepad' });
    // Make sure Notepad is in front (the test runner may own the foreground).
    const fg = await pc.foreground();
    if (!/notepad/i.test(fg.process)) {
      const list = await new Promise((res) => execFile('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', '(Get-Process notepad | Where-Object MainWindowHandle -ne 0 | Select-Object -First 1).MainWindowHandle'], (e, out) => res(out.trim())));
      await pc.activate(list);
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));
    }
    const look = await run('computer_look');
    assert.match(look.window, /Notepad/i);
    const field = look.controls.split('\n').find((l) => /(Edit|Document)/.test(l));
    assert.ok(field, look.controls);
    const index = Number(field.split(' ')[0]);
    await run('computer_type', { element: index, text: 'Hello from Maya' });
    const after = await run('computer_look');
    assert.match(after.window + after.controls, /Hello from Maya|\*/);
    assert.ok(services.computer.log().some((l) => l.action === 'type'));
    run('computer_done', { summary: 'typed' });
    assert.equal(services.computer.active, false);
  } finally {
    for (const pid of notepadPids()) execFile('taskkill.exe', ['/PID', String(pid), '/F']); // none was open before this test
    pc.stop();
  }
});
```

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { cleanDictation, finishDictation } from '../src/main/services/dictate.js';

test('fillers go, spoken corrections are followed', () => {
  assert.equal(cleanDictation("Hey Sam, I'm running about ten, actually fifteen minutes late. Uh, save me a seat!"),
    "Hey Sam, I'm running about fifteen minutes late. Save me a seat!");
  assert.equal(cleanDictation('um so the meeting is at 3, no, make that 4 pm'), 'So the meeting is at 4 pm');
  assert.equal(cleanDictation('see you on tuesday actually make that wednesday'), 'See you on wednesday');
});

test('spoken punctuation, new lines and bullet points', () => {
  assert.equal(cleanDictation('shopping list colon bullet point milk bullet point eggs bullet point bread'), 'Shopping list:\n- Milk\n- Eggs\n- Bread');
  assert.equal(cleanDictation('hi rahul comma new line can you send the notes question mark'), 'Hi rahul,\nCan you send the notes?');
  assert.equal(cleanDictation('that is all full stop thanks exclamation mark'), 'That is all. Thanks!');
});

test('normal words that contain filler sounds are kept', () => {
  assert.equal(cleanDictation('The umbrella and the hummus are here.'), 'The umbrella and the hummus are here.');
  assert.equal(cleanDictation('Version 1.6 at 10:30 costs $4.50.'), 'Version 1.6 at 10:30 costs $4.50.');
});

test('polished mode uses the AI only for small fixes', async () => {
  assert.equal(await finishDictation('i has a apple', 'polished', async () => 'I have an apple'), 'I have an apple');
  // a rewrite that changes too much keeps the user's own words
  assert.equal(await finishDictation('ok see you', 'polished', async () => 'Okay! I will see you very soon, have a wonderful day.'), 'Ok see you');
  assert.equal(await finishDictation('um hello', 'raw'), 'um hello');
  assert.equal(await finishDictation('um hello', 'polished', async () => { throw new Error('model down'); }), 'Hello');
```

### test/everyday.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'maya-test-'));
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { everydayTools, whereOnScreen, firstVideoId } = await import('../src/main/tools/everyday.js');
const { createTimers, spoken } = await import('../src/main/services/timers.js');

const run = (store, name, args, services = {}) => everydayTools.find((t) => t.name === name).run(args, { store, services });

test('timers ring once at the end and can be cancelled', () => {
  let clock = 0;
  const pending = [], said = [], badges = [];
  const timers = createTimers({ notify: (title, body) => said.push(body), onChange: (l) => badges.push(l.length), now: () => clock,
    setTimer: (fn, ms) => { pending.push({ fn, at: clock + ms }); return pending.length - 1; }, clearTimer: (i) => { pending[i].fn = () => {}; } });
  assert.ok(timers.start(0).error);
  const a = timers.start(10, 'pasta');
  timers.start(0.5);
  clock = 15_000;
  assert.equal(timers.list().find((t) => t.id === a.id).left, '9:45');
  assert.deepEqual(timers.cancel(), { cancelled: 2, label: '' });
  pending.forEach((p) => p.fn());
  assert.deepEqual(said, ['pasta: your 10 minutes timer is up.']);
  assert.deepEqual(badges, [1, 2, 1, 0]);
  assert.equal(spoken(1.5), '1 minute 30 seconds');
  assert.equal(spoken(90), '1 hour 30 minutes');
});

test('lists: add, read, tick off', () => {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  assert.equal(run(store, 'list_add', { list: 'Shopping list', items: ['milk', 'eggs', 'bread'] }).total, 3);
  run(store, 'list_add', { items: ['mangoes'] });
  assert.deepEqual(run(store, 'list_query', { list: 'shopping' }).map((r) => r.item), ['milk', 'eggs', 'bread', 'mangoes']);
  assert.deepEqual(run(store, 'list_remove', { list: 'shopping', items: ['Milk'] }).removed, ['milk']);
  assert.deepEqual(run(store, 'list_query', {}).map((r) => ({ ...r })), [{ list: 'shopping', items: 3 }]);
  run(store, 'list_remove', { list: 'shopping' });
  assert.deepEqual(run(store, 'list_query', { list: 'shopping' }), []);
});

test('pointing: finds a control by name and says where it is', async () => {
  const pointed = [];
  const services = {
    pc: { foreground: async () => ({ process: 'notepad', title: 'Notes' }), elements: async () => [
      { i: 1, name: 'File', type: 'MenuItem', x: 20, y: 40, w: 30, h: 20 },
      { i: 2, name: 'Save as', type: 'Button', x: 1400, y: 60, w: 60, h: 24 }] },
    point: (at) => pointed.push(at.label), screen: { bounds: () => ({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 1536, height: 960 }) },
  };
  const r = await run(null, 'screen_point', { target: 'save' }, services);
  assert.deepEqual([r.found, r.name, r.where], [true, 'Save as', 'at the top right']);
  assert.deepEqual(pointed, ['Save as']);
  assert.equal((await run(null, 'screen_point', { target: 'attach file' }, services)).found, false);
  assert.equal(whereOnScreen({ x: 768, y: 480 }, { x: 0, y: 0, width: 1536, height: 960 }), 'in the middle');
});

test('music: the first YouTube result is opened so it plays', () => {

});
```

### test/eyes.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { direction, interpretTurn, englishShare } from '../src/main/services/interpreter.js';
import { everydayTools } from '../src/main/tools/everyday.js';
import { selectTools } from '../src/main/tools/select.js';
import { allTools } from '../src/main/tools/index.js';

const tool = (name) => everydayTools.find((t) => t.name === name);

test('interpreter: the script of what was heard decides the direction', async () => {
  assert.deepEqual(direction('Where is the bus stand?', 'ta'), { from: 'en', to: 'ta' });
  assert.deepEqual(direction('பேருந்து நிலையம் எங்கே?', 'ta'), { from: 'ta', to: 'en' });
  assert.deepEqual(direction('बस स्टैंड कहाँ है?', 'hi'), { from: 'hi', to: 'en' });
  const calls = [];
  const ml = { call: async (op, audio, lang) => { calls.push(lang); return lang === 'ta' ? 'பேருந்து நிலையம் எங்கே?' : 'பெருந்து நிலயம் எங்கே'; } };
  const turn = await interpretTurn(new Float32Array(10), 'ta', { ml, complete: async (p) => (/English/.test(p) ? '"Where is the bus stand?"' : 'x') });
  assert.deepEqual(turn, { heard: 'பேருந்து நிலையம் எங்கே?', said: 'Where is the bus stand?', from: 'ta', to: 'en' });
  assert.deepEqual(calls, [null, 'ta']); // auto first, then the Tamil listener for accuracy
  // Whisper wrote Tamil speech in English letters: still recognised as Tamil.
  assert.ok(englishShare('Varya maruthuva manayangé, yana thadhaikku udevithayavé.') < 0.25);
  assert.ok(englishShare('Where is the nearest hospital? My father needs help.') > 0.5);
});

test('camera: describing attaches the photo; reading returns the printed text', async () => {
  const photo = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,AAAA';
  const look = await tool('camera_look').run({ question: 'what colour is the bottle?' }, { services: { camera: async () => photo } });
  assert.equal(look.attachImage, photo);
  assert.match(look.how, /what colour is the bottle/);
  const read = await tool('camera_read').run({}, { services: { camera: async () => photo, ocr: async () => 'PARACETAMOL  500 mg\n\n\n\nTake one tablet after food' } });
  assert.equal(read.text, 'PARACETAMOL 500 mg\n\nTake one tablet after food');
  assert.equal(read.attachImage, undefined);
  const blurry = await tool('camera_read').run({}, { services: { camera: async () => photo, ocr: async () => 'Il' } });
  assert.equal(blurry.attachImage, photo); // too little text: the AI looks at the photo instead
});

test('requests reach the camera and interpreter tools', () => {
  const names = (q) => selectTools(allTools, q).map((t) => t.name);
  assert.ok(names("what's in front of me?").includes('camera_look'));
  assert.ok(names('read this paper for me').includes('camera_read'));
  assert.ok(names('be my interpreter in Tamil').includes('interpreter'));
  assert.ok(!names('what is the capital of France').includes('camera_look'));
});
```

### test/headpose.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { headDirection, createPointer, createGestures, createDwell } from '../src/renderer/shared/headpose.js';

/** A fake face: eyes at y 0.4, forehead 0.2, chin 0.8, nose shifted by (dx, dy). */
const face = (dx = 0, dy = 0) => {
  const lm = Array.from({ length: 300 }, () => ({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }));
  lm[33] = { x: 0.45, y: 0.4 }; lm[263] = { x: 0.55, y: 0.4 }; lm[10] = { x: 0.5, y: 0.2 }; lm[152] = { x: 0.5, y: 0.8 };
  lm[1] = { x: 0.5 + dx, y: 0.5 + dy };
  return lm;
};

test('head direction is measured from between the eyes', () => {
  const d = headDirection(face(0.01, 0));
  assert.ok(Math.abs(d.x - 0.1) < 1e-9);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(d.y - 0.1 / 0.6) < 1e-9);
});

test('pointer calibrates to the centre, then follows the head (mirrored)', () => {
  const p = createPointer({ calibrate: 3, smooth: 1 });
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) p.update(headDirection(face()));
  assert.equal(p.calibrating, false);
  assert.deepEqual(p.update(headDirection(face())), { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 });
  const right = p.update(headDirection(face(-0.005, 0))); // nose moves left in the picture = user turned right
  assert.ok(right.x > 0.6, `x ${right.x}`);
  const down = p.update(headDirection(face(0, 0.03)));
  assert.ok(down.y > 0.6 && down.y <= 1);
  assert.equal(p.update(headDirection(face(0.5, 0))).x, 0); // clamped to the screen
});

test('open mouth clicks once per opening; smile right-clicks; mouth opening freezes the cursor', () => {
  const g = createGestures({ hold: 100, cooldown: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(g({ jawOpen: 0.6 }, 0), { click: null, freeze: true });
  assert.equal(g({ jawOpen: 0.6 }, 150).click, 'left');
  assert.equal(g({ jawOpen: 0.6 }, 300).click, null); // still open: no repeat
  g({ jawOpen: 0 }, 400);
  g({ jawOpen: 0.6 }, 500);
  assert.equal(g({ jawOpen: 0.6 }, 650).click, 'left');
  g({ mouthSmileLeft: 0.8, mouthSmileRight: 0.8 }, 700);
  assert.equal(g({ mouthSmileLeft: 0.8, mouthSmileRight: 0.8 }, 900).click, 'right');
  assert.equal(g({ jawOpen: 0.05 }, 1000).freeze, false);
});

test('dwell: holding still clicks once, moving away arms it again', () => {
  const d = createDwell({ ms: 1000, radius: 0.02 });
  const at = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }, near = { x: 0.505, y: 0.5 }, far = { x: 0.6, y: 0.5 };
  assert.deepEqual(d(at, 0), { progress: 0, click: false });
  assert.equal(d(near, 500).progress, 0.5); // small wobble does not restart the timer
  assert.deepEqual(d(at, 1000), { progress: 1, click: true });
  assert.equal(d(at, 3000).click, false); // still there: no second click
  d(far, 3100);
  assert.equal(d(far, 4100).click, true);
});
```

### test/holdkeys.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createHoldMachine } from '../src/main/services/holdkeys.js';

/** A machine with a fake clock: run() fires the pending hold timers. */
function setup() {
  const events = [], timers = [];
  const feed = createHoldMachine({
    onStart: (m) => events.push(`start ${m}`), onEnd: (m) => events.push(`end ${m}`), onCancel: (m) => events.push(`cancel ${m}`),
    setTimer: (fn) => { timers.push(fn); return timers.length; }, clearTimer: (id) => { timers[id - 1] = () => {}; },
  });
  return { events, feed, run: () => timers.splice(0).forEach((fn) => fn()) };
}

test('holding Right Ctrl starts a command, letting go ends it', () => {
  const { events, feed, run } = setup();
  feed({ ctrl: true, alt: false, other: false });
  run();
  feed({ ctrl: false, alt: false, other: false });
  assert.deepEqual(events, ['start command', 'end command']);
});

test('Right Alt dictates; a quick tap does nothing', () => {
  const { events, feed, run } = setup();
  feed({ ctrl: false, alt: true, other: false });
  feed({ ctrl: false, alt: false, other: false }); // released before the hold time
  run();
  assert.deepEqual(events, []);
  feed({ ctrl: false, alt: true, other: false });
  run();
  feed({ ctrl: false, alt: false, other: false });
  assert.deepEqual(events, ['start dictate', 'end dictate']);
});

test('Right Ctrl + another key is a shortcut, not talking', () => {
  const { events, feed, run } = setup();
  feed({ ctrl: true, alt: false, other: false });
  feed({ ctrl: true, alt: false, other: true }); // Ctrl+C before the hold time
  run();
  feed({ ctrl: false, alt: false, other: false });
  assert.deepEqual(events, []);
  feed({ ctrl: true, alt: false, other: false });
  run();
  feed({ ctrl: true, alt: false, other: true }); // a key after talking started: cancel, nothing is sent
  feed({ ctrl: false, alt: false, other: false });
  assert.deepEqual(events, ['start command', 'cancel command']);
});
```

### test/image-extras.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import sharp from 'sharp';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-img-'));
process.env.ATHER_MODELS = join(process.env.APPDATA || '', 'Ather', 'models');
const core = await import('../src/main/ml/core.js');
const opts = { timeout: 600_000 };

const sample = async (name, size) => {
  const file = join(process.env.ATHER_DATA, name);
  const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${size}" height="${size}"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#7ec8e3"/>
    <circle cx="${size / 2}" cy="${size / 2}" r="${size / 4}" fill="#e4572e"/><rect x="${size / 3}" y="${size * 0.7}" width="${size / 3}" height="${size / 8}" fill="#333"/></svg>`;
  await sharp(Buffer.from(svg)).png().toFile(file);
  return file;
};

test('background removal produces a transparent cut-out', opts, async () => {
  const out = await core.removeBackground(await sample('ball.png', 320), join(process.env.ATHER_DATA, 'cut.png'));
  const meta = await sharp(out).metadata();
  const { data } = await sharp(out).ensureAlpha().extractChannel(3).raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
  const hist = [0, 0, 0, 0];
  for (const a of data) hist[a >> 6]++;
  assert.equal(meta.channels, 4, `channels ${meta.channels}`);
  assert.ok(hist[0] > 1000 && hist[3] > 1000, `alpha histogram ${hist}`);
});

test('upscaler doubles the resolution', opts, async () => {
  const out = await core.upscale(await sample('small.png', 96), join(process.env.ATHER_DATA, 'big.png'));
  const { width, height } = await sharp(out).metadata();
  assert.equal(width, 192);
  assert.equal(height, 192);
});

test('upscaler refuses huge pictures with a clear message', opts, async () => {
  await assert.rejects(core.upscale(await sample('huge.png', 1500), join(process.env.ATHER_DATA, 'x.png')), /up to 1024/);
});

test('quick transcriber hears the wake word', opts, async () => {
  const { samples, sampleRate } = await core.speak('Hey Maya, what is the time?', 'af_heart');
  const out = new Float32Array(Math.floor((samples.length * 16000) / sampleRate));
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = samples[Math.floor((i * sampleRate) / 16000)];
  const text = await core.transcribeQuick(out);
  assert.match(text.toLowerCase(), /time/);
  console.log('heard:', text);
});
```

```javascript
// Real image generation + blur (slow, uses the GPU). Skipped until the models are downloaded.
```

```javascript
// Integration: smart search, MCP agent connection, calendar feeds. Needs Ollama + downloaded models + internet.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import sharp from 'sharp';

const realModels = join(process.env.APPDATA || '', 'Ather', 'models');
process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-int-'));
process.env.ATHER_MODELS = realModels;
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { OLLAMA } = await import('../src/main/ollama.js');
const ready = existsSync(join(realModels, 'hf', 'Xenova', 'clip-vit-base-patch32'))
  && await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/version`).then((r) => r.ok, () => false);
const opts = { skip: !ready && 'needs Ollama and models', timeout: 300_000 };

test('smart search finds a note, a text file and a photo by meaning', opts, async () => {
  const core = await import('../src/main/ml/core.js');
  const { createSearch } = await import('../src/main/services/search.js');
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  const search = createSearch({ store, ml: { call: (op, ...a) => core[op](...a) } });

  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-files-'));
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'resume.txt'), 'Curriculum vitae. Skills: Java, SQL, React. Education: B.Tech computer science.');
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'groceries.txt'), 'Buy rice, dal, onions and tomatoes.');
  // A sunny beach: blue sky over sand and sea.
  await sharp({ create: { width: 224, height: 224, channels: 3, background: '#f2d9a0' } })
    .composite([{ input: { create: { width: 224, height: 90, channels: 3, background: '#4aa3df' } }, top: 0, left: 0 },
      { input: { create: { width: 224, height: 40, channels: 3, background: '#1f6fb2' } }, top: 90, left: 0 }])
    .jpeg().toFile(join(dir, 'IMG_2041.jpg'));
  store.run("INSERT INTO notes (title, body) VALUES ('Lab exam', 'The DBMS lab exam is in room 204 on Monday')");

  await search.index([dir]);
  assert.match((await search.query('my CV with programming skills'))[0].path, /resume/);
  assert.equal((await search.query('where is the database lab test'))[0].kind, 'note');
  const photo = (await search.query('photo of the beach and the sea')).find((r) => r.kind === 'image');
  assert.ok(photo, 'beach photo should be in the results');
});

test('MCP server lists tools and an agent can add a task', opts, async () => {
  const { startMcp } = await import('../src/main/services/mcp.js');
  const { allTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/index.js');
  const { Client } = await import('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js');
  const { StreamableHTTPClientTransport } = await import('@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/streamableHttp.js');
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  const server = startMcp({ tools: allTools, ctx: { store, services: {} } });
  try {
    const client = new Client({ name: 'test-agent', version: '1.0.0' });
    await client.connect(new StreamableHTTPClientTransport(new URL(server.url)));
    const { tools } = await client.listTools();
    assert.ok(tools.some((t) => t.name === 'tasks_create'));
    await client.callTool({ name: 'tasks_create', arguments: { title: 'Review PR from Claude' } });
    assert.equal(store.get('SELECT title FROM tasks').title, 'Review PR from Claude');
    await client.close();
  } finally {
    server.close();
  }
});

test('reads a public Google calendar feed', { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
  const { createCalendarFeeds } = await import('../src/main/services/calendar-feeds.js');
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  store.setSetting('calendarFeeds', [{ name: 'Holidays', url: 'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/en.indian%23holiday%40group.v.calendar.google.com/public/basic.ics' }]);
  const feeds = createCalendarFeeds({ store });
  const year = new Date().getFullYear();
  const events = await feeds.events(`${year}-01-01`, `${year}-12-31`);
  assert.ok(events.length > 5, `expected holidays, got ${events.length}`);
  assert.ok(events.every((e) => e.source === 'Holidays' && e.start.startsWith(String(year))));
});
```

```javascript
// Lecture pipeline with real models: Kokoro "teacher" audio → Whisper transcript pieces → notes → flashcards.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { existsSync, mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const realModels = join(process.env.APPDATA || '', 'Ather', 'models');
process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-lec-'));
process.env.ATHER_MODELS = realModels;
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { createLectures } = await import('../src/main/services/lectures.js');
const { createStudy } = await import('../src/main/services/study.js');
const { OLLAMA } = await import('../src/main/ollama.js');
const ready = existsSync(join(realModels, 'hf', 'onnx-community', 'whisper-small')) && await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/version`).then((r) => r.ok, () => false);

const to16k = (s, rate) => { const o = new Float32Array(Math.floor((s.length * 16000) / rate)); for (let i = 0; i < o.length; i++) o[i] = s[Math.floor((i * rate) / 16000)]; return o; };

test('lecture audio becomes a transcript, notes and flashcards', { skip: !ready && 'needs models', timeout: 900_000 }, async () => {
  const core = await import('../src/main/ml/core.js');
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  const lectures = createLectures({ store });
  const id = lectures.start('OS: Deadlocks', 'mic');
  const pieces = [
    'Today we study deadlocks. A deadlock happens when processes wait for each other forever.',
    'There are four Coffman conditions: mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, and circular wait.',
    'The banker\'s algorithm avoids deadlock by checking if a resource request keeps the system in a safe state.',
  ];
  for (const p of pieces) {
    const { samples, sampleRate } = await core.speak(p, 'am_michael');
    lectures.append(id, await core.transcribe(to16k(samples, sampleRate), 'english'));
  }
  assert.match(lectures.get(id).transcript, /deadlock/i);

  const done = await lectures.finish(id, 1);
  assert.match(done.notes, /##/);
  assert.match(done.notes, /circular wait|coffman|banker/i);
  assert.ok(store.get("SELECT id FROM notes WHERE title LIKE 'Lecture notes:%'"));

  const set = await createStudy({ store, docs: {} }).create({ kind: 'flashcards', topic: done.title, text: done.transcript, count: 4 });
  assert.ok(JSON.parse(set.items).length >= 3);
});
```

### test/mail.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-mail-'));
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { createMail, criteria, smtpHost } = await import('../src/main/services/mail.js');
const { addFollowUp, checkFollowUps, weeklyMarkdown, weeklyTick } = await import('../src/main/services/work.js');
const { createFiles } = await import('../src/main/services/files.js');
const { allTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/index.js');
const { selectTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/select.js');

const raw = (uid, from, subject, body, extra = '') => Buffer.from(
  `From: ${from}\r\nTo: me@example.com\r\nSubject: ${subject}\r\nMessage-ID: <m${uid}@example.com>\r\nDate: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:00:00 +0530\r\n${extra}\r\n${body}\r\n`);
const box = [
  { uid: 11, flags: new Set(['\\Seen']), source: raw(11, 'Rahul <rahul@example.com>', 'Project report', 'Please send the report by Friday.') },
  { uid: 12, flags: new Set(), source: raw(12, 'Deals <news@shop.com>', '50% off', 'Big sale', 'List-Unsubscribe: <mailto:u@shop.com>\r\n') },
];

/** A fake IMAP server: records what was asked of it. */
function fakeImap(calls) {
  return () => ({
    mailbox: { exists: box.length },
    connect: async () => {}, logout: async () => {},
    getMailboxLock: async () => ({ release() {} }),
    async *fetch(range) { calls.push(['fetch', range]); for (const m of box) if (String(range).includes(':*') || String(range).split(',').includes(String(m.uid))) yield m; },
    search: async (c) => { calls.push(['search', c]); return box.filter((m) => !c.from || m.source.toString().includes(c.from)).map((m) => m.uid); },
    fetchOne: async (uid) => box.find((m) => String(m.uid) === uid),
    messageFlagsAdd: async (uids, flags) => calls.push(['flags', uids, flags]),
    messageMove: async (uids, dest) => calls.push(['move', uids, dest]),
    list: async () => [{ path: 'INBOX' }, { path: '[Gmail]/All Mail', specialUse: '\\All' }],
  });
}

function setup() {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  store.setSetting('mail', { host: 'imap.gmail.com', user: 'me@example.com' });
  const calls = [];
  const transport = nodemailer.createTransport({ jsonTransport: true });
  const mail = createMail({ store, secrets: { get: () => 'app-pass' }, imap: fakeImap(calls), transport });
  return { store, calls, mail };
}

test('search criteria and SMTP host', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(criteria({}), { all: true });
  assert.deepEqual(criteria({ from: 'Rahul', unread: true }), { from: 'Rahul', seen: false });
  assert.equal(smtpHost('imap.gmail.com'), 'smtp.gmail.com');
  assert.equal(smtpHost('imap.zoho.com'), 'smtp.zoho.com');
});

test('reads, searches and spots newsletters', async () => {
  const { mail } = setup();
  const found = await mail.search({ from: 'rahul' });
  assert.deepEqual(found.map((m) => m.subject), ['Project report']);
  const one = await mail.read(11);
  assert.match(one.text, /report by Friday/);
  assert.equal(one.message_id, '<m11@example.com>');
  assert.deepEqual((await mail.promotions()).map((m) => m.uid), [12]);
});

test('reply threads to the original; archive moves, never deletes', async () => {
  const { mail, calls } = setup();
  const sent = await mail.reply(11, 'Sending it today.');
  assert.equal(sent.subject, 'Re: Project report');
  assert.match(sent.to, /rahul@example.com/);
  await mail.archive([12]);
  assert.deepEqual(calls.at(-1), ['move', '12', '[Gmail]/All Mail']);
  await mail.markRead([11, 12]);
  assert.deepEqual(calls.at(-1), ['flags', '11,12', ['\\Seen']]);
});

test('not connected: a clear message', async () => {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  const mail = createMail({ store, secrets: { get: () => null } });
  await assert.rejects(mail.search({}), /not connected/);
});

test('sending, archiving and adding tasks from mail all need approval', () => {
  for (const name of ['mail_send', 'mail_reply', 'mail_archive', 'mail_add_tasks']) assert.equal(allTools.find((t) => t.name === name).confirm, true, name);
  for (const name of ['mail_search', 'mail_read', 'mail_promotions']) assert.ok(!allTools.find((t) => t.name === name).confirm, name);
});

test('mail requests get mail tools, not screen control', () => {
  const names = (text) => selectTools(allTools, text).map((t) => t.name);
  for (const text of ['reply to Rahul\'s email', 'send an email to my guide', 'remind me if Rahul doesn\'t reply by Friday', 'clean up the newsletters']) {
    assert.ok(names(text).some((n) => n.startsWith('mail_')), text);
    assert.ok(!names(text).includes('computer_start'), text);
  }
  assert.ok(names('make my weekly report').includes('report_weekly'));
});

test('follow-up: a reply closes it; no reply by the date adds a task', async () => {
  const { store, mail } = setup();
  const told = [];
  const notify = (title, body) => told.push(title);
  addFollowUp(store, { from: 'rahul', subject: 'report', by: '2026-10-30T17:00' });
  addFollowUp(store, { from: 'priya', by: '2026-10-30T17:00' });
  assert.throws(() => addFollowUp(store, { from: 'x', by: 'someday' }));
  await checkFollowUps({ store, mail, notify, at: new Date('2026-10-29T10:00') });
  assert.deepEqual(told, ['They replied']); // priya: not yet due
  await checkFollowUps({ store, mail, notify, at: new Date('2026-10-31T10:00') });
  assert.deepEqual(told, ['They replied', 'No reply yet']);
  assert.equal(store.all('SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE title LIKE ?', 'Follow up with priya%').length, 1);
  assert.ok(store.getSetting('followups').every((f) => f.done));
});

test('weekly report: done and open work, once per Friday evening', async () => {
  const { store } = setup();
  store.insert('tasks', { title: 'Finish DBMS notes', done: 1, completed_at: '2026-10-28T12:00:00', created_at: '2026-10-27' }, 't');
  store.insert('tasks', { title: 'Submit project', due: '2026-10-27T10:00', created_at: '2026-10-26' }, 't');
  const md = weeklyMarkdown(store, new Date('2026-10-30T18:00'));
  assert.match(md, /## Done \(1\)\n\n- Finish DBMS notes/);
  assert.match(md, /Submit project \(due 2026-10-27, overdue\)/);
  const files = createFiles({ outDir: join(process.env.ATHER_DATA, 'out') });
  const told = [];
  const notify = (title) => told.push(title);
  assert.equal(await weeklyTick({ store, files, notify, at: new Date('2026-10-29T18:00') }), null); // Thursday
  const path = await weeklyTick({ store, files, notify, at: new Date('2026-10-30T17:30') });
  assert.ok(existsSync(path));
  assert.equal(await weeklyTick({ store, files, notify, at: new Date('2026-10-30T19:00') }), null); // already made
  store.setSetting('weeklyReport', false);
  store.setSetting('weeklyReportLast', null);
  assert.equal(await weeklyTick({ store, files, notify, at: new Date('2026-10-30T19:00') }), null);
  assert.deepEqual(told, ['Weekly report ready']);
});

// Live: the real model, with the fake mailbox. Nothing is sent: the reply's approval is refused.
const { ask } = await import('../src/main/brain.js');
const { OLLAMA } = await import('../src/main/ollama.js');
const running = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/version`).then((r) => r.ok, () => false);

test('by voice or text: a follow-up is set from plain words', live, async () => {
  const { store, mail } = setup();
  const used = [];
  await ask({ text: 'Remind me if Rahul doesn\'t reply to my email by Friday.', store, tools: allTools, services: { mail }, style: 'chat', mode: 'fast',
    onEvent: (e) => e.type === 'tool' && used.push(e.name) });
  assert.ok(used.includes('mail_follow_up'), `tools: ${used}`);

  const asked = [];
  const services = { mail, confirm: async (req) => { asked.push(req); return false; } };
  await ask({ text: 'Reply to Rahul\'s email about the project report: tell him I will send it today.', store, tools: allTools, services, style: 'chat', mode: 'fast' });
  const reply = asked.find((r) => r.name === 'mail_reply');
```

### test/mcp-client.test.js

```javascript
// Real MCP servers: each must connect, list tools AND run a tool. Needs internet + Node (npx) the first time.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-mcpc-'));
process.env.ATHER_MODELS = join(process.env.APPDATA, 'Ather', 'models');
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { createMcpClient, toolName, isReadTool } = await import('../src/main/services/mcp-client.js');
const { MCP_PRESETS, resolveEnv, GH } = await import('../src/main/services/mcp-presets.js');
const { devTools, safePath } = await import('../src/main/tools/dev.js');

const work = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-approved-'));
const store = openStore(':memory:');
store.setSetting('approvedFolders', [work]);
const mcp = createMcpClient({ store, presets: MCP_PRESETS, resolveEnv });
const long = { timeout: 240_000 };
const dev = (name, args) => devTools.find((t) => t.name === name).run(args, { store, services: { trash: async () => {} } });

test('tool names and read-only detection', () => {
  assert.equal(toolName('github', 'search_code'), 'mcp_github_search_code');
  assert.equal(toolName('my-server', 'Do.Thing'), 'mcp_my_server_do_thing');
  assert.ok(isReadTool('list_directory') && isReadTool('browser_snapshot') && !isReadTool('write_file') && !isReadTool('browser_click'));
});

test('filesystem server: connects, lists tools, reads only the approved folder', long, async () => {
  writeFileSync(join(work, 'hello.txt'), 'hello from ather');
  const s = await mcp.connect('filesystem');
  assert.equal(s.status, 'connected', s.error);
  assert.ok(s.tools.some((t) => t.name === 'read_text_file' || t.name === 'read_file'));
  const r = await mcp.call('filesystem', 'list_directory', { path: work });
  assert.match(r.content, /hello\.txt/);
  const outside = await mcp.call('filesystem', 'list_directory', { path: 'C:\\Windows' });
  assert.ok(outside.isError, 'must refuse folders that are not approved');
});

test('context7 docs server: real documentation lookup', long, async () => {
  const s = await mcp.connect('context7');
  assert.equal(s.status, 'connected', s.error);
  const resolveTool = s.tools.find((t) => /resolve/i.test(t.name)).name;
  const r = await mcp.call('context7', resolveTool, { libraryName: 'react', query: 'react hooks' });
  assert.match(r.content, /react/i);
});

test('sequential thinking server runs a step', long, async () => {
  const s = await mcp.connect('thinking');
  assert.equal(s.status, 'connected', s.error);
  const r = await mcp.call('thinking', s.tools[0].name, { thought: 'Step one: list the exams.', thoughtNumber: 1, totalThoughts: 2, nextThoughtNeeded: true });
  assert.ok(!r.isError, r.content);
});

test('playwright browser server opens a page', long, async () => {
  const s = await mcp.connect('playwright');
  assert.equal(s.status, 'connected', s.error);
  const r = await mcp.call('playwright', 'browser_navigate', { url: 'https://example.com' });
  assert.match(r.content, /Example Domain/i);
  await mcp.call('playwright', 'browser_close', {}).catch(() => {});
});

test('github server uses the GitHub CLI sign-in', { ...long, skip: !existsSync(GH) && 'GitHub CLI not installed' }, async () => {
  const s = await mcp.connect('github');
  assert.equal(s.status, 'connected', s.error);
  const r = await mcp.call('github', 'get_me', {});
  assert.match(r.content, /Achu226/i);
  // Writes need approval: the github server's permission is "ask".
  mcp.save('github', { enabled: true });
  assert.ok(mcp.tools().filter((t) => t.mcp === 'github').every((t) => t.confirm));
});

test('built-in file manager stays inside approved folders', () => {
  assert.throws(() => safePath(store, 'C:\\Windows\\system.ini'), /outside your approved folders/);
  assert.throws(() => safePath(store, join(work, '..', '..', 'secret.txt')), /outside/);
  writeFileSync(join(work, '.env'), 'KEY=1');
  assert.throws(() => dev('fs_read', { path: join(work, '.env') }), /passwords or keys/);
  writeFileSync(join(work, 'photo.jpg'), 'x'); writeFileSync(join(work, 'notes.pdf'), 'x');
  const r = dev('fs_organize', { path: work });
  assert.equal(r.moved.Images, 1);
  assert.ok(existsSync(join(work, 'Documents', 'notes.pdf')));
});

test('git, sqlite (read-only) and time tools', async () => {
  const repo = join(work, 'proj');
  mkdirSync(repo);
  execFileSync('git', ['init', '-q'], { cwd: repo });
  writeFileSync(join(repo, 'a.txt'), 'x');
  assert.match((await dev('git_status', { path: repo })).status, /\?\? a\.txt/);

  const dbFile = join(work, 'shop.db');
  const { DatabaseSync } = await import('node:sqlite');
  const db = new DatabaseSync(dbFile); db.exec("CREATE TABLE items (name TEXT, price INT); INSERT INTO items VALUES ('pen', 10)"); db.close();
  assert.equal(dev('db_query', { path: dbFile, sql: 'SELECT * FROM items WHERE price > ?', params: [5] }).rows[0].name, 'pen');
  assert.throws(() => dev('db_query', { path: dbFile, sql: "UPDATE items SET price = 0" }), /readonly|read-only/i);

  const c = dev('time_convert', { datetime: '2026-11-02T18:30', from: 'Asia/Kolkata', to: 'UTC' });
  assert.equal(c.utc, '2026-11-02T13:00:00.000Z');
  // New York is UTC-4 in July (daylight saving) and UTC-5 in January.
  assert.equal(dev('time_convert', { datetime: '2026-07-01T09:00', from: 'America/New_York', to: 'UTC' }).utc, '2026-07-01T13:00:00.000Z');
  assert.equal(dev('time_convert', { datetime: '2026-01-15T09:00', from: 'America/New_York', to: 'UTC' }).utc, '2026-01-15T14:00:00.000Z');
  assert.equal(dev('time_until', { datetime: new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 864e5 + 5e6).toISOString() }).days, 3);
});

test.after(() => mcp.stopAll());
```

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-test-'));
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { assistantTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/assistant.js');

const runner = (store) => (name, args = {}) => assistantTools.find((t) => t.name === name).run(args, { store });

test('preference survives a restart, then updates and deletes', () => {
  const file = join(process.env.ATHER_DATA, 'mem.db');
  let store = openStore(file);
  const saved = runner(store)('memory_save', { fact: 'Prefers short answers with examples', category: 'preference' });
  store.db.close();

  store = openStore(file); // "restart"
  const run = runner(store);
  const [m] = run('memory_list');
  assert.equal(m.id, saved.id);
  assert.equal(m.category, 'preference');

  run('memory_update', { id: m.id, fact: 'Prefers detailed answers with examples', category: 'preference' });
  assert.equal(run('memory_list')[0].fact, 'Prefers detailed answers with examples');

  run('memory_forget', { id: m.id });
  assert.equal(run('memory_list').length, 0);
});

test('refuses secrets and updates an overlapping older fact', () => {
  const run = runner(openStore(':memory:'));
  assert.ok(run('memory_save', { fact: 'My wifi password is hunter22' }).refused);
  assert.ok(run('memory_save', { fact: 'GitHub token ghp_abcdefghijklmnop1234' }).refused);
  assert.ok(run('memory_save', { fact: 'Card 4111 1111 1111 1111' }).refused);

  run('memory_save', { fact: 'DBMS exam on 14 December' });
  run('memory_save', { fact: 'DBMS exam on 16 December' });
  const list = run('memory_list');
  assert.equal(list.length, 1);
  assert.equal(list[0].fact, 'DBMS exam on 16 December');
});
```

```javascript
// Real-model checks (slow). Skipped until the models are downloaded: node scripts/fetch-models.js
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const { modelsDir } = await import('../src/main/paths.js');
const ready = existsSync(join(modelsDir, 'hf', 'onnx-community', 'whisper-small'));
const core = ready ? await import('../src/main/ml/core.js') : null;
const opts = { skip: !ready && 'models not downloaded', timeout: 600_000 };

/** Linear resample to 16 kHz for Whisper. */
function to16k(samples, rate) {
  const out = new Float32Array(Math.floor((samples.length * 16000) / rate));
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = samples[Math.floor((i * rate) / 16000)];
  return out;
}

test('Kokoro speaks and Whisper hears it back', opts, async () => {
  const { samples, sampleRate } = await core.speak('Remind me to study databases tomorrow.', 'af_heart');
  assert.ok(samples.length > sampleRate); // more than a second of audio
  const text = await core.transcribe(to16k(samples, sampleRate), 'english');
  assert.match(text.toLowerCase(), /study.*database/);
});

test('CLIP matches text to the right meaning', opts, async () => {
  const cat = await core.clipText('a photo of a cat');
  const kitten = await core.clipText('a picture of a kitten');
  const car = await core.clipText('a red sports car');
  const dot = (a, b) => a.reduce((s, x, i) => s + x * b[i], 0);
  assert.ok(dot(cat, kitten) > dot(cat, car));
});
```

```javascript
test('fs_edit replaces one exact piece of a file, with Windows line endings too', async () => {
  const { writeFileSync, readFileSync, mkdtempSync } = await import('node:fs');
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'maya-edit-'));
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  store.setSetting('approvedFolders', [dir]);
  const edit = allTools.find((t) => t.name === 'fs_edit');
  assert.equal(edit.confirm, true);
  const f = join(dir, 'calc.js');
  writeFileSync(f, 'export function add(a, b) {\r\n  return a - b;\r\n}\r\n');
  assert.ok((await edit.run({ path: f, find: 'return a - b;', replace: 'return a + b;' }, { store })).edited);
  assert.match(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'), /return a \+ b;\r\n/);
  assert.ok((await edit.run({ path: f, find: '{\n  return a + b;', replace: '{\n  return b + a;' }, { store })).edited); // \n written, \r\n in the file
  assert.match(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'), /\{\r\n  return b \+ a;/);
  assert.match((await edit.run({ path: f, find: 'nothing like this', replace: 'x' }, { store })).error, /not in the file/);
  writeFileSync(f, 'x = 1\nx = 1\n');
  assert.match((await edit.run({ path: f, find: 'x = 1', replace: 'y' }, { store })).error, /appears 2 times/);
  await assert.rejects(async () => edit.run({ path: join(tmpdir(), 'outside.js'), find: 'a', replace: 'b' }, { store }));
});

test('fs_edit: a whole corrected file in "replace" becomes the file, not a duplicate', async () => {
  const { writeFileSync, readFileSync, mkdtempSync } = await import('node:fs');
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'maya-edit2-'));
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  store.setSetting('approvedFolders', [dir]);
  const edit = allTools.find((t) => t.name === 'fs_edit');
  const f = join(dir, 'calc.js');
  const orig = 'export function add(a, b) {\n  return a - b;\n}\n\nexport function multiply(a, b) {\n  return a * b;\n}\n';
  writeFileSync(f, orig);
  await edit.run({ path: f, find: 'export function add(a, b) {', replace: orig.replace('a - b', 'a + b') }, { store });
  assert.equal(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'), orig.replace('a - b', 'a + b'));
  await edit.run({ path: f, find: '  return a * b;\n}', replace: '  return a * b;\n}\n\nexport function sub(a, b) {\n  return a - b;\n}' }, { store }); // a real insertion stays one
  assert.match(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'), /multiply[\s\S]*export function sub/);
  assert.equal(readFileSync(f, 'utf8').split('export function add').length, 2);
});
```

### test/places.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'maya-places-'));
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const places = await import('../src/main/services/places.js');
const { searchUrl, rankPlaces, findAccessible, KINDS } = places;
const { allTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/index.js');
const { selectTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/select.js');

const CHENNAI = { latitude: 13.0827, longitude: 80.2707 };
// Nominatim (jsonv2 + extratags + addressdetails) results.
const hit = (name, wheelchair, lat, lon, extra = {}, type = 'pharmacy', category = 'amenity') =>
  ({ name, category, type, lat: String(lat), lon: String(lon), extratags: { ...(wheelchair ? { wheelchair } : {}), ...extra.tags }, address: extra.address || {} });
const RESULTS = [
  hit('Far Accessible Pharmacy', 'yes', 13.10, 80.27),
  hit('Near Unknown Pharmacy', null, 13.0830, 80.2710),
  hit('Steps Only Pharmacy', 'no', 13.0828, 80.2708),
  hit('Near Accessible Pharmacy', 'yes', 13.0840, 80.2720, { tags: { phone: '+91 44 1234', opening_hours: '24/7' }, address: { house_number: '12', road: 'Anna Salai' } }),
  hit('Ramp Pharmacy', 'limited', 13.0835, 80.2715),
  hit('Pharmacy Road', null, 13.0829, 80.2709, {}, 'residential', 'highway'), // a street named "pharmacy", not a pharmacy
  hit('', null, 13.083, 80.271), // no name: useless to the user
  hit('Out Of Range Pharmacy', 'yes', 13.20, 80.27), // inside the square box, beyond the radius
];

test('the search asks for that kind of place in a box around the point', () => {
  const u = new URL(searchUrl('pharmacy', 13.08, 80.27, 3));
  assert.equal(u.host, 'nominatim.openstreetmap.org');
  assert.equal(u.searchParams.get('q'), 'pharmacy');
  assert.equal(u.searchParams.get('bounded'), '1');
  assert.equal(u.searchParams.get('extratags'), '1');
  const [w, n, e, s] = u.searchParams.get('viewbox').split(',').map(Number);
  assert.ok(w < 80.27 && e > 80.27 && s < 13.08 && n > 13.08);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(n - 13.08 - 3 / 111) < 0.001, 'about 3 km north');
  assert.equal(new URL(searchUrl('bus_stop', 1, 2, 1)).searchParams.get('q'), 'bus stop');
  assert.throws(() => searchUrl('casino', 1, 2, 1), /kind/);
  for (const k of ['hospital', 'pharmacy', 'toilets', 'restaurant', 'train_station']) assert.ok(KINDS[k], k);
});

test('wheelchair access first, then distance; wrong kinds, inaccessible, nameless and far places are left out', () => {
  const ranked = rankPlaces(RESULTS, CHENNAI, 'pharmacy', 3);
  assert.deepEqual(ranked.map((p) => p.name), ['Near Accessible Pharmacy', 'Far Accessible Pharmacy', 'Ramp Pharmacy', 'Near Unknown Pharmacy']);
  assert.deepEqual(ranked.map((p) => p.wheelchair), ['yes', 'yes', 'limited', 'unknown']);
  const top = ranked[0];
  assert.equal(top.address, '12 Anna Salai');
  assert.equal(top.phone, '+91 44 1234');
  assert.equal(top.opening_hours, '24/7');
  assert.ok(top.distance_km > 0 && top.distance_km < 1, String(top.distance_km));
  assert.match(top.map, /^https:\/\/www\.openstreetmap\.org\/\?mlat=/);
  assert.equal(rankPlaces(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => hit(`P${i}`, 'yes', 13.08 + i / 1000, 80.27)), CHENNAI, 'pharmacy', 3).length, 8);
});

test('finds places through the geocoder and the map search', async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const fetchFn = async (url, opts = {}) => {
    calls.push(String(url));
    if (String(url).includes('geocoding')) return { ok: true, json: async () => ({ results: [{ name: 'Chennai', admin1: 'Tamil Nadu', ...CHENNAI }] }) };
    assert.match(opts.headers?.['User-Agent'] || '', /Maya/, 'OpenStreetMap asks apps to name themselves');
    return { ok: true, json: async () => RESULTS };
  };
  const r = await findAccessible({ kind: 'pharmacy', near: 'Chennai', radiusKm: 3 }, { fetchFn });
  assert.match(r.summary, /within 3 km of Chennai, Tamil Nadu/);
  assert.equal(r.places[0].name, 'Near Accessible Pharmacy');
  assert.match(r.how, /never add a place/i);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 2);
  const nowhere = async () => ({ ok: true, json: async () => ({ results: [] }) });
  await assert.rejects(findAccessible({ kind: 'pharmacy', near: 'Qwxzzy' }, { fetchFn: nowhere }), /Couldn't find the place "Qwxzzy"/);
  const down = async (url) => (String(url).includes('geocoding') ? { ok: true, json: async () => ({ results: [CHENNAI] }) } : { ok: false, status: 503, json: async () => ({}) });
  await assert.rejects(findAccessible({ kind: 'pharmacy', near: 'Chennai' }, { fetchFn: down }), /map service is busy/);
});

test('the summary says plainly what is known, so Maya cannot invent an accessible place', () => {
  const { placesSummary } = places;
  const ranked = rankPlaces(RESULTS, CHENNAI, 'pharmacy', 3);
  const s = placesSummary(ranked, 'pharmacy', 'Chennai, Tamil Nadu', 3);
  assert.match(s, /^Found 4 pharmacies within 3 km of Chennai, Tamil Nadu\./);
  assert.match(s, /2 have step-free \(wheelchair\) access recorded: Near Accessible Pharmacy \(0\.\d+ km\), Far Accessible Pharmacy/);
  assert.match(s, /Ramp Pharmacy .* partly accessible/);
  const none = placesSummary(rankPlaces(RESULTS.filter((r) => !r.extratags.wheelchair), CHENNAI, 'pharmacy', 3), 'pharmacy', 'Chennai', 3);
  assert.match(none, /None has wheelchair access recorded/);
  assert.match(none, /Nearest: Near Unknown Pharmacy \(0\.\d+ km\)/);
  assert.match(none, /call ahead/);
  assert.match(placesSummary([], 'hospital', 'Ooty', 2), /^No hospitals found within 2 km of Ooty/);
});

test('the tool asks for a place when it knows none, and uses the saved city otherwise', async () => {
  const tool = allTools.find((t) => t.name === 'places_accessible');
  assert.ok(tool, 'places_accessible is registered');
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  const r = await tool.run({ kind: 'hospital' }, { store, services: {} });
  assert.match(r.ask_user, /which town or area/i);
  store.setSetting('city', 'Qwxzzy');
  const seen = [];
  const fetchFn = async (url) => { seen.push(String(url)); return { ok: true, json: async () => ({ results: [] }) }; };
  await assert.rejects(tool.run({ kind: 'hospital' }, { store, services: { fetch: fetchFn } }), /Qwxzzy/);
  assert.match(seen[0], /Qwxzzy/);
});

test('accessibility and "near me" requests reach the tool', () => {
  const names = (t) => selectTools(allTools, t).map((x) => x.name);
  for (const t of ['find a wheelchair accessible pharmacy near me', 'nearest hospital', 'accessible toilets in Chennai', 'is there a cafe nearby with a ramp'])
    assert.ok(names(t).includes('places_accessible'), t);

});
```

### test/productivity.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-test-'));
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { productivityTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/productivity.js');

const store = openStore(':memory:');
const call = (name, args = {}) => productivityTools.find((t) => t.name === name).run(args, { store });

test('a reminder can be set some days ahead without date maths (9 am that day)', () => {
  const day = new Date();
  day.setDate(day.getDate() + 2);
  const ymd = `${day.getFullYear()}-${String(day.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(day.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const r = call('reminders_create', { text: 'Refill BP tablets', in_days: 2, care: true });
  assert.equal(r.at, `${ymd}T09:00`);
  assert.equal(call('reminders_create', { text: 'exact', at: '2026-12-01T18:30', in_days: 5 }).at, '2026-12-01T18:30', 'an exact time wins');
  assert.throws(() => call('reminders_create', { text: 'when?' }), /at or in_days/);
});

test('task lifecycle with undo', () => {
  const t = call('tasks_create', { title: 'Study DBMS', due: '2026-10-29T17:00' });
  assert.equal(t.title, 'Study DBMS');
  assert.equal(call('tasks_query').length, 1);

  call('tasks_complete', { id: t.id });
  assert.equal(call('tasks_query', { status: 'done' }).length, 1);
  assert.equal(call('history_query').tasks_done_today, 1);

  assert.equal(call('app_undo').undone, `Completed task ${t.id}`);
  assert.equal(call('tasks_query').length, 1);

  call('tasks_delete', { id: t.id });
  assert.equal(call('tasks_query').length, 0);
  call('app_undo');
  assert.equal(call('tasks_query').length, 1);
});

test('notes append and search', () => {
  const n = call('notes_create', { title: 'Shopping', body: 'milk' });
  call('notes_update', { id: n.id, body: 'eggs', append: true });
  assert.equal(call('notes_query', { search: 'eggs' })[0].body, 'milk\neggs');
});

test('habit check-in builds a streak', () => {
  const h = call('habits_create', { name: 'Drink water' });
  const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 864e5).toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
  call('habits_checkin', { id: h.id, day: yesterday });
  call('habits_checkin', { id: h.id });
  call('habits_checkin', { id: h.id }); // second check-in the same day is not double counted
  const p = call('habits_progress').find((x) => x.id === h.id);
  assert.equal(p.streak, 2);
  assert.equal(p.done_today, true);
});

test('only one focus session at a time', () => {
  call('focus_start', { minutes: 25, label: 'Maths' });
  assert.ok(call('focus_start', { minutes: 10 }).error);
  assert.equal(call('focus_status').running, true);
  call('focus_stop');
  assert.equal(call('focus_status').running, false);
});

test('calendar query merges feeds and sorts', async () => {
  call('calendar_create', { title: 'Haircut', start: '2026-11-03T11:00' });
  const services = { calendarFeeds: { events: async () => [{ title: 'Exam', start: '2026-11-02T09:00', source: 'Google' }] } };
  const tool = productivityTools.find((t) => t.name === 'calendar_query');
  const events = await tool.run({ from: '2026-11-01', to: '2026-11-05' }, { store, services });
  assert.deepEqual(events.map((e) => e.title), ['Exam', 'Haircut']);
});

test('store rejects unknown tables', () => {
  assert.throws(() => store.row('settings; DROP TABLE tasks', 1), /Unknown table/);
});
```

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';

import { words, align } from '../src/renderer/shared/prompter.js';

test('the position follows what was just read, even with Whisper mistakes', () => {

  assert.equal(script[align(script, words('for people who cannot use a mouse'), 10)], 'maya');
  assert.equal(script[align(script, words('so your voice never leaves'), 30)], 'it');
});

  assert.equal(align(script, [], 12), 12);
  assert.equal(align(script, words('hello can you hear me'), 12), 12);
  assert.equal(align(script, words('good morning everyone'), 20), 20);
});
```

### test/scanning.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { createScanner } from '../src/main/services/scanning.js';

const items = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => i); // 3 groups: 0-7, 8-15, 16-19

test('scanning: group, then control, then start again', () => {
  const s = createScanner(items, { size: 8 });
  assert.deepEqual(s.lit.items, [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]);
  s.next();
  assert.deepEqual(s.lit.items, [8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15]);
  assert.equal(s.press(), null); // into the second group
  assert.deepEqual(s.lit.items, [8]);
  s.next(); s.next();
  assert.equal(s.press(), 10);
  assert.deepEqual(s.lit.items, [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]); // back to the first group for the next choice
});

test('scanning: the back step returns to the groups; few controls skip the group level', () => {
  const s = createScanner(items, { size: 8 });
  s.next(); s.next();
  s.press(); // group 16-19
  for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) s.next();
  assert.deepEqual(s.lit, { items: [], back: true });
  assert.equal(s.press(), null);
  assert.equal(s.lit.items.length, 8);

  const small = createScanner([5, 6, 7], { size: 8 });
  assert.deepEqual(small.lit.items, [5]);
  small.next(); small.next(); small.next();
  assert.deepEqual(small.lit.items, [5]); // wraps, no back step
  small.next();
  assert.equal(small.press(), 6);
});
```

### test/security.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync, existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-sec-'));
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { hashPin, verifyPin, createLock } = await import('../src/main/security.js');
const { createBackup, unpackBackup, applyBackup, autoBackup } = await import('../src/main/backup.js');
const { toIco } = await import('../scripts/make-icon.js');
const { dataDir } = await import('../src/main/paths.js');

test('PIN hashes verify and differ by salt', () => {
  const a = hashPin('4821'), b = hashPin('4821');
  assert.notEqual(a, b);
  assert.ok(verifyPin('4821', a));
  assert.ok(!verifyPin('4822', a));
  assert.ok(!verifyPin('4821', 'garbage'));
});

test('lock: set, lock, unlock, pause after 5 wrong tries, remove', () => {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  const changes = [];
  const lock = createLock({ store, onChange: (l) => changes.push(l) });
  assert.equal(lock.locked, false);
  assert.throws(() => lock.setPin('', '12'), /4 to 8 digits/);
  lock.setPin('', '2580');
  lock.lock();
  assert.equal(lock.locked, true);
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) assert.equal(lock.unlock('0000').ok, false);
  assert.ok(lock.unlock('2580').wait > 0, 'should pause after 5 wrong PINs');
  assert.throws(() => lock.setPin('1111', null), /current PIN is wrong/);
  assert.deepEqual(changes, [true]);
});

test('idle locking respects the setting', () => {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  const lock = createLock({ store });
  lock.setPin('', '2580');
  store.setSetting('lockAfterMinutes', 5);
  lock.checkIdle(200);
  assert.equal(lock.locked, false);
  lock.checkIdle(301);
  assert.equal(lock.locked, true);
});

test('backup → restore round trip brings data back', () => {
  const store = openStore(join(dataDir, 'ather.db'));
  store.run("INSERT INTO tasks (title) VALUES ('Keep me')");
  const zip = createBackup(store, join(dataDir, 'backups'));
  assert.ok(existsSync(zip));
  store.run('DELETE FROM tasks');
  const dir = unpackBackup(zip);
  store.db.close();
  applyBackup(dir);
  const reopened = openStore(join(dataDir, 'ather.db'));
  assert.equal(reopened.get('SELECT title FROM tasks').title, 'Keep me');
  reopened.db.close();
});

test('restore refuses a zip that is not an Maya backup', () => {
  assert.throws(() => unpackBackup(join(process.cwd(), 'assets', 'icon.png')));
});

test('automatic backup runs weekly only', () => {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  const folder = join(dataDir, 'auto');
  assert.ok(autoBackup(store, folder));
  assert.equal(autoBackup(store, folder), null);
});

test('generated .ico files have a valid header', () => {
  const ico = readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), 'assets', 'icon-dark.ico'));
  assert.equal(ico.readUInt16LE(2), 1);
  assert.equal(ico.readUInt16LE(4), 1);
  assert.equal(ico.readUInt32LE(18), 22);
  assert.equal(ico.subarray(22, 26).toString('latin1'), '\x89PNG');
  assert.equal(toIco(Buffer.from('x')).length, 23);
});
```

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
```

```javascript
  const READ_ONLY_TOOL = /_(query|status|progress|list|files|history)$|^(web_|files_search|mail_(triage|search|read|promotions)|open_)/;
  const readByScreens = ['memory_list', 'routines_list', 'tasks_query', 'notes_query', 'habits_progress', 'focus_status', 'calendar_query', 'activity_query', 'history_query', 'reminders_query', 'timetable_query', 'exams_query', 'clipboard_history', 'system_status'];
  for (const name of readByScreens) assert.ok(READ_ONLY_TOOL.test(name), name);
  assert.ok(!READ_ONLY_TOOL.test('tasks_create'));
  assert.ok(READ_ONLY_TOOL.test('mail_read') && !READ_ONLY_TOOL.test('mail_add_tasks'));
  const src = (await import('node:fs')).readFileSync(new URL('../src/main/ipc.js', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  assert.ok(src.includes(READ_ONLY_TOOL.source.replace(/\\/g, '\\')), 'ipc.js pattern changed: update this test');
});

test('due reminder fires once; repeating reminder moves to the next weekday', () => {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');

  tick(store, (title, body) => fired.push(body));

});

test('readWav decodes 16-bit PCM', () => {
  const data = Buffer.alloc(4); data.writeInt16LE(16384, 0); data.writeInt16LE(-32768, 2);
  const header = Buffer.alloc(44);
  header.write('RIFF', 0); header.write('WAVE', 8); header.write('fmt ', 12); header.writeUInt32LE(16, 16);
  header.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); header.writeUInt16LE(1, 22); header.writeUInt32LE(22050, 24);
  header.write('data', 36); header.writeUInt32LE(4, 40);
  const { samples, sampleRate } = readWav(Buffer.concat([header, data]));
  assert.equal(sampleRate, 22050);
  assert.deepEqual(Array.from(samples), [0.5, -1]);
});
```

### test/session.test.js

```javascript
import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';

process.env.ATHER_DATA = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'ather-session-'));
const { openStore } = await import('../src/main/store.js');
const { createSession, daySummary } = await import('../src/main/services/session.js');
const { createSos, phoneCall, validPhone } = await import('../src/main/services/sos.js');
const { careTick, careDone, tick } = await import('../src/main/services/scheduler.js');
const { createVoiceControl, pages } = await import('../src/main/services/voicecontrol.js');
const { parseCommand } = await import('../src/renderer/shared/voicecommands.js');
const { createBlink } = await import('../src/renderer/shared/headpose.js');
const { answerIn } = await import('../src/main/services/chatbots.js');
const { allTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/index.js');
const { selectTools } = await import('../src/main/tools/select.js');

function timer() {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  let t = Date.parse('2026-10-30T16:00:00');
  const states = [], powered = [];
  const session = createSession({ store, power: async (a) => powered.push(a), onState: (s) => states.push(s.state), clock: () => t, countdownMs: 60_000 });
  return { store, session, states, powered, at: (min) => { t += min * 60_000; } };
}

test('work timer: goodbye with the day summary, then shutdown after the minute', async () => {
  const { store, session, states, powered, at } = timer();
  store.insert('tasks', { title: 'Report', done: 1, completed_at: new Date().toISOString(), created_at: 'x' }, 't');
  session.start(120, 'project');
  assert.equal(session.status().minutes_left, 120);
  at(119); assert.equal(await session.tick(), null);
  at(1); assert.equal(await session.tick(), 'goodbye');
  assert.ok(session.status().saying_goodbye);
  at(0.5); assert.equal(await session.tick(), null);
  at(0.5); assert.equal(await session.tick(), 'shutdown');
  assert.deepEqual(powered, ['shutdown']);
  assert.deepEqual(states, ['running', 'goodbye', 'off']);
  assert.match(daySummary(store), /You finished 1 task/);
});

test('work timer: "wait" gives 15 minutes, "cancel" means no shutdown at all', async () => {
  const { session, powered, at } = timer();
  session.start(60);
  at(60); await session.tick();
  session.extend(15);
  at(1); assert.equal(await session.tick(), null); // the goodbye minute is over, but 15 more minutes were given
  at(14); assert.equal(await session.tick(), 'goodbye');
  session.cancel();
  at(5); assert.equal(await session.tick(), null);
  assert.deepEqual(powered, []);
});

test('work timer: a PC switched on long after the timer ended is not shut down', async () => {
  const { session, powered, at } = timer();
  session.start(30);
  at(12 * 60); // overnight
  assert.equal(await session.tick(), 'expired');
  assert.deepEqual(powered, []);
  assert.throws(() => session.start(0));
});

test('voice: wait / cancel during the goodbye, magnifier, reading pages', async () => {
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand('Wait'), { cmd: 'later' });
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand("I'm still working"), { cmd: 'later' });
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand('magnify'), { cmd: 'magnify', action: 'in' });
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand('stop magnifier'), { cmd: 'magnify', action: 'off' });
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand('zoom in'), { cmd: 'keys', keys: 'ctrl+=' }); // browser zoom is unchanged
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand('read my document DBMS notes'), { cmd: 'readdoc', name: 'dbms notes' });
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand('next page'), { cmd: 'page', go: 'next' });
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand('அடுத்த பக்கம்'), { cmd: 'page', go: 'next' });
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand('page five'), { cmd: 'page', go: 5 });
  assert.deepEqual(parseCommand('மீண்டும்'), { cmd: 'page', go: 'repeat' });

  const { session, at } = timer();
  const keys = [], activated = [];
  // After the Windows key the taskbar has the focus, like on a real PC.
  const pc = { chord: async (...k) => keys.push(k), foreground: async () => (keys.length && !activated.length ? { hwnd: 9, process: 'explorer' } : { hwnd: 5, process: 'chrome' }), activate: async (h) => activated.push(h) };
  const vc = createVoiceControl({ pc, overlay() {}, computer: { lastExternal: () => null }, bounds: () => ({}), session,
    findDoc: async () => ({ name: 'Notes', text: `${'First part. '.repeat(150)}\n\n${'Second part. '.repeat(150)}` }) });
  assert.deepEqual(await vc.run({ cmd: 'later' }), { pass: true }); // no goodbye: a normal sentence
  session.start(10); at(10); await session.tick();
  assert.match((await vc.run({ cmd: 'later' })).said, /15 more/);
  await vc.run({ cmd: 'magnify', action: 'in' });
  assert.deepEqual(keys, [[0x5b, 0xbb]]);
  assert.deepEqual(activated, [5]); // focus handed back to the user's app
  assert.match((await vc.run({ cmd: 'readdoc', name: 'notes' })).read, /^Notes\. First part[\s\S]*Page 1 of \d/);
  assert.match((await vc.run({ cmd: 'page', go: 'next' })).read, /Page 2 of/);
  assert.match((await vc.run({ cmd: 'page', go: 99 })).error, /There are \d+ pages/);
});

test('pages are cut at sentences and lose nothing', () => {
  const text = Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, i) => `Sentence ${i}.`).join(' ');
  const p = pages(text, 300);
  assert.ok(p.length > 5 && p.every((x) => x.length <= 300));
  assert.ok(p.slice(0, -1).every((x) => x.endsWith('.')));
  assert.equal(p.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' '), text);
});

test('blink to click: natural blinks ignored, half a second = click, long = right click', () => {
  const blink = createBlink();
  const run = (ms) => { blink({ eyeBlinkLeft: 0.9, eyeBlinkRight: 0.9 }, 1000); blink({ eyeBlinkLeft: 0.9, eyeBlinkRight: 0.9 }, 1000 + ms); return blink({}, 1000 + ms).click; };
  assert.equal(run(150), null);
  assert.equal(run(600), 'left');
  assert.equal(run(1800), 'right');
  assert.equal(blink({ eyeBlinkLeft: 0.9, eyeBlinkRight: 0.1 }, 0).click, null); // one eye = a wink, not a click
});

test('care reminder: spoken done is saved; no answer emails the caregiver once', async () => {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  store.setSetting('sos', { contacts: ['amma@example.com'], name: 'Ronald' });
  const sent = [];
  const transport = nodemailer.createTransport({ jsonTransport: true });
  const sos = createSos({ store, secrets: { get: () => null }, transport });
  const told = [];
  const past = new Date(Date.now() - 60_000);
  const at = `${past.toLocaleDateString('en-CA')}T${past.toTimeString().slice(0, 5)}`;
  const a = store.insert('reminders', { text: 'Take BP tablet', at, care: 1, created_at: 'x' }, 'r');
  const b = store.insert('reminders', { text: 'Insulin', at, care: 1, created_at: 'x' }, 'r');
  tick(store, (title, body, kind, id) => told.push([kind, id]));
  assert.deepEqual(told.map((x) => x[0]), ['care', 'care']);
  careDone(store, told[0][1]);
  const alert = async (reason) => { sent.push(reason); return sos.notify(reason); };
  assert.equal(await careTick(store, alert, 15 * 60_000, Date.now() + 16 * 60_000), 1);
  assert.match(sent[0], /Insulin/);
  assert.equal(await careTick(store, alert, 15 * 60_000, Date.now() + 30 * 60_000), 0); // only once
  assert.equal(store.getSetting('sosLog')[0].event, 'notice');
  assert.ok(a && b);
});

test('ChatGPT / Claude: the answer is what follows the prompt, without the footer', () => {
  const page = 'New chat\nWhat is DBMS?\nChatGPT said:\nA DBMS is software that stores and manages data.\nChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.';
  assert.equal(answerIn(page, 'What is DBMS?', 'chatgpt'), 'A DBMS is software that stores and manages data.');
  assert.equal(answerIn('Log in', 'What is DBMS?', 'chatgpt'), '');
  // Real page text (Oct 2026): the prompt is also still in the text box below the footer.
  const real = '￼\nLog in\nYou said:\nWhat is DBMS?\nCopy\n￼\nChatGPT said:\nDatabase management system.\nChatGPT is AI and can make mistakes.\n￼\nNew chat\nWhat is DBMS?\nAdd files and more\nSend message';
  assert.equal(answerIn(real, 'What is DBMS?', 'chatgpt'), 'Database management system.');
  assert.equal(answerIn(real.replace('Database management system.\n', ''), 'What is DBMS?', 'chatgpt'), ''); // not answered yet
});

// Live: the real model picks the right tool from plain words. Nothing runs: approvals are refused, services are fakes.
const { ask } = await import('../src/main/brain.js');
const { OLLAMA } = await import('../src/main/ollama.js');
const running = await fetch(`${OLLAMA}/api/version`).then((r) => r.ok, () => false);
const live = { skip: !running && 'Ollama not running', timeout: 600_000 };
const used = async (text, services = {}) => {
  const store = openStore(':memory:');
  const calls = [];
  await ask({ text, store, tools: allTools, services: { confirm: async (r) => { calls.push(r); return false; }, ...services }, style: 'chat', mode: 'fast',
    onEvent: (e) => e.type === 'tool' && calls.push({ name: e.name, args: e.args }) });
  return { calls, store };
};

  const store = openStore(':memory:');

test('nod = yes, shake = no; steering the pointer is neither', async () => {
  const { createHeadGesture } = await import('../src/renderer/shared/headpose.js');
  const run = (pts) => { const g = createHeadGesture(); let out = null; pts.forEach((p, i) => { out = g(p, i * 80) || out; }); return out; };
  const wave = (k, n) => Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => ({ x: 0, y: 0, [k]: [0, 0.09, 0, -0.09][i % 4] }));
  assert.equal(run(wave('y', 14)), 'yes');
  assert.equal(run(wave('x', 14)), 'no');
  assert.equal(run(Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => ({ x: i * 0.01, y: 0 }))), null); // a slow turn to move the pointer
  assert.equal(run(Array.from({ length: 20 }, () => ({ x: 0.001, y: -0.001 }))), null); // holding still
});
```
